author: hannah-whitall-smith
fields.title: Katonda ow'Okubudaabuda Kwonna
fields.description: Lwaki Abakristaayo bangi beetikka okukkiriza kwabwe ng'omugugu omuzito, mu kifo ky'okukufuula ensibuko y'okuwummula? Mu kitabo kino eky'edda ekitaggwaawo, Hannah Whitall Smith aggyawo emitendera egikooya egy'okufubira mu ddiini, alyoke ayolese engeri Katonda gy'ali mu mazima. Akuyita oveewo ku bulamu obw'omwoyo obulinnya ne bukka ng'eby'okuzannya, osobole okunywerera mu bukakafu obuteredde era obunywevu obuva mu kukkiriza obwangu obw'okwesiga Katonda ku kigambo kye. Zuula emirembe egitayinza kunyeenyezebwa.

fields.title: Lwaki Ekitabo Kino Kyawandiikibwa
fields.body_html:
“Omutima gwange gujjudde ekigambo ekirungi; ebigambo byange mbyogera eri kabaka.” Zabbuli 45:1 Lumu nnali njogera ku nsonga y’eddiini n’omusajja ow’amagezi eyabuusabuusa okubaawo kwa Katonda (agnostic), gwe nnali njagala nnyo okukwatako. Bwe yamala okumpuliriza n’ekitiibwa akaseera, n’aŋŋamba nti, “Kale, mukyala, kye nnina okwogera kye kino kyokka: bwe muba nga mmwe Abakristaayo mwagala okutuleetera ffe abatakkiriza okwetegereza eddiini yammwe, muteekwa okugezaako okuba abasanyufu era abamativu mu ky’okugirina. Abakristaayo be nsanga bandabikira ng’abantu abatalina mativu okusinga bonna abanneetoolodde. Balaba ng’basitula eddiini yaabwe ng’omuntu bw’asitula omutwe ogulumwa. Taagala kuggyawo mutwe gwe, naye mu kiseera kye kimu kizibu nnyo okugubeerera nagwo. Nze, ku lwange, saagala kubeera na ddiini ya ngeri eyo.” Kino kyali essomo lye sikooye kwerabira, era y’ensonga esokera awo lwe nawandiikira ekitabo kino.

Nnali nkyali muto nnyo mu bulamu obw’Ekikristaayo mu kiseera ky’olukungaana luno, era nnali nkyali mu ssanyu erisooka ery’okuyingira mu bwo, bwe kityo saasobola kukkiriza nti abaana ba Katonda yenna bandibadde abatalina mativu mu bulamu bwabwe obw’eddiini nga munnange agnostic bwe yali agamba. Naye ekimyanso eky’olubereberye eky’okukyuka kwange bwe kyayita, ne nzika mu bujjumbizi obw’emirimu n’obuvunaanyizibwa obwa buli lunaku, mangwago ne ntegeera okuva mu bumanyirivu bwange, era n’okuva mu bumanyirivu obufaanana obw’Abakristaayo abasinga obungi abaali banneetoolodde, nti mu kigambo kye waaliwo amazima mangi nnyo, era nti obulamu obw’eddiini obwa ffe abasinga bwali bujjudde obutabeera bulungi n’obutabeera na mirembe. Mu butuufu, kyalabika, nga omu ku mikwano gyange egy’Ekikristaayo bwe yaŋŋamba lumu bwe twali tugeraageranya obumanyirivu bwaffe, nti “twali n’eddiini emala okututeeka mu nnaku bwokka.”

Njatula nti kino kyannakuwaza nnyo, kubanga nnali nsuubidde ekintu eky’enjawulo ddala. Kyandabikira nga tekikwatagana n’obwenkanya nti eddiini, ebibala byayo bye byalangibwa mu Bayibuli okuba okwagala, essanyu, n’emirembe, esaanidde okukoleramu mu ngeri ekyamu ddala, n’ereeta okubuusabuusa, okutya, obutabeera na mirembe, entalo, n’obutabeera bulungi obwa buli ngeri; ne nsalawo, bwe kiba nga kisoboka, okuvumbula ekyali kikyamu. Nnebuuza nti, Lwaki abaana ba Katonda bandibadde n’obulamu obw’eddiini obutali bulungi ddala bwe bityo, ate ng’atuleese okukkiriza nti ekikoligo kye kyangu era omugugu gwe mwangu? Lwaki tweraliikirizibwa okubuusabuusa okw’omwoyo okungi bwe kutyo, n’okweraliikirira okw’omwoyo okuzitowa bwe kutyo?

Lwaki tukisanga nga kizibu okuba abakakafu nti Katonda ddala atwagala, era lwaki kiba nti tetulabika kusobola kukkiriza kwa bbanga ddene ku bulungi bwe n’okulabirira kwe? Kiba kitya nga tuyinza okwekkiriza okumuteebereza nga atwerabidde era ng’atulese mu biseera eby’obwetaavu? Tusobola okwesiga mikwano gyaffe egy’oku nsi ne twewulira nga tuli bulungi mu kubeera nabo; kale kiba kitya nga tetusobola kwesiga Mukwano gwaffe ogw’omu ggulu, era ne kiba nga tetusobola kubeera na mirembe mu buweereza bwe?

Nkkiriza nti nzudde eky’okuddamu ku bibuuzo bino, era nnandyagadde okwatula lwatu nti ekigendererwa kyange mu kuwandiika ekitabo kino kwe kugezaako okuleeta obuweweevu obutono obw’amazima era obwa nnamaddala mu bulamu obumu obw’Abakristaayo obweraliikiridde obunneetoolodde. Okutegeera kwange nze ku ddiini eya Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo kwe kuti yakolebwa okuba ejjudde obuweweevu. Nkakasa nti buli musomi atalina kyekubiira ku Ndagaano Empya yandyogedde bw’omu, era nkkiriza nti buli muntu akyakyusibbwa, mu ssanyu erisooka ery’okukyuka kwe, akisuubira ddala. Naye ate, nga bwe njogedde, kiba nga eri Abakristaayo abangi ennyo obulamu bwabwe obw’eddiini kye kitundu ekisinga obutabeera bulungi mu kubaawo kwabwe. Omusango gw’ekyo guli ku Mukama? Asuubizza ebisukka ku by’asobola okuwa?

Omuwandiisi omu yagamba nti, “Tumanyi okulanga ebibuubaano ekyo bwe kiri. Bulwadde bwa mirembe gino bwe tubonaabona fenna. Waliwo ebiwandiiko ku buli kifo eky’okulanga, okulambika okusukkiridde ku buli kisenge ekiŋŋaanvu, okulaga n’okulaga ebitali bituufu ebitabalika. Ebifaananyi ki bye tulabye eby’ebibala n’ebimuli ebitasoboka ebikuzibwa okuva mu nsigo za nnaani. Buli kimu kilangibwa okusukkiridde. Kifaanana bwe kityo n’obwakabaka bwa Katonda? Ebibala bye tuvaamu okuva mu nsigo ennungi ey’obwakabaka bituukana n’okunnyonnyola oyo gwe twaggya ku nsigo eyo ennungi kw’atuwa? Atulimbye? Waliwo endowooza egyetoolodde nti Kristo asuubizza mu Njiri ye ebisukka ku by’alina okuwa. Abantu balowooza nti tebafunye ddala ekyo ekyasuubizibwa okuba omugabo gw’abaana ba Katonda. Naye lwaki kiri kityo? Obwakabaka bwa Katonda bwalangibwa okusukkiridde, oba bwakkirizibwa katono okusinga bwe kyagwanidde? Mukama Yesu Kristo yatendebwa okusukkiridde, oba yeesigibwa katono okusinga bwe kyagwanidde?”

Kye njagala okukola mu kitabo kino kwe kulaga, mu ngeri yange entono, kye nkkiririza ddala nti: obwakabaka bwa Katonda tebusoboka kulangibwa kusukkiridde, ne Mukama Yesu Kristo tasoboka kutendebwa kusukkiridde, kubanga “ekyo eriiso lye litalabanga, n’okutu bwe kutawuliranga, n’omutima gw’omuntu bwe gutateeberezanga, Katonda kye yateekerateekera abo abamwagala”; era nti obuzibu bwonna buva mu kuba nti twakkiriza katono era twesiga katono.

Kyenva njagala okulaga, mu bujjuvu nga bwe nsobola, ensonga eziriwo mu ddiini eya Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo ez’emirembe n’obuweweevu obw’omwoyo obwo obw’ebuziba era obw’olubeerera, obutayinza kunyeenyezebwa kintu kyonna ku nsi, era obwogerwako okuba omugabo gw’abo abagwanirira. Era njagala okunnyonnyola, obanga guno gwe mugabo gwaffe ogutuufu, engeri gye tusaanidde okugukozesaamu, n’ebintu ki ebiziyiza. Waliwo omulimu gwa Katonda mu nsonga eno, era waliwo omulimu gw’omuntu, era tuteekwa okwetegereza byombi n’obwegendereza.

Omuvubuka omu omukambwe, eyaleetebwa eri Mukama mu lukungaana lw’obuvunaanyizibwa (mission meeting), oluvannyuma n’afuuka Omukristaayo omusanyufu era n’abeera obulamu obulungi, yabuuzibwa omuntu ky’akola okukyusibwa. “Ah,” n’agamba, “nakola omulimu gwange, ne Mukama n’akola ogugwe.”

“Naye omulimu gwo gwali guluwa,” omubuuzi n’abuuza, “ate ogwa Mukama gwali guluwa?”

“Omulimu gwange,” okuddamu ne kujja mangu, “kwali kudduka, ate omulimu gwa Mukama kwali kungoberera okutuusa lwe yankwata.”

Eky’okuddamu eky’amakulu mangi; naye batono nnyo abasobola okukitegeera mu butuufu!

Omulimu gwa Katonda bulijjo kwe kutugoberera. Kristo yajja okunoonya n’okulokola ekyo ekyabula. “Ani ku mmwe, alina endiga kikumi, bw’aba abuzeeko emu ku zo, atalese ekyenda mu mwenda mu ddundiro, n’agenda okunoonya eyo ebuze okutuusa lw’agisanga? Era bw’agisanga, agiteeka ku kibegabega kye, ng’asanyuka.” Guno bulijjo gwe mulimu ogw’obwakatonda; naye mu busirusiru bwaffe tetegeera, ne tulowooza nti Mukama y’oyo eyabula, era nti omulimu gwaffe kwe kunoonya n’okumulaba. Ebigambo bye twogera byennyini bikiraga. Tukubiriza aboonoonyi “okunoonya Mukama,” era twogera ku kuba nga “tumulabye.” “Omulabyeko Omulokozi?” omukozi w’obuvunaanyizibwa eyali anyiikiridde ennyo bwe yabuuza omuwala omuto omusanyufu era eyeesiga.

N’endabika ey’okwewuunya, n’addamu mu ddoboozi ery’okwesamba nti, “Naye nze saamanyi nga Omulokozi yali abuze!”

Obutamanya bwaffe Katonda bwe buleeta bino byonna. Olw’okuba tetumumanyi, mu buwezi bwaffe tuteekawo endowooza embi eza buli ngeri ku ye. Tulowooza nti Mulamuzi w’obusungu alindirira obukyamu bwaffe obutonotono, oba Nnannyini mulimu omukambwe amaliridde okutubanja obuweereza obusukkulumu, oba Katonda eyeefaako yekka ayagala ekitiibwa kye kyonna ekijjuvu, oba Kabaka ali ewala eyeeraliikirira ebibye byokka nga tafaayo ku bulamu bwaffe. Ani ayinza okwewuunya nti Katonda ng’oyo tasobola kwagalwa wadde kwesigibwa? Era ani ayinza okusuubira Abakristaayo, abalina endowooza ng’ezo ku ye, okuba ekintu kirala okuggyako okujjula obutabeera bulungi n’ennaku?

Naye nsobola okwogera n’obwesige, awatali kutya kuwakanyizibwa, nti tekisoboka omuntu yenna amanyi Katonda mu butuufu okuba n’endowooza embi bwe zityo ku ye. Wayinza okubaawo obutabeera bulungi obungi obw’ebweru, n’ennaku n’ebigezo bingi eby’oku nsi, naye wakati mu byonna, emmeeme emanyi Katonda eteekwa okubeera munda mu kifo eky’emirembe emituukirivu. “Buli awuliriza nze aligenda mirembe era aliwummulira awatali kutya kabi.” Era kino ky’ekigambo omuntu yenna ky’atasobola kubuusabuusa. Singa tuwuliriza Katonda mu butuufu—ekitegeeza si kumuwulira kyokka wabula n’okukkiriza kye tuwulira—tetwandiremye kumanya nti, kubanga ye Katonda, tasobola kukola kirala okuggyako okutulabirira ng’emmunye y’eriiso lye, era nti buli kintu okwagala okuwewuufu n’amagezi ag’obwakatonda kye biyinza okukolera obulungi bwaffe kijja kukolebwa mazima. Tewali mulyango n’ogumu ogusigalidde okweraliikirira oba okutya eri emmeeme emanyi Katonda.

“Ah, weewaawo,” ogamba, “naye nnaamumanya ntya? Abantu abalala balabika ng’abalina engeri y’okubikkulirwa munda ekibaleetera okumumanya, naye nze sirina; era ne bwe nsaba ntya, buli kimu kindabikira nga kya kizikiza. Njagala okumanya Katonda, naye sikiraba nga nnaakikola ntya.”

Obuzibu bwo buli mu kuba nti olina endowooza embi ku kye kitegeeza okumanya Katonda, oba awakiri ku ngeri y’okumanya gye ntegeeza. Kubanga sitegeeza kubikkulirwa kwa munda okwa kyama. Obumanyirivu ng’obwo businga kusanyusa bwe bubaawo, naye tebulijjo bwa mu buyinza bwaffe, era buyinza okuba obutakakafu era obutali bunywevu. Engeri y’okumanya gye ntegeeza kwe kumanya okwangu era okw’amakulu okw’obuwangwa n’empisa za Katonda okuva mu kukkiriza ekyo ekibikkulwa ku ye mu Bayibuli.

Omutume Yokaana, ku nkomerero y’Enjiri ye, agamba ku bintu bye yali awandiise nti: “Yesu yakola n’obubonero obulala bungi mu maaso g’abayigirizwa, obutawandiikibwa mu kitabo kino; naye bino byawandiikibwa mulyoke mukkirize nti Yesu ye Kristo, Omwana wa Katonda, era nga bwe mukkiriza mube n’obulamu mu linnya lye.” (Yokaana 20:30). Kwe kukkiriza ekyawandiikibwa, so si ekyo ekibikkulwa munda, okuwa obulamu; era engeri y’okumanya gye ntegeeza kwe kumanya okuva mu kukkiriza ekyo ekyawandiikibwa.

Ntegeeza, mu ngeri ey’obwakabi, nti bwe nsoma mu Bayibuli nti Katonda kwe kwagala, nteekwa okukikkiriza olw’okuba kyawandiikibwa, so si olw’okuba nnina obumanyirivu obwa munda obukakasa nti kya mazima; era Bayibuli bw’agamba nti atulabirira nga bw’alabirira amalanga ag’omu nnimiro n’ebinyonyi eby’omu bbanga, era nti n’enviiri ez’oku mutwe gwaffe zonna zibaliddwa, nteekwa okukikkiriza olw’okuba kyawandiikibwa, ka mbe n’okuwulira kwa munda oba nedda.

Kikulu nnyo gye tuli okutegeera nti Bayibuli kigambo, si kya nteebereza, wabula kya bintu ebituufu; era nti ebintu si bya mazima olw’okuba biri mu Bayibuli, naye biri mu Bayibuli olw’okuba bya mazima. Omulenzi omuto, eyali ayize ku ssomero ku kuvumbula kwa Amerika, yagamba kitaawe olunaku olumu nti, “Taata, singa nnali Kolombo, sandyetaaganye bwe ntyo okuvumbula Amerika.”

“Lwaki, wandikoze ki?” kitaawe n’abuuza.

“Ah,” omulenzi omuto n’addamu, “nandigenze butereevu ku maapu ne ngiraba.”

Omulenzi omuto ono teyategeera nti amaapu bibaluliro byokka eby’ebifo ebimaze okumanyika, era nti Amerika teyabaawo olw’okuba yali ku maapu, naye yali asobola okuba ku maapu olw’okuba yali amaze okubaawo. Era kiri kimu ne Bayibuli. Guli, ng’amaapu, kigambo kyangu eky’ebintu ebituufu; bw’atugamba nti Katonda atwagala, atugamba kyokka ekintu ekimaze okuba ekya mazima, era ekitandibadde mu Bayibuli singa tekyali kya mazima.

Kyali kivumbulo kinene gye ndi bwe nnategeera kino. Kyalabika ng’ekiggyawo okubuusabuusa n’okuteebereza kwonna okuva mu kubikkulirwa kwe twaweebwa mu Bayibuli ku bulokozi obwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, era ng’ekifuula buli kyawandiikibwa ku ye okuba ekigambo ekyangu eky’ebintu ebituufu ebitawakanyizika. Ebintu ebituufu kye tusobola okukkiriza—era mazima, tubikkiriza amangu nga bwe tubitegeera okuba ebituufu. Okubikkulirwa okwa munda si kye tusobola okufuga, naye omuntu yenna alina amagezi amalungi asobola okukkiriza ekyawandiikibwa. Ne bwe kiyinza okulabika nga kyangu era kya bwereere ku lusooka, bwe kigobererwa n’obunywevu, kirivaamu obukakafu obw’omunda obw’omukisa ennyo, era ku nkomerero kiritutwala mu kumanya Katonda okulikyusa obulamu bwaffe.

Engeri eno ey’okumanya ereeta obukakafu; era mu ndowooza yange, obukakafu businga wala obumanyirivu obw’omunda, ne bwe buba obusanyusa bwe butya. Obumanyirivu obw’omunda buyinza okukwatibwako obulamu bw’omubiri oba ebintu ebirala bingi ebiteganya, naye obukakafu businga kusigalawo. Omuntu bw’amala okukakasibwa nti bbiri na bbiri zenkana nnya, tewali bulwadde, butabeera bulungi, oba kintu kya bweru ekiyinza okunyeenya obukakafu obwo. Akimanyi bulungi bw’aba omulwadde nga bw’akimanyi bw’aba ow’amaanyi. Obukakafu buva mu kumanya, era tewali kukyuka mu nneewulira oba embeera y’omubiri ekiyinza okukyusa okumanya.

Kye kigendererwa okuyamba abasomi bange okutuuka ku ngeri eno ey’okumanya Katonda okw’obwakabi, n’okutuuka ku bukakafu obuva mu kwo, ekitabo kino kyennaava kiwandiikibwa. Nnaasooka okugezaako okulaga Katonda kye ali—si mu ngeri ey’obuyivu oba ey’enyigiriza z’eddiini, wabula kyokka kye ali mu bulamu obwa buli lunaku obw’amazima, nga Katonda era Kitaawe wa buli omu ku ffe. Nnaalaga era ebimu ku bintu ebindabikira okuba emitawaana emikulu egiziyiza okumumanya mu butuufu.

Nkakafu ddala nti okumumanya nga bw’ali ddala kulireeta obuweweevu n’emirembe ebitaggwaawo eri buli mutima ogweraliikiridde, era neegomba nnyo okuyamba buli muntu gwe nsobola okutuuka gy’ali okutuuka ku kumanya kuno. Omu ku mikwano gya Yobu yagamba, ng’addamu ku nnaku ya Yobu nti, “Kkiriziganya ne Katonda, obeere mu mirembe; bw’otyo obulungi bulikujjira.” (Yobu 22:21) Ne Mukama waffe, mu kusaba kwe okwasembayo okwawandiikibwa, yagamba nti: “Buno bwe bulamu obutaggwaawo, nti bakumanye ggwe, Katonda omu ow’amazima, ne Yesu Kristo gwe watuma.” (Yokaana 17:3). Si nsonga ya kwemanya ffe fennyini—kye tuli, kye tukola, oba kye tuwulira—wabula nsonga ya kumanyiira Katonda, n’okumanya kye ali, kye akola, ne kye awulira. Obuweweevu n’emirembe tebiva ku kye tumanyi ku ffe fennyini, wabula bulijjo ku kye tumanyi ku ye.

Tuyinza okumala ennaku zaffe nga tukola kye tuyita emirimu egy’eddiini, ne tujjuza okusinza kwaffe obunyiikivu, ne tusigala nga tuli mu nnaku. Tewali kisobola kuleeta kiwummulo kya mazima mu mitima gyaffe okuggyako okumanya Katonda okwa mazima; kubanga ku nkomerero, buli kimu mu bulokozi bwaffe kisinziira ku ye. Obuweweevu bwaffe businziira ddala ku kuba nga asaanira okwesigibwa kwaffe. Singa twali tuteekateeka olugendo olw’akabi, ekisooka kye twandifaako kwe ngeri ya kapiteeni w’emmeeri gwe twandibadde naye. Amagezi amalungi gandituwadde okutegeera nti singa kapiteeni teyeesigika, obwesige bwaffe bwonna tebwandifudde lugendo kutebenkera. Empisa ze, so si zaffe, ze zandisinze obukulu.

Bwe nnyinza okukyogera emirundi emingi obulungi, ne mu ngeri ez’enjawulo ennyingi, okuleeta obukakafu mu mitima egimu egyeraliikiridde, n’okugiggya mu bulamu bwabwe obw’eddiini obutali bulungi era obuteganya, okubuyingiza mu bwakabaka obw’okwagala, essanyu, n’emirembe—obwe busika bwabwe obw’ensobozi—nnaawulira nti ekigendererwa kyange mu kuwandiika ekitabo kino kituukiriziddwa. Era nnaasobola okugamba nti, “Mukama, kaakano oleka omuweereza wo agende mu mirembe, ng’ekigambo kyo bwe kiri; kubanga amaaso gange galabye obulokozi bwo”; era ekkalaamu yange egezezaako okububikkula.

Naye kiteekwa okutegeerekeka bulungi nti ekitabo kino tekigezaako kukwatagana na nsonga za kukenkanya oba za buyivu bwa ddiini. Tekiddirira bibuuzo ku bwannamaddala bwa Bayibuli.

Abalala, abasobola okusinga, basobola okukwatagana n’ensonga ng’ezo. Ekitabo kino kiwandiikiddwa lwa bantu, abafaanana nga nze, abeeyatula okukkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo, era abakkiriza Bayibuli nga kwe kubikkulirwa kwe.

Kyenva, nga nvuddeeko ebibuuzo byonna eby’okukenkanya, nnoonya kwokka okunnyonnyola ekindabikira okuba ekivaamu obutonde okw’okukkiriza ng’okwo, n’engeri abakkiriza gye basobola okwekakasizaamu bo bennyini.

Wayinza okubaawo obukyamu mu ngeri gye njogeramu ebintu bino, era ku ekyo nsaba abasomi bange okutegeera. Naye amazima ge njagala okutuusa—era okugatuusa mu ngeri nti tewali n’omu ayinza okulemererwa okutegeera—si makyamu. Era amazima ago ge gano: obulamu bwaffe obw’eddiini bugwanidde okujjula essanyu, emirembe, n’obuweweevu, era bwe tunaatuuka okumanya Katonda obulungi, bugenda kubeera bwe bityo.

Taagala kuggyawo mutwe gwe, naye mu kiseera kye kimu kizibu nnyo okugubeerera nagwo. Nze, ku lwange, saagala kubeera na ddiini ya ngeri eyo.” Kino kyali essomo lye sikooye kwerabira, era y’ensonga esokera awo lwe nawandiikira ekitabo kino. Nnali nkyali muto nnyo mu bulamu obw’Ekikristaayo mu kiseera ky’olukungaana luno, era nnali nkyali mu ssanyu erisooka ery’okuyingira mu bwo, bwe kityo saasobola kukkiriza nti abaana ba Katonda yenna bandibadde abatalina mativu mu bulamu bwabwe obw’eddiini nga munnange agnostic bwe yali agamba. Naye ekimyanso eky’olubereberye eky’okukyuka kwange bwe kyayita, ne nzika mu bujjumbizi obw’emirimu n’obuvunaanyizibwa obwa buli lunaku, mangwago ne ntegeera okuva mu bumanyirivu bwange, era n’okuva mu bumanyirivu obufaanana obw’Abakristaayo abasinga obungi abaali banneetoolodde, nti mu kigambo kye waaliwo amazima mangi nnyo, era nti obulamu obw’eddiini obwa ffe abasinga bwali bujjudde obutabeera bulungi n’obutabeera na mirembe. Mu butuufu, kyalabika, nga omu ku mikwano gyange egy’Ekikristaayo bwe yaŋŋamba lumu bwe twali tugeraageranya obumanyirivu bwaffe, nti “twali n’eddiini emala okututeeka mu nnaku bwokka.” Njatula nti kino kyannakuwaza nnyo, kubanga nnali nsuubidde ekintu eky’enjawulo ddala. Kyandabikira nga tekikwatagana n’obwenkanya nti eddiini, ebibala byayo bye byalangibwa mu Bayibuli okuba okwagala, essanyu, n’emirembe, esaanidde okukoleramu mu ngeri ekyamu ddala, n’ereeta okubuusabuusa, okutya, obutabeera na mirembe, entalo, n’obutabeera bulungi obwa buli ngeri; ne nsalawo, bwe kiba nga kisoboka, okuvumbula ekyali kikyamu. Nnebuuza nti, Lwaki abaana ba Katonda bandibadde n’obulamu obw’eddiini obutali bulungi ddala bwe bityo, ate ng’atuleese okukkiriza nti ekikoligo kye kyangu era omugugu gwe mwangu? Lwaki tweraliikirizibwa okubuusabuusa okw’omwoyo okungi bwe kutyo, n’okweraliikirira okw’omwoyo okuzitowa bwe kutyo? Lwaki tukisanga nga kizibu okuba abakakafu nti Katonda ddala atwagala, era lwaki kiba nti tetulabika kusobola kukkiriza kwa bbanga ddene ku bulungi bwe n’okulabirira kwe? Kiba kitya nga tuyinza okwekkiriza okumuteebereza nga atwerabidde era ng’atulese mu biseera eby’obwetaavu? Tusobola okwesiga mikwano gyaffe egy’oku nsi ne twewulira nga tuli bulungi mu kubeera nabo; kale kiba kitya nga tetusobola kwesiga Mukwano gwaffe ogw’omu ggulu, era ne kiba nga tetusobola kubeera na mirembe mu buweereza bwe? Nkkiriza nti nzudde eky’okuddamu ku bibuuzo bino, era nnandyagadde okwatula lwatu nti ekigendererwa kyange mu kuwandiika ekitabo kino kwe kugezaako okuleeta obuweweevu obutono obw’amazima era obwa nnamaddala mu bulamu obumu obw’Abakristaayo obweraliikiridde obunneetoolodde. Okutegeera kwange nze ku ddiini eya Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo kwe kuti yakolebwa okuba ejjudde obuweweevu. Nkakasa nti buli musomi atalina kyekubiira ku Ndagaano Empya yandyogedde bw’omu, era nkkiriza nti buli muntu akyakyusibbwa, mu ssanyu erisooka ery’okukyuka kwe, akisuubira ddala. Naye ate, nga bwe njogedde, kiba nga eri Abakristaayo abangi ennyo obulamu bwabwe obw’eddiini kye kitundu ekisinga obutabeera bulungi mu kubaawo kwabwe. Omusango gw’ekyo guli ku Mukama? Asuubizza ebisukka ku by’asobola okuwa? Omuwandiisi omu yagamba nti, “Tumanyi okulanga ebibuubaano ekyo bwe kiri. Bulwadde bwa mirembe gino bwe tubonaabona fenna. Waliwo ebiwandiiko ku buli kifo eky’okulanga, okulambika okusukkiridde ku buli kisenge ekiŋŋaanvu, okulaga n’okulaga ebitali bituufu ebitabalika. Ebifaananyi ki bye tulabye eby’ebibala n’ebimuli ebitasoboka ebikuzibwa okuva mu nsigo za nnaani. Buli kimu kilangibwa okusukkiridde. Kifaanana bwe kityo n’obwakabaka bwa Katonda? Ebibala bye tuvaamu okuva mu nsigo ennungi ey’obwakabaka bituukana n’okunnyonnyola oyo gwe twaggya ku nsigo eyo ennungi kw’atuwa? Atulimbye? Waliwo endowooza egyetoolodde nti Kristo asuubizza mu Njiri ye ebisukka ku by’alina okuwa. Abantu balowooza nti tebafunye ddala ekyo ekyasuubizibwa okuba omugabo gw’abaana ba Katonda. Naye lwaki kiri kityo? Obwakabaka bwa Katonda bwalangibwa okusukkiridde, oba bwakkirizibwa katono okusinga bwe kyagwanidde? Mukama Yesu Kristo yatendebwa okusukkiridde, oba yeesigibwa katono okusinga bwe kyagwanidde?” Kye njagala okukola mu kitabo kino kwe kulaga, mu ngeri yange entono, kye nkkiririza ddala nti: obwakabaka bwa Katonda tebusoboka kulangibwa kusukkiridde, ne Mukama Yesu Kristo tasoboka kutendebwa kusukkiridde, kubanga “ekyo eriiso lye litalabanga, n’okutu bwe kutawuliranga, n’omutima gw’omuntu bwe gutateeberezanga, Katonda kye yateekerateekera abo abamwagala”; era nti obuzibu bwonna buva mu kuba nti twakkiriza katono era twesiga katono. Kyenva njagala okulaga, mu bujjuvu nga bwe nsobola, ensonga eziriwo mu ddiini eya Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo ez’emirembe n’obuweweevu obw’omwoyo obwo obw’ebuziba era obw’olubeerera, obutayinza kunyeenyezebwa kintu kyonna ku nsi, era obwogerwako okuba omugabo gw’abo abagwanirira. Era njagala okunnyonnyola, obanga guno gwe mugabo gwaffe ogutuufu, engeri gye tusaanidde okugukozesaamu, n’ebintu ki ebiziyiza. Waliwo omulimu gwa Katonda mu nsonga eno, era waliwo omulimu gw’omuntu, era tuteekwa okwetegereza byombi n’obwegendereza. Omuvubuka omu omukambwe, eyaleetebwa eri Mukama mu lukungaana lw’obuvunaanyizibwa (mission meeting), oluvannyuma n’afuuka Omukristaayo omusanyufu era n’abeera obulamu obulungi, yabuuzibwa omuntu ky’akola okukyusibwa. “Ah,” n’agamba, “nakola omulimu gwange, ne Mukama n’akola ogugwe.” “Naye omulimu gwo gwali guluwa,” omubuuzi n’abuuza, “ate ogwa Mukama gwali guluwa?” “Omulimu gwange,” okuddamu ne kujja mangu, “kwali kudduka, ate omulimu gwa Mukama kwali kungoberera okutuusa lwe yankwata.” Eky’okuddamu eky’amakulu mangi; naye batono nnyo abasobola okukitegeera mu butuufu! Omulimu gwa Katonda bulijjo kwe kutugoberera. Kristo yajja okunoonya n’okulokola ekyo ekyabula. “Ani ku mmwe, alina endiga kikumi, bw’aba abuzeeko emu ku zo, atalese ekyenda mu mwenda mu ddundiro, n’agenda okunoonya eyo ebuze okutuusa lw’agisanga? Era bw’agisanga, agiteeka ku kibegabega kye, ng’asanyuka.” Guno bulijjo gwe mulimu ogw’obwakatonda; naye mu busirusiru bwaffe tetegeera, ne tulowooza nti Mukama y’oyo eyabula, era nti omulimu gwaffe kwe kunoonya n’okumulaba. Ebigambo bye twogera byennyini bikiraga. Tukubiriza aboonoonyi “okunoonya Mukama,” era twogera ku kuba nga “tumulabye.” “Omulabyeko Omulokozi?” omukozi w’obuvunaanyizibwa eyali anyiikiridde ennyo bwe yabuuza omuwala omuto omusanyufu era eyeesiga. N’endabika ey’okwewuunya, n’addamu mu ddoboozi ery’okwesamba nti, “Naye nze saamanyi nga Omulokozi yali abuze!” Obutamanya bwaffe Katonda bwe buleeta bino byonna. Olw’okuba tetumumanyi, mu buwezi bwaffe tuteekawo endowooza embi eza buli ngeri ku ye. Tulowooza nti Mulamuzi w’obusungu alindirira obukyamu bwaffe obutonotono, oba Nnannyini mulimu omukambwe amaliridde okutubanja obuweereza obusukkulumu, oba Katonda eyeefaako yekka ayagala ekitiibwa kye kyonna ekijjuvu, oba Kabaka ali ewala eyeeraliikirira ebibye byokka nga tafaayo ku bulamu bwaffe. Ani ayinza okwewuunya nti Katonda ng’oyo tasobola kwagalwa wadde kwesigibwa? Era ani ayinza okusuubira Abakristaayo, abalina endowooza ng’ezo ku ye, okuba ekintu kirala okuggyako okujjula obutabeera bulungi n’ennaku? Naye nsobola okwogera n’obwesige, awatali kutya kuwakanyizibwa, nti tekisoboka omuntu yenna amanyi Katonda mu butuufu okuba n’endowooza embi bwe zityo ku ye. Wayinza okubaawo obutabeera bulungi obungi obw’ebweru, n’ennaku n’ebigezo bingi eby’oku nsi, naye wakati mu byonna, emmeeme emanyi Katonda eteekwa okubeera munda mu kifo eky’emirembe emituukirivu. “Buli awuliriza nze aligenda mirembe era aliwummulira awatali kutya kabi.” Era kino ky’ekigambo omuntu yenna ky’atasobola kubuusabuusa. Singa tuwuliriza Katonda mu butuufu—ekitegeeza si kumuwulira kyokka wabula n’okukkiriza kye tuwulira—tetwandiremye kumanya nti, kubanga ye Katonda, tasobola kukola kirala okuggyako okutulabirira ng’emmunye y’eriiso lye, era nti buli kintu okwagala okuwewuufu n’amagezi ag’obwakatonda kye biyinza okukolera obulungi bwaffe kijja kukolebwa mazima. Tewali mulyango n’ogumu ogusigalidde okweraliikirira oba okutya eri emmeeme emanyi Katonda. “Ah, weewaawo,” ogamba, “naye nnaamumanya ntya? Abantu abalala balabika ng’abalina engeri y’okubikkulirwa munda ekibaleetera okumumanya, naye nze sirina; era ne bwe nsaba ntya, buli kimu kindabikira nga kya kizikiza. Njagala okumanya Katonda, naye sikiraba nga nnaakikola ntya.” Obuzibu bwo buli mu kuba nti olina endowooza embi ku kye kitegeeza okumanya Katonda, oba awakiri ku ngeri y’okumanya gye ntegeeza. Kubanga sitegeeza kubikkulirwa kwa munda okwa kyama. Obumanyirivu ng’obwo businga kusanyusa bwe bubaawo, naye tebulijjo bwa mu buyinza bwaffe, era buyinza okuba obutakakafu era obutali bunywevu. Engeri y’okumanya gye ntegeeza kwe kumanya okwangu era okw’amakulu okw’obuwangwa n’empisa za Katonda okuva mu kukkiriza ekyo ekibikkulwa ku ye mu Bayibuli. Omutume Yokaana, ku nkomerero y’Enjiri ye, agamba ku bintu bye yali awandiise nti: “Yesu yakola n’obubonero obulala bungi mu maaso g’abayigirizwa, obutawandiikibwa mu kitabo kino; naye bino byawandiikibwa mulyoke mukkirize nti Yesu ye Kristo, Omwana wa Katonda, era nga bwe mukkiriza mube n’obulamu mu linnya lye.” (Yokaana 20:30). Kwe kukkiriza ekyawandiikibwa, so si ekyo ekibikkulwa munda, okuwa obulamu; era engeri y’okumanya gye ntegeeza kwe kumanya okuva mu kukkiriza ekyo ekyawandiikibwa. Ntegeeza, mu ngeri ey’obwakabi, nti bwe nsoma mu Bayibuli nti Katonda kwe kwagala, nteekwa okukikkiriza olw’okuba kyawandiikibwa, so si olw’okuba nnina obumanyirivu obwa munda obukakasa nti kya mazima; era Bayibuli bw’agamba nti atulabirira nga bw’alabirira amalanga ag’omu nnimiro n’ebinyonyi eby’omu bbanga, era nti n’enviiri ez’oku mutwe gwaffe zonna zibaliddwa, nteekwa okukikkiriza olw’okuba kyawandiikibwa, ka mbe n’okuwulira kwa munda oba nedda. Kikulu nnyo gye tuli okutegeera nti Bayibuli kigambo, si kya nteebereza, wabula kya bintu ebituufu; era nti ebintu si bya mazima olw’okuba biri mu Bayibuli, naye biri mu Bayibuli olw’okuba bya mazima. Omulenzi omuto, eyali ayize ku ssomero ku kuvumbula kwa Amerika, yagamba kitaawe olunaku olumu nti, “Taata, singa nnali Kolombo, sandyetaaganye bwe ntyo okuvumbula Amerika.” “Lwaki, wandikoze ki?” kitaawe n’abuuza. “Ah,” omulenzi omuto n’addamu, “nandigenze butereevu ku maapu ne ngiraba.” Omulenzi omuto ono teyategeera nti amaapu bibaluliro byokka eby’ebifo ebimaze okumanyika, era nti Amerika teyabaawo olw’okuba yali ku maapu, naye yali asobola okuba ku maapu olw’okuba yali amaze okubaawo. Era kiri kimu ne Bayibuli. Guli, ng’amaapu, kigambo kyangu eky’ebintu ebituufu; bw’atugamba nti Katonda atwagala, atugamba kyokka ekintu ekimaze okuba ekya mazima, era ekitandibadde mu Bayibuli singa tekyali kya mazima. Kyali kivumbulo kinene gye ndi bwe nnategeera kino. Kyalabika ng’ekiggyawo okubuusabuusa n’okuteebereza kwonna okuva mu kubikkulirwa kwe twaweebwa mu Bayibuli ku bulokozi obwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, era ng’ekifuula buli kyawandiikibwa ku ye okuba ekigambo ekyangu eky’ebintu ebituufu ebitawakanyizika. Ebintu ebituufu kye tusobola okukkiriza—era mazima, tubikkiriza amangu nga bwe tubitegeera okuba ebituufu. Okubikkulirwa okwa munda si kye tusobola okufuga, naye omuntu yenna alina amagezi amalungi asobola okukkiriza ekyawandiikibwa. Ne bwe kiyinza okulabika nga kyangu era kya bwereere ku lusooka, bwe kigobererwa n’obunywevu, kirivaamu obukakafu obw’omunda obw’omukisa ennyo, era ku nkomerero kiritutwala mu kumanya Katonda okulikyusa obulamu bwaffe. Engeri eno ey’okumanya ereeta obukakafu; era mu ndowooza yange, obukakafu businga wala obumanyirivu obw’omunda, ne bwe buba obusanyusa bwe butya. Obumanyirivu obw’omunda buyinza okukwatibwako obulamu bw’omubiri oba ebintu ebirala bingi ebiteganya, naye obukakafu businga kusigalawo. Omuntu bw’amala okukakasibwa nti bbiri na bbiri zenkana nnya, tewali bulwadde, butabeera bulungi, oba kintu kya bweru ekiyinza okunyeenya obukakafu obwo. Akimanyi bulungi bw’aba omulwadde nga bw’akimanyi bw’aba ow’amaanyi. Obukakafu buva mu kumanya, era tewali kukyuka mu nneewulira oba embeera y’omubiri ekiyinza okukyusa okumanya. Kye kigendererwa okuyamba abasomi bange okutuuka ku ngeri eno ey’okumanya Katonda okw’obwakabi, n’okutuuka ku bukakafu obuva mu kwo, ekitabo kino kyennaava kiwandiikibwa. Nnaasooka okugezaako okulaga Katonda kye ali—si mu ngeri ey’obuyivu oba ey’enyigiriza z’eddiini, wabula kyokka kye ali mu bulamu obwa buli lunaku obw’amazima, nga Katonda era Kitaawe wa buli omu ku ffe. Nnaalaga era ebimu ku bintu ebindabikira okuba emitawaana emikulu egiziyiza okumumanya mu butuufu. Nkakafu ddala nti okumumanya nga bw’ali ddala kulireeta obuweweevu n’emirembe ebitaggwaawo eri buli mutima ogweraliikiridde, era neegomba nnyo okuyamba buli muntu gwe nsobola okutuuka gy’ali okutuuka ku kumanya kuno. Omu ku mikwano gya Yobu yagamba, ng’addamu ku nnaku ya Yobu nti, “Kkiriziganya ne Katonda, obeere mu mirembe; bw’otyo obulungi bulikujjira.” (Yobu 22:21) Ne Mukama waffe, mu kusaba kwe okwasembayo okwawandiikibwa, yagamba nti: “Buno bwe bulamu obutaggwaawo, nti bakumanye ggwe, Katonda omu ow’amazima, ne Yesu Kristo gwe watuma.” (Yokaana 17:3). Si nsonga ya kwemanya ffe fennyini—kye tuli, kye tukola, oba kye tuwulira—wabula nsonga ya kumanyiira Katonda, n’okumanya kye ali, kye akola, ne kye awulira. Obuweweevu n’emirembe tebiva ku kye tumanyi ku ffe fennyini, wabula bulijjo ku kye tumanyi ku ye. Tuyinza okumala ennaku zaffe nga tukola kye tuyita emirimu egy’eddiini, ne tujjuza okusinza kwaffe obunyiikivu, ne tusigala nga tuli mu nnaku. Tewali kisobola kuleeta kiwummulo kya mazima mu mitima gyaffe okuggyako okumanya Katonda okwa mazima; kubanga ku nkomerero, buli kimu mu bulokozi bwaffe kisinziira ku ye. Obuweweevu bwaffe businziira ddala ku kuba nga asaanira okwesigibwa kwaffe. Singa twali tuteekateeka olugendo olw’akabi, ekisooka kye twandifaako kwe ngeri ya kapiteeni w’emmeeri gwe twandibadde naye. Amagezi amalungi gandituwadde okutegeera nti singa kapiteeni teyeesigika, obwesige bwaffe bwonna tebwandifudde lugendo kutebenkera. Empisa ze, so si zaffe, ze zandisinze obukulu. Bwe nnyinza okukyogera emirundi emingi obulungi, ne mu ngeri ez’enjawulo ennyingi, okuleeta obukakafu mu mitima egimu egyeraliikiridde, n’okugiggya mu bulamu bwabwe obw’eddiini obutali bulungi era obuteganya, okubuyingiza mu bwakabaka obw’okwagala, essanyu, n’emirembe—obwe busika bwabwe obw’ensobozi—nnaawulira nti ekigendererwa kyange mu kuwandiika ekitabo kino kituukiriziddwa. Era nnaasobola okugamba nti, “Mukama, kaakano oleka omuweereza wo agende mu mirembe, ng’ekigambo kyo bwe kiri; kubanga amaaso gange galabye obulokozi bwo”; era ekkalaamu yange egezezaako okububikkula. Naye kiteekwa okutegeerekeka bulungi nti ekitabo kino tekigezaako kukwatagana na nsonga za kukenkanya oba za buyivu bwa ddiini. Tekiddirira bibuuzo ku bwannamaddala bwa Bayibuli. Abalala, abasobola okusinga, basobola okukwatagana n’ensonga ng’ezo. Ekitabo kino kiwandiikiddwa lwa bantu, abafaanana nga nze, abeeyatula okukkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo, era abakkiriza Bayibuli nga kwe kubikkulirwa kwe. Kyenva, nga nvuddeeko ebibuuzo byonna eby’okukenkanya, nnoonya kwokka okunnyonnyola ekindabikira okuba ekivaamu obutonde okw’okukkiriza ng’okwo, n’engeri abakkiriza gye basobola okwekakasizaamu bo bennyini. Wayinza okubaawo obukyamu mu ngeri gye njogeramu ebintu bino, era ku ekyo nsaba abasomi bange okutegeera. Naye amazima ge njagala okutuusa—era okugatuusa mu ngeri nti tewali n’omu ayinza okulemererwa okutegeera—si makyamu. Era amazima ago ge gano: obulamu bwaffe obw’eddiini bugwanidde okujjula essanyu, emirembe, n’obuweweevu, era bwe tunaatuuka okumanya Katonda obulungi, bugenda kubeera bwe bityo.

fields.title: Erinnya Lye Ani?
fields.body_html:
Musa n'agamba Katonda nti, ‘Bwe ndijja eri abaana ba Isiraeri ne mbagamba nti, “Katonda wa bajjajjammwe antumye gye muli,” ne bambuuza nti, “Erinnya lye ani?” nnaabaddamu ntya?’

Okuva 3:14 Ekibuuzo ekikulu ennyo eky’emirembe gyonna era eky’omutima gwa buli muntu kiraga wano nti: “Erinnya lye ani?”

Ebiseera by’abantu bonna byesigamye ku kuddamu okw’ekibuuzo kino. Nga bwe tumanyi, embeera y’ensi eyeesigamye ku mpisa z’abo abagifuga. Embeera y’eggye eyeesigamye ku baami abaliduumira. Era gavumenti gy’esingako okuba ey’obuyinza obungi, gy’ekyo kiba bwe kityo.

Kale tuyinza okulaba nti buli kintu mu nsi yonna kyesigamye ku ngeri y’Omutonzi n’omufuzi eyagireeta mu bubaawo, era nti obulamu obulungi bwonna obw’abantu abagissibwamu bwesigamiziddwa ku mpisa z’Omutonzi waabwe. Katonda eyatutonda bw’aba Katonda omulungi, kale buli kimu ku nkomerero kiteekwa okuba ekituufu gye tuli, kubanga Katonda omulungi tasobola kulagira kirala wabula ekirungi. Naye bw’aba Katonda omubi, oba Katonda atafaayo, oba Katonda atali wa kisa, kale tetuyinza kukakasa nti waliwo ekituufu, era tetuyinza kubeera na mirembe oba kubudaabudibwa wonna wonna.

Omusingi ogutuufu ogw’emirembe n’okubudaabudibwa guzuulibwa mu ngeri ya Katonda gwe tulina yokka. Noolwekyo, tusooka okuzuula erinnya lye — kwe kugamba, empisa ze — mu bufunze, Katonda w’engeri ki.

Mu lulimi lwa Baibuli, erinnya bulijjo litegeeza mpisa. Amannya eyo tegaweebwa buwa nga bwe kitera okuba gye tuli, wabula bulijjo gaweebwa ng’agatunuulira empisa oba omulimu gw’oyo ayitibwa.

Creden, mu Concordance ye, agamba nti amannya ga Katonda gategeeza ky’ali mu bwenkanya, era gakozesebwa mu Baibuli yonna okwoleka engeri ze, ebigendererwa bye, ekitiibwa kye, ekisa kye, okusaasira kwe, okwagala kwe, amagezi ge, obuyinza bwe, n’obulungi bwe. Okwekenneenya n’obwegendereza amannya ge kikirambika.

Kale, abaana ba Isiraeri bwe baabuuza nti, “Erinnya lye ani?” baali bategeeza nti, “Ono Katonda gw’oyogerako y’ani era ki? Empisa ze z’eziruwa? Engeri ze z’eziruwa? Akola ki?

Mu bufunze, muntu wa ngeri ki?”

Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli agamba nti, “Abamanyi erinnya lyo banaakwesiganga, kubanga ggwe, Ai Mukama, tolese abo abakunoonya.” (Zabbuli 9:10) Era nate agamba nti, “Erinnya lya Mukama kigo eky’amaanyi; omutuukirivu addukiramu n’aba mirembe.” (Zabbuli 18:10) “Abamanyi erinnya lyo banaakwesiganga.” Tebayinza kukola kirala, kubanga bwe bamanya erinnya lye bamanya empisa ze n’obuntu bwe — nti ye Katonda asaanira ddala okwesigibwa.

Tewali kubuusabuusa nti ekitundu ekinene eky’obutabeera na mirembe n’obweraliikirivu obuli mu mitima gy’Abakristaayo bangi kiva mu nsonga nti tebannaba kumanya rinnya lye. “Abamu beesiga amagaali n’abalala embalaasi, naye ffe tunajjukira erinnya lya Mukama Katonda waffe. Bo bafukamira ne bagwa, naye ffe tugolokoka ne tuyimirira.” (Zabbuli 20:7-8) Mu byonna bye tusoma ku Isiraeri ab’edda, tulaba amazima gano agataggwaawo: buli kye baali na buli kye baalina byesigama ku nsonga nti Katonda waabwe yali Mukama. “Alina omukisa eggwanga Katonda waalyo gwe Mukama, abantu be yeerondera okuba omugabo gwe.” (Zabbuli 33:12) “Kyova oba omukulu, Ai Mukama Katonda. Kubanga tewali akufaanana, era tewali Katonda mulala wabula ggwe, ng’ebyo byonna bye twawulira n’amatu gaffe bwe biri. Era ani afaanana ng’abantu bo Isiraeri, eggwanga limu ku nsi Katonda lye yagenda okununula okuba abantu be, nga yeekolera erinnya, era nga abakolera ebintu ebikulu era eby’entiisa, ng’agoba mu maaso g’abantu bo, be wenunulira okuva mu Misiri, eggwanga ne bakatonda baalyo? Era weenyweza abantu bo Isiraeri okuba abantu bo emirembe gyonna; era ggwe, Ai Mukama, n’ofuuka Katonda waabwe.” (Zabbuli 7:22-24) “Balina essanyu abantu Katonda waabwe gwe Mukama!” (Zabbuli 144:15) Eggwanga eryo lya mukisa; abantu abo balina essanyu, abo Katonda waabwe gwe Mukama. Omukisa gwonna n’essanyu lya Isiraeri byava mu nsonga nti Katonda waabwe yali Mukama. Tewaali kirala kikulu kimala okwogerwako nga bategeeza emikisa gyabwe. Ensonga nti Katonda waabwe yali Mukama yamala okunnyonnyola buli kirungi kye baalina.

Kale, ekibuuzo ekisinga ebibuuzo byonna eri buli omu ku ffe kye kino nti: “Erinnya lye ani?”

Eri Abaisiraeri, Katonda yennyini yaddamu ekibuuzo kino. Katonda yagamba Musa nti, “NDI OYO ANDI.”

(Okuva 3:14) Era yagamba nti, “Gamba abaana ba Isiraeri nti, ‘NDI antumye gye muli.’” Katonda era yagamba Musa nti, “Gamba abaana ba Isiraeri nti, ‘Mukama, Katonda wa bajjajjammwe, Katonda wa Ibulayimu, Katonda wa Isaaka, ne Katonda wa Yakobo, antumye gye muli. Lino lye linnya lyange emirembe gyonna, era bwe ntyo bwe nnaajjukirwanga mu mirembe gyonna.’” (Okuva 3:15) Mu Njiri ya Yokaana, Kristo yeetwalira erinnya lino “Ndi.” Abayudaaya bwe baamubuuza ku buyinza bwe, yabagamba nti, “Ddala ddala mbagamba nti, Ibulayimu nga tannabaawo, nze ndiwo.”

(Yokaana 8:58) Era mu Kitabo ky’Okubikkulirwa addamu okwatula nti: “Nze Alufa era Omega… oyo aliwo, eyaliwo, era anaajja, Ayinzabyonna.” (Okubikkulirwa 1:8) Ebigambo bino ebyangu, “Ndi,” byoleka obutaggwaawo n’obutakyuka obw’okubaawo, nga ye ngeri esooka era ey’omugaso eya Katonda ayinza okwesigwa. Tewali muntu ayinza kwesiga Katonda akyukakyuka. Ateekwa okuba nga bw’ali jjo, leero, n’emirembe gyonna, bwe tuba n’okugenda okufuna emirembe oba okubudaabudibwa. Naye kino kye kyokka erinnya lye kye litegeeza — “Ndi” kyokka? Ndi ki? tubuuza. “Ndi” kino kizingiramu ki? Nzikiriza nti kizingiramu buli kimu omutima gw’omuntu kye gwegomba era kye gwetaaga. Erinnya lino lya Katonda eritawedde lifaanana ng’ecapa etaliiko muwendo, ekiteekeddwako omukono omukwano gwaffe omugagga, ekituweereddwa okujjuza omuwendo gwonna gwe twetaaga. Baibuli yonna etubuulira kye litegeeza.

Buli ngeri ya Katonda, buli kubikkulirwa okw’empisa ze, buli bukakafu obw’okwagala kwe okutaggwaawo, buli kulangirira okw’okulabirira kwe, buli kukakasa okw’okusaasira kwe okw’ekisa, buli kwoleka okw’ekisa kye eky’okwagala — byonna gwe kujjuza kw’eri “Ndi” eritawedde.

Katonda atubuulira mu Kigambo kye kyonna ky’ali. “Ndi,” bw’agamba, “byonna abantu bange bye beetaaga. Ndi maanyi gaabwe. Ndi magezi gaabwe. Ndi butuukirivu bwabwe. Ndi mirembe gyabwe. Ndi bulokozi bwabwe.

Ndi bulamu bwabwe. Ndi byonna mu byonna gye bali.”

Erinnya lino eririraga ng’eritawedde noolwekyo lye linnya erisinga okubudaabuda omutima gw’omuntu lye guyinza okulowooza, kubanga litusobozesa okuligattako, awatali kkomo, kyonna kye twetaaga — ne “okusukka nnyo ku byonna bye tusaba oba bye tulowooza.”

Naye emitima gyaffe bwe gijjula “Ndi” zaffe ffe ez’ennaku, tetuubeere na matu ga kuwulira “Ndi” Lye ery’ekitiibwa, erimatiza emmeeme. Tugamba nti, “Ndi muntu munafu nnyo,” oba “Ndi musirusiru nnyo,” oba “Siriimu mugaso,” oba “Sirina buyambi,” era “Ndi” zino ez’obwavu tuzireeta nga y’ensonga y’ennaku n’obweraliikirivu obw’obulamu bwaffe obw’eddiini, ne tuwulira ne nti tusaanira okusaasirwa kubanga ebintu bituzibuwalira nnyo. Mu kiseera kye kimu, tutunuulira ddala nga tetufaayo ku capa etaliiko muwendo eya “Ndi” lya Katonda ery’ekitiibwa, erituwa olukusa okusena okuva gy’ali ebimala ebingi eri buli kyetaago.

Bw’oba Omukristaayo atali mu ddembe, kale ekintu kyokka ekiyinza okukuwa obulamu obw’eddiini obulimu ddembe ddala kwe kumanya Katonda. Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli agamba nti abo abamanyi erinnya lya Katonda banaamwesiganga, era nkakasa nti tekisoboka kumumanya ddala n’oba nga tomwesiga. Omuntu eyeesigika mu buteesigika aleeta obwesige — si lwa kubwetaaga, wabula ng’abuwangula olw’empisa ze.

Mukama waffe ky’ayatula kya mazima emirembe gyonna nti: “Nange, bwe nnaawanulibwa okuva ku nsi, ndikoona abantu bonna gye ndi.” Bw’omala okumumanya ddala, Kristo tasobola kugaanibwa. Toyinza butamwesiga nga bw’otoyinza butassa mukka. Era singa ensi yonna emumanya nga bw’ali ddala, ensi yonna — n’aboonoonyi bonna — bandigudde ku bigere bye nga bamusinza. Tebandisobodde butakikola. Obulungi bwe obusukkiridde bwandiwangudde buli kimu.

Kale tuyinza tutya okutuuka okumanya Katonda?

Ebintu bibiri byeetaagisa: ekisooka, Katonda ateekwa okwebikkula; era ekyokubiri, tuteekwa okukkiriza okubikkulirwa kwe n’okukkiriza ky’abikkula.

Omutume Yokaana atubuulira nti “tewali n’omu eyali alabyeko Katonda; Katonda omu yekka, ali ku lubaziba lwa Kitaawe, ye yamwoleka.” (Yokaana 1:18) Kale, Kristo ye kubikkulirwa kwa Katonda. Tewali n’omu ku ffe alabyeko Katonda, era tetuyinza kumulaba mu mbeera yaffe eno, kubanga tetulina busobozi kukikola. Naye yeebikkulidde mu Kristo, era tuyinza okulaba Kristo, kubanga yafuuka omuntu nga ffe.

Omuntu eyandyagadde okwogera n’entudde ayinza okuyimirira ku kiswa ky’entudde n’ayogera olunaku lwonna, naye tewali kigambo na kimu ekyandibatuuseeko. Zandyeyongedde okutambulatambula, nga tezimumanyiiko n’akatono. Nga bwe tumanyi, entudde tezirina busobozi kutegeera kwogera kwa bantu. Naye singa omuntu yandisobodde okufuuka entudde, n’abeera nazo, n’ayogera olulimi lwazo, amangwago yandyetegeezezza gye zziri.

Ekiramu eky’oku ntikko bwe kyagala okutuukagana n’ekiramu eky’ewansi, okufuuka omuntu mu mubiri kyetaagisa.

Kristo yayoleka Katonda mu ky’ali, mu kye yakola, ne mu kye yayogera. Okuva mu kikunkumuli okutuuka mu ntaana, buli kaseera k’obulamu bwe kaayoleka Katonda. Kale tuteekwa okumugendako okumanya Katonda, era tuteekwa okugaana okukkiriza kyonna ekikwata ku Katonda ekitatulagibwa mu Kristo. Okubikkulirwa okulala kwonna tekutuukiridde noolwekyo tekwesigika kimala. Mu Kristo mwokka mwe tulabira Katonda nga bw’ali ddala, kubanga Kristo ye “kifaananyi ekituufu eky’obuntu bwe.”

Kyonna Katonda kye yandyogedde oba kye yandikoze mu mbeera yonna, Kristo ye yakyogera n’akikola. “Sikola kintu ku buyinza bwange kennyini… Kitange abeera mu nze y’akola emirimu gye.” (Yokaana 14:10) “Nze ne Kitange tuli omu.” (Yokaana 10:30) “Andabyeko alabye Kitange.” (Yokaana 14:9) Tewali kyatulwa bulungi mu Ndagaano Empya okusinga amazima gano: nti tuteekwa okulaba “ekitangaala eky’okumanya ekitiibwa kya Katonda mu maaso ga Yesu Kristo,” (2 Abakkolinso 4:6) era nti tetuyinza kukiraba mu bujjuvu awantu walala wonna.

Bwe twagala okumanya amakulu amajjuvu aga Katonda kye yali ategeeza bwe yawa Musa erinnya eryo eririraga ng’eritawedde, “Ndi,” tulyakizuula nga kibikkuddwa mu Kristo. Ye yekka annyonnyola Katonda. Ye yekka kye kifaananyi kya Katonda atalabika.

Kale kya lwatu nti tetusaana kukkiriza ndowooza yonna ku Katonda ekontana ne kye tulaba mu Kristo, era tuteekwa okugaana ddala endowooza yonna ku mpisa ze, ku bikolwa bye, oba ku nkolagana ye naffe — ka ebe ng’esomesebwa n’amaanyi ki — bw’eba etakkiriziganya ne kye Kristo yabikkula.

Ffenna tumanyi nti okubikkulirwa kwa Katonda okuli mu Ndagaano Enkadde oluusi kulabika ng’okwawukana ku kubikkulirwa okwaweebwa mu Kristo, era ekibuuzo kivaayo nti kiruwa kye tuteekwa okukkiriza ng’ekisinga obutuufu. Olw’ensonga nti Katonda yennyini atubuulira nti mu nnaku zino ez’oluvannyuma ayogedde naffe ng’ayita mu Mwana we, “ekimasamasa eky’ekitiibwa kya Katonda era ekifaananyi ekituufu eky’obuntu bwe,” tetuyinza kugaana bujulizi bwa Kristo. Wabula, tuteekwa okutwala okubikkulirwa kw’Endagaano Enkadde, we kwawukana ku kubikkulirwa okuli mu Kristo, ng’okw’ekitundu era okutatuukiridde, era tukkirize ng’ekifaananyi ekituufu ekya Katonda ekyo kyokka kye tuzuula mu Kristo.

Kristo yekka y’atubuulira erinnya lya Katonda ery’amazima era ery’ekituufu. Mu kusaba kwe okw’enkomerero era okw’ekitalo agamba nti: “Nayolese erinnya lyo eri abantu be wampa okuva mu nsi… Nabawa ebigambo bye wampa, era baabyaniziza ne bategeera mu mazima nti nava gy’oli; era bakkiriza nti ggwe wantuma.”

Tuyinza kusaba buyinza businga buno?

Mu bulamu bwa Kristo bwonna, tewali kiri lwatu oba kya maanyi okusinga ensonga nti yeeyongera bulijjo okwatula nti ye kubikkulirwa okujjuvu okwa Katonda. “Ebigambo bye mbagamba sibyogera ku buyinza bwange kennyini, wabula Kitange abeera mu nze y’akola emirimu gye.” (Yokaana 14:10) Emirundi n’emirundi ayatula nti ayogera kyokka Kitaawe ky’amuwa okwogera. “Ntegeeza ensi bye nawulira okuva gy’ali.” (Yokaana 8:26) “Sikola kintu ku buyinza bwange kennyini, wabula njogera nga Kitange bwe yanjigiriza.” (Yokaana 12:49) Omutume era ayatula mu bwerufu obungi nti kyasanyusa Kitaawe nti mu Kristo “obujjuvu bwonna obwa Katonda bwasiima okubeeramu.” (Abakkolosaayi 1:19) Ne bwe tuba nga tetuyinza kutegeera bulungi byonna kino bye kitegeeza mu ndowooza ey’obuyivu bwa Katonda, tetuyinza butalaba nti bwe twagala okumanya Katonda, twetaaga kwatiikirana na makubo ga Kristo n’empisa za Kristo tusobole okumanya amakubo ga Katonda n’empisa za Katonda. “Andabyeko alabye Kitange.” Era nate ayatula nti “tewali amanyi Kitaawe wabula Omwana n’oyo Omwana gw’anaalonda okumubikkulira.”

(Matayo 11:27) Kino kimalirawo ensonga ddala. Tuyinza okuba n’endowooza nnyingi ku Katonda; tuyinza okulowooza oba okuteebereza — naye byonna bya bwereere. Tetuyinza kumumanya wabula ng’ayita mu kubikkulirwa okwaweebwa mu Kristo.

Tuyinza okumanya ebintu bingi ku Katonda, naye ekyo kyawukana nnyo ku kumumanya nga bw’ali ddala mu buntu ne mpisa. Abajulizi abalala bayinza okutubuulira ku bikolwa bye eby’ebweru, naye okuva mu bino oluusi tufuna endowooza enkyamu nnyo ku mpisa ze ez’amazima. Tewali n’omu wabula Kristo ayinza okubikkula obuntu bwa Katonda obw’omunda obw’amazima, kubanga ku ye yekka kye kiyinza okugambibwa nti “Katonda omu yekka, ali ku lubaziba lwa Kitaawe, ye yamwoleka.” (Yokaana 1:18) Kireeta enjawulo yonna mu bulamu bwaffe obw’Ekikristaayo oba tukkiriza kino nga kya mazima oba nedda. Bwe tukikkiriza, kale Omulamuzi ow’amaanyi n’Omukama omukambwe gwe twatidde — ne bwe twali tugezaako okumugoberera — era gwe twasanga okuweereza kwe nga kuzibu era nga tekulimu ddembe, banaabula. Mu kifo kye munaajja Katonda ow’okwagala eyatubikkulirwa mu “maaso ga Yesu Kristo,” Katonda atufaako nga bw’afaayo ku nkazaluggya n’ebimuli eby’omu nnimiro, era atubuulira nti n’enviiri ez’oku mutwe gwaffe zonna zibaliddwa.

Tewali ayinza okutya Katonda ng’ono.

Bwe tuba nga twamanyiira okusemberera Katonda nga tulina okubuusabuusa kwonna ku bulungi bwe gye tuli; obulamu bwaffe obw’eddiini bwe buba nga bwataliddwa obutwa n’okutya; endowooza etaasaana ku mpisa ze ne ku kwagala kwe bwe zibba nga zijjuza emitima gyaffe okuteeberezaako obulungi bwe; bwe tuba nga tumuteebereza ng’omufuzi omukambwe oba omuyinza eyeenoonya bufuzi bwe; mu bufunze, bwe tuba nga tumulowoozezaako mu ngeri yonna okuggyako ekyo ekyatubikkulirwa mu “maaso ga Yesu Kristo,” tuteekwa okuddayo, n’omutima omwangu, eri ebyawandiikibwa eby’obulamu obwo obulungi obwabeerera mu bantu, ne tuleeta okutegeera kwaffe okwa Katonda mu kukkiriziganya okujjuvu n’empisa n’amakubo g’oyo ayatula nti yajja okwoleka erinnya lya Katonda.

Kale, nga nziramu ekibuuzo nti, “Erinnya lye ani?” nnina kino kyokka eky’okwogera: buuza Kristo. Tubuulirwa nti yali “Katonda eyayolesebwa mu mubiri,” era nti buli amulaba alaba Katonda eyamutuma. Kale, kya lwatu ddala nti bwe twagala okumanya erinnya, tuteekwa okutunuulira okwolesebwa. Kino kitegeeza kwokka nti tuteekwa okwekenneenya obulamu, ebigambo, n’ebikolwa bya Kristo, ne twegamba nti, “Buli alabye Kristo alabye Katonda,” era nti nga Kristo bwe yali ku nsi, Katonda bw’ali bw’atyo mu ggulu. Okutabukatabuka kwonna okwetoolodde empisa za Katonda kunaabula bwe tunaakkiriza ekitangaala Kristo ky’awadde ne tukkiriza “okwolesebwa kw’erinnya lye” Kristo kw’atulaze, ne tugaana okukkiriza ekirala kyonna.

Nikodemo bwe yajja eri Yesu ekiro okubuuza engeri ebintu bino gye biyinza okuba amazima, Yesu yamugamba nti ka abitegeere oba tabitegeere, byali bikyali bya mazima, era yagamba mu bwerufu ddala nti: “Ddala ddala nkugamba nti twogera kye tumanyi, era tukakasa kye twalaba.” (Yokaana 3:11) Tewali akkiriza Kristo ayinza okubuusabuusa nti yamanya Katonda; era tewali ayinza okuwakanya oba tusaanira okukkiriza obujulizi bwe. Emirundi mingi yatukakasa nti yamanya kye yali ayogerako, era nti ebigambo bye biteekwa okukkirizibwa ng’amazima matuufu ddala, kubanga yava mu ggulu noolwekyo amanyi eby’omu ggulu.

Tewali n’omu ku ffe ayinza okukiwakanya mu lwatu; naye mu bukulu abantu ba Katonda bangi tebafaayo ku bujulizi bwa Kristo ne bawulira emitima gyabwe egibuusabuusa, egibagamba nti tekiyinza kuba mazima nti Katonda mwagazi, mukwatirwa kisa, oba mwetegefu kusonyiwa nga Kristo bwe yamulaze okuba. Naye nteekwa okuddiŋŋana emirundi n’emirundi, ne bwe kiba nga kiyinza okuddiŋŋanwa, ekyo abatono bennyini kye balabika okutegeera: bwe wabaawo amazima gamu agasomesebwa mu bwerufu okusinga ago gonna mu Baibuli, ge nti erinnya — kwe kugamba, empisa — za Kitaawe, nga Kristo bwe yazibikkula, ze mpisa ze ez’amazima. Kristo yeeyongera bulijjo okwatula nti ye kwolesebwa okulamu okwa Kitaawe, era nti mu buli kye yayogera na kye yakola, yali ayogera kyokka era akola Kitaawe kye yandyogedde n’akola singa yali akoledde butereevu okuva mu ggulu.

Nga tulaba ebigambo ebya lwatu ng’ebyo okuva eri Mukama waffe yennyini, kifuuka si mukisa gwaffe gwokka wabula n’obuvunaanyizibwa bwaffe okuggya mu kutegeera kwaffe okwa Katonda ekintu kyonna ekitakkiriziganya n’obulamu, empisa, n’okuyigiriza kwa Kristo. Bwe twagala okumanya erinnya lya Katonda ery’amazima, tuteekwa okukkiriza erinnya Kristo lye yabikkula ne tutawuliriza ddala rinnya rirala.

Empisa zonna ze tulaba mu Kristo, zino zijjuza amakulu ga “Ndi” lya Katonda. Bwe tutunuulira obulamu bwa Kristo ne tuwuliriza ebigambo bye, tuwulira Katonda ng’agamba nti, “Ndi kiwummulo eri abakooye; ndi mirembe eri abateganyizibwa; ndi maanyi eri abanafu; ndi magezi eri abasirusiru; ndi butuukirivu eri aboonoonyi; ndi buli kimu emmeeme eyeetaaga ennyo kye yeyagaliza; ndi okusukka nnyo ku byonna bye musobola okusaba oba okulowooza, mu mukisa, obuyambi, n’okulabirira.”

Naye wano omuntu ayinza okugamba nti, “Weewaawo, kino kyonna kiyinza okuba amazima, naye nnyinza ntya okukikwata? Ndi muntu ataasaana nnyo n’olwekyo sikaaba kukkiriza nti ekisa ng’ekyo kya kkange.”

Oyinza otya okukikwata? Toyinza kukikwata n’akatono — naye oyinza okukireka kikukwate ggwe. Ye njiri ennungi gy’olangiriddwa mu Baibuli, era weetaaga kwokka kugifaako nga bw’ofaako ku mawulire gonna ageesigika ag’okubuulirwa ensibuko eyeesigika. Oyo ayogera bw’aba nga yeesigika, okkiriza ky’agamba n’okikoleramu. Era oteekwa okukola bw’otyo wano. Kristo bw’aba nga yeesigika bw’agamba nti ye kubikkulirwa kwa Katonda, kale oteekwa okumukkiriza n’okikoleramu.

Oteekwa okwesigama ku kwesigika kwe. Oteekwa okwegamba, era bwe kiba kyetaagisa n’okugamba abalala nti, “Nnaakkiriza Kristo ky’agamba ku Katonda. Ka ebintu bibe bwe bilabika, ka endowooza zange oba enneewulira zange zibe ky’ezigamba, ka omuntu omulala yenna abe ky’ayogera, mmanyi nti Kristo ky’agamba kiteekwa okuba amazima, kubanga ye amanyi ate ng’omulala tamanyi. Nnaamukkiriza mu bujjuvu.

Agamba nti ye omu ne Katonda; noolwekyo, buli ky’ali, Katonda bw’ali. Sikyaddayo kutya Katonda. Sijja kumulowoozaako ng’omuwi w’amateeka omukambwe ansunguwaliddeko, oba ng’omukama omukambwe asaba ebitasoboka, oba ng’omuntu ali wala atasemberekeka atafaayo ku kufuba kwange n’okutya kwange. Endowooza zonna ng’ezo tezisoboka kaakano nga mmaze okumanya nti Kristo abikkula Katonda.”

Bwe tunywerera ku mazima gano — nti Kristo ne Katonda bali omu — ne tugaana okukkiriza endowooza yonna ku Katonda ekontana ne kye Kristo yalaga, obulamu bwaffe bunaakyusibwa.

Oluusi tuyinza okwetaaga okunywerera ku kino, kubanga okubuusabuusa n’okutya okw’edda binaakomawo ne bigezaako okukwata nate. Naye tuteekwa okubivaako n’obumalirivu ne twatula nti kaakano tumanyi erinnya — kwe kugamba, empisa — za Katonda waffe, era nti ebintu ng’ebyo tebisoboka gy’ali.

Noolwekyo, tugaana okuwuliriza ekiteeso kyonna ekyoleka empisa ze oba amakubo ge mu ngeri enkyamu.

Tekisoboka kulowooza nti Katonda bwe yagamba Musa nti, “NDI,” yali ategeeza nti, “Ndi muwi wa mateeka mukambwe,” oba “Ndi mukama mukambwe,” oba “Sifaayo ku kubonaabona kw’abantu bange.” Singa tugezaako okujjuza “Ndi” Lye n’amakulu ng’ago, Abakristaayo wonna bandyewuunyizza. Naye okutya n’okubuusabuusa kw’abakkiriza bangi tebyogera bintu bino byennyini mu kasirise mu mitima gyabwe buli lunaku?

Katonda akkirize nti kye tuyiga nga twekenneenya erinnya lye kinaafuula okubuusabuusa n’okutya okwenkanidde awo okutasoboka gye tuli okuva kaakano.

Yesu ye Katonda! Ayi, singa nnyinza Okutambula ettaka n’ennyanja, Okuyigiriza n’okubuulira amazima gano gokka, Nnandibadde n’essanyu lingi nnyo!

Ayi, singa mba n’eddoboozi lya malayika, Nnandirangiridde waggulu — Yesu, omulungi, omulabika obulungi, Ye kifaananyi kya Katonda waffe!
fields.body_text: Musa n'agamba Katonda nti, ‘Bwe ndijja eri abaana ba Isiraeri ne mbagamba nti, “Katonda wa bajjajjammwe antumye gye muli,” ne bambuuza nti, “Erinnya lye ani?” nnaabaddamu ntya?’ Okuva 3:14 Ekibuuzo ekikulu ennyo eky’emirembe gyonna era eky’omutima gwa buli muntu kiraga wano nti: “Erinnya lye ani?” Ebiseera by’abantu bonna byesigamye ku kuddamu okw’ekibuuzo kino. Nga bwe tumanyi, embeera y’ensi eyeesigamye ku mpisa z’abo abagifuga. Embeera y’eggye eyeesigamye ku baami abaliduumira. Era gavumenti gy’esingako okuba ey’obuyinza obungi, gy’ekyo kiba bwe kityo. Kale tuyinza okulaba nti buli kintu mu nsi yonna kyesigamye ku ngeri y’Omutonzi n’omufuzi eyagireeta mu bubaawo, era nti obulamu obulungi bwonna obw’abantu abagissibwamu bwesigamiziddwa ku mpisa z’Omutonzi waabwe. Katonda eyatutonda bw’aba Katonda omulungi, kale buli kimu ku nkomerero kiteekwa okuba ekituufu gye tuli, kubanga Katonda omulungi tasobola kulagira kirala wabula ekirungi. Naye bw’aba Katonda omubi, oba Katonda atafaayo, oba Katonda atali wa kisa, kale tetuyinza kukakasa nti waliwo ekituufu, era tetuyinza kubeera na mirembe oba kubudaabudibwa wonna wonna. Omusingi ogutuufu ogw’emirembe n’okubudaabudibwa guzuulibwa mu ngeri ya Katonda gwe tulina yokka. Noolwekyo, tusooka okuzuula erinnya lye — kwe kugamba, empisa ze — mu bufunze, Katonda w’engeri ki. Mu lulimi lwa Baibuli, erinnya bulijjo litegeeza mpisa. Amannya eyo tegaweebwa buwa nga bwe kitera okuba gye tuli, wabula bulijjo gaweebwa ng’agatunuulira empisa oba omulimu gw’oyo ayitibwa. Creden, mu Concordance ye, agamba nti amannya ga Katonda gategeeza ky’ali mu bwenkanya, era gakozesebwa mu Baibuli yonna okwoleka engeri ze, ebigendererwa bye, ekitiibwa kye, ekisa kye, okusaasira kwe, okwagala kwe, amagezi ge, obuyinza bwe, n’obulungi bwe. Okwekenneenya n’obwegendereza amannya ge kikirambika. Kale, abaana ba Isiraeri bwe baabuuza nti, “Erinnya lye ani?” baali bategeeza nti, “Ono Katonda gw’oyogerako y’ani era ki? Empisa ze z’eziruwa? Engeri ze z’eziruwa? Akola ki? Mu bufunze, muntu wa ngeri ki?” Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli agamba nti, “Abamanyi erinnya lyo banaakwesiganga, kubanga ggwe, Ai Mukama, tolese abo abakunoonya.” (Zabbuli 9:10) Era nate agamba nti, “Erinnya lya Mukama kigo eky’amaanyi; omutuukirivu addukiramu n’aba mirembe.” (Zabbuli 18:10) “Abamanyi erinnya lyo banaakwesiganga.” Tebayinza kukola kirala, kubanga bwe bamanya erinnya lye bamanya empisa ze n’obuntu bwe — nti ye Katonda asaanira ddala okwesigibwa. Tewali kubuusabuusa nti ekitundu ekinene eky’obutabeera na mirembe n’obweraliikirivu obuli mu mitima gy’Abakristaayo bangi kiva mu nsonga nti tebannaba kumanya rinnya lye. “Abamu beesiga amagaali n’abalala embalaasi, naye ffe tunajjukira erinnya lya Mukama Katonda waffe. Bo bafukamira ne bagwa, naye ffe tugolokoka ne tuyimirira.” (Zabbuli 20:7-8) Mu byonna bye tusoma ku Isiraeri ab’edda, tulaba amazima gano agataggwaawo: buli kye baali na buli kye baalina byesigama ku nsonga nti Katonda waabwe yali Mukama. “Alina omukisa eggwanga Katonda waalyo gwe Mukama, abantu be yeerondera okuba omugabo gwe.” (Zabbuli 33:12) “Kyova oba omukulu, Ai Mukama Katonda. Kubanga tewali akufaanana, era tewali Katonda mulala wabula ggwe, ng’ebyo byonna bye twawulira n’amatu gaffe bwe biri. Era ani afaanana ng’abantu bo Isiraeri, eggwanga limu ku nsi Katonda lye yagenda okununula okuba abantu be, nga yeekolera erinnya, era nga abakolera ebintu ebikulu era eby’entiisa, ng’agoba mu maaso g’abantu bo, be wenunulira okuva mu Misiri, eggwanga ne bakatonda baalyo? Era weenyweza abantu bo Isiraeri okuba abantu bo emirembe gyonna; era ggwe, Ai Mukama, n’ofuuka Katonda waabwe.” (Zabbuli 7:22-24) “Balina essanyu abantu Katonda waabwe gwe Mukama!” (Zabbuli 144:15) Eggwanga eryo lya mukisa; abantu abo balina essanyu, abo Katonda waabwe gwe Mukama. Omukisa gwonna n’essanyu lya Isiraeri byava mu nsonga nti Katonda waabwe yali Mukama. Tewaali kirala kikulu kimala okwogerwako nga bategeeza emikisa gyabwe. Ensonga nti Katonda waabwe yali Mukama yamala okunnyonnyola buli kirungi kye baalina. Kale, ekibuuzo ekisinga ebibuuzo byonna eri buli omu ku ffe kye kino nti: “Erinnya lye ani?” Eri Abaisiraeri, Katonda yennyini yaddamu ekibuuzo kino. Katonda yagamba Musa nti, “NDI OYO ANDI.” (Okuva 3:14) Era yagamba nti, “Gamba abaana ba Isiraeri nti, ‘NDI antumye gye muli.’” Katonda era yagamba Musa nti, “Gamba abaana ba Isiraeri nti, ‘Mukama, Katonda wa bajjajjammwe, Katonda wa Ibulayimu, Katonda wa Isaaka, ne Katonda wa Yakobo, antumye gye muli. Lino lye linnya lyange emirembe gyonna, era bwe ntyo bwe nnaajjukirwanga mu mirembe gyonna.’” (Okuva 3:15) Mu Njiri ya Yokaana, Kristo yeetwalira erinnya lino “Ndi.” Abayudaaya bwe baamubuuza ku buyinza bwe, yabagamba nti, “Ddala ddala mbagamba nti, Ibulayimu nga tannabaawo, nze ndiwo.” (Yokaana 8:58) Era mu Kitabo ky’Okubikkulirwa addamu okwatula nti: “Nze Alufa era Omega… oyo aliwo, eyaliwo, era anaajja, Ayinzabyonna.” (Okubikkulirwa 1:8) Ebigambo bino ebyangu, “Ndi,” byoleka obutaggwaawo n’obutakyuka obw’okubaawo, nga ye ngeri esooka era ey’omugaso eya Katonda ayinza okwesigwa. Tewali muntu ayinza kwesiga Katonda akyukakyuka. Ateekwa okuba nga bw’ali jjo, leero, n’emirembe gyonna, bwe tuba n’okugenda okufuna emirembe oba okubudaabudibwa. Naye kino kye kyokka erinnya lye kye litegeeza — “Ndi” kyokka? Ndi ki? tubuuza. “Ndi” kino kizingiramu ki? Nzikiriza nti kizingiramu buli kimu omutima gw’omuntu kye gwegomba era kye gwetaaga. Erinnya lino lya Katonda eritawedde lifaanana ng’ecapa etaliiko muwendo, ekiteekeddwako omukono omukwano gwaffe omugagga, ekituweereddwa okujjuza omuwendo gwonna gwe twetaaga. Baibuli yonna etubuulira kye litegeeza. Buli ngeri ya Katonda, buli kubikkulirwa okw’empisa ze, buli bukakafu obw’okwagala kwe okutaggwaawo, buli kulangirira okw’okulabirira kwe, buli kukakasa okw’okusaasira kwe okw’ekisa, buli kwoleka okw’ekisa kye eky’okwagala — byonna gwe kujjuza kw’eri “Ndi” eritawedde. Katonda atubuulira mu Kigambo kye kyonna ky’ali. “Ndi,” bw’agamba, “byonna abantu bange bye beetaaga. Ndi maanyi gaabwe. Ndi magezi gaabwe. Ndi butuukirivu bwabwe. Ndi mirembe gyabwe. Ndi bulokozi bwabwe. Ndi bulamu bwabwe. Ndi byonna mu byonna gye bali.” Erinnya lino eririraga ng’eritawedde noolwekyo lye linnya erisinga okubudaabuda omutima gw’omuntu lye guyinza okulowooza, kubanga litusobozesa okuligattako, awatali kkomo, kyonna kye twetaaga — ne “okusukka nnyo ku byonna bye tusaba oba bye tulowooza.” Naye emitima gyaffe bwe gijjula “Ndi” zaffe ffe ez’ennaku, tetuubeere na matu ga kuwulira “Ndi” Lye ery’ekitiibwa, erimatiza emmeeme. Tugamba nti, “Ndi muntu munafu nnyo,” oba “Ndi musirusiru nnyo,” oba “Siriimu mugaso,” oba “Sirina buyambi,” era “Ndi” zino ez’obwavu tuzireeta nga y’ensonga y’ennaku n’obweraliikirivu obw’obulamu bwaffe obw’eddiini, ne tuwulira ne nti tusaanira okusaasirwa kubanga ebintu bituzibuwalira nnyo. Mu kiseera kye kimu, tutunuulira ddala nga tetufaayo ku capa etaliiko muwendo eya “Ndi” lya Katonda ery’ekitiibwa, erituwa olukusa okusena okuva gy’ali ebimala ebingi eri buli kyetaago. Bw’oba Omukristaayo atali mu ddembe, kale ekintu kyokka ekiyinza okukuwa obulamu obw’eddiini obulimu ddembe ddala kwe kumanya Katonda. Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli agamba nti abo abamanyi erinnya lya Katonda banaamwesiganga, era nkakasa nti tekisoboka kumumanya ddala n’oba nga tomwesiga. Omuntu eyeesigika mu buteesigika aleeta obwesige — si lwa kubwetaaga, wabula ng’abuwangula olw’empisa ze. Mukama waffe ky’ayatula kya mazima emirembe gyonna nti: “Nange, bwe nnaawanulibwa okuva ku nsi, ndikoona abantu bonna gye ndi.” Bw’omala okumumanya ddala, Kristo tasobola kugaanibwa. Toyinza butamwesiga nga bw’otoyinza butassa mukka. Era singa ensi yonna emumanya nga bw’ali ddala, ensi yonna — n’aboonoonyi bonna — bandigudde ku bigere bye nga bamusinza. Tebandisobodde butakikola. Obulungi bwe obusukkiridde bwandiwangudde buli kimu. Kale tuyinza tutya okutuuka okumanya Katonda? Ebintu bibiri byeetaagisa: ekisooka, Katonda ateekwa okwebikkula; era ekyokubiri, tuteekwa okukkiriza okubikkulirwa kwe n’okukkiriza ky’abikkula. Omutume Yokaana atubuulira nti “tewali n’omu eyali alabyeko Katonda; Katonda omu yekka, ali ku lubaziba lwa Kitaawe, ye yamwoleka.” (Yokaana 1:18) Kale, Kristo ye kubikkulirwa kwa Katonda. Tewali n’omu ku ffe alabyeko Katonda, era tetuyinza kumulaba mu mbeera yaffe eno, kubanga tetulina busobozi kukikola. Naye yeebikkulidde mu Kristo, era tuyinza okulaba Kristo, kubanga yafuuka omuntu nga ffe. Omuntu eyandyagadde okwogera n’entudde ayinza okuyimirira ku kiswa ky’entudde n’ayogera olunaku lwonna, naye tewali kigambo na kimu ekyandibatuuseeko. Zandyeyongedde okutambulatambula, nga tezimumanyiiko n’akatono. Nga bwe tumanyi, entudde tezirina busobozi kutegeera kwogera kwa bantu. Naye singa omuntu yandisobodde okufuuka entudde, n’abeera nazo, n’ayogera olulimi lwazo, amangwago yandyetegeezezza gye zziri. Ekiramu eky’oku ntikko bwe kyagala okutuukagana n’ekiramu eky’ewansi, okufuuka omuntu mu mubiri kyetaagisa. Kristo yayoleka Katonda mu ky’ali, mu kye yakola, ne mu kye yayogera. Okuva mu kikunkumuli okutuuka mu ntaana, buli kaseera k’obulamu bwe kaayoleka Katonda. Kale tuteekwa okumugendako okumanya Katonda, era tuteekwa okugaana okukkiriza kyonna ekikwata ku Katonda ekitatulagibwa mu Kristo. Okubikkulirwa okulala kwonna tekutuukiridde noolwekyo tekwesigika kimala. Mu Kristo mwokka mwe tulabira Katonda nga bw’ali ddala, kubanga Kristo ye “kifaananyi ekituufu eky’obuntu bwe.” Kyonna Katonda kye yandyogedde oba kye yandikoze mu mbeera yonna, Kristo ye yakyogera n’akikola. “Sikola kintu ku buyinza bwange kennyini… Kitange abeera mu nze y’akola emirimu gye.” (Yokaana 14:10) “Nze ne Kitange tuli omu.” (Yokaana 10:30) “Andabyeko alabye Kitange.” (Yokaana 14:9) Tewali kyatulwa bulungi mu Ndagaano Empya okusinga amazima gano: nti tuteekwa okulaba “ekitangaala eky’okumanya ekitiibwa kya Katonda mu maaso ga Yesu Kristo,” (2 Abakkolinso 4:6) era nti tetuyinza kukiraba mu bujjuvu awantu walala wonna. Bwe twagala okumanya amakulu amajjuvu aga Katonda kye yali ategeeza bwe yawa Musa erinnya eryo eririraga ng’eritawedde, “Ndi,” tulyakizuula nga kibikkuddwa mu Kristo. Ye yekka annyonnyola Katonda. Ye yekka kye kifaananyi kya Katonda atalabika. Kale kya lwatu nti tetusaana kukkiriza ndowooza yonna ku Katonda ekontana ne kye tulaba mu Kristo, era tuteekwa okugaana ddala endowooza yonna ku mpisa ze, ku bikolwa bye, oba ku nkolagana ye naffe — ka ebe ng’esomesebwa n’amaanyi ki — bw’eba etakkiriziganya ne kye Kristo yabikkula. Ffenna tumanyi nti okubikkulirwa kwa Katonda okuli mu Ndagaano Enkadde oluusi kulabika ng’okwawukana ku kubikkulirwa okwaweebwa mu Kristo, era ekibuuzo kivaayo nti kiruwa kye tuteekwa okukkiriza ng’ekisinga obutuufu. Olw’ensonga nti Katonda yennyini atubuulira nti mu nnaku zino ez’oluvannyuma ayogedde naffe ng’ayita mu Mwana we, “ekimasamasa eky’ekitiibwa kya Katonda era ekifaananyi ekituufu eky’obuntu bwe,” tetuyinza kugaana bujulizi bwa Kristo. Wabula, tuteekwa okutwala okubikkulirwa kw’Endagaano Enkadde, we kwawukana ku kubikkulirwa okuli mu Kristo, ng’okw’ekitundu era okutatuukiridde, era tukkirize ng’ekifaananyi ekituufu ekya Katonda ekyo kyokka kye tuzuula mu Kristo. Kristo yekka y’atubuulira erinnya lya Katonda ery’amazima era ery’ekituufu. Mu kusaba kwe okw’enkomerero era okw’ekitalo agamba nti: “Nayolese erinnya lyo eri abantu be wampa okuva mu nsi… Nabawa ebigambo bye wampa, era baabyaniziza ne bategeera mu mazima nti nava gy’oli; era bakkiriza nti ggwe wantuma.” Tuyinza kusaba buyinza businga buno? Mu bulamu bwa Kristo bwonna, tewali kiri lwatu oba kya maanyi okusinga ensonga nti yeeyongera bulijjo okwatula nti ye kubikkulirwa okujjuvu okwa Katonda. “Ebigambo bye mbagamba sibyogera ku buyinza bwange kennyini, wabula Kitange abeera mu nze y’akola emirimu gye.” (Yokaana 14:10) Emirundi n’emirundi ayatula nti ayogera kyokka Kitaawe ky’amuwa okwogera. “Ntegeeza ensi bye nawulira okuva gy’ali.” (Yokaana 8:26) “Sikola kintu ku buyinza bwange kennyini, wabula njogera nga Kitange bwe yanjigiriza.” (Yokaana 12:49) Omutume era ayatula mu bwerufu obungi nti kyasanyusa Kitaawe nti mu Kristo “obujjuvu bwonna obwa Katonda bwasiima okubeeramu.” (Abakkolosaayi 1:19) Ne bwe tuba nga tetuyinza kutegeera bulungi byonna kino bye kitegeeza mu ndowooza ey’obuyivu bwa Katonda, tetuyinza butalaba nti bwe twagala okumanya Katonda, twetaaga kwatiikirana na makubo ga Kristo n’empisa za Kristo tusobole okumanya amakubo ga Katonda n’empisa za Katonda. “Andabyeko alabye Kitange.” Era nate ayatula nti “tewali amanyi Kitaawe wabula Omwana n’oyo Omwana gw’anaalonda okumubikkulira.” (Matayo 11:27) Kino kimalirawo ensonga ddala. Tuyinza okuba n’endowooza nnyingi ku Katonda; tuyinza okulowooza oba okuteebereza — naye byonna bya bwereere. Tetuyinza kumumanya wabula ng’ayita mu kubikkulirwa okwaweebwa mu Kristo. Tuyinza okumanya ebintu bingi ku Katonda, naye ekyo kyawukana nnyo ku kumumanya nga bw’ali ddala mu buntu ne mpisa. Abajulizi abalala bayinza okutubuulira ku bikolwa bye eby’ebweru, naye okuva mu bino oluusi tufuna endowooza enkyamu nnyo ku mpisa ze ez’amazima. Tewali n’omu wabula Kristo ayinza okubikkula obuntu bwa Katonda obw’omunda obw’amazima, kubanga ku ye yekka kye kiyinza okugambibwa nti “Katonda omu yekka, ali ku lubaziba lwa Kitaawe, ye yamwoleka.” (Yokaana 1:18) Kireeta enjawulo yonna mu bulamu bwaffe obw’Ekikristaayo oba tukkiriza kino nga kya mazima oba nedda. Bwe tukikkiriza, kale Omulamuzi ow’amaanyi n’Omukama omukambwe gwe twatidde — ne bwe twali tugezaako okumugoberera — era gwe twasanga okuweereza kwe nga kuzibu era nga tekulimu ddembe, banaabula. Mu kifo kye munaajja Katonda ow’okwagala eyatubikkulirwa mu “maaso ga Yesu Kristo,” Katonda atufaako nga bw’afaayo ku nkazaluggya n’ebimuli eby’omu nnimiro, era atubuulira nti n’enviiri ez’oku mutwe gwaffe zonna zibaliddwa. Tewali ayinza okutya Katonda ng’ono. Bwe tuba nga twamanyiira okusemberera Katonda nga tulina okubuusabuusa kwonna ku bulungi bwe gye tuli; obulamu bwaffe obw’eddiini bwe buba nga bwataliddwa obutwa n’okutya; endowooza etaasaana ku mpisa ze ne ku kwagala kwe bwe zibba nga zijjuza emitima gyaffe okuteeberezaako obulungi bwe; bwe tuba nga tumuteebereza ng’omufuzi omukambwe oba omuyinza eyeenoonya bufuzi bwe; mu bufunze, bwe tuba nga tumulowoozezaako mu ngeri yonna okuggyako ekyo ekyatubikkulirwa mu “maaso ga Yesu Kristo,” tuteekwa okuddayo, n’omutima omwangu, eri ebyawandiikibwa eby’obulamu obwo obulungi obwabeerera mu bantu, ne tuleeta okutegeera kwaffe okwa Katonda mu kukkiriziganya okujjuvu n’empisa n’amakubo g’oyo ayatula nti yajja okwoleka erinnya lya Katonda. Kale, nga nziramu ekibuuzo nti, “Erinnya lye ani?” nnina kino kyokka eky’okwogera: buuza Kristo. Tubuulirwa nti yali “Katonda eyayolesebwa mu mubiri,” era nti buli amulaba alaba Katonda eyamutuma. Kale, kya lwatu ddala nti bwe twagala okumanya erinnya, tuteekwa okutunuulira okwolesebwa. Kino kitegeeza kwokka nti tuteekwa okwekenneenya obulamu, ebigambo, n’ebikolwa bya Kristo, ne twegamba nti, “Buli alabye Kristo alabye Katonda,” era nti nga Kristo bwe yali ku nsi, Katonda bw’ali bw’atyo mu ggulu. Okutabukatabuka kwonna okwetoolodde empisa za Katonda kunaabula bwe tunaakkiriza ekitangaala Kristo ky’awadde ne tukkiriza “okwolesebwa kw’erinnya lye” Kristo kw’atulaze, ne tugaana okukkiriza ekirala kyonna. Nikodemo bwe yajja eri Yesu ekiro okubuuza engeri ebintu bino gye biyinza okuba amazima, Yesu yamugamba nti ka abitegeere oba tabitegeere, byali bikyali bya mazima, era yagamba mu bwerufu ddala nti: “Ddala ddala nkugamba nti twogera kye tumanyi, era tukakasa kye twalaba.” (Yokaana 3:11) Tewali akkiriza Kristo ayinza okubuusabuusa nti yamanya Katonda; era tewali ayinza okuwakanya oba tusaanira okukkiriza obujulizi bwe. Emirundi mingi yatukakasa nti yamanya kye yali ayogerako, era nti ebigambo bye biteekwa okukkirizibwa ng’amazima matuufu ddala, kubanga yava mu ggulu noolwekyo amanyi eby’omu ggulu. Tewali n’omu ku ffe ayinza okukiwakanya mu lwatu; naye mu bukulu abantu ba Katonda bangi tebafaayo ku bujulizi bwa Kristo ne bawulira emitima gyabwe egibuusabuusa, egibagamba nti tekiyinza kuba mazima nti Katonda mwagazi, mukwatirwa kisa, oba mwetegefu kusonyiwa nga Kristo bwe yamulaze okuba. Naye nteekwa okuddiŋŋana emirundi n’emirundi, ne bwe kiba nga kiyinza okuddiŋŋanwa, ekyo abatono bennyini kye balabika okutegeera: bwe wabaawo amazima gamu agasomesebwa mu bwerufu okusinga ago gonna mu Baibuli, ge nti erinnya — kwe kugamba, empisa — za Kitaawe, nga Kristo bwe yazibikkula, ze mpisa ze ez’amazima. Kristo yeeyongera bulijjo okwatula nti ye kwolesebwa okulamu okwa Kitaawe, era nti mu buli kye yayogera na kye yakola, yali ayogera kyokka era akola Kitaawe kye yandyogedde n’akola singa yali akoledde butereevu okuva mu ggulu. Nga tulaba ebigambo ebya lwatu ng’ebyo okuva eri Mukama waffe yennyini, kifuuka si mukisa gwaffe gwokka wabula n’obuvunaanyizibwa bwaffe okuggya mu kutegeera kwaffe okwa Katonda ekintu kyonna ekitakkiriziganya n’obulamu, empisa, n’okuyigiriza kwa Kristo. Bwe twagala okumanya erinnya lya Katonda ery’amazima, tuteekwa okukkiriza erinnya Kristo lye yabikkula ne tutawuliriza ddala rinnya rirala. Empisa zonna ze tulaba mu Kristo, zino zijjuza amakulu ga “Ndi” lya Katonda. Bwe tutunuulira obulamu bwa Kristo ne tuwuliriza ebigambo bye, tuwulira Katonda ng’agamba nti, “Ndi kiwummulo eri abakooye; ndi mirembe eri abateganyizibwa; ndi maanyi eri abanafu; ndi magezi eri abasirusiru; ndi butuukirivu eri aboonoonyi; ndi buli kimu emmeeme eyeetaaga ennyo kye yeyagaliza; ndi okusukka nnyo ku byonna bye musobola okusaba oba okulowooza, mu mukisa, obuyambi, n’okulabirira.” Naye wano omuntu ayinza okugamba nti, “Weewaawo, kino kyonna kiyinza okuba amazima, naye nnyinza ntya okukikwata? Ndi muntu ataasaana nnyo n’olwekyo sikaaba kukkiriza nti ekisa ng’ekyo kya kkange.” Oyinza otya okukikwata? Toyinza kukikwata n’akatono — naye oyinza okukireka kikukwate ggwe. Ye njiri ennungi gy’olangiriddwa mu Baibuli, era weetaaga kwokka kugifaako nga bw’ofaako ku mawulire gonna ageesigika ag’okubuulirwa ensibuko eyeesigika. Oyo ayogera bw’aba nga yeesigika, okkiriza ky’agamba n’okikoleramu. Era oteekwa okukola bw’otyo wano. Kristo bw’aba nga yeesigika bw’agamba nti ye kubikkulirwa kwa Katonda, kale oteekwa okumukkiriza n’okikoleramu. Oteekwa okwesigama ku kwesigika kwe. Oteekwa okwegamba, era bwe kiba kyetaagisa n’okugamba abalala nti, “Nnaakkiriza Kristo ky’agamba ku Katonda. Ka ebintu bibe bwe bilabika, ka endowooza zange oba enneewulira zange zibe ky’ezigamba, ka omuntu omulala yenna abe ky’ayogera, mmanyi nti Kristo ky’agamba kiteekwa okuba amazima, kubanga ye amanyi ate ng’omulala tamanyi. Nnaamukkiriza mu bujjuvu. Agamba nti ye omu ne Katonda; noolwekyo, buli ky’ali, Katonda bw’ali. Sikyaddayo kutya Katonda. Sijja kumulowoozaako ng’omuwi w’amateeka omukambwe ansunguwaliddeko, oba ng’omukama omukambwe asaba ebitasoboka, oba ng’omuntu ali wala atasemberekeka atafaayo ku kufuba kwange n’okutya kwange. Endowooza zonna ng’ezo tezisoboka kaakano nga mmaze okumanya nti Kristo abikkula Katonda.” Bwe tunywerera ku mazima gano — nti Kristo ne Katonda bali omu — ne tugaana okukkiriza endowooza yonna ku Katonda ekontana ne kye Kristo yalaga, obulamu bwaffe bunaakyusibwa. Oluusi tuyinza okwetaaga okunywerera ku kino, kubanga okubuusabuusa n’okutya okw’edda binaakomawo ne bigezaako okukwata nate. Naye tuteekwa okubivaako n’obumalirivu ne twatula nti kaakano tumanyi erinnya — kwe kugamba, empisa — za Katonda waffe, era nti ebintu ng’ebyo tebisoboka gy’ali. Noolwekyo, tugaana okuwuliriza ekiteeso kyonna ekyoleka empisa ze oba amakubo ge mu ngeri enkyamu. Tekisoboka kulowooza nti Katonda bwe yagamba Musa nti, “NDI,” yali ategeeza nti, “Ndi muwi wa mateeka mukambwe,” oba “Ndi mukama mukambwe,” oba “Sifaayo ku kubonaabona kw’abantu bange.” Singa tugezaako okujjuza “Ndi” Lye n’amakulu ng’ago, Abakristaayo wonna bandyewuunyizza. Naye okutya n’okubuusabuusa kw’abakkiriza bangi tebyogera bintu bino byennyini mu kasirise mu mitima gyabwe buli lunaku? Katonda akkirize nti kye tuyiga nga twekenneenya erinnya lye kinaafuula okubuusabuusa n’okutya okwenkanidde awo okutasoboka gye tuli okuva kaakano. Yesu ye Katonda! Ayi, singa nnyinza Okutambula ettaka n’ennyanja, Okuyigiriza n’okubuulira amazima gano gokka, Nnandibadde n’essanyu lingi nnyo! Ayi, singa mba n’eddoboozi lya malayika, Nnandirangiridde waggulu — Yesu, omulungi, omulabika obulungi, Ye kifaananyi kya Katonda waffe!

fields.title: Katonda ow’Okubudaabuda Kwonna
fields.body_html:
“Yeebazibwe Katonda, era Kitaawe wa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, Kitaawe w’okusaasira era Katonda ow’okubudaabuda kwonna, atubudaabuda mu kubonaabona kwaffe kwonna, tulyoke tusobole okubudaabuda abo abali mu kubonaabona kwonna, n’okubudaabuda Katonda kwe yatubudaabuza ffe ffennyini.” (2 Abakkolinso 1:3-4) Mu mannya gonna agabikkula Katonda, lino—“Katonda ow’okubudaabuda kwonna”—kirabika gye ndi ng’erimu ku agasinga obulungi era agawa emmeeme amaanyi ennyo. Ebigambo bino “okubudaabuda kwonna” tebiriimu kkomo wadde eby’okuggyibwako; era omuntu ayinza okusuubira nti, wadde ng’abagoberezi ba Katonda oyo bayinza okusanga ebizibu bingi eby’ebweru, obulamu bwabwe obw’omunda obw’omwoyo bwandibadde bujjudde okubudaabuda bulijjo.

Naye mu mazima, emirundi mingi kirabika ng’okwawukana ddala, era obulamu obw’omwoyo obw’abantu ba Katonda abangi bujjudde, si kubudaabuda, wabula obuyinike bungi. Obuyinike buno buva mu kweraliikirira olw’enkolagana yaabwe ne Katonda, n’okubuusabuusa okwagala kwe. Beeraliikirira nga balowooza nti tebasaanira kulabirirwa Katonda olw’obutasaanira kwabwe, era bamuteebereza okuba nga tafaayo ku kulwanagana kwabwe oba nga abaleka mu biseera eby’obwetaavu.

Beeraliikirira era batawaanyizibwa buli kimu mu bulamu bwabwe obw’omwoyo—endowooza zaabwe n’enneewulira zaabwe, obutafaayo kwabwe ku Bayibuli, obutanyiikira kwabwe mu kusaba, n’obunnyogovu bw’emitima gyabwe.

Bazitoowererwa okwejjusa olw’ebiseera ebyayita era bajjudde okutya olw’ebiro ebijja. Beewulira nga tebasaanira kujja mu maaso ga Katonda era tebasobola kukkiriza nti ddala bantu ba Katonda. Bayinza okuwulira essanyu n’emirembe ne mikwano gyabwe egy’oku nsi, naye tebasobola kuwulira mirembe ne Katonda.

Era wadde ng’eyeeyita Katonda ow’okubudaabuda kwonna, beeyongera okugamba nti tebasobola kufuna kubudaabuda wonna; era ebyenyi byabwe ebinakuwavu n’amaloboozi gaabwe agaggwaamu essuubi bilaga nti boogera bya mazima, boogera amazima.

Abakristaayo ng’abo, wadde nga beeyita abagoberezi ba Katonda ow’okubudaabuda kwonna, basaasaanya ekizikiza n’obutabeera bulungi buli gye bagenda. Kizibu nnyo okukakasa omuntu yenna nti erinnya lino eddungi—Katonda lye yeyeyisaamu—kintu ekisingako ku bigambo eby’eddiini ebitaliimu makulu ga nnamaddala. Era ntya nnyo nti obulamu obw’abakristaayo abangi obulabika obutali bulungi bwe buvunaanyizibwa ku kitundu kinene eky’obutakkiriza mu nsi.

Omutume atugamba nti tuli “bbaluwa... ezisomebwa era ezitegeerebwa abantu bonna.” Abantu kye basoma mu ffe kisukka nnyo obukulu ku kubunyisa obwakabaka bwa Kristo okusinga bwe tutera okukitegeera. Si kye twogera ekisinga obukulu, wabula kye tuli. Kyangu okwogera ebigambo bingi ebirungi ku Katonda ng’ali Katonda ow’okubudaabuda kwonna; naye bwe tutamanya ffe ffennyini kye kitegeeza okubudaabudibwa mu butuufu, ebigambo byaffe biba bikalu bukalu. Abantu balina okulaba mu bulamu bwaffe kye bawulira mu bigambo byaffe, oba nno okwogera kwaffe kwonna kuleeta obulabe okusinga obulungi. Kyandibadde kya magezi gye tuli okwebuuza abalala kye basoma mu ffe. Kubudaabuda oba butabeera bulungi ekweraga mu bulamu bwaffe obwa buli lunaku?

Naye mu kifo kino omuntu ayinza okubuuza kye ntegeeza olw’okubudaabuda Katonda kw’awa. Kika ky’enneewulira ey’eddiini eyinza okututegekera eggulu naye etalina maanyi ga kutuyamba mu mazima g’obulamu bwa buli lunaku n’okugezesebwa kwabwo kwonna n’obulumi bwabwo? Oba kubudaabuda okwa nnamaddala era okwa mazima—okwo kwe tutegeera—okuleeta emirembe wakati mu bizibu by’obulamu? N’omutima gwange gwonna, nzikiriza nti kwe kwo okw’oluvannyuma.

Okubudaabuda, ka kube okw’omuntu oba okwa Katonda, kwe kubudaabuda—si kirala. Tetufaayo ku bigambo ebikalu; twagala ekintu eky’amazima. Era amazima ag’okubudaabudibwa gandabikira ng’ege limu ku bintu eby’omuwendo ennyo mu bulamu. Ffenna tukimanyi kye kiri. Nga tuli baana, bwe twaddukira maama waffe oluvannyuma lw’okulumizibwa oba okutiisibwa ne tuwulira emikono gye nga gitwetoolodde n’okutulabirira kwe okw’obuweweevu, twamanya okubudaabuda. Nga tukuze, oluvannyuma lw’olunaku oluwanvu, bwe tuwummula ne tuwulira emirembe, twamanya okubudaabuda. Endwadde bw’etandika okuwona n’amaanyi ne gakomawo, twamanya okubudaabuda. Omuntu gwe twagala bw’aba asemberedde okufa naye n’awona, twamanya okubudaabuda.

Emirundi mingi mu bulamu twagamba n’okuwummulamu nti, “Kino kya mirembe,” era mu kigambo ekyo mulimu okuwummula, okuwulira obulungi, n’essanyu ery’obusirifu ekizibu okunnyonnyola mu ngeri endala yonna. Kale tutegeera kye kitegeeza Katonda bw’ayitibwa “Katonda ow’okubudaabuda kwonna.”

Naye kya nnaku, tetukyakkirizza. Kirabise ng’ekirungi nnyo okuba amazima. Essanyu lyakyo lisukkiridde okukkirizibwa emitima gyaffe egy’okubuusabuusa. Emirundi egimu tuyinza okusuubira obumu obudde obutono obw’okubudaabuda, naye tutya okukkiriza obujjuvu bw’“okubudaabuda kwonna” kwe tulina mu bulokozi bwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo.

Naye Katonda yandyogedde ki ekisingawo ku kino: “Ng’omuntu nnyina gw’abudaabuda, bwe ntyo bwe ndibabudaabuda mmwe; era mulibudaabudibwa”? (Isaaya 66:13) Weetegereze okugeraageranya—nga... bwe ntyo. Kubudaabuda kwa mazima okutegeezebwa wano—okwo omwana kw’awulira ng’anyweddwa era ng’alabiriddwa maama we. Naye bameka ku ffe abakkirizza ddala nti okubudaabuda kwa Katonda kwa mazima era kuweweevu ng’okwa maama, oba n’okusembera awo? Mu kifo ky’okweraba nga tunyweddwa okumpi n’omutima gwe, emirundi mingi tumulowoozezaako ng’omulamuzi omukambwe era ali ewala, ayagala okussibwamu ekitiibwa era akuuma ku nsobi zaffe. Kyewuunyisa nti eddiini yaffe etufudde abatali ba mirembe mu kifo ky’okutuleetera okubudaabuda? Ani ayinza okuwulira emirembe mu maaso g’omulamuzi ng’oyo?

Naye nsanyuka okugamba nti omulamuzi ng’oyo taliwo. Katonda ali mu butuufu afaanana nga maama ayagala. Ayogera lwatu nti, “Ng’omuntu nnyina gw’abudaabuda, bwe ntyo bwe ndibabudaabuda mmwe.”
