Akiddiŋŋana n’akiddiŋŋana. “Nze, Nze, nze oyo ababudaabuda,” bw’agamba abantu be. Ate n’abuuza lwaki bakyatidde: lwaki ekintu kyonna kyandibatiisizza ng’Omutonzi wammwe yennyini yeeteeseteese era ayagala okubabudaabuda? Lwaki okutya amaanyi g’abalala ne mwerabira Oyo eyatonda ebintu byonna?

Katonda ali ddala ye Katonda era Kitaawe wa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo—Katonda eyayagala ensi ennyo ne kiba nti yatuma Omwana we, si kugisalira musango, wabula okugirokola. Ye Katonda eyatuma Kristo “okusiba abalina emitima egimenyese... okubudaabuda bonna abakungubaga.” (Isaaya 61:1-3) Weetegereze ekigambo ekyo bonna. Si abatono bokka, wabula buli omu. Buli mutima oguli mu nnaku, buli mmeeme erwanagana, mulimu. Singa n’omu yasigalibwa ebweru, tekyandibadde “bonna.” Emirundi mingi neebazizza nti n’abanafu n’abateganyizibwa balimu mu ngeri ey’enjawulo mu Byawandiikibwa. Tulagirwa obutanenya bantu ng’abo, wabula okubabudaabuda. Abo abeetaaga okubudaabuda ennyo be bo Katonda b’ayagala okubudaabuda ennyo—si abanyweevu, wabula abanafu.

Kuno kwe kuwaana kw’eddiini ey’okwagala. Kristo yatumibwa okubudaabuda bonna abakungubaga. Katonda ow’okubudaabuda kwonna yatuma Omwana we okuleeta okubudaabuda mu nsi ejjudde ennaku. Era mu bulamu bwe bwonna, Kristo yatuukiriza omulimu guno.

Abayigirizwa be bwe baayagala okumusaba okussa omusango ku abo abaamugaana, yabanenya n’agamba nti teyajja kuzikiriza bulamu wabula okubulokola. Yasembeza aboonoonyi. Yalaga okusaasira mu kifo abalala mwe baalaga okusalira omusango. Eri omukazi eyakwatibwa mu kwonoona, yagamba nti, “Nange sikusalira musango; genda, era okuva kaakati toddangayo kwonoona.” (Yokaana 8:11) Buli wantu, yayimirira ku ludda lw’abo abeetaaga. Ekyo kye kyali ekigendererwa kye—okulokola aboonoonyi.

Abawala babiri abato lwali baali boogera ku Katonda, omu n’agamba nti, “Sirowooza nti Katonda anjagala. Ndi mutono nnyo era simuli maanyi.”

Omulala n’addamu nti, “Naye abo be bo ddala Katonda b’afaako—abantu nga ffe abatasobola kwewangula bokka.”

“Ekyo kya mazima?” omusooka n’agamba. “Kale sseetaaga kweraliikirira nate.”

Oba waliwo asoma bino awulira okutya oba okuteganyizibwa, ka njogere lwatu: kino kye kituufu Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo ky’ali—okulabirira n’okubudaabuda bonna abakungubaga. Bonna—buli omu, ng’oli mw’oli. Tekyandibadde “bonna” singa ggwe wasigala ebweru. Ne bw’oba weewulira ng’oyongobedde ddala, ye ayogerwako ng’Oyo “abudaabuda abayongobevu.”

Nga kigendererwa kirungi—okuleeta okubudaabuda mu nsi ejjudde ennaku. Era nga nneegomba nnyo buli mutima oguteganyiziddwa okufuna okubudaabuda kuno okuva eri Katonda.

Era Omubudaabudi waffe tali wala. Ali kumpi. Asigala naffe. Kristo bwe yali anaatera okuva mu nsi eno, yagamba abayigirizwa be nti taalibaleke bokka, wabula anaabaweereza “Omubeezi omulala” abeere nabo emirembe gyonna. Omubudaabudi ono yandibayigirizza era n’abajjukiza amazima gonna.

Ate n’agattako nti: “Emirembe mbaleetera; emirembe gyange mbawa... Emitima gyammwe gireme okweraliikirira, so tegitya.” (Yokaana 14:27) Tuyinza tutya okusigala nga tutidde nga tulaba ebigambo ng’ebyo?

“Omubudaabudi”—kigambo kya kitalo, singa kyokka tukitegeera ddala. Ka tukifumiitirizeeko okutuusa lwe kifuuka amazima gye tuli. Era si mubudaabudi ajja n’agenda, wabula oyo asigalawo—abeerawo bulijjo, mwetegefu bulijjo okuleeta essanyu mu kifo ky’ennaku.

Omubudaabudi abeerera ennaku zonna—amazima ag’ekitalo. N’okuba n’omukwano ow’omuntu asigala naffe mu buzibu kuyamba nnyo. Naye wano waliwo Omubudaabudi owa Katonda ali naffe bulijjo era obusobozi bwe obw’okubudaabuda tebuggwaawo. Tewandibadde kaseera we tuli awatali kubudaabuda.

Naye bangi tebakitegeera. Singa bakitegeera, tewandibadde bakristaayo bangi bwe batyo abateganyizibwa.

Oyinza okubuuza oba Omubudaabudi ono atuluŋŋamya, era oba ekyo kiyinza okubudaabuda ddala.

Mu butuufu, eno y’emu ku ngeri z’atubudaabuzaamu. Twandibadde tutya awatali muntu w’atulaga ensobi zaffe n’atuyamba okukyuka?

Singa nnali ntambula n’ekyonoono mu ndabika yange kye ssimanyi, kyandibadde kya kisa ku mukwano gwange okukindaga. Mu ngeri y’emu, kya kubudaabuda okumanya nti Omwoyo mpolampola atulaga ensobi zaffe tuleme okusigala nga tetuzimanyi.

Waliwo okubudaabuda ne mu kunenya, kubanga kuleeta okuwona. Katonda “abudaabuda ebifo byaffe byonna ebyazika” ng’atulaga ekyetaaga okuzzibwa obuggya n’oluvannyuma n’akizza obuggya.

Oyinza okuwulira nga tosaanira kubudaabuda ng’okwo. Ekyo kiyinza okuba amazima—naye ekyo kyennyini kye kikuleetera okukwetaaga.

Kristo yajja kulokola boonoonyi, si abo abeerowooza okuba nga basaanira. Obwetaavu bwo bwe busaanyizo bwo.

Ekkubo ery’okufuna okubudaabuda kwa Katonda emirundi mingi liyita mu kutegeera obwetaavu bwaffe olw’okwo. Kye kiva Katonda oluusi n’akkiriza ennaku okujja. Mu bifo ebizibu, tusobola okuwulira eddoboozi lye obulungi. Emirundi mingi mu ddungu mwe tuwulira ebigambo bye eby’okubudaabuda.

Katonda amanyi nti kirungi gye tuli okufuna okubudaabuda kwe, ne bwe kuyita mu kugezesebwa, okusinga obutakufunako n’akatono. Ky’atuwa kisukka nnyo ku kye tufiirwa. Eby’ensi biyinza okuggwaawo, naye ky’atuwa kya mirembe gyonna.

Nga Pawulo, tusobola okutuuka okulaba nti buli kintu kifa ku bwereere bwe kigeraageranyizibwa n’okumanya Kristo.

Naye mu ngeri ey’ekitalo, obulamu bwe bwanguyira, tukkiriza nti Katonda ye Katonda ow’okubudaabuda kwonna—naye bwe tuba twetaaga okubudaabuda mu butuufu, tulwanagana okukkiriza nti kuliwo. Kiba ng’okukyusa amakulu g’Ekyawandiikibwa mu mitima gyaffe. Mu kifo ky’okukkiriza nti “Balina omukisa abakungubaga, kubanga balibudaabudibwa,” tutandika okulowooza nti abo bokka abasanyufu dda be balifuna okubudaabuda.

Tuyinza n’okunyoola ebigambo nga “Katonda abudaabuda abayongobevu” ne tubifuula ekintu ekyawukana ddala, ng’omuntu eyeerabira oba atafaayo ku abo abalwanagana. Era mu kukola bwe tutyo, tufiirwa okubudaabuda kwennyini kwe tuweereddwa.

Naye Katonda agamba nti anatubudaabuda ku njuyi zonna. Tewali kisigala bweru. Naye mu biseera eby’okuteganyizibwa, emirundi mingi tukkiriza nti tewali kubudaabuda mu kifo kyennyini gye tukwetaagira ennyo. Kino si kubanga Katonda alemereddwa, wabula kubanga ffe twabuusabuusa.

Kiri nga Isirayiri ow’edda. Katonda yalangirira okubudaabuda kwe, naye bo ne bagamba nti, “Mukama anneerabidde.”

N’okuddamu kwe ne kujja nga kujjudde obuweweevu: omukazi ayinza okwerabira omwana we? Ne bw’ayinza, Katonda talyerabira. Tuli mu maaso ge bulijjo.

Kale mubudaabudibwe.

Naye oyinza okwongera okubuuza, oyinza otya okufuna okubudaabuda kuno? Eky’okuddamu kyangu: olina okukukkiriza. Katonda awa okubudaabuda kwe obutakoma—naye bw’otokufuna, tosobola kukuwulira.

Okubudaabuda kwa Katonda tekutujjira mu ngeri ey’ekyama oba ey’obutamanyibwa. Kujja nga kuyita mu nkola ennyonnyofu era ennyangu. Omubudaabudi abeera mu ffe atujjukiza amazima ag’okubudaabuda agakwata ku Mukama waffe, era bwe tugakkiriza, tubudaabudibwa.

Olunyiriri lw’Ekyawandiikibwa luyinza okujja mu birowoozo, oba omukutu gw’oluyimba, oba okujjukizibwa mu bukkakkamu okwagala kwa Kristo n’okulabirira kwe okw’obuweweevu. Bwe tukikkiriza mu kukkiriza okw’obwangu, okubudaabuda kugoberera mu butonde. Naye bwe tugaana okuwuliriza eddoboozi ly’Omubudaabudi ne tuwaayo ekitiibwa eri okuggwaamu essuubi oba okwewuunya, olwo tewali kubudaabuda kuyinza kutuuka ku mmeeme zaffe.

Ne maama ayinza okufuka okwagala kwe kwonna awatali kugasa ku mwana agaana okubudaabudibwa. Omwana ayinza okutuula ng’akakanyavu era nga takyuka, ng’agaana buli kigambo. Mu ngeri y’emu, ebigambo eby’okubudaabuda bisobola kutubudaabuda bwe tubikkiriza.

Katonda ayogedde ebigambo eby’okubudaabuda ebimala okuweweeza ensi yonna, naye abakristaayo bangi basigala nga beeraliikirivu, nga bazitoowereddwa, era nga tebateredde. Lwaki? Kubanga tebakkiriza bigambo ebyo kuyingira mu mitima gyabwe. Abamu bakkiriza n’okuba nti kya kyonoono okuwulira okubudaabuda—beewulira nga tebasaanira. Era okubudaabuda bwe kutandika okusituka munda mu bo, bakusindiikiriza, nga bakugaana, nga Ekyawandiikibwa bwe kigamba nti, “baagaana okubudaabudibwa.” (Yeremiya 31:15) Tugambibwa nti buli kyawandiikibwa mu Byawandiikibwa kyaweebwa tulyoke, olw’okugumiikiriza n’okubudaabuda kwe kiwa, tubeere n’essuubi. Naye okubudaabuda kuno kuyinza kujja kuyita mu kukkiriza kwokka.

Tewali Katonda ky’ayogera kiyinza kuleeta mirembe mu mutima ogubuusabuusa amazima gaakyo.

Omukulu w’ekyombo bw’atukakasa nti ekyombo kirungi, tulina okumukkiriza tusobole okuwummula. Omukubiriza w’eggaali y’omukka bw’atugamba nti tuli mu ggaali entuufu, tulina okwesiga ekigambo kye tusobole okutuula mu mirembe. Kino kyeeyoleka lwatu mu bulamu obwa bulijjo—naye mu bintu eby’omwoyo, emirundi mingi tukiraba nga tekikulu.

Abantu abamu bagezaako n’okuwulira okubudaabuda nga tebannakkiriza bisuubizo bya Katonda. Naye ekyo kikyusa entegeka yonna. Nga omutambuze bw’atasobola kuwulira bukuume nga tannaba kwesiga omuluŋŋamya, bwe tutyo tetusobola kuwulira kubudaabuda nga tetunnakkiriza Katonda.

Entegeka ya Katonda nnyangu: sooka kukkiriza, olwo owulire.

Ffe emirundi mingi tugikyusa: sooka kuwulira, olwo okkirize.

Okukyusa kuno kwe muzi gw’okulwanagana kwaffe okungi.

Lowooza ku kino: bwe tuba tuzitoowereddwa okweraliikirira, Katonda atugamba obuteeraliikirira, wabula okuteeka obuyinike bwaffe ku ye kubanga atufaako. Atulaga ennyonyi ez’omu bbanga n’amalanga ag’omu nnimiro, ng’atukakasa nti tusinga nnyo omuwendo okuzisukka.

Kubudaabuda ki okusingawo okuyinza okubaawo okusinga kuno—nti Omutonzi w’eggulu n’ensi yeetikka obuvunaanyizibwa obw’okutulabirira?

Naye, bangi tebabudaabudibwa. Lwaki? Kubanga tebakikkiriza. Basiima ebigambo, beegomba nga bya mazima, naye bakubira ku kubikkiriza nga bikwata ku bo. Balindirira enneewulira okukakasa amazima, mu kifo ky’okwesiga amazima gennyini.

Tugamba nti, “Singa nnali nsobola okuwulira nti kya mazima.”

Katonda agamba nti, “Singa oba okkiriza nti kya mazima.”

Ku muzi gw’okubulwa okubudaabuda kwaffe kuli obutakkiriza bwokka.

Eddagala lyeyoleka lwatu. Bwe twagala okubudaabuda, tulina okulonda okukkiriza buli kigambo eky’okubudaabuda Katonda ky’ayogedde. Tulina okugaana okuwuliriza amaloboozi ag’okubuusabuusa—ka gave mu mbeera zaffe oba mu birowoozo byaffe.

Kino kyetaagisa obumalirivu. Tulina okunyweza emitima gyaffe—ng’ejjinja ery’embaalebaale—okukkiriza, ne bwe kiba nti buli kintu ekitwetoolodde kirabika nga kya njawulo. Okubudaabudibwa si kya butafuba; kizingiramu okwagala kwaffe. Tulina okukulonda.

Obulamu bwe buwulikika ng’obutali bukakafu, tulina okugamba nti: “Katonda akyogedde. Kyekiva kiba kya mazima. Nzija kukikkiriza, ne bwe kiba kirabika kitya.”

Era bwe tumaze okulonda okukkiriza, tulina okugaana okudda mu kubuusabuusa.

Buli abeera bw’atyo, oluvannyuma oba mangu, alyingira mu kubudaabuda okwa nnamaddala era okuwangaala.

Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli yagamba nti, “Mu bungi bw’ebirowoozo byange eby’omunda, okubudaabuda kwo kusanyusa emmeeme yange.”

Naye emirundi mingi ebirowoozo byaffe bijjudde ebizibu byaffe okusinga okubudaabuda kwa Katonda. Bwe twagala okubudaabudibwa, tulina okugenderera okufumiitiriza ku bisuubizo bye.

Kiyinza okuyamba okwekebejja ebirowoozo byaffe: emirundi emeka gye tulowooza ku kubudaabuda kwa Katonda nga tugeraageranya n’okweraliikirira kwaffe?

Eky’okuddamu kiyinza okutwewuunyisa.

Ekisembayo, ekigambo eri abo ababuulira Enjiri.

Obubaka bwo bwe buluwa?

Bwe buno: “Mubudaabude abantu bange.”

Si kubanenya, si kubazitoowerera—wabula okubabudaabuda.

Enjiri ey’amazima bwe bubaka obulungi—obulungi obutaliimu ka kizibu. Naye emirundi mingi butabulwamu ebiragiro, okulabula, n’ebyongerwako by’abantu ebiggyako okubudaabuda kwabwo.

Kristo abudaabuda.

Omuntu emirundi mingi azibuwaza.

Enjiri ey’amazima efaanana ng’obubaka bwa malayika eri abasumba: “Temutya. Mbaleetera amawulire amalungi ag’essanyu eddene ery’abantu bonna.” (Lukka 2:10) Bino bye bigambo ebireeta okubudaabuda okw’amazima.

Singa buli mubuulizi yalangirira ebigambo ng’ebyo mu bweru, era buli awuliriza n’abikkiriza, tewandibaddewo bakristaayo abateredde, abeeraliikirivu. Wabula, emitima buli wantu gyandinyweziddwa era ne gijjuzibwa emirembe.

Era okusaba kuno kwandituukiriziddwa: Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo yennyini, ne Katonda Kitaffe—eyatwagala n’atuwa okubudaabuda okutaggwaawo n’essuubi eddungi olw’ekisa—abudaabude emitima gyammwe era abanyweze mu buli kigambo ekirungi ne buli mulimu omulungi.
fields.body_text: “Yeebazibwe Katonda, era Kitaawe wa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, Kitaawe w’okusaasira era Katonda ow’okubudaabuda kwonna, atubudaabuda mu kubonaabona kwaffe kwonna, tulyoke tusobole okubudaabuda abo abali mu kubonaabona kwonna, n’okubudaabuda Katonda kwe yatubudaabuza ffe ffennyini.” (2 Abakkolinso 1:3-4) Mu mannya gonna agabikkula Katonda, lino—“Katonda ow’okubudaabuda kwonna”—kirabika gye ndi ng’erimu ku agasinga obulungi era agawa emmeeme amaanyi ennyo. Ebigambo bino “okubudaabuda kwonna” tebiriimu kkomo wadde eby’okuggyibwako; era omuntu ayinza okusuubira nti, wadde ng’abagoberezi ba Katonda oyo bayinza okusanga ebizibu bingi eby’ebweru, obulamu bwabwe obw’omunda obw’omwoyo bwandibadde bujjudde okubudaabuda bulijjo. Naye mu mazima, emirundi mingi kirabika ng’okwawukana ddala, era obulamu obw’omwoyo obw’abantu ba Katonda abangi bujjudde, si kubudaabuda, wabula obuyinike bungi. Obuyinike buno buva mu kweraliikirira olw’enkolagana yaabwe ne Katonda, n’okubuusabuusa okwagala kwe. Beeraliikirira nga balowooza nti tebasaanira kulabirirwa Katonda olw’obutasaanira kwabwe, era bamuteebereza okuba nga tafaayo ku kulwanagana kwabwe oba nga abaleka mu biseera eby’obwetaavu. Beeraliikirira era batawaanyizibwa buli kimu mu bulamu bwabwe obw’omwoyo—endowooza zaabwe n’enneewulira zaabwe, obutafaayo kwabwe ku Bayibuli, obutanyiikira kwabwe mu kusaba, n’obunnyogovu bw’emitima gyabwe. Bazitoowererwa okwejjusa olw’ebiseera ebyayita era bajjudde okutya olw’ebiro ebijja. Beewulira nga tebasaanira kujja mu maaso ga Katonda era tebasobola kukkiriza nti ddala bantu ba Katonda. Bayinza okuwulira essanyu n’emirembe ne mikwano gyabwe egy’oku nsi, naye tebasobola kuwulira mirembe ne Katonda. Era wadde ng’eyeeyita Katonda ow’okubudaabuda kwonna, beeyongera okugamba nti tebasobola kufuna kubudaabuda wonna; era ebyenyi byabwe ebinakuwavu n’amaloboozi gaabwe agaggwaamu essuubi bilaga nti boogera bya mazima, boogera amazima. Abakristaayo ng’abo, wadde nga beeyita abagoberezi ba Katonda ow’okubudaabuda kwonna, basaasaanya ekizikiza n’obutabeera bulungi buli gye bagenda. Kizibu nnyo okukakasa omuntu yenna nti erinnya lino eddungi—Katonda lye yeyeyisaamu—kintu ekisingako ku bigambo eby’eddiini ebitaliimu makulu ga nnamaddala. Era ntya nnyo nti obulamu obw’abakristaayo abangi obulabika obutali bulungi bwe buvunaanyizibwa ku kitundu kinene eky’obutakkiriza mu nsi. Omutume atugamba nti tuli “bbaluwa... ezisomebwa era ezitegeerebwa abantu bonna.” Abantu kye basoma mu ffe kisukka nnyo obukulu ku kubunyisa obwakabaka bwa Kristo okusinga bwe tutera okukitegeera. Si kye twogera ekisinga obukulu, wabula kye tuli. Kyangu okwogera ebigambo bingi ebirungi ku Katonda ng’ali Katonda ow’okubudaabuda kwonna; naye bwe tutamanya ffe ffennyini kye kitegeeza okubudaabudibwa mu butuufu, ebigambo byaffe biba bikalu bukalu. Abantu balina okulaba mu bulamu bwaffe kye bawulira mu bigambo byaffe, oba nno okwogera kwaffe kwonna kuleeta obulabe okusinga obulungi. Kyandibadde kya magezi gye tuli okwebuuza abalala kye basoma mu ffe. Kubudaabuda oba butabeera bulungi ekweraga mu bulamu bwaffe obwa buli lunaku? Naye mu kifo kino omuntu ayinza okubuuza kye ntegeeza olw’okubudaabuda Katonda kw’awa. Kika ky’enneewulira ey’eddiini eyinza okututegekera eggulu naye etalina maanyi ga kutuyamba mu mazima g’obulamu bwa buli lunaku n’okugezesebwa kwabwo kwonna n’obulumi bwabwo? Oba kubudaabuda okwa nnamaddala era okwa mazima—okwo kwe tutegeera—okuleeta emirembe wakati mu bizibu by’obulamu? N’omutima gwange gwonna, nzikiriza nti kwe kwo okw’oluvannyuma. Okubudaabuda, ka kube okw’omuntu oba okwa Katonda, kwe kubudaabuda—si kirala. Tetufaayo ku bigambo ebikalu; twagala ekintu eky’amazima. Era amazima ag’okubudaabudibwa gandabikira ng’ege limu ku bintu eby’omuwendo ennyo mu bulamu. Ffenna tukimanyi kye kiri. Nga tuli baana, bwe twaddukira maama waffe oluvannyuma lw’okulumizibwa oba okutiisibwa ne tuwulira emikono gye nga gitwetoolodde n’okutulabirira kwe okw’obuweweevu, twamanya okubudaabuda. Nga tukuze, oluvannyuma lw’olunaku oluwanvu, bwe tuwummula ne tuwulira emirembe, twamanya okubudaabuda. Endwadde bw’etandika okuwona n’amaanyi ne gakomawo, twamanya okubudaabuda. Omuntu gwe twagala bw’aba asemberedde okufa naye n’awona, twamanya okubudaabuda. Emirundi mingi mu bulamu twagamba n’okuwummulamu nti, “Kino kya mirembe,” era mu kigambo ekyo mulimu okuwummula, okuwulira obulungi, n’essanyu ery’obusirifu ekizibu okunnyonnyola mu ngeri endala yonna. Kale tutegeera kye kitegeeza Katonda bw’ayitibwa “Katonda ow’okubudaabuda kwonna.” Naye kya nnaku, tetukyakkirizza. Kirabise ng’ekirungi nnyo okuba amazima. Essanyu lyakyo lisukkiridde okukkirizibwa emitima gyaffe egy’okubuusabuusa. Emirundi egimu tuyinza okusuubira obumu obudde obutono obw’okubudaabuda, naye tutya okukkiriza obujjuvu bw’“okubudaabuda kwonna” kwe tulina mu bulokozi bwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo. Naye Katonda yandyogedde ki ekisingawo ku kino: “Ng’omuntu nnyina gw’abudaabuda, bwe ntyo bwe ndibabudaabuda mmwe; era mulibudaabudibwa”? (Isaaya 66:13) Weetegereze okugeraageranya—nga... bwe ntyo. Kubudaabuda kwa mazima okutegeezebwa wano—okwo omwana kw’awulira ng’anyweddwa era ng’alabiriddwa maama we. Naye bameka ku ffe abakkirizza ddala nti okubudaabuda kwa Katonda kwa mazima era kuweweevu ng’okwa maama, oba n’okusembera awo? Mu kifo ky’okweraba nga tunyweddwa okumpi n’omutima gwe, emirundi mingi tumulowoozezaako ng’omulamuzi omukambwe era ali ewala, ayagala okussibwamu ekitiibwa era akuuma ku nsobi zaffe. Kyewuunyisa nti eddiini yaffe etufudde abatali ba mirembe mu kifo ky’okutuleetera okubudaabuda? Ani ayinza okuwulira emirembe mu maaso g’omulamuzi ng’oyo? Naye nsanyuka okugamba nti omulamuzi ng’oyo taliwo. Katonda ali mu butuufu afaanana nga maama ayagala. Ayogera lwatu nti, “Ng’omuntu nnyina gw’abudaabuda, bwe ntyo bwe ndibabudaabuda mmwe.” Akiddiŋŋana n’akiddiŋŋana. “Nze, Nze, nze oyo ababudaabuda,” bw’agamba abantu be. Ate n’abuuza lwaki bakyatidde: lwaki ekintu kyonna kyandibatiisizza ng’Omutonzi wammwe yennyini yeeteeseteese era ayagala okubabudaabuda? Lwaki okutya amaanyi g’abalala ne mwerabira Oyo eyatonda ebintu byonna? Katonda ali ddala ye Katonda era Kitaawe wa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo—Katonda eyayagala ensi ennyo ne kiba nti yatuma Omwana we, si kugisalira musango, wabula okugirokola. Ye Katonda eyatuma Kristo “okusiba abalina emitima egimenyese... okubudaabuda bonna abakungubaga.” (Isaaya 61:1-3) Weetegereze ekigambo ekyo bonna. Si abatono bokka, wabula buli omu. Buli mutima oguli mu nnaku, buli mmeeme erwanagana, mulimu. Singa n’omu yasigalibwa ebweru, tekyandibadde “bonna.” Emirundi mingi neebazizza nti n’abanafu n’abateganyizibwa balimu mu ngeri ey’enjawulo mu Byawandiikibwa. Tulagirwa obutanenya bantu ng’abo, wabula okubabudaabuda. Abo abeetaaga okubudaabuda ennyo be bo Katonda b’ayagala okubudaabuda ennyo—si abanyweevu, wabula abanafu. Kuno kwe kuwaana kw’eddiini ey’okwagala. Kristo yatumibwa okubudaabuda bonna abakungubaga. Katonda ow’okubudaabuda kwonna yatuma Omwana we okuleeta okubudaabuda mu nsi ejjudde ennaku. Era mu bulamu bwe bwonna, Kristo yatuukiriza omulimu guno. Abayigirizwa be bwe baayagala okumusaba okussa omusango ku abo abaamugaana, yabanenya n’agamba nti teyajja kuzikiriza bulamu wabula okubulokola. Yasembeza aboonoonyi. Yalaga okusaasira mu kifo abalala mwe baalaga okusalira omusango. Eri omukazi eyakwatibwa mu kwonoona, yagamba nti, “Nange sikusalira musango; genda, era okuva kaakati toddangayo kwonoona.” (Yokaana 8:11) Buli wantu, yayimirira ku ludda lw’abo abeetaaga. Ekyo kye kyali ekigendererwa kye—okulokola aboonoonyi. Abawala babiri abato lwali baali boogera ku Katonda, omu n’agamba nti, “Sirowooza nti Katonda anjagala. Ndi mutono nnyo era simuli maanyi.” Omulala n’addamu nti, “Naye abo be bo ddala Katonda b’afaako—abantu nga ffe abatasobola kwewangula bokka.” “Ekyo kya mazima?” omusooka n’agamba. “Kale sseetaaga kweraliikirira nate.” Oba waliwo asoma bino awulira okutya oba okuteganyizibwa, ka njogere lwatu: kino kye kituufu Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo ky’ali—okulabirira n’okubudaabuda bonna abakungubaga. Bonna—buli omu, ng’oli mw’oli. Tekyandibadde “bonna” singa ggwe wasigala ebweru. Ne bw’oba weewulira ng’oyongobedde ddala, ye ayogerwako ng’Oyo “abudaabuda abayongobevu.” Nga kigendererwa kirungi—okuleeta okubudaabuda mu nsi ejjudde ennaku. Era nga nneegomba nnyo buli mutima oguteganyiziddwa okufuna okubudaabuda kuno okuva eri Katonda. Era Omubudaabudi waffe tali wala. Ali kumpi. Asigala naffe. Kristo bwe yali anaatera okuva mu nsi eno, yagamba abayigirizwa be nti taalibaleke bokka, wabula anaabaweereza “Omubeezi omulala” abeere nabo emirembe gyonna. Omubudaabudi ono yandibayigirizza era n’abajjukiza amazima gonna. Ate n’agattako nti: “Emirembe mbaleetera; emirembe gyange mbawa... Emitima gyammwe gireme okweraliikirira, so tegitya.” (Yokaana 14:27) Tuyinza tutya okusigala nga tutidde nga tulaba ebigambo ng’ebyo? “Omubudaabudi”—kigambo kya kitalo, singa kyokka tukitegeera ddala. Ka tukifumiitirizeeko okutuusa lwe kifuuka amazima gye tuli. Era si mubudaabudi ajja n’agenda, wabula oyo asigalawo—abeerawo bulijjo, mwetegefu bulijjo okuleeta essanyu mu kifo ky’ennaku. Omubudaabudi abeerera ennaku zonna—amazima ag’ekitalo. N’okuba n’omukwano ow’omuntu asigala naffe mu buzibu kuyamba nnyo. Naye wano waliwo Omubudaabudi owa Katonda ali naffe bulijjo era obusobozi bwe obw’okubudaabuda tebuggwaawo. Tewandibadde kaseera we tuli awatali kubudaabuda. Naye bangi tebakitegeera. Singa bakitegeera, tewandibadde bakristaayo bangi bwe batyo abateganyizibwa. Oyinza okubuuza oba Omubudaabudi ono atuluŋŋamya, era oba ekyo kiyinza okubudaabuda ddala. Mu butuufu, eno y’emu ku ngeri z’atubudaabuzaamu. Twandibadde tutya awatali muntu w’atulaga ensobi zaffe n’atuyamba okukyuka? Singa nnali ntambula n’ekyonoono mu ndabika yange kye ssimanyi, kyandibadde kya kisa ku mukwano gwange okukindaga. Mu ngeri y’emu, kya kubudaabuda okumanya nti Omwoyo mpolampola atulaga ensobi zaffe tuleme okusigala nga tetuzimanyi. Waliwo okubudaabuda ne mu kunenya, kubanga kuleeta okuwona. Katonda “abudaabuda ebifo byaffe byonna ebyazika” ng’atulaga ekyetaaga okuzzibwa obuggya n’oluvannyuma n’akizza obuggya. Oyinza okuwulira nga tosaanira kubudaabuda ng’okwo. Ekyo kiyinza okuba amazima—naye ekyo kyennyini kye kikuleetera okukwetaaga. Kristo yajja kulokola boonoonyi, si abo abeerowooza okuba nga basaanira. Obwetaavu bwo bwe busaanyizo bwo. Ekkubo ery’okufuna okubudaabuda kwa Katonda emirundi mingi liyita mu kutegeera obwetaavu bwaffe olw’okwo. Kye kiva Katonda oluusi n’akkiriza ennaku okujja. Mu bifo ebizibu, tusobola okuwulira eddoboozi lye obulungi. Emirundi mingi mu ddungu mwe tuwulira ebigambo bye eby’okubudaabuda. Katonda amanyi nti kirungi gye tuli okufuna okubudaabuda kwe, ne bwe kuyita mu kugezesebwa, okusinga obutakufunako n’akatono. Ky’atuwa kisukka nnyo ku kye tufiirwa. Eby’ensi biyinza okuggwaawo, naye ky’atuwa kya mirembe gyonna. Nga Pawulo, tusobola okutuuka okulaba nti buli kintu kifa ku bwereere bwe kigeraageranyizibwa n’okumanya Kristo. Naye mu ngeri ey’ekitalo, obulamu bwe bwanguyira, tukkiriza nti Katonda ye Katonda ow’okubudaabuda kwonna—naye bwe tuba twetaaga okubudaabuda mu butuufu, tulwanagana okukkiriza nti kuliwo. Kiba ng’okukyusa amakulu g’Ekyawandiikibwa mu mitima gyaffe. Mu kifo ky’okukkiriza nti “Balina omukisa abakungubaga, kubanga balibudaabudibwa,” tutandika okulowooza nti abo bokka abasanyufu dda be balifuna okubudaabuda. Tuyinza n’okunyoola ebigambo nga “Katonda abudaabuda abayongobevu” ne tubifuula ekintu ekyawukana ddala, ng’omuntu eyeerabira oba atafaayo ku abo abalwanagana. Era mu kukola bwe tutyo, tufiirwa okubudaabuda kwennyini kwe tuweereddwa. Naye Katonda agamba nti anatubudaabuda ku njuyi zonna. Tewali kisigala bweru. Naye mu biseera eby’okuteganyizibwa, emirundi mingi tukkiriza nti tewali kubudaabuda mu kifo kyennyini gye tukwetaagira ennyo. Kino si kubanga Katonda alemereddwa, wabula kubanga ffe twabuusabuusa. Kiri nga Isirayiri ow’edda. Katonda yalangirira okubudaabuda kwe, naye bo ne bagamba nti, “Mukama anneerabidde.” N’okuddamu kwe ne kujja nga kujjudde obuweweevu: omukazi ayinza okwerabira omwana we? Ne bw’ayinza, Katonda talyerabira. Tuli mu maaso ge bulijjo. Kale mubudaabudibwe. Naye oyinza okwongera okubuuza, oyinza otya okufuna okubudaabuda kuno? Eky’okuddamu kyangu: olina okukukkiriza. Katonda awa okubudaabuda kwe obutakoma—naye bw’otokufuna, tosobola kukuwulira. Okubudaabuda kwa Katonda tekutujjira mu ngeri ey’ekyama oba ey’obutamanyibwa. Kujja nga kuyita mu nkola ennyonnyofu era ennyangu. Omubudaabudi abeera mu ffe atujjukiza amazima ag’okubudaabuda agakwata ku Mukama waffe, era bwe tugakkiriza, tubudaabudibwa. Olunyiriri lw’Ekyawandiikibwa luyinza okujja mu birowoozo, oba omukutu gw’oluyimba, oba okujjukizibwa mu bukkakkamu okwagala kwa Kristo n’okulabirira kwe okw’obuweweevu. Bwe tukikkiriza mu kukkiriza okw’obwangu, okubudaabuda kugoberera mu butonde. Naye bwe tugaana okuwuliriza eddoboozi ly’Omubudaabudi ne tuwaayo ekitiibwa eri okuggwaamu essuubi oba okwewuunya, olwo tewali kubudaabuda kuyinza kutuuka ku mmeeme zaffe. Ne maama ayinza okufuka okwagala kwe kwonna awatali kugasa ku mwana agaana okubudaabudibwa. Omwana ayinza okutuula ng’akakanyavu era nga takyuka, ng’agaana buli kigambo. Mu ngeri y’emu, ebigambo eby’okubudaabuda bisobola kutubudaabuda bwe tubikkiriza. Katonda ayogedde ebigambo eby’okubudaabuda ebimala okuweweeza ensi yonna, naye abakristaayo bangi basigala nga beeraliikirivu, nga bazitoowereddwa, era nga tebateredde. Lwaki? Kubanga tebakkiriza bigambo ebyo kuyingira mu mitima gyabwe. Abamu bakkiriza n’okuba nti kya kyonoono okuwulira okubudaabuda—beewulira nga tebasaanira. Era okubudaabuda bwe kutandika okusituka munda mu bo, bakusindiikiriza, nga bakugaana, nga Ekyawandiikibwa bwe kigamba nti, “baagaana okubudaabudibwa.” (Yeremiya 31:15) Tugambibwa nti buli kyawandiikibwa mu Byawandiikibwa kyaweebwa tulyoke, olw’okugumiikiriza n’okubudaabuda kwe kiwa, tubeere n’essuubi. Naye okubudaabuda kuno kuyinza kujja kuyita mu kukkiriza kwokka. Tewali Katonda ky’ayogera kiyinza kuleeta mirembe mu mutima ogubuusabuusa amazima gaakyo. Omukulu w’ekyombo bw’atukakasa nti ekyombo kirungi, tulina okumukkiriza tusobole okuwummula. Omukubiriza w’eggaali y’omukka bw’atugamba nti tuli mu ggaali entuufu, tulina okwesiga ekigambo kye tusobole okutuula mu mirembe. Kino kyeeyoleka lwatu mu bulamu obwa bulijjo—naye mu bintu eby’omwoyo, emirundi mingi tukiraba nga tekikulu. Abantu abamu bagezaako n’okuwulira okubudaabuda nga tebannakkiriza bisuubizo bya Katonda. Naye ekyo kikyusa entegeka yonna. Nga omutambuze bw’atasobola kuwulira bukuume nga tannaba kwesiga omuluŋŋamya, bwe tutyo tetusobola kuwulira kubudaabuda nga tetunnakkiriza Katonda. Entegeka ya Katonda nnyangu: sooka kukkiriza, olwo owulire. Ffe emirundi mingi tugikyusa: sooka kuwulira, olwo okkirize. Okukyusa kuno kwe muzi gw’okulwanagana kwaffe okungi. Lowooza ku kino: bwe tuba tuzitoowereddwa okweraliikirira, Katonda atugamba obuteeraliikirira, wabula okuteeka obuyinike bwaffe ku ye kubanga atufaako. Atulaga ennyonyi ez’omu bbanga n’amalanga ag’omu nnimiro, ng’atukakasa nti tusinga nnyo omuwendo okuzisukka. Kubudaabuda ki okusingawo okuyinza okubaawo okusinga kuno—nti Omutonzi w’eggulu n’ensi yeetikka obuvunaanyizibwa obw’okutulabirira? Naye, bangi tebabudaabudibwa. Lwaki? Kubanga tebakikkiriza. Basiima ebigambo, beegomba nga bya mazima, naye bakubira ku kubikkiriza nga bikwata ku bo. Balindirira enneewulira okukakasa amazima, mu kifo ky’okwesiga amazima gennyini. Tugamba nti, “Singa nnali nsobola okuwulira nti kya mazima.” Katonda agamba nti, “Singa oba okkiriza nti kya mazima.” Ku muzi gw’okubulwa okubudaabuda kwaffe kuli obutakkiriza bwokka. Eddagala lyeyoleka lwatu. Bwe twagala okubudaabuda, tulina okulonda okukkiriza buli kigambo eky’okubudaabuda Katonda ky’ayogedde. Tulina okugaana okuwuliriza amaloboozi ag’okubuusabuusa—ka gave mu mbeera zaffe oba mu birowoozo byaffe. Kino kyetaagisa obumalirivu. Tulina okunyweza emitima gyaffe—ng’ejjinja ery’embaalebaale—okukkiriza, ne bwe kiba nti buli kintu ekitwetoolodde kirabika nga kya njawulo. Okubudaabudibwa si kya butafuba; kizingiramu okwagala kwaffe. Tulina okukulonda. Obulamu bwe buwulikika ng’obutali bukakafu, tulina okugamba nti: “Katonda akyogedde. Kyekiva kiba kya mazima. Nzija kukikkiriza, ne bwe kiba kirabika kitya.” Era bwe tumaze okulonda okukkiriza, tulina okugaana okudda mu kubuusabuusa. Buli abeera bw’atyo, oluvannyuma oba mangu, alyingira mu kubudaabuda okwa nnamaddala era okuwangaala. Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli yagamba nti, “Mu bungi bw’ebirowoozo byange eby’omunda, okubudaabuda kwo kusanyusa emmeeme yange.” Naye emirundi mingi ebirowoozo byaffe bijjudde ebizibu byaffe okusinga okubudaabuda kwa Katonda. Bwe twagala okubudaabudibwa, tulina okugenderera okufumiitiriza ku bisuubizo bye. Kiyinza okuyamba okwekebejja ebirowoozo byaffe: emirundi emeka gye tulowooza ku kubudaabuda kwa Katonda nga tugeraageranya n’okweraliikirira kwaffe? Eky’okuddamu kiyinza okutwewuunyisa. Ekisembayo, ekigambo eri abo ababuulira Enjiri. Obubaka bwo bwe buluwa? Bwe buno: “Mubudaabude abantu bange.” Si kubanenya, si kubazitoowerera—wabula okubabudaabuda. Enjiri ey’amazima bwe bubaka obulungi—obulungi obutaliimu ka kizibu. Naye emirundi mingi butabulwamu ebiragiro, okulabula, n’ebyongerwako by’abantu ebiggyako okubudaabuda kwabwo. Kristo abudaabuda. Omuntu emirundi mingi azibuwaza. Enjiri ey’amazima efaanana ng’obubaka bwa malayika eri abasumba: “Temutya. Mbaleetera amawulire amalungi ag’essanyu eddene ery’abantu bonna.” (Lukka 2:10) Bino bye bigambo ebireeta okubudaabuda okw’amazima. Singa buli mubuulizi yalangirira ebigambo ng’ebyo mu bweru, era buli awuliriza n’abikkiriza, tewandibaddewo bakristaayo abateredde, abeeraliikirivu. Wabula, emitima buli wantu gyandinyweziddwa era ne gijjuzibwa emirembe. Era okusaba kuno kwandituukiriziddwa: Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo yennyini, ne Katonda Kitaffe—eyatwagala n’atuwa okubudaabuda okutaggwaawo n’essuubi eddungi olw’ekisa—abudaabude emitima gyammwe era abanyweze mu buli kigambo ekirungi ne buli mulimu omulungi.

fields.title: Mukama ye Musumba Waffe
fields.body_html:
“Mukama ye musumba waffe, siribaako kye mbulwa.” Zabbuli 23:1 Nnafuna okumanya kuno okw’amaanyi mu kiseera kimu mu bulamu bwange obw’Ekikristaayo. Zabbuli ey’Amakumi Abiri mu Esatu, mazima ddala, yali ekimanyiddwa gye ndi okuva mu nnaku zange ez’obuto, naye yali tennalabikako ng’erina amakulu ga njawulo. Awo ne wajja akaseera akazibu mu bulamu bwange lwe nnali neetaaga nnyo okusanyusibwa, naye ne siraba kwe nkufuna wonna. Mu kaseera ako saasobola kukwata ku Baibuli yange, ne nnoonya mu birowoozo byange ekitundu kya Byawandiikibwa ekyandinnyambye. Amangwago ne wajja mu birowoozo byange ebigambo nti, “Mukama ye musumba wange, siribaako kye mbulwa.” (Zabbuli 23:1) Okusooka nakivaako nga mbeera n’akanyoomo.

“Ekyawandiikibwa ekya bulijjo ng’ekyo,” bwe nnegamba, “tekirabika nga kiyinza kunnyamba”; ne nfuba nnyo okulowooza ku kirala eky’enjawulo, naye ne watabaawo kijja; era ku nkomerero kyali ng’almya nti tewali kyawandiikibwa kirala mu Baibuli yonna. Ne ku nkomerero ne nzikirizibwa okugamba nti, “Kale, bwe siyinza kulowooza ku kyawandiikibwa kirala, nteekwa okugezaako okuggya mu kino akalungi akatono kye nsobola,” ne ntandika okwedduukiriza emirundi mingi nti, “Mukama ye musumba wange, siribaako kye mbulwa.” Amangwago, bwe nnali nkola bwe ntyo, ebigambo ne bimulisibwa mu ngeri ey’obwakatonda, ne wanfukirira emigga egy’okusanyusibwa nga bwe nnawulira nti siriddayo kufuna buzibu nate.

Amangu ddala bwe nnafuna Baibuli, ne ngiwuubaayo n’obwesunga okulaba obanga kyali kya mazima nti eby’obugagga eby’okusanyusibwa ebitayogerekeka byali byange ddala, era obanga nnandiyinzizza okuleka omutima gwange okubinyumirwa mu bujjuvu. Ne nkola kye ntera okufunamu enkizo ennene: ne nzimba ekigongolo eky’ebigambo n’ebisuubizo ebikwata ku Mukama okuba omusumba waffe, ekyo bwe kyamala okuzimbibwa, ne kiyimirira ng’ekitasumululwa era ekitayinza kuzikirizibwa eri empewo zonna n’emiyaga egy’okubuusabuusa oba okugezesebwa ebyandigyagganye. Ne nzikirizibwa, awatali kubuusabuusa n’akatono, nti Mukama yali ddala musumba wange, era nti bwe yeetuuma erinnya lino yatwala n’obuvunaanyizibwa obw’erinnya lino, era mazima yali ajja kuba ekyo ky’eyeeyita nti, “omusumba omulungi awaayo obulamu bwe olw’endiga ze.” (Yokaana 10:11) Ye yennyini alaga enjawulo eri wakati w’omusumba omulungi n’omubi. Bwe yamala okwogera nti, “Nze musumba omulungi,” n’ayongera nti: “Naye omuweereza empeera, atali musumba, endiga nga si zize, alaba omusege nga jjija n’aleka endiga n’adduka; omusege n’azikwata n’azisaasaanya.” (Yokaana 10:12) Okuyita mu bannabbi be, Mukama ayogera n’okunenya okw’amaanyi ku basumba abatali beesigwa ng’abo. Nnabbi Zekkaliya awandiika nti: “Ziwe omusumba wange omutaliimu, aleka ekisibo! Ekitala kikube omukono gwe n’eriiso lye erya ddyo! Omukono gwe guwote ddala, n’eriiso lye erya ddyo lizibe ddala!” (Zekkaliya 11:27) Era nate, ng’ayita mu nnabbi Ezeekyeri: “Ennafu temuzizizzaamu maanyi, endwadde temuziwonyezza, ezaalumizibwa temuzisibye biwundu, ezaabula temuzikomezzaawo, ezaabuze temuzinoonyezza, era mwazifuga n’amaanyi n’obukambwe.”

Mazima ddala tewali Mukristaayo yenna ayinza kuvunaana Musumba waffe ow’obwakatonda obutali bwesigwa nga akimanyi. Naye, singa ebirowoozo ebikwekeddwa eby’emitima mingi bibikkulwa, kiyinza okusangibwa nti, wadde nga tebyogeddwa, okuteebereza okwenkanankana kuno kubeera nga kwekwese wansi w’olususu.

Kirala kyandiba kitegeeza ki abakkiriza bwe boogera nti Mukama abaabulidde? Bwe bakaabira emmere ey’omwoyo ne bawulira nga tebawulirwa? Bwe bazingizibwa okugezesebwa ne bakkiriza nti tabalokola? Bwe bawulira nga banafu ne bateebereza nti tabawa maanyi, oba nga balwadde mu mwoyo ne balowooza nti tabawonya?

Ebirowoozo bino, wadde nga tebigenderwa, si kuvunaana kwa kasirise eri Omusumba yennyini eyasuubiza obutalekulira ekisibo kye?

Waliwo Omukristaayo omwagalwa eyali agambye nti: “Nnali ntera okugamba nti, ‘Mukama ye musumba wange,’ naye kyali tekiriimu kitegeeza gye ndi. Mu mazima, nnali mbeera ng’oyo nze musumba naye ye ndiga—nga ntya nti bwe sirimunywerera nnyo, agenda kubula. Ennaku enzibu bwe zaajja, sasuubira nti ajja kunnyweza. Omwoyo gwange bwe gwalumwa enjala, saakkiriza nti ajja kummeza. Kaakano ntegeera nti sasooka kumwesiga nga Musumba omwesigwa n’akatono.

Naye kaakano buli kimu kikyuse. Sirina maanyi kusinga bwe nnali, naye nzudde nti nnina Omusumba omulungi—era ekyo kimala. Kaakano ndaba nti kya mazima ddala: Mukama ye musumba wange, era siribaako kye mbulwa.”

Munnange omukkiriza omwagalwa, lowooza ku kino n’amazima.

Ogambye emirundi mingi nti, “Mukama ye musumba wange.” Naye okikkirizza ddala? Obeeredde mu mirembe ne mu bukuume amazima ng’ago bye gireeta? Oba weewuliridde ng’endiga ebuze—etalabirirwa, etakakasa, era eyeeyawudde?

Weebuuze n’obwesimbu: obulamu bwo obw’omwoyo bubadde bujjudde okusanyusibwa oba okutabuka?

Bwe buba bubadde bujjudde okulwana n’obwetaavu, ekyo kituukagana kitya n’ekisuubizo nti, “Siribaako kye mbulwa”?

Bwe kiba nti Omusumba atalina kamogo, obulemu bube wa?

Oyinza okuddamu nti, “Omusango gwange nze. Ndi munafu nnyo, musirusiru nnyo, atasaanira nnyo.”

Naye eyo ye ndaba y’endiga ddala. Ziba nnafu, zeetaaga okulabirirwa, era teziyinza kwerabirira zennyini. Kyeziva zeetaaga omusumba. Obukuume bwazo tebuli mu maanyi gaazo, naye buli ku kulabirira kw’omusumba kwokka.

Era bwe kityo bwe kiri gy’oli.

Teebereza ebisibo bibiri nga bisisinkana oluvannyuma lw’ebiseera eby’obutiti—ekimu nga kya maanyi era nga kiramu bulungi, ekirala nga kinafu era nga kifa enjala.

Endiga ez’amaanyi zandyetenderezza zennyini? Nedda ddala. Zandyogedde ku musumba waazo yokka: nga bwe yazikuuma, n’azimeza, n’azikulembera okuyita mu myaga. N’ekisibo ekinafu—kyandyevunaanye kyennyini? Nedda. Nakyo kyandyogedde ku musumba waakyo: “Omusumba waffe yatulemererwa. Teyatumeza, teyatuwonya, teyatukuuma. Mu kabi, yatudduka.”

Kino tukitegeera bulungi bwe twogera ku ndiga. Naye bwe tukisereza mu bulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo, tuggya obuvunaanyizibwa ku Musumba ne tubuteeka ku ffe ffennyini—nga tulindirira okuva mu ffe kye Ye yekka ky’ayinza okuwaayo.

Kyetuva tulemererwa, n’obulamu bwaffe ne buzitoowererwa ne butabuka.

Waliwo, mazima ddala, enjawulo emu: endiga teziyinza kuleka musumba waazo, naye ffe tuyinza. Tewali ndiga eyandigambye nti: “Omusumba waffe atuwa okulabirira, naye ffe tetusaanira kumwesiga. Abalala bayinza okuwummulira mu kuwa kwe, naye ffe tuteekwa okwerwaniririra.”

Endowooza ng’eyo yandibadde nga teri ya makulu eri endiga. Kyokka eno ye ngeri abakkiriza bangi gye balowoozamu ddala.

Twerowooza ng’abagezi okusinga endiga—era bwe tukola bwe tutyo, tugaana okwesiga okwo kwennyini okwandituulokodde.

Amazima si mazibu: singa endiga eri mu kisibo kya Kristo enafu era efa enjala, waliwo ebinnyonnyola bibiri byokka.

Oba Omusumba si mwesigwa, oba endiga teyesiga kulabirira kwe. Tewali n’omu ayinza kwenya kugamba nti Mukama si mwesigwa. Kale, ensonga esaanidde okuba eno: oba tetumukkirizza ddala nti ye Musumba waffe, oba tetumukkirizza kutulabirira.

Tunuulira kino n’amazima.

Si mirembe gyo gyokka egisinziira ku kino—naye n’ekitiibwa kye kyennyini.

Omusumba asalirwa omusango okusinziira ku mbeera y’ekisibo kye. Tewali kwenyumiriza kwa bulungi kuyinza kuyimirira singa endiga tezirabiriddwa era nga zimenyeddwa.

Mukama alangirira eri ebitonde byonna nti, “Nze Musumba omulungi.” N’ensi etunuulira abantu be ng’obujulizi obulaga okwenyumiriza okwo.

Ffe tuli bujulizi bw’okulabirira kwe?

Oba obulamu bwaffe bulaga obutalabirirwa, obunafu, n’entiisa?

Omutume Pawulo awandiika nti okuyita mu Kkanisa, amagezi ga Katonda gamanyisibwa—ne eri obuyinza obw’omu ggulu. Okuyitibwa okw’ekitalo ki: nti obulamu bwaffe bulaga obulungi n’amagezi g’Omusumba waffe.

Kale, tetusaanidde kumwesiga mu bujjuvu? Tetusaanidde kwewaayo ffennyini ffenna mu kulabirira kwe—amazima ekisa kye kirabike mu ffe? Naye bwe tugaana okulabirira kwe—bwe tetulya mu ddundiro lye oba okuwummulira mu kiraalo kye—kale tusigala nga banafu era nga tutabuse, n’embeera yaffe teyonoona ffe kyokka, naye emwogera bubi. Ensi etunuulira. Era kye balaba mu ffe kye kirikola kye bakkiriza ku Musumba waffe.

Sewuunya nti abatakkiriza tebasikirizibwa kuyingira mu kkanisa bwe ndowooza ku mbeera y’abakkiriza. Sewuunya nti mu makanisa agamu tewaba kukyusibwa kwa mitima okuva ku nkomerero y’omwaka okutuuka ku ndala. Singa nnali ndiga ya nnaku ng’ebulubbana mu ddungu, ne ndaba endiga ez’ennaku, embi, ez’endwadde nga zitunula okuva mu kiraalo nga zimpita njingire, ne ntunula mu kiraalo ne ndaba nga kikakanyavu, nga kyereere, era nga tekiwummuza, sirowooza nti nnandisikiriziddwa nnyo okuyingira mu kiraalo ekifaanana bwe kityo.

Waliwo eyali agambye nti amakanisa agamu gaali gafaanana nnyo ng’amalaalo agatereezeddwa obulungi: abantu baaleetebwa ne baziikibwa, era ekyo ne kiba nkomerero. Mazima ddala toyinza kusuubira bantu balamu kwagala kubeera mu malaalo. Tuteekwa okuba n’ekiraalo ekiraga endiga nga ziri mu mbeera nnungi bwe tuba twagala ab’ebweru okuyingira mu kiraalo ekyo; era bwe twagala okusikiriza abalala eri obulokozi bwa Mukama Yesu Kristo, tuteekwa okusobola okubalaga nti buli bulokozi obumatiza era obusanyusa. Tewali n’omu ayagala kwongera ku kutabuka kwe okw’ensi mu kwetikka eddiini etatabula, era tekigasa kusuubira kuwangula ba bweru olw’okulaba ennaku yaffe.

Mazima ddala, bwe muba temwefaako mwekka, muteekwa okufaayo ku buswavu bwe muleeta ku Musumba wammwe ow’obwakatonda olw’embeera yammwe embi era ey’ennaku. Mwegomba okumuweereza n’okumuleetera ekitiibwa; era muyinza okukikola bwe mulaga ensi nti ye Musumba gwe kitali kya bulabe kwesiga.

Ka nkuyambe okukola kino. Okusooka, tunuulira amazima ku ekyo omusumba ky’ateekwa okuba n’okukola okuba omusumba omulungi, olwo otunuulire amazima nti Mukama, mu ngeri esingayo obulungi, ye Musumba omulungi ddala. Olwo weegambe ebigambo bino n’obumalirivu bwonna bw’osobola okukuŋŋaanya: “Mukama ye musumba wange. Ye. Ye. Ka mbe nga mpulira ntya, agamba nti ye, era ye. Nnaakikkiriza, ne bwe kijja kutya.” Olwo oddiŋŋane ebigambo n’ossa amaanyi awatali kimu buli mulundi: Mukama ye musumba wange.

Mukama ye musumba wange.

Mukama ye musumba wange.

Tegeera Omusumba wo ow’ekituufu bw’ali, byonna bye wandisuubidde omuntu yenna mu kifo eky’obwesige n’obuvunaanyizibwa obungi bwe kityo, olwo otegeere nti ekituufu ekisukka wo ennyo, n’endaba y’obuvunaanyizibwa obw’omulimu ng’ogwo eyaali waggulu ennyo okusinga kyonna kye wateebereza, byali mu birowoozo bya Mukama waffe bwe yagamba nti, “Nze musumba omulungi. Omusumba omulungi awaayo obulamu bwe olw’endiga.” (Yokaana 10:11) Ye, okusinga omuntu yenna, yamanya endiga ze yali yeetissizza okulokola, era yamanya obuvunaanyizibwa bw’Omusumba. Yamanya nti Omusumba avunaanyizibwa ku kisibo kye, era ateekwa, ne bwe kiba nga kimuwaganya emirembe, obulamu obulungi, oba obulamu bwe bwennyini, okuzirabirira n’okuzikomyawo mirembe eri ekiraalo kya Kitaawe. Kyeyava agamba nti: “Era kuno kwe kwagala kw’oyo eyantuma, nti sirifiirwa kyonna ku ebyo byonna bye yampa, wabula nga nnaabizuukiza ku lunaku olw’enkomerero.” (Yokaana 6:39) Era nate: “Endiga zange ziwulira eddoboozi lyange, era mmanyi zo, era zingoberera. Nziwa obulamu obutaggwaawo, era tezirizikirira n’akatono, era tewali n’omu alizisikula mu ngalo zange.” (Yokaana 10:27–28) Emyaka mingi nga Yesu tannajja ng’Omusumba, Kitaffe yagamba nti: “Ndirokola ekisibo kyange; tekiriddayo kuba muyiggo. Era ndibateekerawo omusumba omu, omuddu wange Dawudi, era anaabaliisanga: anaabaliisanga era anaabeeranga musumba waabwe.” (Ezeekyeri 34:22–23) Kirabika mu bigambo bino tulaba okwagala kwa Kitaffe okw’omunda era okwegomba. Yateeka obuyambi ku Oyo ow’amaanyi; kyeyava tewali eri ekisibo kino agwana kutya kabi konna.

Yatwala omulimu gwe, ng’amanyidde ddala obuvunaanyizibwa bwagwo. Amanyi nti akola n’endiga ennafu ennyo, ezitalina maanyi kwekuuma, ezitalina magezi kwekulembera, era ezitalina kya kwewaanira okuggyako obunafu bwazo obujjuvu n’obwetaavu bwazo. Kyokka ekyo kyonna tekimutabula. Amaanyi ge n’obukugu bwe bimala buli mbeera yonna eyandivuddeyo.

Waliwo ekintu kimu kyokka ekiyinza okumuziyiza: singa endiga zigaana okumwesiga era ne zitamukkiriza kuzirabirira. Bwe ziyimirira ewala, ne zitunuulira emmere gy’ateekeddewo, ne zigyegomba, ne zigikaabira, kyokka ne zigaana okulya, tayinza kumatiza njala yaazo. Bwe zisigala ebweru w’ekisiikirize ky’akoze, nga zitya okuyingira olw’okuwulira nga tezisaanira oba nga tezimwesiga, tayinza kuzikuuma. Tewali ndiga eyandikoze bw’etyo, naye ffe abantu, abeerowooza abagezi okusinga, tukikola bulijjo.

Tewali ndiga, singa yandisobodde okwogera, eyandigambye omusumba nti, “Njegomba emmere gy’oteeseewo, n’ekisiikirize n’emirembe eby’ekiraalo kyo, era nnandyagadde okubinyumirwa; naye mpulira nga sisaanira.

Ndi munafu nnyo era musirusiru nnyo. Sivumbula nga ndi wa kwebaza kimala. Sirina bukakafu nti nkyegomba kimala. Sinyumirwa kuteebereza nti ebintu bino ebirungi obituusa ku nze.” Oyinza okuteebereza engeri ebigambo ng’ebyo bwe byandinakuwazizza ennyo omusumba omulungi.

Era Mukama waffe atulaze ennaku ye ku abo abagaana okumwesiga. Bwe yatunuulira Yerusaalemi, yakaaba n’agamba nti: “Singa ggwe, ye ggwe, wamanya ku lunaku luno ebireeta emirembe! Naye kaakano bikwekeddwa amaaso go.” (Lukka 19:42) Abakristaayo abaagalwa, si mulundi mumu gwe mwanakuwaza Omusumba wammwe ow’obwakatonda mu ngeri y’emu eno? Bwe kiba bwe kityo, lowooza akaseera ku ndaba y’Omusumba. Lowooza engeri gy’awulira n’ekiri mu mutima gwe gy’oli. Bw’aba Musumba wo, kale ayagala okukulabirira mu ngeri esingayo obulungi, kubanga ye Musumba omulungi era afaayo ku ndiga ze. Tekisinziira ku ky’olowooza oba ky’owulira. Si ggwe Musumba—ggwe ndiga. Ekikulu ye ky’alowooza n’engeri gy’awulira.

Weerabire akaseera olabe ebintu okuva mu ndaba ye. Lowooza embeera yo nga bw’agiraba. Mulabe ng’ajja okukunoonya mu kubula kwo. Laba okwagala kwe okw’ekisa, okwegomba kwe okunene okukulokola. Kkiriza by’ayogera ku ye yennyini, era omutwale ku kigambo kye.

Singa okukkiriza kwaffe kwali kwangu, Twandimututwadde ku kigambo kye; N’obulamu bwaffe bwandijjudde essanyu Mu kitangaala kya Mukama waffe.

Weewaawo, guno gwe muzibu. Okukkiriza kwaffe si kwangu kimala okumutwala ku kigambo kye. Mu kifo ky’ekyo, twongerako “singa” n’“naye” ebyaffe ffennyini ne tukwafuwaza obulungi bw’okwagala kwe n’okubuusabuusa kwe tweekolera.

Singa twategeera ddala ekitureetera emirembe, nga twandisudde mangu okubuusabuusa kwonna ne twesiga mu bujjuvu okwagala kwe n’okulabirira kwe okutalemererwa.

Oyinza okubuuza nti, bwe kiba nti kino kyonna kya mazima ku Musumba, omulimu gw’endiga guba guluwa? Kwe kumwesiga n’okumugoberera bwokka. Tewali kizibu mu kugondera bwe twesiga mu bujjuvu oyo gwe tugoberera.

Kyenva nkukubiriza otandike okwesiga n’okugoberera Omusumba wo kaakano. Weewaayo mu bujjuvu mu kulabirira kwe n’okukulembera kwe, ng’endiga eri wansi w’okulabirira kw’omusumba, era omwesige mu bujjuvu.

Toteekwa kutya kumugoberera buli w’akukulembera, kubanga bulijjo akulembera endiga ze mu ddundiro erisibuka n’okumpi n’amazzi agatereera. Ne bw’owulira ng’oli mu ddungu, nga tewali kikuzzaamu amaanyi mu maaso go, Omusumba omulungi ayinza okufuula ekifo ekyo ddundiro erisibuka. Alina obuyinza okufuula eddungu okumulisa, era yasuubiza nti: “Mu kifo ky’eriggwa mulivaamu omuberosi; mu kifo ky’omwennyango mulivaamu omukalitunsi.”

(Isaaya 55:13) “Eddungu n’ensi enkalu birisanyuka; olukoola lulijaguza ne lumulisa ng’ekimuli.” (Isaaya 35:1) “Era amazzi galyatika mu ddungu, n’emigga mu lukoola.” (Isaaya 35:6) Oba oyinza okugamba nti, “Obulamu bwange bujjudde emiyaga n’obuzibu. Kirituusa ekiseera kiwanvu nga sinnalaba mirembe.” Naye Omusumba wo teyagamba dda nti: “N’azuukuka n’aboggolera empewo n’agamba ennyanja nti, ‘Sirika! Beera mumativu!’ Empewo n’ekkakkana, ne wabaawo obusirifu bungi.” (Makko 4:39) Tayinza kuddamu kukola bwe kimu nate?

Bangi mu kisibo kya Kristo bayinza okujulira nti bwe baamwesiga mu bujjuvu, yakkakkanya emiyaga gyabwe n’afuula amalungu gaabwe ebifo eby’obulamu n’obulungi. Kino tekitegeeza nti obuzibu obw’ebweru buggwaawo, naye ne mu bifo ebyo, omwoyo gusanga emirembe n’emmere. Omusumba amanyi ddundiro ki erisinga obulungi eri endiga ze, era ziteekwa okumwesiga awatali kubuusabuusa. Oluusi enkula esinga obulungi ejja mu biseera eby’obuzibu. Bw’akukulembera eyo, oyinza okukakasa nti kirungi gy’oli.

Ebigambo tebiyinza kunnyonnyola mu bujjuvu Omusumba omulungi ky’akolera abo abamwesiga. Atuukiriza ekisuubizo kye era akola nabo endagaano ey’emirembe: “Ndikola nabo endagaano ey’emirembe era ndigoba ensolo enkambwe okuva mu nsi, balyoke babeere n’emirembe mu ddungu ne beebaka mu bibira.” (Ezeekyeri 34:25) “Era ndibafuula bo n’ebifo ebiri okwetooloola akasozi kange omukisa, era ndissa enkuba mu biseera byayo; ziriba nkuba za mikisa.” (Ezeekyeri 34:26) “N’emiti egy’omu nnimiro girirumbula ebibala byagyo, n’ettaka lirivaamu ebibala byalyo… Era tebaliddayo kuba muyiggo eri amawanga, era ensolo ez’ensi tezirilya; balibeera n’emirembe, era tewali alibatiisa.” (Ezeekyeri 34:27–28) Kaakano oyinza okwewuunya engeri gy’oyinza okufuna Mukama okuba Omusumba wo. Eky’okuddamu kiri nti toyinza kwetaaga kumufuula Musumba wo—amaze kubeera bwe kityo. Weetaaga bwokka okukitegeera n’okwewaayo mu kulabirira kwe.

Abaana bwe babuulirwa nti mwannyinaabwe eyalindiriddwa ebbanga ddene azaaliddwa, tebeeyongera kugamba nti, “Twandyagadde okuba ne mwannyinaffe,” oba “Tukole ki okumufuna?” Mu kifo ky’ekyo, basanyuka ne bagamba nti, “Kaakano tulina mwannyinaffe!”

Mu ngeri y’emu, ekirango kimaze okulangirirwa gye tuli: “Temutya, kubanga laba, mbaleetera amawulire amalungi ag’essanyu lingi eririba eri abantu bonna. Kubanga ku lunaku luno mu kibuga kya Dawudi muzaaliddwa Omulokozi, ye Kristo Mukama.” (Lukka 2:10–11) Tetwetaaga kugamba nti, “Singa nnandibadde n’Omulokozi,” oba “Nkole ki okufuula Kristo Omulokozi wange?” Amaze kubeera Mulokozi waffe. Tuteekwa bwokka okusanyuka n’okweteeka mu kulabirira kwe. Si kizibu. Kwe kukikkiriza n’okubeera ng’oyo akikkiriza nga kya mazima. Era buli muntu atandika leero okwesiga Omusumba omulungi, oluvannyuma alizuula nga aliisibwa mu ddundiro lye erisibuka era ng’atambulira ku mabbali g’amazzi ge agatereera.

Kiki ekirala Mukama, Musumba waffe, ky’ayinza okukola n’endiga ze, wabula kino kyokka? Talina biraalo ebitali birungi, talina ddundiro eritasibuka, era talina mazzi okuggyako agatereera.

Biyinza obutalabika bwe bityo ku bweru; naye ffe abaabifunyeko tuyinza okujulira nti, ka kibe kitya ku bweru, ekiraalo kye n’amaddundiro ge bulijjo bifo bya mirembe na kusanyusibwa eri obulamu obw’omunda obw’omwoyo.

Bw’olabika ng’olwanagana okutegeera bino byonna, era obulamu obw’okwesiga okujjuvu bwe bulabika ng’obukalubu era obw’ekyama, nandikuwadde amagezi nti toteekwa kugezaako kubitegeera, wabula tandika bwokka okubibeeramu. Twala bwokka zabbuli yaffe ey’obuto ogambe nti, “Eno ye zabbuli yange, era njja kugikkiriza. Bulijjo nnagimanyi mu mutima, naye teyabaako makulu mangi gye ndi. Naye kaakano nsazeewo okukkiriza nti Mukama ye Musumba wange ddala era nti ajja kundabirira ng’omusumba bw’alabirira endiga ze.

Sijja kuddayo kukibuusabuusa oba kukibuuza nate.” Olwo weewaayo bwokka mu kulabirira kwe, ng’endiga bwe zeewaayo mu kulabirira kw’omusumba waazo, ng’omwesiga mu bujjuvu, era ng’ogoberera buli w’akulembera.

Naye tetuteekwa kwerabira nti wadde endiga zeesiga awatali kutegeera era mu buzaaliranwa, ffe twetaaga okwesiga n’amagezi era mu bugenderevu, kubanga obuzaaliranwa bwaffe, eky’ennaku, bwonna businga okwesiga. Tuteekwa okufuba okwesiga. Tuteekwa okulonda okukikola. Naye tuyinza okukola kino, ka tube nga tunafu era abatamanyi tutya. Tuyinza obutategeera byonna kye kitegeeza okuba endiga ez’Omusumba ng’oyo, naye Ye amanyi. Era singa okukkiriza kwaffe kumwanukula bwokka mu nkolagana eno ey’omukisa era ey’ekitalo, alitulabirira ng’okwagala kwe, amagezi ge, n’amaanyi ge bwe biri, so si ng’okutegeera kwaffe okukoma bwe kuli.

Kirabika ddala gye ndi nti tetwandyetaaze kitundu kirala kyonna mu Baibuli yonna okuggyako zabbuli eno ey’obuto okufuula obulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo obujjudde okusanyusibwa. Mu mazima siraba we wasigadde ekifo omukkiriza kwe yandyeraliikiridde, singa akkiriza ddala zabbuli eno. Nga Mukama ye Musumba waffe, kiyinzika kitya ekintu kyonna okugenda obubi? Nga Ye Musumba waffe, byonna zabbuli eno bye ssuubiza biteekwa okuba byaffe; era bwe tumaze okumumanya mu ngeri eno, tulisobola okugamba n’obwesige obw’obuwanguzi nti: “Mazima obulungi n’ekisa binaangobereranga ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwange, era ndituula mu nnyumba ya Mukama emirembe gyonna.” (Zabbuli 23:6) Ne ebiseera eby’omu maaso birifiirwa entiisa yaabyo gye tuli, era obwesige bwaffe mu Musumba waffe bulitulokola mu ntiisa yonna ey’amawulire agatiisa.

Era nsobola bwokka okugamba, mu kumaliriza, nti buli omu ku mmwe bw’aliyingira mu nkolagana eno ne Kristo, era n’abeera ddala ndiga etalina buyinza, eyeetegefu, eyeesiga, era n’amukkiriza okuba Omusumba wo, ng’akulabirira n’okwagala kwonna, okulabirira, n’ekisa erinnya lino bye litegeeza, era n’amugoberera buli w’akulembera, olimala okufiirwa okutabuka kwo kwonna okw’edda okw’omwoyo, era olimanya emirembe gya Katonda egisukka okutegeera kwonna, nga gikuuma emitima gyammwe n’ebirowoozo byammwe mu Kristo Yesu (Abafiripi 4:7).

“Tebaategeera nti yali ayogera nabo ku Kitaawe.” (Yokaana 8:27)
fields.body_text: “Mukama ye musumba waffe, siribaako kye mbulwa.” Zabbuli 23:1 Nnafuna okumanya kuno okw’amaanyi mu kiseera kimu mu bulamu bwange obw’Ekikristaayo. Zabbuli ey’Amakumi Abiri mu Esatu, mazima ddala, yali ekimanyiddwa gye ndi okuva mu nnaku zange ez’obuto, naye yali tennalabikako ng’erina amakulu ga njawulo. Awo ne wajja akaseera akazibu mu bulamu bwange lwe nnali neetaaga nnyo okusanyusibwa, naye ne siraba kwe nkufuna wonna. Mu kaseera ako saasobola kukwata ku Baibuli yange, ne nnoonya mu birowoozo byange ekitundu kya Byawandiikibwa ekyandinnyambye. Amangwago ne wajja mu birowoozo byange ebigambo nti, “Mukama ye musumba wange, siribaako kye mbulwa.” (Zabbuli 23:1) Okusooka nakivaako nga mbeera n’akanyoomo. “Ekyawandiikibwa ekya bulijjo ng’ekyo,” bwe nnegamba, “tekirabika nga kiyinza kunnyamba”; ne nfuba nnyo okulowooza ku kirala eky’enjawulo, naye ne watabaawo kijja; era ku nkomerero kyali ng’almya nti tewali kyawandiikibwa kirala mu Baibuli yonna. Ne ku nkomerero ne nzikirizibwa okugamba nti, “Kale, bwe siyinza kulowooza ku kyawandiikibwa kirala, nteekwa okugezaako okuggya mu kino akalungi akatono kye nsobola,” ne ntandika okwedduukiriza emirundi mingi nti, “Mukama ye musumba wange, siribaako kye mbulwa.” Amangwago, bwe nnali nkola bwe ntyo, ebigambo ne bimulisibwa mu ngeri ey’obwakatonda, ne wanfukirira emigga egy’okusanyusibwa nga bwe nnawulira nti siriddayo kufuna buzibu nate. Amangu ddala bwe nnafuna Baibuli, ne ngiwuubaayo n’obwesunga okulaba obanga kyali kya mazima nti eby’obugagga eby’okusanyusibwa ebitayogerekeka byali byange ddala, era obanga nnandiyinzizza okuleka omutima gwange okubinyumirwa mu bujjuvu. Ne nkola kye ntera okufunamu enkizo ennene: ne nzimba ekigongolo eky’ebigambo n’ebisuubizo ebikwata ku Mukama okuba omusumba waffe, ekyo bwe kyamala okuzimbibwa, ne kiyimirira ng’ekitasumululwa era ekitayinza kuzikirizibwa eri empewo zonna n’emiyaga egy’okubuusabuusa oba okugezesebwa ebyandigyagganye. Ne nzikirizibwa, awatali kubuusabuusa n’akatono, nti Mukama yali ddala musumba wange, era nti bwe yeetuuma erinnya lino yatwala n’obuvunaanyizibwa obw’erinnya lino, era mazima yali ajja kuba ekyo ky’eyeeyita nti, “omusumba omulungi awaayo obulamu bwe olw’endiga ze.” (Yokaana 10:11) Ye yennyini alaga enjawulo eri wakati w’omusumba omulungi n’omubi. Bwe yamala okwogera nti, “Nze musumba omulungi,” n’ayongera nti: “Naye omuweereza empeera, atali musumba, endiga nga si zize, alaba omusege nga jjija n’aleka endiga n’adduka; omusege n’azikwata n’azisaasaanya.” (Yokaana 10:12) Okuyita mu bannabbi be, Mukama ayogera n’okunenya okw’amaanyi ku basumba abatali beesigwa ng’abo. Nnabbi Zekkaliya awandiika nti: “Ziwe omusumba wange omutaliimu, aleka ekisibo! Ekitala kikube omukono gwe n’eriiso lye erya ddyo! Omukono gwe guwote ddala, n’eriiso lye erya ddyo lizibe ddala!” (Zekkaliya 11:27) Era nate, ng’ayita mu nnabbi Ezeekyeri: “Ennafu temuzizizzaamu maanyi, endwadde temuziwonyezza, ezaalumizibwa temuzisibye biwundu, ezaabula temuzikomezzaawo, ezaabuze temuzinoonyezza, era mwazifuga n’amaanyi n’obukambwe.” Mazima ddala tewali Mukristaayo yenna ayinza kuvunaana Musumba waffe ow’obwakatonda obutali bwesigwa nga akimanyi. Naye, singa ebirowoozo ebikwekeddwa eby’emitima mingi bibikkulwa, kiyinza okusangibwa nti, wadde nga tebyogeddwa, okuteebereza okwenkanankana kuno kubeera nga kwekwese wansi w’olususu. Kirala kyandiba kitegeeza ki abakkiriza bwe boogera nti Mukama abaabulidde? Bwe bakaabira emmere ey’omwoyo ne bawulira nga tebawulirwa? Bwe bazingizibwa okugezesebwa ne bakkiriza nti tabalokola? Bwe bawulira nga banafu ne bateebereza nti tabawa maanyi, oba nga balwadde mu mwoyo ne balowooza nti tabawonya? Ebirowoozo bino, wadde nga tebigenderwa, si kuvunaana kwa kasirise eri Omusumba yennyini eyasuubiza obutalekulira ekisibo kye? Waliwo Omukristaayo omwagalwa eyali agambye nti: “Nnali ntera okugamba nti, ‘Mukama ye musumba wange,’ naye kyali tekiriimu kitegeeza gye ndi. Mu mazima, nnali mbeera ng’oyo nze musumba naye ye ndiga—nga ntya nti bwe sirimunywerera nnyo, agenda kubula. Ennaku enzibu bwe zaajja, sasuubira nti ajja kunnyweza. Omwoyo gwange bwe gwalumwa enjala, saakkiriza nti ajja kummeza. Kaakano ntegeera nti sasooka kumwesiga nga Musumba omwesigwa n’akatono. Naye kaakano buli kimu kikyuse. Sirina maanyi kusinga bwe nnali, naye nzudde nti nnina Omusumba omulungi—era ekyo kimala. Kaakano ndaba nti kya mazima ddala: Mukama ye musumba wange, era siribaako kye mbulwa.” Munnange omukkiriza omwagalwa, lowooza ku kino n’amazima. Ogambye emirundi mingi nti, “Mukama ye musumba wange.” Naye okikkirizza ddala? Obeeredde mu mirembe ne mu bukuume amazima ng’ago bye gireeta? Oba weewuliridde ng’endiga ebuze—etalabirirwa, etakakasa, era eyeeyawudde? Weebuuze n’obwesimbu: obulamu bwo obw’omwoyo bubadde bujjudde okusanyusibwa oba okutabuka? Bwe buba bubadde bujjudde okulwana n’obwetaavu, ekyo kituukagana kitya n’ekisuubizo nti, “Siribaako kye mbulwa”? Bwe kiba nti Omusumba atalina kamogo, obulemu bube wa? Oyinza okuddamu nti, “Omusango gwange nze. Ndi munafu nnyo, musirusiru nnyo, atasaanira nnyo.” Naye eyo ye ndaba y’endiga ddala. Ziba nnafu, zeetaaga okulabirirwa, era teziyinza kwerabirira zennyini. Kyeziva zeetaaga omusumba. Obukuume bwazo tebuli mu maanyi gaazo, naye buli ku kulabirira kw’omusumba kwokka. Era bwe kityo bwe kiri gy’oli. Teebereza ebisibo bibiri nga bisisinkana oluvannyuma lw’ebiseera eby’obutiti—ekimu nga kya maanyi era nga kiramu bulungi, ekirala nga kinafu era nga kifa enjala. Endiga ez’amaanyi zandyetenderezza zennyini? Nedda ddala. Zandyogedde ku musumba waazo yokka: nga bwe yazikuuma, n’azimeza, n’azikulembera okuyita mu myaga. N’ekisibo ekinafu—kyandyevunaanye kyennyini? Nedda. Nakyo kyandyogedde ku musumba waakyo: “Omusumba waffe yatulemererwa. Teyatumeza, teyatuwonya, teyatukuuma. Mu kabi, yatudduka.” Kino tukitegeera bulungi bwe twogera ku ndiga. Naye bwe tukisereza mu bulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo, tuggya obuvunaanyizibwa ku Musumba ne tubuteeka ku ffe ffennyini—nga tulindirira okuva mu ffe kye Ye yekka ky’ayinza okuwaayo. Kyetuva tulemererwa, n’obulamu bwaffe ne buzitoowererwa ne butabuka. Waliwo, mazima ddala, enjawulo emu: endiga teziyinza kuleka musumba waazo, naye ffe tuyinza. Tewali ndiga eyandigambye nti: “Omusumba waffe atuwa okulabirira, naye ffe tetusaanira kumwesiga. Abalala bayinza okuwummulira mu kuwa kwe, naye ffe tuteekwa okwerwaniririra.” Endowooza ng’eyo yandibadde nga teri ya makulu eri endiga. Kyokka eno ye ngeri abakkiriza bangi gye balowoozamu ddala. Twerowooza ng’abagezi okusinga endiga—era bwe tukola bwe tutyo, tugaana okwesiga okwo kwennyini okwandituulokodde. Amazima si mazibu: singa endiga eri mu kisibo kya Kristo enafu era efa enjala, waliwo ebinnyonnyola bibiri byokka. Oba Omusumba si mwesigwa, oba endiga teyesiga kulabirira kwe. Tewali n’omu ayinza kwenya kugamba nti Mukama si mwesigwa. Kale, ensonga esaanidde okuba eno: oba tetumukkirizza ddala nti ye Musumba waffe, oba tetumukkirizza kutulabirira. Tunuulira kino n’amazima. Si mirembe gyo gyokka egisinziira ku kino—naye n’ekitiibwa kye kyennyini. Omusumba asalirwa omusango okusinziira ku mbeera y’ekisibo kye. Tewali kwenyumiriza kwa bulungi kuyinza kuyimirira singa endiga tezirabiriddwa era nga zimenyeddwa. Mukama alangirira eri ebitonde byonna nti, “Nze Musumba omulungi.” N’ensi etunuulira abantu be ng’obujulizi obulaga okwenyumiriza okwo. Ffe tuli bujulizi bw’okulabirira kwe? Oba obulamu bwaffe bulaga obutalabirirwa, obunafu, n’entiisa? Omutume Pawulo awandiika nti okuyita mu Kkanisa, amagezi ga Katonda gamanyisibwa—ne eri obuyinza obw’omu ggulu. Okuyitibwa okw’ekitalo ki: nti obulamu bwaffe bulaga obulungi n’amagezi g’Omusumba waffe. Kale, tetusaanidde kumwesiga mu bujjuvu? Tetusaanidde kwewaayo ffennyini ffenna mu kulabirira kwe—amazima ekisa kye kirabike mu ffe? Naye bwe tugaana okulabirira kwe—bwe tetulya mu ddundiro lye oba okuwummulira mu kiraalo kye—kale tusigala nga banafu era nga tutabuse, n’embeera yaffe teyonoona ffe kyokka, naye emwogera bubi. Ensi etunuulira. Era kye balaba mu ffe kye kirikola kye bakkiriza ku Musumba waffe. Sewuunya nti abatakkiriza tebasikirizibwa kuyingira mu kkanisa bwe ndowooza ku mbeera y’abakkiriza. Sewuunya nti mu makanisa agamu tewaba kukyusibwa kwa mitima okuva ku nkomerero y’omwaka okutuuka ku ndala. Singa nnali ndiga ya nnaku ng’ebulubbana mu ddungu, ne ndaba endiga ez’ennaku, embi, ez’endwadde nga zitunula okuva mu kiraalo nga zimpita njingire, ne ntunula mu kiraalo ne ndaba nga kikakanyavu, nga kyereere, era nga tekiwummuza, sirowooza nti nnandisikiriziddwa nnyo okuyingira mu kiraalo ekifaanana bwe kityo. Waliwo eyali agambye nti amakanisa agamu gaali gafaanana nnyo ng’amalaalo agatereezeddwa obulungi: abantu baaleetebwa ne baziikibwa, era ekyo ne kiba nkomerero. Mazima ddala toyinza kusuubira bantu balamu kwagala kubeera mu malaalo. Tuteekwa okuba n’ekiraalo ekiraga endiga nga ziri mu mbeera nnungi bwe tuba twagala ab’ebweru okuyingira mu kiraalo ekyo; era bwe twagala okusikiriza abalala eri obulokozi bwa Mukama Yesu Kristo, tuteekwa okusobola okubalaga nti buli bulokozi obumatiza era obusanyusa. Tewali n’omu ayagala kwongera ku kutabuka kwe okw’ensi mu kwetikka eddiini etatabula, era tekigasa kusuubira kuwangula ba bweru olw’okulaba ennaku yaffe. Mazima ddala, bwe muba temwefaako mwekka, muteekwa okufaayo ku buswavu bwe muleeta ku Musumba wammwe ow’obwakatonda olw’embeera yammwe embi era ey’ennaku. Mwegomba okumuweereza n’okumuleetera ekitiibwa; era muyinza okukikola bwe mulaga ensi nti ye Musumba gwe kitali kya bulabe kwesiga. Ka nkuyambe okukola kino. Okusooka, tunuulira amazima ku ekyo omusumba ky’ateekwa okuba n’okukola okuba omusumba omulungi, olwo otunuulire amazima nti Mukama, mu ngeri esingayo obulungi, ye Musumba omulungi ddala. Olwo weegambe ebigambo bino n’obumalirivu bwonna bw’osobola okukuŋŋaanya: “Mukama ye musumba wange. Ye. Ye. Ka mbe nga mpulira ntya, agamba nti ye, era ye. Nnaakikkiriza, ne bwe kijja kutya.” Olwo oddiŋŋane ebigambo n’ossa amaanyi awatali kimu buli mulundi: Mukama ye musumba wange. Mukama ye musumba wange. Mukama ye musumba wange. Mukama ye musumba wange. Tegeera Omusumba wo ow’ekituufu bw’ali, byonna bye wandisuubidde omuntu yenna mu kifo eky’obwesige n’obuvunaanyizibwa obungi bwe kityo, olwo otegeere nti ekituufu ekisukka wo ennyo, n’endaba y’obuvunaanyizibwa obw’omulimu ng’ogwo eyaali waggulu ennyo okusinga kyonna kye wateebereza, byali mu birowoozo bya Mukama waffe bwe yagamba nti, “Nze musumba omulungi. Omusumba omulungi awaayo obulamu bwe olw’endiga.” (Yokaana 10:11) Ye, okusinga omuntu yenna, yamanya endiga ze yali yeetissizza okulokola, era yamanya obuvunaanyizibwa bw’Omusumba. Yamanya nti Omusumba avunaanyizibwa ku kisibo kye, era ateekwa, ne bwe kiba nga kimuwaganya emirembe, obulamu obulungi, oba obulamu bwe bwennyini, okuzirabirira n’okuzikomyawo mirembe eri ekiraalo kya Kitaawe. Kyeyava agamba nti: “Era kuno kwe kwagala kw’oyo eyantuma, nti sirifiirwa kyonna ku ebyo byonna bye yampa, wabula nga nnaabizuukiza ku lunaku olw’enkomerero.” (Yokaana 6:39) Era nate: “Endiga zange ziwulira eddoboozi lyange, era mmanyi zo, era zingoberera. Nziwa obulamu obutaggwaawo, era tezirizikirira n’akatono, era tewali n’omu alizisikula mu ngalo zange.” (Yokaana 10:27–28) Emyaka mingi nga Yesu tannajja ng’Omusumba, Kitaffe yagamba nti: “Ndirokola ekisibo kyange; tekiriddayo kuba muyiggo. Era ndibateekerawo omusumba omu, omuddu wange Dawudi, era anaabaliisanga: anaabaliisanga era anaabeeranga musumba waabwe.” (Ezeekyeri 34:22–23) Kirabika mu bigambo bino tulaba okwagala kwa Kitaffe okw’omunda era okwegomba. Yateeka obuyambi ku Oyo ow’amaanyi; kyeyava tewali eri ekisibo kino agwana kutya kabi konna. Yatwala omulimu gwe, ng’amanyidde ddala obuvunaanyizibwa bwagwo. Amanyi nti akola n’endiga ennafu ennyo, ezitalina maanyi kwekuuma, ezitalina magezi kwekulembera, era ezitalina kya kwewaanira okuggyako obunafu bwazo obujjuvu n’obwetaavu bwazo. Kyokka ekyo kyonna tekimutabula. Amaanyi ge n’obukugu bwe bimala buli mbeera yonna eyandivuddeyo. Waliwo ekintu kimu kyokka ekiyinza okumuziyiza: singa endiga zigaana okumwesiga era ne zitamukkiriza kuzirabirira. Bwe ziyimirira ewala, ne zitunuulira emmere gy’ateekeddewo, ne zigyegomba, ne zigikaabira, kyokka ne zigaana okulya, tayinza kumatiza njala yaazo. Bwe zisigala ebweru w’ekisiikirize ky’akoze, nga zitya okuyingira olw’okuwulira nga tezisaanira oba nga tezimwesiga, tayinza kuzikuuma. Tewali ndiga eyandikoze bw’etyo, naye ffe abantu, abeerowooza abagezi okusinga, tukikola bulijjo. Tewali ndiga, singa yandisobodde okwogera, eyandigambye omusumba nti, “Njegomba emmere gy’oteeseewo, n’ekisiikirize n’emirembe eby’ekiraalo kyo, era nnandyagadde okubinyumirwa; naye mpulira nga sisaanira. Ndi munafu nnyo era musirusiru nnyo. Sivumbula nga ndi wa kwebaza kimala. Sirina bukakafu nti nkyegomba kimala. Sinyumirwa kuteebereza nti ebintu bino ebirungi obituusa ku nze.” Oyinza okuteebereza engeri ebigambo ng’ebyo bwe byandinakuwazizza ennyo omusumba omulungi. Era Mukama waffe atulaze ennaku ye ku abo abagaana okumwesiga. Bwe yatunuulira Yerusaalemi, yakaaba n’agamba nti: “Singa ggwe, ye ggwe, wamanya ku lunaku luno ebireeta emirembe! Naye kaakano bikwekeddwa amaaso go.” (Lukka 19:42) Abakristaayo abaagalwa, si mulundi mumu gwe mwanakuwaza Omusumba wammwe ow’obwakatonda mu ngeri y’emu eno? Bwe kiba bwe kityo, lowooza akaseera ku ndaba y’Omusumba. Lowooza engeri gy’awulira n’ekiri mu mutima gwe gy’oli. Bw’aba Musumba wo, kale ayagala okukulabirira mu ngeri esingayo obulungi, kubanga ye Musumba omulungi era afaayo ku ndiga ze. Tekisinziira ku ky’olowooza oba ky’owulira. Si ggwe Musumba—ggwe ndiga. Ekikulu ye ky’alowooza n’engeri gy’awulira. Weerabire akaseera olabe ebintu okuva mu ndaba ye. Lowooza embeera yo nga bw’agiraba. Mulabe ng’ajja okukunoonya mu kubula kwo. Laba okwagala kwe okw’ekisa, okwegomba kwe okunene okukulokola. Kkiriza by’ayogera ku ye yennyini, era omutwale ku kigambo kye. Singa okukkiriza kwaffe kwali kwangu, Twandimututwadde ku kigambo kye; N’obulamu bwaffe bwandijjudde essanyu Mu kitangaala kya Mukama waffe. Weewaawo, guno gwe muzibu. Okukkiriza kwaffe si kwangu kimala okumutwala ku kigambo kye. Mu kifo ky’ekyo, twongerako “singa” n’“naye” ebyaffe ffennyini ne tukwafuwaza obulungi bw’okwagala kwe n’okubuusabuusa kwe tweekolera. Singa twategeera ddala ekitureetera emirembe, nga twandisudde mangu okubuusabuusa kwonna ne twesiga mu bujjuvu okwagala kwe n’okulabirira kwe okutalemererwa. Oyinza okubuuza nti, bwe kiba nti kino kyonna kya mazima ku Musumba, omulimu gw’endiga guba guluwa? Kwe kumwesiga n’okumugoberera bwokka. Tewali kizibu mu kugondera bwe twesiga mu bujjuvu oyo gwe tugoberera. Kyenva nkukubiriza otandike okwesiga n’okugoberera Omusumba wo kaakano. Weewaayo mu bujjuvu mu kulabirira kwe n’okukulembera kwe, ng’endiga eri wansi w’okulabirira kw’omusumba, era omwesige mu bujjuvu. Toteekwa kutya kumugoberera buli w’akukulembera, kubanga bulijjo akulembera endiga ze mu ddundiro erisibuka n’okumpi n’amazzi agatereera. Ne bw’owulira ng’oli mu ddungu, nga tewali kikuzzaamu amaanyi mu maaso go, Omusumba omulungi ayinza okufuula ekifo ekyo ddundiro erisibuka. Alina obuyinza okufuula eddungu okumulisa, era yasuubiza nti: “Mu kifo ky’eriggwa mulivaamu omuberosi; mu kifo ky’omwennyango mulivaamu omukalitunsi.” (Isaaya 55:13) “Eddungu n’ensi enkalu birisanyuka; olukoola lulijaguza ne lumulisa ng’ekimuli.” (Isaaya 35:1) “Era amazzi galyatika mu ddungu, n’emigga mu lukoola.” (Isaaya 35:6) Oba oyinza okugamba nti, “Obulamu bwange bujjudde emiyaga n’obuzibu. Kirituusa ekiseera kiwanvu nga sinnalaba mirembe.” Naye Omusumba wo teyagamba dda nti: “N’azuukuka n’aboggolera empewo n’agamba ennyanja nti, ‘Sirika! Beera mumativu!’ Empewo n’ekkakkana, ne wabaawo obusirifu bungi.” (Makko 4:39) Tayinza kuddamu kukola bwe kimu nate? Bangi mu kisibo kya Kristo bayinza okujulira nti bwe baamwesiga mu bujjuvu, yakkakkanya emiyaga gyabwe n’afuula amalungu gaabwe ebifo eby’obulamu n’obulungi. Kino tekitegeeza nti obuzibu obw’ebweru buggwaawo, naye ne mu bifo ebyo, omwoyo gusanga emirembe n’emmere. Omusumba amanyi ddundiro ki erisinga obulungi eri endiga ze, era ziteekwa okumwesiga awatali kubuusabuusa. Oluusi enkula esinga obulungi ejja mu biseera eby’obuzibu. Bw’akukulembera eyo, oyinza okukakasa nti kirungi gy’oli. Ebigambo tebiyinza kunnyonnyola mu bujjuvu Omusumba omulungi ky’akolera abo abamwesiga. Atuukiriza ekisuubizo kye era akola nabo endagaano ey’emirembe: “Ndikola nabo endagaano ey’emirembe era ndigoba ensolo enkambwe okuva mu nsi, balyoke babeere n’emirembe mu ddungu ne beebaka mu bibira.” (Ezeekyeri 34:25) “Era ndibafuula bo n’ebifo ebiri okwetooloola akasozi kange omukisa, era ndissa enkuba mu biseera byayo; ziriba nkuba za mikisa.” (Ezeekyeri 34:26) “N’emiti egy’omu nnimiro girirumbula ebibala byagyo, n’ettaka lirivaamu ebibala byalyo… Era tebaliddayo kuba muyiggo eri amawanga, era ensolo ez’ensi tezirilya; balibeera n’emirembe, era tewali alibatiisa.” (Ezeekyeri 34:27–28) Kaakano oyinza okwewuunya engeri gy’oyinza okufuna Mukama okuba Omusumba wo. Eky’okuddamu kiri nti toyinza kwetaaga kumufuula Musumba wo—amaze kubeera bwe kityo. Weetaaga bwokka okukitegeera n’okwewaayo mu kulabirira kwe. Abaana bwe babuulirwa nti mwannyinaabwe eyalindiriddwa ebbanga ddene azaaliddwa, tebeeyongera kugamba nti, “Twandyagadde okuba ne mwannyinaffe,” oba “Tukole ki okumufuna?” Mu kifo ky’ekyo, basanyuka ne bagamba nti, “Kaakano tulina mwannyinaffe!” Mu ngeri y’emu, ekirango kimaze okulangirirwa gye tuli: “Temutya, kubanga laba, mbaleetera amawulire amalungi ag’essanyu lingi eririba eri abantu bonna. Kubanga ku lunaku luno mu kibuga kya Dawudi muzaaliddwa Omulokozi, ye Kristo Mukama.” (Lukka 2:10–11) Tetwetaaga kugamba nti, “Singa nnandibadde n’Omulokozi,” oba “Nkole ki okufuula Kristo Omulokozi wange?” Amaze kubeera Mulokozi waffe. Tuteekwa bwokka okusanyuka n’okweteeka mu kulabirira kwe. Si kizibu. Kwe kukikkiriza n’okubeera ng’oyo akikkiriza nga kya mazima. Era buli muntu atandika leero okwesiga Omusumba omulungi, oluvannyuma alizuula nga aliisibwa mu ddundiro lye erisibuka era ng’atambulira ku mabbali g’amazzi ge agatereera. Kiki ekirala Mukama, Musumba waffe, ky’ayinza okukola n’endiga ze, wabula kino kyokka? Talina biraalo ebitali birungi, talina ddundiro eritasibuka, era talina mazzi okuggyako agatereera. Biyinza obutalabika bwe bityo ku bweru; naye ffe abaabifunyeko tuyinza okujulira nti, ka kibe kitya ku bweru, ekiraalo kye n’amaddundiro ge bulijjo bifo bya mirembe na kusanyusibwa eri obulamu obw’omunda obw’omwoyo. Bw’olabika ng’olwanagana okutegeera bino byonna, era obulamu obw’okwesiga okujjuvu bwe bulabika ng’obukalubu era obw’ekyama, nandikuwadde amagezi nti toteekwa kugezaako kubitegeera, wabula tandika bwokka okubibeeramu. Twala bwokka zabbuli yaffe ey’obuto ogambe nti, “Eno ye zabbuli yange, era njja kugikkiriza. Bulijjo nnagimanyi mu mutima, naye teyabaako makulu mangi gye ndi. Naye kaakano nsazeewo okukkiriza nti Mukama ye Musumba wange ddala era nti ajja kundabirira ng’omusumba bw’alabirira endiga ze. Sijja kuddayo kukibuusabuusa oba kukibuuza nate.” Olwo weewaayo bwokka mu kulabirira kwe, ng’endiga bwe zeewaayo mu kulabirira kw’omusumba waazo, ng’omwesiga mu bujjuvu, era ng’ogoberera buli w’akulembera. Naye tetuteekwa kwerabira nti wadde endiga zeesiga awatali kutegeera era mu buzaaliranwa, ffe twetaaga okwesiga n’amagezi era mu bugenderevu, kubanga obuzaaliranwa bwaffe, eky’ennaku, bwonna businga okwesiga. Tuteekwa okufuba okwesiga. Tuteekwa okulonda okukikola. Naye tuyinza okukola kino, ka tube nga tunafu era abatamanyi tutya. Tuyinza obutategeera byonna kye kitegeeza okuba endiga ez’Omusumba ng’oyo, naye Ye amanyi. Era singa okukkiriza kwaffe kumwanukula bwokka mu nkolagana eno ey’omukisa era ey’ekitalo, alitulabirira ng’okwagala kwe, amagezi ge, n’amaanyi ge bwe biri, so si ng’okutegeera kwaffe okukoma bwe kuli. Kirabika ddala gye ndi nti tetwandyetaaze kitundu kirala kyonna mu Baibuli yonna okuggyako zabbuli eno ey’obuto okufuula obulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo obujjudde okusanyusibwa. Mu mazima siraba we wasigadde ekifo omukkiriza kwe yandyeraliikiridde, singa akkiriza ddala zabbuli eno. Nga Mukama ye Musumba waffe, kiyinzika kitya ekintu kyonna okugenda obubi? Nga Ye Musumba waffe, byonna zabbuli eno bye ssuubiza biteekwa okuba byaffe; era bwe tumaze okumumanya mu ngeri eno, tulisobola okugamba n’obwesige obw’obuwanguzi nti: “Mazima obulungi n’ekisa binaangobereranga ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwange, era ndituula mu nnyumba ya Mukama emirembe gyonna.” (Zabbuli 23:6) Ne ebiseera eby’omu maaso birifiirwa entiisa yaabyo gye tuli, era obwesige bwaffe mu Musumba waffe bulitulokola mu ntiisa yonna ey’amawulire agatiisa. Era nsobola bwokka okugamba, mu kumaliriza, nti buli omu ku mmwe bw’aliyingira mu nkolagana eno ne Kristo, era n’abeera ddala ndiga etalina buyinza, eyeetegefu, eyeesiga, era n’amukkiriza okuba Omusumba wo, ng’akulabirira n’okwagala kwonna, okulabirira, n’ekisa erinnya lino bye litegeeza, era n’amugoberera buli w’akulembera, olimala okufiirwa okutabuka kwo kwonna okw’edda okw’omwoyo, era olimanya emirembe gya Katonda egisukka okutegeera kwonna, nga gikuuma emitima gyammwe n’ebirowoozo byammwe mu Kristo Yesu (Abafiripi 4:7). “Tebaategeera nti yali ayogera nabo ku Kitaawe.” (Yokaana 8:27)

fields.title: Yayogera Nabo ku Kitaawe
fields.body_html:
“Tebategeera nga yali ayogera nabo ku Kitaawe.” Yokaana 8:27 Erimu ku mannya agasingira ddala okwakiza ebifa ku Katonda lye linnya Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo lye yatategeeza mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, erinnya lya Kitaawe. Njogera nti Kristo ye yalibikkulira mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, kubanga wadde nga Katonda yayitibwanga mu mirembe gyonna amannya amalala mangi agaayolesa engeri endala ez’obuntu bwe, Kristo yekka ye yatubikkulira ye ng’atuuma erinnya erigatta byonna, erya Kitaawe—erinnya eririmu mu lyennyini amannya amalala gonna ag’amagezi n’obuyinza, era okusinga byonna ag’okwagala n’obulungi, erinnya erituwa byonna bye twetaaga mu bujjuvu. Kristo, eyali Omwana Omuzaalibwa omu yekka mu maaso ga Kitaawe, ye yekka eyasobola okubikkula erinnya lino, kubanga ye yekka ye yamanya Kitaawe.

“Nga Kitange bw’ammanyi, era nange bwe mmanyi Kitange.” (Yokaana 10:15) “Tewali muntu yali alabye Kitaawe, wabula oyo ava eri Katonda; oyo ye yalaba Kitaawe.” (Yokaana 6:46) Mu Ndagaano Enkadde, Katonda teyabikkulwa nga Kitaawe nnyo, wabula ng’omulwanyi omukulu alwanirira abantu be, oba nga kabaka ow’amaanyi abafuga era abalabirira. Erinnya lya Kitaawe liweebwa gy’ali emirundi mitono nnyo eyo, emirundi mukaaga oba musanvu okusingira ddala; songa mu Ndagaano Empya likozesebwa emirundi nga ebikumi bibiri oba bisatu. Kristo, eyamumanya, ye yekka eyasobola okumubikkula. “Tewali amanyi Kitaawe bw’ali okuggyako Omwana, n’oyo Omwana gw’anaayagala okumubikkulira.” (Lukka 10:22) Kale, ekibuuzo ekikulu ekituukirira buli omu ku ffe kwe kumanya oba ffe ffennyini tutegeera nti Kristo ayogera naffe ku Kitaawe. Tumanyi nti akozesa ekigambo Kitaawe bulijjo, naye ddala tutegeera amakulu g’ekigambo ekyo? Waakiri tulina n’akatono okutegeera Kitaawe kye ali? Obweraliikirivu bwonna n’obutabeera na mirembe mu bulamu obw’omwoyo obw’abaana ba Katonda bangi, nkakasa nti buva ku nsonga eno yennyini—nti tebategeera nti Katonda ddala era ye kennyini ye Kitaawe waabwe. Bamulowoozaako nga Omulamuzi omukalubo, oba Omukuluze ow’amaanyi, oba waakiri nga obuyinza obuli ewala obutasemberekeka obutudde ewala nnyo, nga bweteesa amateeka amazibu eri ensi etidde era ekankana; era mu kutya kwabwe nti bayinza obutatuukiriza bye yeetaaga, tebamanyi na gye banaakyukira. Naye Katonda ali nga Kitaawe, ow’ekisa, ayagala, era ajjudde okusaasira, Katonda, ng’omuzadde, ayimirira ku ludda lwabwe ng’awakanya ensi yonna, tebamutegeera ddala.

Sitya kwogera nti obutabeera na mirembe n’obweraliikirivu obw’omunda tebisoboka eri abo abatuuka okumanya nti Katonda ddala ye Kitaawe waabwe.

Naye nga sinnaba kweyongerayo, nteekwa okwolesa nti njogera ku Kitaawe ng’oyo emitima gyaffe egisingayo bwe gitutegeeza nti kitaawe omulungi bw’asaanidde okuba. Oluusi bakitaawe ab’ensi si ba kisa, balaga nkambwe, ba mululu, oba n’okuba abakambwe ennyo, oba bayinza obutafaayo n’okwerabira abaana baabwe; naye tewali ku bano ayinza mu ngeri yonna ey’amazima okuyitibwa kitaawe omulungi. Naye Katonda, omulungi, ateekwa okuba Kitaawe omulungi, oba obutaba Kitaawe n’akatono.

Ffenna twamanya bakitaffe abalungi mu nsi eno, oba waakiri tusobola okubalowoozaako. Nnamanya omu, era yajjuza obuto bwange ekitangaala olw’obwakitaawe bwe obulungi. Nkijjukira bulungi obwesige n’essanyu bye nnabeeranga nabyo buli lunaku, nga nteredde ddala mu kumanya nti nnalina kitange. Era nkakasa nti ntuuse okutegeera ekitundu ku bwakitaawe obutuukiridde obwa Katonda ng’ayita mu ngeri gye nnamanyiramu kitange ow’ensi oyo.

Naye Katonda si Kitaawe kyokka; ayolesebwa ne mu ngeri eziraga engeri z’obwakitaawe n’ez’obwamaama, era ffenna twamanya bamaama abaagala n’okusaasira kwabwe tekulina kkomo. Kya mazima nti Katonda eyabatonda bombi, era mu ye kennyini ng’ajjudde obwajjuvu bw’okwagala kw’omuzadde, teyandisobodde kutonda bakitaffe ne bamaama ab’ensi abaagala oba abasaasira okusinga ye. N’olwekyo, bwe twagala okutegeera Kitaawe ali wa ngeri ki, tuteekwa okugatta wamu engeri ennungi ennyo eza bakitaffe ne bamaama bonna be twali tumanyi oba be tusobola okulowoozaako, ne tutegeera nti n’ekyo kinnyini kya kifaananyi kitono nnyo eky’a Katonda Kitaffe ali mu ggulu.

Mukama waffe bwe yali ayigiriza abayigirizwa be engeri y’okusaba, erinnya lye yabalagira okuyita Katonda lyali, “Kitaffe ali mu ggulu, erinnya lyo litukuzibwe.” (Matayo 6:9) Kino kiraga bulungi nti tuteekwa okumulowoozaako mu ngeri eno. Emirundi obukadde n’obukadde mu mirembe gyonna, erinnya lino liyogeddwa abaana ba Katonda buli wamu; naye litegeeddwa mu buziba butya? Singa bonna abaakozesa erinnya lino baategeera ddala amakulu gaalyo, tekyandisoboddeka okuwaanyisa engeri ye n’okubuusabuusa ku kwagala kwe n’okulabirira kwe, ebyeraliikiriza emitima gy’abaana be mu byafaayo byonna, okunywera. Obukambwe, obutaba na kisa, n’obutafaayo, biyinza okuvunaanibwa Katonda erinnya lye lyali kabaka, omulamuzi, oba muteesa wa mateeka kyokka; naye Katonda ali okusooka era okusinga byonna nga Kitaawe, era kya lubeerera, kubanga ye Katonda, nga Kitaawe omulungi, ebirowoozo ng’ebyo tebiyinza kunywezebwa mu butuufu. Ekirala, kubanga ye “Kitaawe ow’emirembe gyonna,” ateekwa, olw’obuntu bwe bwennyini, okukolanga bulijjo nga Kitaawe omulungi bw’asaanidde, mu mbeera zonna, so si mu ngeri ndala yonna. Tekitegeerekeka nti kitaawe omulungi ayinza okwerabira, okulekulira, oba okukolera abaana be eby’obutali bwenkanya. Kitaawe omubi oba atafaayo ayinza okukola bw’atyo, naye kitaawe omulungi tayinza n’akatono. Era bwe tuyita Katonda waffe erinnya eddungi erya Kitaawe, tuteekwa okutegeera nti, oba nga ddala ye Kitaawe, ateekwa okuba omusinga obulungi ku bakitaffe bonna, era obwakitaawe bwe buteekwa okuba obusinga obulungi mu bwakitaawe bwonna bwe tusobola okulowooza.

Bwe bwakitaawe obulimu engeri ennungi ennyo eza kitaawe ne maama nga bagattiddwa wamu, obulimu okwagala kwonna, obukwatampola, okusaasira, okuyaayaana, n’okwefiiriza, bye tugerageranya n’obuzadde mu butuufu, wadde nga tetulaba nga bino byolesebwa mu bujjuvu mu bazadde ab’ensi.

Naye oyinza okubuuza ku mannya amalala aga Katonda—tegaleeta birowoozo ebitiisa okusinga? Galabika okukola bwe gatyo kubanga erinnya lino eddungi erya Kitaawe teritegeerebwa nga lye lisibuka wansi wa gonna.

Erinnya lino liteekwa okuba omusingi gw’erinnya lyonna eddala lye amanyibwa. Ayitiddwa Omulamuzi? Yee, naye ye Kitaawe-Omulamuzi, alamula nga kitaawe eyeeyagaza bw’andikoze. Ye Kabaka?

Yee, naye ye Kabaka era ye Kitaawe w’abantu be, abafuga n’obukwatampola bwa kitaawe. Ye Muteesa wa mateeka? Yee, naye ye Muteesa wa mateeka awa amateeka nga kitaawe bw’andikoze, ng’ajjukira obunafu n’obutamanya bw’abaana be. “Nga kitaawe w’abaana bw’asaasira abaana be, bw’atyo Mukama bw’asaasira abo abamutya.
