Okuba omulungi kye kikontania ddala n'okuba omubi. Okuba omubi kwe kumanya ekituufu naye n'otokikola, naye okuba omulungi kwe kukola ekisinga obulungi kye tumanyi. Ne ndaba nti, kubanga Katonda amanyi buli kimu, ateekwa okumanya ekisinga obulungi n'ekisingira ddala eky'ebintu byonna, era kyekiva obulungi bwe butasoboka kubuusabuusa. Sisobola kunnyonnyola kye kino kye kyantegeeza. Nnafuna okutunuulira obulungi bwa Katonda obwennyini era obw'amazima ne ndaba nti tewali kintu kiyinza kwonoonekera wansi w'obulabirizi bwe, era ne kindabikira nti tewali muntu ayinza okuddamu okweraliikirira.

Era emirundi n'emirundi, enfaanana bwe ziba zimuwakanya, era bwe mba nkemebwa okubuusabuusa obanga yali tannaŋŋambe kisa, oba yannirabidde, oba yali tafaayo, ebigambo bino bimpagalidde: “Mukama mulungi”; era ne ndaba nti tekyandiba kiyinzika ntegeere nti Katonda omulungi ayinza okukola ebibi bye nnali ndowoozeza.

Oyinza okutya n'okwewala endowooza nti oyinza mu mbeera yonna, ne mu ntobo y'omutima gwo eyeekusifu, okuwa Katonda ekibi. Kyokka toddirira kumuvunaana kukola bintu, singa omu ku mikwano gyo abikoze, bye wandiraba ng'eby'ensonyi ennyo era eby'obutali kisa. Okugeza, Abakristaayo bagwa mu buzibu; buli kimu kiraba nga kiddugavu, era tewali kuwulira kabeerwo ka Mukama. Batandika okubuusabuusa obanga Mukama abaleseeko, era oluusi ne bamuvunaana obutafaayo n'obunafu. Tebamanya nti okuvunaana kuno kwenkanankana n'okugamba nti Mukama takuuma bye yasuubiza, era nti tabakwatirwa kisa na kitiibwa nga bwe basuubira mikwano gyabwe egy'abantu bonna okubakwata. Singa omu ku mikwano gyaffe egy'abantu atulekawo kubanga tuli mu buzibu, twandiraba omukwano ng'oyo ng'ali wala nnyo n'okuba omulungi. Kale, kiyinzika kitya nti ne mu kaseera akamu tuvunaana Mukama waffe okukola ebifaanana bwe bityo? Nedda, munnange omwagalwa, oba nga Mukama mulungi — si mutuukirivu mu ddiini kyokka, wabula mulungi ddala — kiteekwa okuva mu nti bulijjo, mu mbeera yonna, akola okusinziira ku kirungi ekisingira ddala kye yennyini kye yatuyigiriza nti bwe bulungi. Obulungi mu ye buteekwa okutegeeza, nga bwe kiri gye tuli, okutuukiriza ekisinga obulungi n'ekisingira ddala ky'amanyi.

Mu nkola, kale, kitegeeza nti taajje kwerabira buvunaanyizibwa bwe bwonna gye tuli, era nti bulijjo ajja kutukwata mu ngeri esinga obulungi esoboka. Kino kiyinza okuwulikika ng'ekigambo ekya bulijjo, era oyinza okwogera nti, “Lwaki mutubuulira kino, kubanga kye tukkiriza ffenna?” Naye ddala mukikkiriza? Singa mubadde mukikkiriza, kyandisobodde okuddayo okulowooza nti yali talabirira, oba tafaayo, oba talina kisa, oba yeefaako yekka, oba talowooza balala?

Toteeka ndabika ya butuukirivu n'ogamba nti, “Nedda, sso simuvunaana bintu ng'ebyo n'akatono. Sandiŋŋanga kukikola.” Ddala tokola bwotyo? Wali tomuvunaanangako bintu bye wandiswadde ggwe wennyini okukola? Byali bitya ekivunanya eky'enaku eky'oluvannyuma bwe kyajja? Wali towulidde nga Mukama yali takoze kya kisa mu kukkiriza ekintu ekifaanana bwe kityo okukujjira, ng'ogezaako nnyo bwotyo okumuweereza? Wali tolaba okwagala kwe ng'okwagala okw'obukambwe n'obufuzi bwe kiteekwa okugonderwa, ddala, naye okutayinzika kuyagalibwa mu ngeri yonna? Wali tekirabikira nga kizibu okugamba nti, “Okwagala kwo kukolebwe”? Naye kyandirabise kizibu singa mubadde mukkiriza ddala nti Mukama mulungi, era nti bulijjo akola ekyo ekirungi?

Mukama Yesu yeegendereza nnyo okutubuulira nti yali Musumba omulungi, kubanga yamanya enfaanana bwe zaali za kumuwakanya emirundi mingi, n'engeri gye twandikemebbwamu okubuusabuusa obulungi bwe. “Nze musumba omulungi,” bwe yagamba mu makulu, “si mubi. Abasumba ababi banyooma era baleka endiga zaabwe, naye nze ndi Musumba omulungi, era sirekawo wadde okunyooma endiga zange. Nteekawo obulamu bwange olw'endiga.” Ekiraga eky'obulungi bwe mu musumba kyali nti omusumba ateekwa okukuuma endiga ze yateresebwa, wadde nga kimuwa okufa. Era yatuukiriza ekiraga kye ye. Kati, tetuyinza kulaba nti bwe tukkiriza ddala nti mulungi — si mu ngeri ey'ekyama ey'eddiini, wabula mu ngeri eno ey'amagezi amatuufu, ey'obuntu — tujja kuleetebwa mu kifo eky'emirembe mingi n'okusanyusa amangwago. Bwe mba ndiga, ne Mukama nga Musumba omulungi mu ntegeeza entuufu eya bulijjo ey'obulungi, nga ndi mukuume ddala! Nga nnyinza okuba omukakafu ku bulabirizi obusinga obulungi mu buli ngeri! Nga ndi mukuume olw'ekiseera n'olw'emirembe n'emirembe!

Twogere amazima gye tuli ffekka. Wali tetumuvunaanangako mu mitima gyaffe egy'ekyama empisa Mukama ze yatubuulira mu Ezeekyeri nti kye kabonero k'omusumba omubi? Wali tetulowoozanga nti yafaayo ku kusanyuka kwe oba ekitiibwa kye okusinga bwe yafaayo ku bwaffe? Wali tetwemulugunyanga nti teyatunyweza bwe twali abanafu, oba nti teyasiba mitima gyaffe egyamenyeka, oba nti teyatunoonya bwe twali tubuze?

Wadde ddala wali tetutunuulizzanga mbeera yaffe ey'obulwadde, n'obunafu, n'okubula, ng'ensonga lwaki teyaddayo kuba na kye tukolagana naye? Kino kyawukana kitya n'okugamba lwatu era mu bwangu nti, Mukama musumba mubi, era tatuukiriza buvunaanyizibwa bwe eri endiga ze? Oyinza okutya n'okwewala okuvvuunula kuno okw'okwemulugunya n'okwibuusabuusa kwaffe okw'omunda, naye kirala ki, mbabuuza, bye biyinza mu bwesimbu okutegeeza? Kikulu nnyo oluusi n'oluusi okuggya ebirowoozo byaffe n'enneewulira zaffe eby'ekyama ku Mukama mu kitangaala ekituufu eky'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, tulyoke tulabe endowooza yaffe gy'ali nga bw'eri ddala. Kyangu ddala okuyingira mu mpisa ey'ebirowoozo ebikyamu ku Katonda, ebirowoozo ebijja okututtandanya n'ye awatali kwetegereza mu lujjuluggwa oluggazi olw'okubuusabuusa n'obutakkiriza.

Okusinga ekintu kyonna ekirala, wadde okusinga ekibi, ebirowoozo ebikyamu ku Katonda bimalawo emisingi gy'obulamu bwaffe obw'omwoyo, era binakuwaza omutima gwe ogw'okwagala. Tuyinza okutegeera kino okuva mu ffe ffekka. Tewali kintu kitunakuwaza nnyo ng'okulaba nga mikwano gyaffe egitusalira omusango ne bitutegeera bubi ne bituwa ebigendererwa bye twenyooma. Era tewali kintu, nga bwe nzikiriza, kinakuwaza bwe kityo Mukama. Mu butuufu, kwe kusinza bakatonda abalala. Kubanga kusinza balala ki wabula okukola n'okusinza katonda ow'obulimba, era ffe kiki kye tukola wabula kino kyennyini, bwe tukkiriza okwekyamira omusango gwe, n'okumuwa ebikolwa n'enneewulira ez'obutali kisa n'ez'obutesigika.

Mu Baibuli kiyitibwa okwogera eri Katonda. “Baayogera eri Katonda; nga bagamba nti, Katonda ayinza okututeekerawo emmeeza mu ddungu?” Kino kyalabika ng'ekibuuzo ekitaliiko musango. Naye Katonda yali asuubizza okubawa byonna bye baali beetaaga mu ddungu; era okubuuza ekibuuzo kino kyategeeza obutaba na bwesige bw'ekyama mu busobozi bwe okukola nga bwe yali asuubizza; kyekyava, wadde nga kyali kifaanana ng'ekitaliiko musango, “okwogera eri” ye okw'amazima. Katonda omulungi teyandiyinzizza kutwala bantu be mu ddungu, n'alyoka alemererwa okubateekerawo emmeeza; era okubuusabuusa obanga yali ayinza okukikola kyali kitegeeza nti yali si mulungi.

Mu ngeri y'emu naffe oluusi tukemebwa nnyo okubuuza ekibuuzo ekifaanana bwe kityo. Embeera emirundi mingi zirabika nga zitasoboza Katonda kutuwa bye twetaaga, ne twesanga nga tukemebwa emirundi n'emirundi “okwogera eri” ye nga tubuuza obanga asobola. Wadde ng'akikoze emirundi mingi edda, tulabika nga tetusobola kukkiriza nti ayinza okuddamu okukikola, era mu mitima gyaffe “tumukoma,” kubanga tetukkiriza Kigambo kye wadde okwesiga obulungi bwe.

Singa okukkiriza kwaffe kwabadde nga bwe kwandibadde, tewandibaddewo mbeera, wadde nga mbi etya, eyandituleetedde “okukoma” obuyinza bwa Katonda okutuwa bye twetaaga. Katonda ayinza okukola embeera ddala ayinza okufuga embeera, era ayinza, wadde mu ddungu, “okuteekawo emmeeza” eri bonna abamwesiga.

Waliwo ebibuuzo bingi ebifaanana bwe bityo mu Baibuli, buli kimu nga kireeta okubuusabuusa ku bulungi bwa Katonda, era buli kimu, ntya nti, kifaanana n'ebibuuzo abaana ba Katonda bye babuuza kaakano.

“Katonda ali wakati mu ffe oba nedda?”

“Katonda yeerabidde okuba ow'ekisa?”

“Okusaasira kwa Katonda kuweddewo ddala emirembe gyonna?”

“Katonda mu busungu asibidde okusaasira kwe okw'ekisa?”

“Ebisuubizo bya Katonda bijja kulemererwa emirembe n'emirembe?”

“Ayi Katonda, lwaki otusuulidde ddala emirembe gyonna?”

“Lwaki wankola bwe nti?”

Ka tulowoozeeko ku bibuuzo bino akaseera katono, tulabe obanga tuyinza okusanga ebibifaananako mu kwebuuza kwaffe okw'ekyama.

“Katonda ali wakati mu ffe oba nedda?”

Atulangiridde mu bigambo ebitasoboka kubuusabuusa, nga bwe yakola abaana ba Isirayiri, nti abeera naffe bulijjo, era talitulekulira n'akatono; kyokka akabi bwe kajja, tutandika, nga bwe baakola, okubuusabuusa Kigambo kye n'okwebuuza obanga mazima ali wano. Musa yayita kino, Abayisirayiri bwe baakikola, “okukema Mukama,” era kisaanira okunenyezebwa kwe kumu bwe tukikola. Tewali muntu ayinza okubuuza ekibuuzo ng'ekyo awatali kussa akabuusabuusa ku bwesimbu n'obwesigwa bwa Mukama; era okukibuuza, singa tukimanyi, kwe kumuvuma n'okwonoona empisa ye. Mmanyi nti, zisanze! kibuuzo kya bulijjo ne mu baana ba Katonda bennyini, era mmanyi era nti bangi ku bo balowooza nti kwe kwetoowaza okw'amazima okukibuuza, era nti, eri ebitonde ebitasaanira nga bwe beewulira, kyandibadde kya malala okuba abakakafu ku kubeerawo kwe naabo.

Naye Kigambo kye kyennyini kigamba ki ku nsonga eno? Atulangiridde mu ngeri yonna esoboka nti abeera naffe, era talitulekulira wadde okututawaanya, era tuyinza tutya “okumufuula omulimba” nga tubuusabuusa amazima g'Ekigambo kye? Katonda omulungi tayinza kulimba, era tuteekwa okulekera awo emirembe gyonna okubuuza ekibuuzo ng'ekino. Mukama abeera naffe mu mazima nga bwe tuli ne ffekka, era tulina okukkiriza busa nti abeerawo, ka embeera zirabike zitya.

“Katonda yeerabidde okuba ow'ekisa?”

Okubuuza ekibuuzo kino kwe “kwogera eri” ye mu bunene nga bwe kyandibadde okubuuza maama omulungi obanga yeerabidde omwana we. Kyokka Mukama yennyini agamba nti: “Omukazi ayinza okwerabira omwana we gwayonsa? Weewaawo bo bayinza okwerabira, naye nze siikwerabire.” Ffe abamu abali ba maama tumanyi bulungi engeri gye twandinakuwalidde ne tuvumibwa singa waliwo omuntu yenna ayogera nti kisoboka ffe okwerabira abaana baffe; era ffe abamaama waakiri, singa tewali mulala, tuteekwa okusobola okutegeera engeri okwebuuza ng'okwo gye kunakuwaza Mukama.

“Okusaasira kwa Katonda kuweddewo ddala emirembe gyonna?” “Katonda mu busungu asibidde okusaasira kwe okw'ekisa?”

Okubuuza ebibuuzo bino ebibiri eri Katonda omulungi kwe kumuvuma. Kyandibadde ekitasoboka okusaasira kwe okw'ekisa okusibirwa gye tuli, oba okusaasira kwe okutuvaako emirembe gyonna, nga bwe kyandibadde ekitasoboka okusaasira kwa maama okw'ekisa okukoma. Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli agamba nti: “Mukama mulungi eri bonna, era okusaasira kwe okw'ekisa kubuna emirimu gye gyonna.” Mu ngeri y'ebintu bwe biri kino kiteekwa okubeerawo, kubanga Katonda mulungi, era tayinza kukola bulala.

“Ebisuubizo bya Katonda bijja kulemererwa emirembe n'emirembe?”

Wajja ebiseera mu bulamu bwa buli Mukristaayo lwe tukemebwa okubuuza ekibuuzo kino. Buli kimu kiraba nga kigenda bubi, era ebisuubizo bya Katonda byonna biraba ng'ebiremye. Naye bwe tujjukira nti Mukama mulungi, tujja kulaba nti yandiremye okuba omulungi singa ekintu ng'ekyo kyandisobose. Omuntu amenya ebisuubizo bye alabibwa ng'omuntu atalina kitiibwa era atesigika; era Katonda ayinza okumenya ebibye, singa omuntu ayinza okulowooza ekintu ng'ekyo, yandibadde atalina kitiibwa era atesigika naye. Era okubuuza ekibuuzo ng'ekyo kwe kussa akamogo ku bulungi bwe, akayinza okuyitibwa bulungi “okwogera eri Katonda.” Ka embeera zirabike zitya, tuyinza okuba abakakafu ku kino, nti kubanga Katonda mulungi tewali kisuubizo kye ekyali kiremye, wadde okuyinza okulemererwa.

Eggulu n'ensi biyinza okuggwaawo, naye Ekigambo kye tekigenda kuggwaawo.

“Ayi Katonda, lwaki otusuulidde ddala emirembe gyonna?”

Kijja kuba ekitasoboka Katonda omulungi okututsuula nga bwe kyandibadde ekitasoboka maama omulungi okusuula omwana we. Tuyinza okuba mu buzibu ne mu kizikiza, era tuyinza okwewulira nga abasuuliddwa era abalekeddwa, naye enneewulira zaffe teziriiko kye zikola n'amazima, era amazima nti Katonda mulungi, era teyandikisoboze. Omusumba omulungi tasuula ndiga ebuze, n'atafaayo nate ku yo, wabula agenda okuginoonya, era anoonya okutuusa lw'agizuula. Okumuteeba nti atusuula emirembe gyonna kwe kufumita n'okunakuwaza okwagala kwe okwesigwa, nga bwe kyandifumitidde omutima gwa maama omulungi singa alowoozebwa nga asobola okusuula omwana we, ka omwana oyo abeere yabuze wala atya. Ekintu kino tekisoboka mu mbeera zombi, naye tekisoboka nnyo mu Katonda okusinga ne mu maama omulungi eyali abaddewo.

“Lwaki wankola bwe nti?”

Kino kye kibuuzo kye tuli beetegefu nnyo okubuuza. Ndowooza, tewali n'omu ku ffe atakemebbwako ekiseera kimu oba ekirala “okuwakana ne Katonda” ku nsonga y'enkola yaffe ffe ffennyini. Tetusiima mpisa zaffe ez'enjawulo oba engeri zaffe ez'enjawulo, era twegomba okuba nga omuntu omulala gwe tulowooza nti alina ebirabo ebisinga eby'endabika oba eby'obusobozi. Tetumatira ku nkola yaffe, ey'omunda n'ey'ebweru, era tuli bakakafu nti okulemererwa kwaffe kwonna kuva ku mpisa zaffe embi; era twesiba okuvunaana Omutonzi waffe olw'“okutukola bwe tuli.”

Nzijukira bulungi nnyo ekiseera mu bulamu bwange lwe nnakemebwa okujeemera nnyo enkola yange. Nnali muntu ayogera lwatu, ow'amaanyi, nga ngezaako okuba Mukristaayo omulungi, naye nga sirina ndabika ya butukuvu ya njawulo. Naye nnalina mwannyinaze eyali mutukuvu nnyo mu ndabika ye, era eyalina empisa ey'obutukuvu, ne kirabika ng'ekifaananyi ky'obutukuvu; era nnali mukakafu nti nnandisobodde okuba Mukristaayo omulungi ennyo singa nnasobodde okufuna endabika ye ey'obutukuvu n'empisa ye. Naye okufuba kwange kwonna okubifuna kwali kwa bwereere.

Empisa yange ey'obuzaaliranwa yali ya maanyi nnyo era ey'okwogera lwatu okusukka endabika yonna ey'obutukuvu, era emirundi mingi nnagamba mu mutima gwange n'okunenya eri Katonda nti, “Lwaki wankola bwe nti?” Naye olunaku olumu ne nsanga sentensi mu kitabo eky'edda eky'ekyama ekyalabika nga kizibula amaaso gange. Yali bw'eti: “Mala kuba nga Katonda wo bwe yakukola”; era ne kimwansikira nti kyali kya mazima ddala nti Katonda ye yankola, era nti ateekwa okumanya ekika ky'ekitonde kye yayagala okuba; era nti singa yankola omuzabbibu gw'ebijanjaalo, nteekwa okumatira okumeza ebijanjaalo, so ssaagombe kuba muti gwa maluuli ne gumeza amaluuli; era singa yampangira emirimu egy'obwetoowaze, nteekwa okumatira n'aleka abalala okukola emirimu egy'ekitiibwa. Tuli “omulimu gwa Katonda,” era Katonda mulungi, kyekiva n'omulimu gwe guteekwa okuba omulungi nagwo; era tuyinza okwesiga n'obwesige nti nga tannaggwa naffe, ajja kutufuulamu ekintu ekinaaba eky'ekitiibwa kye, ka twewulire tutya nga tetukifaanana kaakano.

Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli yalabika ng'asanyukira okuddiŋŋaana emirundi n'emirundi ekigambo kino ekya mukisa, “kubanga Mukama mulungi.” Kyandibadde kya mugaso okuddira konkodanoosi zo n'olaba nga bw'akyogera emirundi emeka. Era yakubiriza buli muntu okwegatta naye mu kukyogera. “Abanunulibwa ba Mukama kaboogere bwe batyo,” kwe kwali okukoowoola kwe okw'amaanyi. Tuteekwa okwegatta amaloboozi gaffe ku gage — Mukama mulungi — Mukama mulungi. Naye tetuteekwa kukyogera na mimwa gyaffe gyokka, ne tulyoka mu bikolwa byaffe tuwakanya ebigambo byaffe. Tuteekwa “okukyogera” n'obulamu bwaffe bwonna, mu birowoozo, mu bigambo, ne mu bikolwa, abantu balyoke balabe nti tukitegeeza ddala, era bakakasibwe nti kya mazima ekinene.

Ebintu bingi nnyo mu nkola za Katonda ez'obwakatonda tebirabika ng'obulungi eri eriiso ery'okuwulira, era nga tusoma Zabbuli twewuunya oboolyawo engeri omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli gye yayinza okugambira, oluvannyuma lw'ebimu ku bintu by'awandiika, nti “kubanga okusaasira kwe kubeerera emirembe gyonna.” Naye okukkiriza kutuula mu maaso g'ebyama ng'ebyo, ne kugamba nti, “Mukama mulungi, kyekiva byonna by'akola biteekwa okuba ebirungi, ka birabike bitya, era nnyinza okulinda ennyinnyonnyola ze.”

Ekifaananyi eky'okulabirira ennyumba emirundi mingi kimbeeredde wano. Bwe mba nina mukwano gwange gwe mmanyi okuba omulabirizi w'ennyumba omulungi, sseeraliikirira olw'ekiruubirirwa nti mu kiseera eky'okuyonja ennyumba ebintu mu nnyumba ye biyinza okulabika nga bikubaganyiziddwa katono oba nnyo, kaapeti nga zisituddwa, n'ebintu nga bibisiddwa n'ebibikka, era oboolyawo n'okusiiga langi n'okuwunda nga bifudde ebisenge ebimu okuba ebitasulwamu. Ne ngamba mu mutima gwange nti, “Mukwano gwange mulabirizi w'ennyumba omulungi, era wadde ng'ebintu bironeeza kaakano bwe bityo, okukubaganyizibwa kuno kwonna kuli lwa kubanga oluvannyuma agenda kugifuula ennungi n'okusinga bwe yali edda.”

Ensi eno ye kulabirira ennyumba kwa Katonda; era wadde ng'ebintu kaakano birabika nga bikubaganyiziddwa mu buzibu, kyokka, kubanga tumanyi nti mulungi, era kyekiva ateekwa okuba Omulabirizi w'ennyumba omulungi, tuyinza okuba abakakafu ddala nti okukubaganyizibwa kuno okwa kaakano kwonna kuli lwa kuleeta mu nkomerero embeera esinga obulungi eyandibaddewo awatali kwo. Nzikiriza nti ffenna oluusi twewuliddeko nga tuyinza okukola okulabirira ennyumba kwa Katonda okusinga bw'akola ye mwennyini, naye, bwe tutegeera nti Katonda mulungi, tetuyinza kuddayo kuwulira kino. Era kimpooyeza nnyo, ensi bw'endabikira nga egenda bubi bwonna, okwogera busa mu mutima gwange nti, “Si kulabirira ennyumba kwange, wabula kwa Mukama; era Mukama mulungi, kyekiva okulabirira ennyumba kwe kuteekwa okuba okulungi nakwo; era kya busirusiru gye ndi okweraliikirira.”

Omukristaayo eyali ayigiriziddwa mu buziba yabuuzibwa omwana wa Katonda eyali mu kunakuwala nti, “Ensi terabika gy'oli ng'ekintu ekyonoonese?”

“Weewaawo,” bwe kwali okuddamu, mu ddoboozi ery'obwesige obw'essanyu; “weewaawo, ng'okuzikirira kw'ensigo eyatuka.”

Yenna ku ffe eyali alabye okumela okusooka kw'omuti gwa oak okuva mu mutima gw'ensigo ya oak evunda ajja kutegeera kino kye kitegeeza. Ensigo ya oak nga tennaleeta muti gwa oak, eteekwa okusooka okwonooneka yokka. Tewali kimera ekyali kivudde mu nsigo yonna okuggyako ensigo eyonoonese.

Mukama waffe akozesa amazima gano okutuyigiriza amakulu g'enkola ze naffe. “Mazima ddala, mazima ddala, mbagamba nti, empeke y'eŋŋaano bw'etagwa mu ttaka n'efa, esigala yokka; naye bw'efa, ereeta ebibala bingi.” Yokaana 12:24.

Ennyinnyonnyola yonna ey'okwonooneka okulabika okw'ensi yonna, oba obulamu bwaffe ffennyini obw'enjawulo, eno wano ewaayo. Era, nga tukitunuulira mu kitangaala kino, tuyinza okutegeera engeri Mukama gy'ayinza okuba omulungi, ate n'akkiriza okubeerawo kw'ennaku n'obukyamu mu nsi gy'atonze, ne mu bulamu bw'abantu b'ayagala. Bwe bulungi bwe bwennyini obumuwaliriza okukikkiriza. Kubanga amanyi nti, okuyita mu kwonooneka okulabika okwo kwokka, kwe kutuukirira kw'ebigendererwa bye eby'ekitiibwa gye tuli kuyinza okuleetebwa. Era ffe emitima gyaffe nagyo egyegomba okutuukirira okwo, bwe tutegeera amakubo ge, tujja kusobola okumutendereza olw'obulungi bwe bwonna, ne bwe wabaawo ebintu ebirabika ebisinga obuzibu n'eby'ekyama.

Omutume atugamba nti okwagala kwa Katonda “kulungi, era kusiimibwa, era kutuukiridde.” Okwagala kwa Katonda omulungi tekuyinza butaba “kulungi” — mu butuufu, kuteekwa okuba okutuukiridde; era, bwe tukimanya, bulijjo tukisanga nga “kusiimibwa”; kwe kugamba nti tujja kukwagala. Nkakasiza ddala nti obuzibu bwonna obw'okwewaayo eri okwagala kwa Katonda bwandibulidde, singa omulundi gumu twasobola okulaba bulungi nti okwagala kwe kulungi.

Tufuba ne tufuba awatali kugasa okwewaayo eri okwagala kwe tutakkiriza kuba kulungi, naye bwe tulaba nti kulungi ddala, tukwewaayo n'essanyu. Twagala kutuukirizibwe. Emitima gyaffe gibuuka okukusisinkana.

Nkusinza, ggwe Okwagala kwa Katonda okuwoomerera!

Era amakubo go gonna ngasinza; Era, buli lunaku lwe mba omulamu, ndabika nga nkwagala okusingawo n'okweyongera.

Njagala okunywegera buli kigere gy'oteeka ebigere byo ebitalabika: Sisobola kukutya, ggwe Okwagala okw'omukisa!

Obwakabaka bwo buwoomerera nnyo.

Ekifo kimbula okubuulira byonna bye nnyinza okwogera ku bulungi bwa Mukama obutakoma. Buli omu ateekwa “okulega n'okulaba” yekka. Era singa akikola mu bwesimbu ne mu bwesigwa, ebigambo by'omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli bijja kumutuukako: “Balifukumula ettutumu ery'obulungi bwo obungi era baliyimba n'eddoboozi ery'obutuukirivu bwo.” Zabbuli 145:7
fields.body_text: “Mulege mulabe nga Mukama bw'ali omulungi! Alina omukisa omuntu eyeekweka mu ye!” (Zabbuli 34:8). Wali weebuuzizzaako ky'olowooza mu bwesimbu ku Katonda mu ntobo y'omutima gwo — obanga omukkiriza okuba Katonda omulungi oba Katonda omubi? Nsuubira ekibuuzo kino kijja kukyewuunyisa, era ojja kutya nnyo endowooza nti oyinza mu ngeri yonna okulowooza nti Katonda mubi. Naye nga tonnaggwa kusoma ssuula eno, ndowooza abamu ku mmwe bajja kuwalirizibwa okukkiriza nti, oboolyawo awatali kukimanya naye mu butuufu, nga muyita mu kubuusabuusa kwammwe n'okwemulugunya kwammwe, mumuwadde empisa gye mwandiswadde okuwa mwekka. Siryerabira ekiseera lwe nnasooka okuzuula nti Katonda yali mulungi ddala. Mu butuufu nnali mmanyi bulijjo nti Baibuli yagamba nti mulungi, naye nnali ndowooza nti kitegeeza nti mulungi mu by'eddiini kyokka; era tekyali kunnetegeereza nti kitegeeza nti mulungi mu butuufu ne mu ngeri ey'enkola, n'obulungi bwe bumu obwo bwe yatulagira okuba nabwo. Ebigambo, “Obulungi bwa Katonda,” byali bindabikira ng'ebitali bimu wabula ng'ekigambo eky'omu ggulu, kye ssaali nsuubirwa kutegeera. Awo olunaku olumu, nga nsoma Baibuli yange, ne nsanga ebigambo, “Mulege mulabe nga Mukama bw'ali omulungi,” amangwago ne bitandika okuba n'amakulu. Mukama mulungi, ne needdiŋŋaanya mu mutima gwange. Kitegeeza ki okuba omulungi? Si kirala wabula kino: okutuukiriza ekisinga obulungi n'ekisingira ddala eky'omuntu ky'amanyi. Okuba omulungi kye kikontania ddala n'okuba omubi. Okuba omubi kwe kumanya ekituufu naye n'otokikola, naye okuba omulungi kwe kukola ekisinga obulungi kye tumanyi. Ne ndaba nti, kubanga Katonda amanyi buli kimu, ateekwa okumanya ekisinga obulungi n'ekisingira ddala eky'ebintu byonna, era kyekiva obulungi bwe butasoboka kubuusabuusa. Sisobola kunnyonnyola kye kino kye kyantegeeza. Nnafuna okutunuulira obulungi bwa Katonda obwennyini era obw'amazima ne ndaba nti tewali kintu kiyinza kwonoonekera wansi w'obulabirizi bwe, era ne kindabikira nti tewali muntu ayinza okuddamu okweraliikirira. Era emirundi n'emirundi, enfaanana bwe ziba zimuwakanya, era bwe mba nkemebwa okubuusabuusa obanga yali tannaŋŋambe kisa, oba yannirabidde, oba yali tafaayo, ebigambo bino bimpagalidde: “Mukama mulungi”; era ne ndaba nti tekyandiba kiyinzika ntegeere nti Katonda omulungi ayinza okukola ebibi bye nnali ndowoozeza. Oyinza okutya n'okwewala endowooza nti oyinza mu mbeera yonna, ne mu ntobo y'omutima gwo eyeekusifu, okuwa Katonda ekibi. Kyokka toddirira kumuvunaana kukola bintu, singa omu ku mikwano gyo abikoze, bye wandiraba ng'eby'ensonyi ennyo era eby'obutali kisa. Okugeza, Abakristaayo bagwa mu buzibu; buli kimu kiraba nga kiddugavu, era tewali kuwulira kabeerwo ka Mukama. Batandika okubuusabuusa obanga Mukama abaleseeko, era oluusi ne bamuvunaana obutafaayo n'obunafu. Tebamanya nti okuvunaana kuno kwenkanankana n'okugamba nti Mukama takuuma bye yasuubiza, era nti tabakwatirwa kisa na kitiibwa nga bwe basuubira mikwano gyabwe egy'abantu bonna okubakwata. Singa omu ku mikwano gyaffe egy'abantu atulekawo kubanga tuli mu buzibu, twandiraba omukwano ng'oyo ng'ali wala nnyo n'okuba omulungi. Kale, kiyinzika kitya nti ne mu kaseera akamu tuvunaana Mukama waffe okukola ebifaanana bwe bityo? Nedda, munnange omwagalwa, oba nga Mukama mulungi — si mutuukirivu mu ddiini kyokka, wabula mulungi ddala — kiteekwa okuva mu nti bulijjo, mu mbeera yonna, akola okusinziira ku kirungi ekisingira ddala kye yennyini kye yatuyigiriza nti bwe bulungi. Obulungi mu ye buteekwa okutegeeza, nga bwe kiri gye tuli, okutuukiriza ekisinga obulungi n'ekisingira ddala ky'amanyi. Mu nkola, kale, kitegeeza nti taajje kwerabira buvunaanyizibwa bwe bwonna gye tuli, era nti bulijjo ajja kutukwata mu ngeri esinga obulungi esoboka. Kino kiyinza okuwulikika ng'ekigambo ekya bulijjo, era oyinza okwogera nti, “Lwaki mutubuulira kino, kubanga kye tukkiriza ffenna?” Naye ddala mukikkiriza? Singa mubadde mukikkiriza, kyandisobodde okuddayo okulowooza nti yali talabirira, oba tafaayo, oba talina kisa, oba yeefaako yekka, oba talowooza balala? Toteeka ndabika ya butuukirivu n'ogamba nti, “Nedda, sso simuvunaana bintu ng'ebyo n'akatono. Sandiŋŋanga kukikola.” Ddala tokola bwotyo? Wali tomuvunaanangako bintu bye wandiswadde ggwe wennyini okukola? Byali bitya ekivunanya eky'enaku eky'oluvannyuma bwe kyajja? Wali towulidde nga Mukama yali takoze kya kisa mu kukkiriza ekintu ekifaanana bwe kityo okukujjira, ng'ogezaako nnyo bwotyo okumuweereza? Wali tolaba okwagala kwe ng'okwagala okw'obukambwe n'obufuzi bwe kiteekwa okugonderwa, ddala, naye okutayinzika kuyagalibwa mu ngeri yonna? Wali tekirabikira nga kizibu okugamba nti, “Okwagala kwo kukolebwe”? Naye kyandirabise kizibu singa mubadde mukkiriza ddala nti Mukama mulungi, era nti bulijjo akola ekyo ekirungi? Mukama Yesu yeegendereza nnyo okutubuulira nti yali Musumba omulungi, kubanga yamanya enfaanana bwe zaali za kumuwakanya emirundi mingi, n'engeri gye twandikemebbwamu okubuusabuusa obulungi bwe. “Nze musumba omulungi,” bwe yagamba mu makulu, “si mubi. Abasumba ababi banyooma era baleka endiga zaabwe, naye nze ndi Musumba omulungi, era sirekawo wadde okunyooma endiga zange. Nteekawo obulamu bwange olw'endiga.” Ekiraga eky'obulungi bwe mu musumba kyali nti omusumba ateekwa okukuuma endiga ze yateresebwa, wadde nga kimuwa okufa. Era yatuukiriza ekiraga kye ye. Kati, tetuyinza kulaba nti bwe tukkiriza ddala nti mulungi — si mu ngeri ey'ekyama ey'eddiini, wabula mu ngeri eno ey'amagezi amatuufu, ey'obuntu — tujja kuleetebwa mu kifo eky'emirembe mingi n'okusanyusa amangwago. Bwe mba ndiga, ne Mukama nga Musumba omulungi mu ntegeeza entuufu eya bulijjo ey'obulungi, nga ndi mukuume ddala! Nga nnyinza okuba omukakafu ku bulabirizi obusinga obulungi mu buli ngeri! Nga ndi mukuume olw'ekiseera n'olw'emirembe n'emirembe! Twogere amazima gye tuli ffekka. Wali tetumuvunaanangako mu mitima gyaffe egy'ekyama empisa Mukama ze yatubuulira mu Ezeekyeri nti kye kabonero k'omusumba omubi? Wali tetulowoozanga nti yafaayo ku kusanyuka kwe oba ekitiibwa kye okusinga bwe yafaayo ku bwaffe? Wali tetwemulugunyanga nti teyatunyweza bwe twali abanafu, oba nti teyasiba mitima gyaffe egyamenyeka, oba nti teyatunoonya bwe twali tubuze? Wadde ddala wali tetutunuulizzanga mbeera yaffe ey'obulwadde, n'obunafu, n'okubula, ng'ensonga lwaki teyaddayo kuba na kye tukolagana naye? Kino kyawukana kitya n'okugamba lwatu era mu bwangu nti, Mukama musumba mubi, era tatuukiriza buvunaanyizibwa bwe eri endiga ze? Oyinza okutya n'okwewala okuvvuunula kuno okw'okwemulugunya n'okwibuusabuusa kwaffe okw'omunda, naye kirala ki, mbabuuza, bye biyinza mu bwesimbu okutegeeza? Kikulu nnyo oluusi n'oluusi okuggya ebirowoozo byaffe n'enneewulira zaffe eby'ekyama ku Mukama mu kitangaala ekituufu eky'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, tulyoke tulabe endowooza yaffe gy'ali nga bw'eri ddala. Kyangu ddala okuyingira mu mpisa ey'ebirowoozo ebikyamu ku Katonda, ebirowoozo ebijja okututtandanya n'ye awatali kwetegereza mu lujjuluggwa oluggazi olw'okubuusabuusa n'obutakkiriza. Okusinga ekintu kyonna ekirala, wadde okusinga ekibi, ebirowoozo ebikyamu ku Katonda bimalawo emisingi gy'obulamu bwaffe obw'omwoyo, era binakuwaza omutima gwe ogw'okwagala. Tuyinza okutegeera kino okuva mu ffe ffekka. Tewali kintu kitunakuwaza nnyo ng'okulaba nga mikwano gyaffe egitusalira omusango ne bitutegeera bubi ne bituwa ebigendererwa bye twenyooma. Era tewali kintu, nga bwe nzikiriza, kinakuwaza bwe kityo Mukama. Mu butuufu, kwe kusinza bakatonda abalala. Kubanga kusinza balala ki wabula okukola n'okusinza katonda ow'obulimba, era ffe kiki kye tukola wabula kino kyennyini, bwe tukkiriza okwekyamira omusango gwe, n'okumuwa ebikolwa n'enneewulira ez'obutali kisa n'ez'obutesigika. Mu Baibuli kiyitibwa okwogera eri Katonda. “Baayogera eri Katonda; nga bagamba nti, Katonda ayinza okututeekerawo emmeeza mu ddungu?” Kino kyalabika ng'ekibuuzo ekitaliiko musango. Naye Katonda yali asuubizza okubawa byonna bye baali beetaaga mu ddungu; era okubuuza ekibuuzo kino kyategeeza obutaba na bwesige bw'ekyama mu busobozi bwe okukola nga bwe yali asuubizza; kyekyava, wadde nga kyali kifaanana ng'ekitaliiko musango, “okwogera eri” ye okw'amazima. Katonda omulungi teyandiyinzizza kutwala bantu be mu ddungu, n'alyoka alemererwa okubateekerawo emmeeza; era okubuusabuusa obanga yali ayinza okukikola kyali kitegeeza nti yali si mulungi. Mu ngeri y'emu naffe oluusi tukemebwa nnyo okubuuza ekibuuzo ekifaanana bwe kityo. Embeera emirundi mingi zirabika nga zitasoboza Katonda kutuwa bye twetaaga, ne twesanga nga tukemebwa emirundi n'emirundi “okwogera eri” ye nga tubuuza obanga asobola. Wadde ng'akikoze emirundi mingi edda, tulabika nga tetusobola kukkiriza nti ayinza okuddamu okukikola, era mu mitima gyaffe “tumukoma,” kubanga tetukkiriza Kigambo kye wadde okwesiga obulungi bwe. Singa okukkiriza kwaffe kwabadde nga bwe kwandibadde, tewandibaddewo mbeera, wadde nga mbi etya, eyandituleetedde “okukoma” obuyinza bwa Katonda okutuwa bye twetaaga. Katonda ayinza okukola embeera ddala ayinza okufuga embeera, era ayinza, wadde mu ddungu, “okuteekawo emmeeza” eri bonna abamwesiga. Waliwo ebibuuzo bingi ebifaanana bwe bityo mu Baibuli, buli kimu nga kireeta okubuusabuusa ku bulungi bwa Katonda, era buli kimu, ntya nti, kifaanana n'ebibuuzo abaana ba Katonda bye babuuza kaakano. “Katonda ali wakati mu ffe oba nedda?” “Katonda yeerabidde okuba ow'ekisa?” “Okusaasira kwa Katonda kuweddewo ddala emirembe gyonna?” “Katonda mu busungu asibidde okusaasira kwe okw'ekisa?” “Ebisuubizo bya Katonda bijja kulemererwa emirembe n'emirembe?” “Ayi Katonda, lwaki otusuulidde ddala emirembe gyonna?” “Lwaki wankola bwe nti?” Ka tulowoozeeko ku bibuuzo bino akaseera katono, tulabe obanga tuyinza okusanga ebibifaananako mu kwebuuza kwaffe okw'ekyama. “Katonda ali wakati mu ffe oba nedda?” Atulangiridde mu bigambo ebitasoboka kubuusabuusa, nga bwe yakola abaana ba Isirayiri, nti abeera naffe bulijjo, era talitulekulira n'akatono; kyokka akabi bwe kajja, tutandika, nga bwe baakola, okubuusabuusa Kigambo kye n'okwebuuza obanga mazima ali wano. Musa yayita kino, Abayisirayiri bwe baakikola, “okukema Mukama,” era kisaanira okunenyezebwa kwe kumu bwe tukikola. Tewali muntu ayinza okubuuza ekibuuzo ng'ekyo awatali kussa akabuusabuusa ku bwesimbu n'obwesigwa bwa Mukama; era okukibuuza, singa tukimanyi, kwe kumuvuma n'okwonoona empisa ye. Mmanyi nti, zisanze! kibuuzo kya bulijjo ne mu baana ba Katonda bennyini, era mmanyi era nti bangi ku bo balowooza nti kwe kwetoowaza okw'amazima okukibuuza, era nti, eri ebitonde ebitasaanira nga bwe beewulira, kyandibadde kya malala okuba abakakafu ku kubeerawo kwe naabo. Naye Kigambo kye kyennyini kigamba ki ku nsonga eno? Atulangiridde mu ngeri yonna esoboka nti abeera naffe, era talitulekulira wadde okututawaanya, era tuyinza tutya “okumufuula omulimba” nga tubuusabuusa amazima g'Ekigambo kye? Katonda omulungi tayinza kulimba, era tuteekwa okulekera awo emirembe gyonna okubuuza ekibuuzo ng'ekino. Mukama abeera naffe mu mazima nga bwe tuli ne ffekka, era tulina okukkiriza busa nti abeerawo, ka embeera zirabike zitya. “Katonda yeerabidde okuba ow'ekisa?” Okubuuza ekibuuzo kino kwe “kwogera eri” ye mu bunene nga bwe kyandibadde okubuuza maama omulungi obanga yeerabidde omwana we. Kyokka Mukama yennyini agamba nti: “Omukazi ayinza okwerabira omwana we gwayonsa? Weewaawo bo bayinza okwerabira, naye nze siikwerabire.” Ffe abamu abali ba maama tumanyi bulungi engeri gye twandinakuwalidde ne tuvumibwa singa waliwo omuntu yenna ayogera nti kisoboka ffe okwerabira abaana baffe; era ffe abamaama waakiri, singa tewali mulala, tuteekwa okusobola okutegeera engeri okwebuuza ng'okwo gye kunakuwaza Mukama. “Okusaasira kwa Katonda kuweddewo ddala emirembe gyonna?” “Katonda mu busungu asibidde okusaasira kwe okw'ekisa?” Okubuuza ebibuuzo bino ebibiri eri Katonda omulungi kwe kumuvuma. Kyandibadde ekitasoboka okusaasira kwe okw'ekisa okusibirwa gye tuli, oba okusaasira kwe okutuvaako emirembe gyonna, nga bwe kyandibadde ekitasoboka okusaasira kwa maama okw'ekisa okukoma. Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli agamba nti: “Mukama mulungi eri bonna, era okusaasira kwe okw'ekisa kubuna emirimu gye gyonna.” Mu ngeri y'ebintu bwe biri kino kiteekwa okubeerawo, kubanga Katonda mulungi, era tayinza kukola bulala. “Ebisuubizo bya Katonda bijja kulemererwa emirembe n'emirembe?” Wajja ebiseera mu bulamu bwa buli Mukristaayo lwe tukemebwa okubuuza ekibuuzo kino. Buli kimu kiraba nga kigenda bubi, era ebisuubizo bya Katonda byonna biraba ng'ebiremye. Naye bwe tujjukira nti Mukama mulungi, tujja kulaba nti yandiremye okuba omulungi singa ekintu ng'ekyo kyandisobose. Omuntu amenya ebisuubizo bye alabibwa ng'omuntu atalina kitiibwa era atesigika; era Katonda ayinza okumenya ebibye, singa omuntu ayinza okulowooza ekintu ng'ekyo, yandibadde atalina kitiibwa era atesigika naye. Era okubuuza ekibuuzo ng'ekyo kwe kussa akamogo ku bulungi bwe, akayinza okuyitibwa bulungi “okwogera eri Katonda.” Ka embeera zirabike zitya, tuyinza okuba abakakafu ku kino, nti kubanga Katonda mulungi tewali kisuubizo kye ekyali kiremye, wadde okuyinza okulemererwa. Eggulu n'ensi biyinza okuggwaawo, naye Ekigambo kye tekigenda kuggwaawo. “Ayi Katonda, lwaki otusuulidde ddala emirembe gyonna?” Kijja kuba ekitasoboka Katonda omulungi okututsuula nga bwe kyandibadde ekitasoboka maama omulungi okusuula omwana we. Tuyinza okuba mu buzibu ne mu kizikiza, era tuyinza okwewulira nga abasuuliddwa era abalekeddwa, naye enneewulira zaffe teziriiko kye zikola n'amazima, era amazima nti Katonda mulungi, era teyandikisoboze. Omusumba omulungi tasuula ndiga ebuze, n'atafaayo nate ku yo, wabula agenda okuginoonya, era anoonya okutuusa lw'agizuula. Okumuteeba nti atusuula emirembe gyonna kwe kufumita n'okunakuwaza okwagala kwe okwesigwa, nga bwe kyandifumitidde omutima gwa maama omulungi singa alowoozebwa nga asobola okusuula omwana we, ka omwana oyo abeere yabuze wala atya. Ekintu kino tekisoboka mu mbeera zombi, naye tekisoboka nnyo mu Katonda okusinga ne mu maama omulungi eyali abaddewo. “Lwaki wankola bwe nti?” Kino kye kibuuzo kye tuli beetegefu nnyo okubuuza. Ndowooza, tewali n'omu ku ffe atakemebbwako ekiseera kimu oba ekirala “okuwakana ne Katonda” ku nsonga y'enkola yaffe ffe ffennyini. Tetusiima mpisa zaffe ez'enjawulo oba engeri zaffe ez'enjawulo, era twegomba okuba nga omuntu omulala gwe tulowooza nti alina ebirabo ebisinga eby'endabika oba eby'obusobozi. Tetumatira ku nkola yaffe, ey'omunda n'ey'ebweru, era tuli bakakafu nti okulemererwa kwaffe kwonna kuva ku mpisa zaffe embi; era twesiba okuvunaana Omutonzi waffe olw'“okutukola bwe tuli.” Nzijukira bulungi nnyo ekiseera mu bulamu bwange lwe nnakemebwa okujeemera nnyo enkola yange. Nnali muntu ayogera lwatu, ow'amaanyi, nga ngezaako okuba Mukristaayo omulungi, naye nga sirina ndabika ya butukuvu ya njawulo. Naye nnalina mwannyinaze eyali mutukuvu nnyo mu ndabika ye, era eyalina empisa ey'obutukuvu, ne kirabika ng'ekifaananyi ky'obutukuvu; era nnali mukakafu nti nnandisobodde okuba Mukristaayo omulungi ennyo singa nnasobodde okufuna endabika ye ey'obutukuvu n'empisa ye. Naye okufuba kwange kwonna okubifuna kwali kwa bwereere. Empisa yange ey'obuzaaliranwa yali ya maanyi nnyo era ey'okwogera lwatu okusukka endabika yonna ey'obutukuvu, era emirundi mingi nnagamba mu mutima gwange n'okunenya eri Katonda nti, “Lwaki wankola bwe nti?” Naye olunaku olumu ne nsanga sentensi mu kitabo eky'edda eky'ekyama ekyalabika nga kizibula amaaso gange. Yali bw'eti: “Mala kuba nga Katonda wo bwe yakukola”; era ne kimwansikira nti kyali kya mazima ddala nti Katonda ye yankola, era nti ateekwa okumanya ekika ky'ekitonde kye yayagala okuba; era nti singa yankola omuzabbibu gw'ebijanjaalo, nteekwa okumatira okumeza ebijanjaalo, so ssaagombe kuba muti gwa maluuli ne gumeza amaluuli; era singa yampangira emirimu egy'obwetoowaze, nteekwa okumatira n'aleka abalala okukola emirimu egy'ekitiibwa. Tuli “omulimu gwa Katonda,” era Katonda mulungi, kyekiva n'omulimu gwe guteekwa okuba omulungi nagwo; era tuyinza okwesiga n'obwesige nti nga tannaggwa naffe, ajja kutufuulamu ekintu ekinaaba eky'ekitiibwa kye, ka twewulire tutya nga tetukifaanana kaakano. Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli yalabika ng'asanyukira okuddiŋŋaana emirundi n'emirundi ekigambo kino ekya mukisa, “kubanga Mukama mulungi.” Kyandibadde kya mugaso okuddira konkodanoosi zo n'olaba nga bw'akyogera emirundi emeka. Era yakubiriza buli muntu okwegatta naye mu kukyogera. “Abanunulibwa ba Mukama kaboogere bwe batyo,” kwe kwali okukoowoola kwe okw'amaanyi. Tuteekwa okwegatta amaloboozi gaffe ku gage — Mukama mulungi — Mukama mulungi. Naye tetuteekwa kukyogera na mimwa gyaffe gyokka, ne tulyoka mu bikolwa byaffe tuwakanya ebigambo byaffe. Tuteekwa “okukyogera” n'obulamu bwaffe bwonna, mu birowoozo, mu bigambo, ne mu bikolwa, abantu balyoke balabe nti tukitegeeza ddala, era bakakasibwe nti kya mazima ekinene. Ebintu bingi nnyo mu nkola za Katonda ez'obwakatonda tebirabika ng'obulungi eri eriiso ery'okuwulira, era nga tusoma Zabbuli twewuunya oboolyawo engeri omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli gye yayinza okugambira, oluvannyuma lw'ebimu ku bintu by'awandiika, nti “kubanga okusaasira kwe kubeerera emirembe gyonna.” Naye okukkiriza kutuula mu maaso g'ebyama ng'ebyo, ne kugamba nti, “Mukama mulungi, kyekiva byonna by'akola biteekwa okuba ebirungi, ka birabike bitya, era nnyinza okulinda ennyinnyonnyola ze.” Ekifaananyi eky'okulabirira ennyumba emirundi mingi kimbeeredde wano. Bwe mba nina mukwano gwange gwe mmanyi okuba omulabirizi w'ennyumba omulungi, sseeraliikirira olw'ekiruubirirwa nti mu kiseera eky'okuyonja ennyumba ebintu mu nnyumba ye biyinza okulabika nga bikubaganyiziddwa katono oba nnyo, kaapeti nga zisituddwa, n'ebintu nga bibisiddwa n'ebibikka, era oboolyawo n'okusiiga langi n'okuwunda nga bifudde ebisenge ebimu okuba ebitasulwamu. Ne ngamba mu mutima gwange nti, “Mukwano gwange mulabirizi w'ennyumba omulungi, era wadde ng'ebintu bironeeza kaakano bwe bityo, okukubaganyizibwa kuno kwonna kuli lwa kubanga oluvannyuma agenda kugifuula ennungi n'okusinga bwe yali edda.” Ensi eno ye kulabirira ennyumba kwa Katonda; era wadde ng'ebintu kaakano birabika nga bikubaganyiziddwa mu buzibu, kyokka, kubanga tumanyi nti mulungi, era kyekiva ateekwa okuba Omulabirizi w'ennyumba omulungi, tuyinza okuba abakakafu ddala nti okukubaganyizibwa kuno okwa kaakano kwonna kuli lwa kuleeta mu nkomerero embeera esinga obulungi eyandibaddewo awatali kwo. Nzikiriza nti ffenna oluusi twewuliddeko nga tuyinza okukola okulabirira ennyumba kwa Katonda okusinga bw'akola ye mwennyini, naye, bwe tutegeera nti Katonda mulungi, tetuyinza kuddayo kuwulira kino. Era kimpooyeza nnyo, ensi bw'endabikira nga egenda bubi bwonna, okwogera busa mu mutima gwange nti, “Si kulabirira ennyumba kwange, wabula kwa Mukama; era Mukama mulungi, kyekiva okulabirira ennyumba kwe kuteekwa okuba okulungi nakwo; era kya busirusiru gye ndi okweraliikirira.” Omukristaayo eyali ayigiriziddwa mu buziba yabuuzibwa omwana wa Katonda eyali mu kunakuwala nti, “Ensi terabika gy'oli ng'ekintu ekyonoonese?” “Weewaawo,” bwe kwali okuddamu, mu ddoboozi ery'obwesige obw'essanyu; “weewaawo, ng'okuzikirira kw'ensigo eyatuka.” Yenna ku ffe eyali alabye okumela okusooka kw'omuti gwa oak okuva mu mutima gw'ensigo ya oak evunda ajja kutegeera kino kye kitegeeza. Ensigo ya oak nga tennaleeta muti gwa oak, eteekwa okusooka okwonooneka yokka. Tewali kimera ekyali kivudde mu nsigo yonna okuggyako ensigo eyonoonese. Mukama waffe akozesa amazima gano okutuyigiriza amakulu g'enkola ze naffe. “Mazima ddala, mazima ddala, mbagamba nti, empeke y'eŋŋaano bw'etagwa mu ttaka n'efa, esigala yokka; naye bw'efa, ereeta ebibala bingi.” Yokaana 12:24. Ennyinnyonnyola yonna ey'okwonooneka okulabika okw'ensi yonna, oba obulamu bwaffe ffennyini obw'enjawulo, eno wano ewaayo. Era, nga tukitunuulira mu kitangaala kino, tuyinza okutegeera engeri Mukama gy'ayinza okuba omulungi, ate n'akkiriza okubeerawo kw'ennaku n'obukyamu mu nsi gy'atonze, ne mu bulamu bw'abantu b'ayagala. Bwe bulungi bwe bwennyini obumuwaliriza okukikkiriza. Kubanga amanyi nti, okuyita mu kwonooneka okulabika okwo kwokka, kwe kutuukirira kw'ebigendererwa bye eby'ekitiibwa gye tuli kuyinza okuleetebwa. Era ffe emitima gyaffe nagyo egyegomba okutuukirira okwo, bwe tutegeera amakubo ge, tujja kusobola okumutendereza olw'obulungi bwe bwonna, ne bwe wabaawo ebintu ebirabika ebisinga obuzibu n'eby'ekyama. Omutume atugamba nti okwagala kwa Katonda “kulungi, era kusiimibwa, era kutuukiridde.” Okwagala kwa Katonda omulungi tekuyinza butaba “kulungi” — mu butuufu, kuteekwa okuba okutuukiridde; era, bwe tukimanya, bulijjo tukisanga nga “kusiimibwa”; kwe kugamba nti tujja kukwagala. Nkakasiza ddala nti obuzibu bwonna obw'okwewaayo eri okwagala kwa Katonda bwandibulidde, singa omulundi gumu twasobola okulaba bulungi nti okwagala kwe kulungi. Tufuba ne tufuba awatali kugasa okwewaayo eri okwagala kwe tutakkiriza kuba kulungi, naye bwe tulaba nti kulungi ddala, tukwewaayo n'essanyu. Twagala kutuukirizibwe. Emitima gyaffe gibuuka okukusisinkana. Nkusinza, ggwe Okwagala kwa Katonda okuwoomerera! Era amakubo go gonna ngasinza; Era, buli lunaku lwe mba omulamu, ndabika nga nkwagala okusingawo n'okweyongera. Njagala okunywegera buli kigere gy'oteeka ebigere byo ebitalabika: Sisobola kukutya, ggwe Okwagala okw'omukisa! Obwakabaka bwo buwoomerera nnyo. Ekifo kimbula okubuulira byonna bye nnyinza okwogera ku bulungi bwa Mukama obutakoma. Buli omu ateekwa “okulega n'okulaba” yekka. Era singa akikola mu bwesimbu ne mu bwesigwa, ebigambo by'omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli bijja kumutuukako: “Balifukumula ettutumu ery'obulungi bwo obungi era baliyimba n'eddoboozi ery'obutuukirivu bwo.” Zabbuli 145:7

fields.title: Mukama Kye Kifo Kyaffe eky'Okubeeramu
fields.body_html:
“Ayi Mukama, ggwe obadde kifo kyaffe eky'okubeeramu mu mirembe gyonna” (Zabbuli 90:1).

Okusanyuka oba obutasanyuka mu bulamu bwaffe obw'okungulu kusinga kwesigama ku kifo emibiri gyaffe gye gibeera; mu ngeri y'emu, okusanyuka oba obutasanyuka mu bulamu bwaffe obw'omunda kwesigama ku kifo emmeeme zaffe gye zibeera.

Ekifo kyaffe eky'okubeeramu kye kifo mwe tubeera ddala, so si kifo kye tukyalira buikyalira. Kye maka gaffe.

Ebintu byonna ebitufaako mu bulamu bwaffe obw'oku nsi bisibiddwa mu maka gaffe, era tukola kyonna kye tusobola okugafuula agasanyusa era agawummuza. Naye emmeeme zaffe zeetaaga ekifo eky'okubeeramu ekiwummuza n'okusinga emibiri gyaffe. Okuwummula okw'omunda kusinga nnyo obukulu okuwummula okw'okungulu; emmeeme bw'ejjula emirembe n'essanyu, ebitwetoolodde eby'omubiri tebifaayo nnyo.

Kale, kikulu nnyo tumanye bulungi ekifo emmeeme zaffe gye zibeera. Mukama alangirira nti ye abadde kifo kyaffe eky'okubeeramu mu byafaayo byonna, naye ekibuuzo kiri nti: Ddala tubeera mu kifo kyaffe eky'okubeeramu? Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli ayogera ku baana ba Isirayiri nti “baabuulukuka mu ddungu awatali kkubo, ne batalaba kibuga eky'okubeeramu; enjala n'ennyonta ne bibaluma, emmeeme zaabwe ne ziggwaamu amaanyi munda yaabwe” (Zabbuli 107:4-5). Ntya nti waliwo emmeeme nnyingi ez'okubuulukuka mu kkanisa leero ze ebigambo bino bye bituukirira ddala. Mu bulamu bwabwe bwonna obw'Ekikristaayo babadde babuulukuka mu ddungu ery'omwoyo, ne batalaba maka ga lubeerera, era emmeeme zaabwe zaggwaamu amaanyi olw'enjala n'ennyonta. Naye mu kiseera ekyo kyonna, ekifo kya Katonda eky'okubeeramu kibadde kigguddwawo, nga kibayita bajje munda babeeremu emirembe gyonna.

Mukama waffe yennyini atukubiriza okuyitibwa kuno: “Mubeere mu nze, nange mbeere mu mmwe” (Yokaana 15:4). Ne yeeyongera okututegeeza ebibala ebirungi eby'okusigala eyo n'ebizibu ebinakuwaza eby'okuvaamu.

Amazima gali nti, emmeeme zaffe zaakolerwa Katonda. Ye maka gaffe amatonde, era tetuyinza kufuna kuwummula wa walala wonna. “Emmeeme yange yeegomba, weewaawo, ezirika olw'empya za Mukama; omutima gwange n'omubiri gwange biyimba n'essanyu eri Katonda omulamu” (Zabbuli 84:2). Tujja kulumwa enjala era tujja kuzirika olw'empya za Mukama ekiseera kyonna kye tuteefuulira eyo maka gaffe.

Katonda yekka ge maka g'ekitonde; Newankubadde ekkubo lizibu era lifunda, Naye tewali kirala kiyinza kumatiza Emmeeme eyeegomba Katonda.

Tunaakuluma tutya ekifo kino ekiramu eky'okubeeramu? Dawudi akinnyonnyola bw'agamba nti: “Mukama lwe lwazi lwange, n'ekigo kyange, n'omununuzi wange; Katonda wange, lwe lwazi lwange, mwe neekweka; engabo yange, n'ejjembe ery'obulokozi bwange, ekigo kyange eky'amaanyi, n'obuddukiro bwange, omulokozi wange; onnyinunula eri obukambwe” (2 Samwiri 22:2-3). Kale tulaba nti ekifo kyaffe eky'okubeeramu kye kigo kyaffe, n'ekigo kyaffe ekiwanvu, n'olwazi lwaffe, n'obuddukiro bwaffe. Ffenna tumanyi ekigo kye kiri. Kye kifo eky'obukuumi abanafu era abatalina buyambi mwe balundibwa ne bakuumibwa okuva eri omulabe. Bwe tugambibwa nti Katonda kye kigo kyaffe, kitegeeza kimu kyokka: bwe tubeera mu Ye, tujja kuba mu bukuumi obutuukiridde okuva eri buli mulabe yenna.

“Kubanga alinkweka mu weema ye ku lunaku olw'okulabiralaba; alinkweka mu kifo eky'ekisiikirize eky'eweema ye; aliwanika ku lwazi” (Zabbuli 27:5). “Abeera mu kifo eky'ekisiikirize eky'Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo, anaabeeranga mu kisiikirize eky'Ayinzabyonna” (Zabbuli 91:1). “Mu kifo eky'okuweeza obwenyi bwo obakweka eri enkwe z'abantu; obakuuma mu weema yo eri okuyomba kw'ennimi” (Zabbuli 31:20). Mu “kifo eky'eweema ya Katonda,” tewali mulabe ayinza kutulaba era tewali buzibu buyinza kututuukako. Amalala g'abantu n'olugambo tebisobola kuyingira mu “kifo eky'ekisiikirize” ekya Katonda. “Ekifo eky'okuweeza obwenyi bwe” buddukiro obw'obukuumi obusinga Gibraltar lukumi. Sitegeeza nti tewali kugezesebwa kujja.

Kuyinza kujja mu bungi, naye tekuyinza kuyingira mu watukuvu w'emmeeme. Tuyinza okubeera mu mirembe emituukiridde ne mu makkati g'omuyaga gw'obulamu ogusinga obukambwe.

Naye, nga ffe abamanyi kino tuli batono! Tuyinza okukozesa olulimi lwa Dawudi, naye gye tuli, kifaananyi kya bigambo kyokka nga tekirimu mazima. Twogera ebigambo mu ddoboozi ery'obwannakyewa, ery'eddiini. “Weewaawo, mmanyi nti Mukama kye kifo kyange eky'okubeeramu, era nneewaddeyo mu bukuumi bwe, nga buli Mukristaayo bw'asaanidde.

Naye—” era wano eddoboozi ery'obulijjo bwe likomawo— “naye siyinza kwerabira nti ndi muntu mwavu, atalina mugaso, atalina maanyi ga kuwangula kukemebwa. Sisobola kusuubira kukuumibwa mu bukuumi obutuukiridde Dawudi bw'ayogerako.” Awo ne wagoberera olugero olw'entiisa n'okweraliikirira, ng'ekifo kya Katonda eky'okubeeramu tekyali kiwuliddwako, era ng'emmeeme ebuulukuka yokka nga tekuumibwa mu nsi ey'akabi.

Waliwo zabbuli gye nyita “Ekifo kya Katonda eky'Okubeeramu.” Ye Zabbuli ey'okulwenkumi mu emu, era ewa ennyonnyola ey'ekitalo ku maka gano bwe gali. “Abeera mu kifo eky'ekisiikirize eky'Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo, anaabeeranga mu kisiikirize eky'Ayinzabyonna. Nnaagamba Mukama nti, ‘Obuddukiro bwange n'ekigo kyange, Katonda wange, gwe neesiga’” (Zabbuli 91:1-2). Endowooza yaffe ku kigo bulijjo kya kizimbe eky'amayinja, omuntu w'abeera mu bukuumi naye ng'era tawummulamu. Naye waliwo ebigo ebirala ebigonvu, ebiweweevu, era ebijjudde okuwummula. Zabbuli eno ebinnyonnyola nti: “Alikubikka n'ebyoya bye, era wansi w'ebiwaawaatiro bye onoofuna obuddukiro” (Zabbuli 91:4), nga enkoko enkazi bw'ebikka ku baana baayo abanafu n'ebiwaawaatiro byayo ebibuguma. Ekigo eky'omutima gwa nnyina—oba wa muntu, oba wa nnyonyi, oba n'ogwa tiger—kye kigo ekisinga amaanyi mu nsi, naye ate kye kisinga obuweweevu. Kino kye kika ky'ekigo Mukama ky'ali. “Aliriisa ekisibo kye ng'omusumba; alikuŋŋaanya abaana b'endiga mu mikono gye; alibisitula mu kifuba kye” (Isaaya 40:11).

“Katonda ow'emirembe gyonna kye kifo kyo eky'okubeeramu, era wansi waliwo emikono egy'emirembe gyonna” (Ekyamateeka 33:27). Ebiwaawaatiro, ekifuba, emikono! Bino bigo bya mukisa nnyo! Buli kintu ekibumbibwa mu byo kiri mu bukuumi. Obutonde bujjudde ebyokulabirako ng'ebyo. Lowooza ku ekyo omuwandiisi omu ky'ayogera ku tiger omukazi. Abaana be bwe bazaalibwa, amaanyi gamuyigiriza okuba omuwombeefu—omwoyo gw'atasobola kuziyiza, kubanga gwe mwoyo gw'Omutonzi we. Kya buzaaliranwa eri tiger okusunguwalira okunyigirizibwa. Singa omusika ebyoya oba n'omukuba, yandikutaaguddetaagudde. Naye okusunguwalira okunyigirizibwa si gwe mpaka ze ez'amaanyi ennyo. Tunuulira obwana obwo obunafu nga bumuzannyisa. Bunafu nnyo nga okwenyeenya kw'ekigere kye ekinene singa kubuzikiriza, naye takola kwenyeenya kwonna okw'obutafaayo. Bumuleetera obulumi obusinga okukubwa, naye tawoolera ggwanga. Abuwuubaawuuba n'okwagala mu maaso ge era akomba abo abamubonyaabonya abato.

Okwagala kufuula okusinda kwe okw'obulumi obw'omubiri okuba amaloboozi ag'essanyu. Anyeenya omutwe gwe omunene mu ngeri eraga nti Katonda oyo omu eyakugamba “okukyusa oluba olulala” ye yamutonda. Bw'afuna amaanyi agamala okugolokoka, afuluma okwewaayo ku lwa babe. Alisiiba enjala baleme kukula. Wa ntiisa ku lw'abaana be abato, nga Katonda bw'ali ow'entiisa ku lw'ababe.

Tulabye “ebigo bya bannyaabwe” bino emirundi ebikumi ne tubiyita ebifaanana nga Katonda. Omuntu yandirowoozezza nti okulaba kuno kwandituleetedde okudduka eri obuddukiro bwaffe mu Katonda ne tuleka okutya kwonna ebweru! Naye ekizibu kiri nti, tugaana ddala okukkiriza nti Bayibuli ategeeza amawulire amalungi ng'ago. Si mu bigambo, oboolyawo, naye mu bikolwa twogera nti, “Emikono gya Mukama tegyesigika nga egy'omuntu nnyina; omutima gwa Mukama teguweweevu nga ogwa tiger; ebiwaawaatiro bya Mukama tebikuuma nga eby'enkoko enkazi.” Tumanyi nti ye yakola ebigo bino eby'oku nsi, naye tetusobola kukkiriza nti yenkanankana nabyo. Okuba naye ng'ekigo kyaffe tekituwulira mu bukuumi oba mu buweweevu wadde ekitundu ng'okuba ne nnyaffe ng'ekigo kyaffe. Kale, bannyaabwe bwe beesigibwa, naye Katonda teyeesigibwa!

Naye laba omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli bw'alangirira ekifo kino eky'obwakatonda eky'okubeeramu bwe kiri eky'obukuumi. Agamba nti ffe abali mu maka gano tetulitya kintu kyonna—si ntiisa ya kiro, si musaale ogw'emisana, si kawumpuli ali mu kizikiza, si kuzikiriza okw'omu ttuntu. Enkumi ziyinza okugwa okutwetooloola, naye tewali kabi kalibaawo eri emmeeme ekwekeddwa mu Katonda. Tewali kawumpuli alisembera abo abafudde Katonda “ekifo kyabwe eky'okubeeramu.”

Entiisa zonna ezifudde obulamu bwaffe obw'eddiini nga tebuwummula ziriiriddwa wano. Tulinunulibwa okuva mu zo zonna bwe tunaafuula Mukama maka gaffe. Kino tekitegeeza nti tetuliba na kugezesebwa kwa kungulu. Kawumpuli ayinza okulumba omubiri gwo oba ebintu byo, naye ebintu ebyo si ggwe. Tewali kiyinza kusembera ggwe ow'amazima ow'omunda ng'okyabeera mu Katonda.

Ekitundu ekinene eky'obulumi obw'obulamu kiva mu “kutya akabi” okutabula. Obulamu bwaffe bujjudde ebigambo nti “singa kiba kityo.”

Ka tugambe nti kino kibaawo, oba kiri kibaawo—twandikoze ki? Twandikigumiikirizza tutya? Naye bwe tuba tubeera mu “kigo ekiwanvu” ekya Katonda, “singa” zino zonna zivaamu mu bulamu bwaffe. Tulibeera “mu mirembe, awatali kutya kabi” (Engero 1:33), kubanga tewali ntiisa ya kabi eyinza okuyingira mu kigo kya Katonda. Ne bw'aba atambula mu kiwonvu eky'ekisiikirize eky'okufa, omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli yasobola okugamba nti, “Siritya kabi” (Zabbuli 23:4); bwe tuba tubeera mu Katonda, naffe tuyinza okukigamba.

Naye oyinza okubuuza engeri y'okuyingira mu kifo kino eky'obwakatonda eky'okubeeramu. Okuddamu kwange kwe kuno: yingiramu buyingizi. Singa mukwano gwaffe atupangisizza ennyumba n'agamba nti eteekateekeddwa, era endagaano ng'esseeko omukono era nga ya mateeka, tetwandibuuzizza ngeri ya kuyingiramu—twandisibye ebintu byaffe ne tujjulukuka. Kitugwanidde okukola bwe kityo wano. Katonda agamba nti ye kifo kyaffe eky'okubeeramu. Bayibuli erimu empapula zonna ezeetaagisa, nga zisseeko omukono era nga ziriko abajulizi.

Mukama waffe atuyita—mu butuufu, atulagira—okuyingira n'okusigala. Agamba nti, “Katonda ge maka go; kakasa nti obeera eyo. Yingiramu.”

Oyingiramu otya? Olw'okukkiriza. Katonda agambye nti ye kifo kyo eky'okubeeramu; kaakano naawe kikugwanidde okukigamba.

“Nnaagamba Mukama nti, ‘Obuddukiro bwange n'ekigo kyange, Katonda wange, gwe neesiga’” (Zabbuli 91:2).

Okukkiriza kutoola Ekigambo kya Katonda ne kukakasa nti kya mazima. Kristo agamba nti, “Mubeere,” era kitugwanidde okugamba nti, “Nnaabeera.” Tumufuula “ekifo kyaffe eky'okubeeramu” nga tukkiriza nti ye maka gaffe era nga tukirangirira bulijjo. Nga omuyimbi Coleridge bwe yagamba: Okukkiriza kwe kukakasa n'ekikolwa, Ekiragira amazima ag'emirembe gyonna okuba amazima agaliwo kaakano.

Kitugwanidde okufuula amazima ag'emirembe gyonna nti Mukama kye kifo kyaffe eky'okubeeramu okuba amazima agaliwo kaakano nga tugakakasa n'okukkiriza kwaffe era nga tukwata ebirowoozo n'ebikolwa ebiva mu kubeera mu maaso ga Katonda.

Ekimu ku bintu ebisooka bye twandikoze kwe kuleka okweraliikirira n'obukwakkalimu emirembe gyonna. Tekirowoozeka nti okweraliikirira kwandiyingidde mu kifo kya Katonda eky'okubeeramu; bwe tuyingira, kitugwanidde okukulekera emabega.

Twogera ku kugondera ebiragiro bya Mukama era tussa essira ku mirimu egy'okungulu, so nga tunyooma ebiragiro ebikwata ku bulamu obw'omunda ebisinga obukulu emirundi lukumi. “Emitima gyammwe gireme kweraliikirira, so tegiretye” (Yokaana 14:27) kye kiragiro kya Mukama waffe ekitagonderwa ku nsi yonna. Naye nsuubira nti tewali kujeema kulala kunyiiza mutima gwe nga kuno. Nkakasa nti nnandinyiize nnyo singa omwana wange tanneesiga n'awulira ng'ebimufaako tebiri mu bukuumi mu mikono gyange okusinga singa yanjeemera mu kaseera k'okukemebwa. Nkakasibwa nti tetutegeera bwe kikwasa ebiwundu Mukama waffe abantu be bwe batawulira mu bukuumi naye.

Tuyinza okutegeera kino okuva mu bulamu bwaffe ffennyini. Ka tugambe nti mukwano gwaffe yatuwa ekintu okumukuumira, ne tumukakasa mu buli ngeri nti kijja kubeera mu bukuumi. Awo mukwano gwaffe n'agenda n'akyeraliikirira, ng'ayolesa eri abalala okweraliikirira kwe kumu kwe twolesa ku bintu bye twawa Katonda.

Twandiwulidde tutya? Twandinyiize nnyo. Ku nkomerero, twandigambye nti, “Okuva bw'olabika nga tonneesiga, kirungi weekuumire ebintu byo wekka.” Kya kitalo nti abaana ba Katonda baguma ne beeraliikirira nga bamaze okumuwa ensonga; kunyooma nnyo empisa ze.

Ab'ebweru bakiraba ne balowooza nti okuba ne Mukama ng'ekifo eky'okubeeramu tekiteekwa kutegeeza kintu kinene, kubanga singa si bwe kiri tetwandibadde beeraliikirivu bwe tutyo.

Oyo afaayo ku nkazaluggya era abala enviiri ez'oku mitwe gyaffe tasobola n'akatono okututtya. Ye kigo ekitamenyeka omutayinza kuyingira kabi wadde omulabe. Nkitwala ng'amazima ag'olwatu: mu kiseera we mmaze okuwaayo ekintu kyonna eri ekifo kino eky'obwakatonda eky'okubeeramu, okweraliikirira kwonna kusaanidde okukoma. Bwe nkuuma ebintu mu bujjuvu bwange, nnina ensonga ey'okukankana, kubanga tebiri mu bukuumi. Naye mu bujjuvu bwa Katonda, obukuumi butuukiridde.

“Erinnya lya Mukama kigo eky'amaanyi; omutuukirivu adukira omwo n'aba mu bukuumi” (Engero 18:10). Kale, ekigendererwa kyokka kwe “kudukira” mu kigo kino n'osigala omwo emirembe gyonna. Kyandibadde busirusiru okuyimirira ebweru w'ekigo ng'omulabe akwetoolodde, ng'okaaba ng'oyagala obukuumi. Bwe njagala okuba mu bukuumi, nsaanidde okuyingira munda.

“Ayi Yerusaalemi, Yerusaalemi... Emirundi emeka gye nnandyagadde okukuŋŋaanya abaana bo ng'enkoko bw'ekuŋŋaanya obwana bwayo wansi w'ebiwaawaatiro byayo, naye ne mutayagala!” (Matayo 23:37). Akayana bwe kaba kaagala okuba mu bukuumi, kasaanidde okudduka eri ebiwaawaatiro bya nnyina. Abantu bangi basigala ebweru w'ekifo kya Katonda eky'okubeeramu kubanga bawulira nga tebasaanira oba nga banafu nnyo okuyingira. Twandirowoozezza ki ku kayana akalaba enkwazi ng'ejja, ne kawulira nnyina ng'akoowoola, naye ne kasigala ebweru nga kakankana nga kagamba nti, “Ndi kayana kanafu, katalina buyambi, ekikuŋŋaanyisa okuyingira wansi w'ebiwaawaatiro ebyo”? Singa enkoko enkazi eyinza okwogera, yandigambye nti, “Ggwe kasirusiru, olw'okuba nga oli munafu era nga tolina buyambi kye njagalira wano. Singa wali sseggwanga ennene ery'amaanyi erisobola okwerabirira, saayagalidde kukukuŋŋaanya n'akatono.” Nkyetaaga okunnyonnyola ekigendererwa?

Naye tetusaanidde “kudukira” mu kifo kyaffe eky'okubeeramu kyokka. “Ka mbeere mu weema yo emirembe gyonna! Ka nneekweke wansi w'ekisiikirize eky'ebiwaawaatiro byo!” (Zabbuli 61:4). Kitugwanidde okukola bwe kityo. Okubeera mu weema ye emirembe gyonna, nkkiriza nti, oluusi kizibu nnyo. Kyangu okutwala eddaawo ery'okukkiriza, naye kizibu nnyo okusigala mu kifo ekyo. Abantu bangi badukira mu kigo kya Katonda ku Ssande ne bafuluma nate amangu ddala ng'obudde bw'oku Balaza obw'enkya butuuse. Abamu badukira mu kyo bwe bafukamira okusaba okw'akawungeezi ne bafuluma edakiika ttaano oluvannyuma nga bagalamidde ku kitanda. Buno busirusiru bwereere. Toyinza kulowooza munoonyi w'obubudamu ng'adukira mu kigo ku lunaku olumu n'addamu okudduka okudda eri omulabe ku lunaku olulala.

Twandirowoozezza nti bagudde eddalu. Naye si busirusiru busingawo eri emmeeme? Abalabe baffe tebakola nnyo ku Balaza? Tusobola okubakwatagana obulungi nga tweebase okusinga nga tusaba?

Ekibuuzo kiri nti: Twagala kukyalira Katonda buikyalira, oba twagala kubeera eyo? Twagala kwekweka leero ne tuvuunulwa eri abalabe enkya? Tewali ayinza kulonda kino mu bugenderevu, naye bangi nnyo baseeyeeyera mu kyo. Okubeera mu Kristo kya kukkiriza kwokka, naye tetukitegeera. Tulowooza nti okulwana kwaffe okw'amaanyi oba okukola ennyo kwe kitundu ekikulu ekya kyo; ebyo bwe biggwaawo, okukkiriza kwaffe kunafuwa. Naye obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo bubeerwa lwa kukkiriza. Awatali kukkiriza tekisoboka kusanyusa Katonda. Tekigasa kufeeza budde ku kafubo kaffe kokka akatakola kantu.

Kitugwanidde okuteeka obusobozi bwaffe obw'okwagala n'amaanyi gaffe mu kukkiriza kwaffe. Kitugwanidde okumalirira okuyingira mu kifo kya Katonda eky'okubeeramu n'okusigala eyo, ne bwe wabaawo okukemebwa okubuusabuusa oba okuwulira ng'omuggweemu amaanyi.

“Abeera mu kifo eky'ekisiikirize eky'Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo, anaabeeranga mu kisiikirize eky'Ayinzabyonna” (Zabbuli 91:1). “Okubeera” n'“okwesiga” mu butuufu bigambo bya makulu gamu; bitegeeza kintu kimu.

Bwe mba nnesiga Mukama, mba mbeera mu Ye. Bwe mmwesiga obutayosa, mba mbeera mu Ye obutayosa. Bwe mmwesiga oluusi n'oluusi, mba nyingira ne mfuluma. Nnali njogera nti waliwo ekyama mu “kubeera,” naye kaakano ndaba nti kitegeeza kwesiga Ye mu bujjuvu. Bw'omala okutegeera kino, kye kintu ekyangu ennyo mu nsi. Oluusi twogera ku bantu babiri nti “babeera mu mitima gya bannaabwe.” Kino kitegeeza bulyo nti balina okwagala okutuukiridde n'obwesige mu bannaabwe, era okubuusabuusa tekisoboka. Bwe mba nnesiga ekigo kya Mukama mu bujjuvu, mba mbeera mu kigo ekyo. Ogwo gwe mboozi gwonna.

Kale, ekintu eky'amagezi eky'okukola, okuva Katonda bw'alangiddwa okuba ekigo kyaffe n'ekigo kyaffe ekiwanvu, kwe kuteeka ffennyini n'ebintu byaffe byonna ebitufaako mu kifo kino eky'obwakatonda eky'okubeeramu nga tukoze ekikolwa eky'olwatu eky'okwewaayo n'okukkiriza, oluvannyuma ne tuggya mu birowoozo byaffe okufaayo kwonna oba okweraliikirira ku byo. Okuva Mukama bw'ali kifo kyaffe eky'okubeeramu, tewali kintu ekiweereddwayo mu bukuumi bwe ekiyinza kutuukibwako kabi konna. Ekiseera kyonna kye tukkiriza kino, ebifaffe bisigala mu bukuumi bwe; mu kiseera kye tutandika okubuusabuusa, tuddiza ebifaffe mu mikono gyaffe, era tebiba nate mu kigo eky'obwakatonda.

Ebintu tebiyinza kubeera mu bifo bibiri mu kiseera kimu. Bwe biba mu bukuumi bwaffe ffe, tebiyinza kuba mu bukuumi bwa Katonda; era bwe biba mu bukuumi bwa Katonda, tebiyinza kuba mu bwaffe. Kino kitangaavu ng'omusana, naye olw'okubulwako akamagezi katono, abantu batera okutabulwa ku kino. Bagezaako okuteeka ebifaabwe mu kigo kya Katonda nga mu kiseera kye kimu bagikuumira mu byabwe, oluvannyuma ne beewuunya lwaki tebifiibwako. Kino busirusiru. Oba weesige Mukama mu bujjuvu, oba weesige wekka mu bujjuvu; naye tegezaako kutabula byombi, kubanga tebijja kutabagana.

Kijja kukuyamba mu ngeri ey'olwatu bw'oteeka obwesige bwo mu bigambo. Gamba mu bwesimbu nti, “Katonda kye kifo kyange eky'okubeeramu, era njagala kubeera mu Ye emirembe gyonna. Byonna bikakasibbwa; ndi mu maka gano ag'obwakatonda, ndi mu bukuumi wano, era sijja kufulumamu nate.” Osaanidde okusisinkana buli kulumba kwa kubuusabuusa n'okuggwaamu amaanyi n'okukakasa okwangu nti oli eyo era nti omanyi nti toojja kukwasibwa nsonyi. Ka abalala bakole nga bwe basobola, naye osaanidde okulangirira nti ggwe, wadde katono, ojja kubeera mu kifo kyo eky'obwakatonda eky'okubeeramu emirembe gyonna. Bw'omala okuyimirira ku kino, osaanidde okugaana ddala okuddamu okulowooza ku nsonga. Kikakasibbwa; tewali kirala kya kwogera.

Mu bino byonna, sitegeeza nti tusaanidde okusigala ku kitanda ne tuleka ebintu bigende. Njogera ku ludda olw'omunda olw'ebifaffe, so si olw'okungulu. Ku bw'okungulu, tuyinza okuba abanyiikivu era abeegendereza, naye byonna bisaanidde okuva ku musingi ogw'omunda ogw'emmeeme eyeekwese yennyini n'ebigifaako mu Katonda, era noolwekyo “eteeraliikirira kintu kyonna” (Abafiripi 4:6) mu makulu amalungi aga Bayibuli ag'obutaba na birowoozo bya kweraliikirira. Okuba awatali kufaayo kwa munda gwe musingi ogusinga obwesigwa ogw'okufaayo okw'okungulu okw'obuwanguzi. Emmeeme eyeekwese mu Katonda ye mmeeme esobola okugumiikiriza mu buwanguzi okugezesebwa okw'ensi okusinga obunene n'okuwangula abalabe baayo abasinga amaanyi.

Waliwo ensonga emu gye nsaanidde okwogerako. Bwe tuyingira mu nnyumba empya, tetuyingiramu ffennyini bwokka; tutwala ebintu byaffe byonna, era okusingira ddala, ab'omu maka gaffe. Tewali muntu ayinza kuba musirusiru nga aleka omuntu gw'ayagala ebweru. Naye ntya nti abamu ku baana ba Katonda beeyingiza mu kifo kye eky'okubeeramu bo bennyini, naye, olw'okubulwa okukkiriza, baleka abo be baagala okusinga ebweru—emirundi mingi abaana baabwe. Twandyekanze olw'ekitiibwa ku kitaawe eyaddukira mu kigo olw'obukuumi mu kiseera eky'akabi naye n'aleka abaana be ebweru; naye Abakristaayo bangi bakola kino kyennyini. Buli kirowoozo eky'okweraliikirira kye tulina ku baana baffe kikakasa nti tetubatutwadde ddala naffe mu kifo kya Katonda eky'okubeeramu.

Bwe twesigira ffennyini, kitugwanidde okwesigira n'abo be twagala. Katonda ye Kitaabwe okusinga kitaabwe yenna ow'oku nsi, era bwe baba nga tubaagala, baagalibwa nnyo okusingawo gy'ali. Tetusobola kubakolera kirungi kisingawo okubawaayo mu bukuumi bwe, era tewali kibi kisingawo ng'okugezaako okubakuumira mu bwaffe. Nnamanya maama eyeesiga mu mirembe ku bulokozi bwe ye, naye eyali ajjudde okweraliikirira ku baana be aboobulenzi, abaali balabika nga tebafaayo ku ddiini. Akawungeezi kamu, yawulira ku kuteeka abo b'oyagala mu kigo kya Katonda olw'okukkiriza. Yalaba engeri gye kyali tekituukagana okwekweka mu Katonda ng'aleka abaana be ebweru.

Amangu ddala, okukkiriza kwe kwabatwala mu kigo wamu naye. Yabawaayo mu bukuumi bwa Katonda mu bujjuvu ennyo n'okweraliikirira kwe ne kubula. Yaŋŋamba nti yawulira ng'abaana be kaakano baana ba Katonda—nga tebakyali babe—era nti Ye yabaagala okusingawo era yandibalabiridde mu magezi okusinga bye yali asobola. Yasigala nga yeeteeseteese okukola kyonna Mukama kye yamuwabula okubakolera, naye yamatira okuleka ensonga mu mikono gye. Yaddayo eka n'agamba abaana be nti, “Mbadde mbeeraliikiridde nnyo ku mmwe era oboolyawo mbanyiizza n'okubuulira kwange. Naye njize okwesiga. Mbateeka mu kigo kya Katonda era mbalese mu bukuumi bwe. Alibalokola mu ngeri ye ye. Okweraliikirira kwange kuweddeko.”

Oluvannyuma lw'omwaka, yaŋŋamba n'essanyu nti, “Sanyuka nange! Abaana bange abalenzi babadde mu bukuumi mu kigo kya Katonda okuva olwo, era bonna Bakristaayo balungi leero.”

Enkomerero nnyangu: yingira mu kifo kyo eky'okubeeramu mu Katonda era otwale buli kintu ky'olina na buli muntu gw'oyagala wamu naawe. Weekweke mu Ye, era oveewo ku ggwe wekka ne ku balala, era ofiirwe okulaba buli kintu ekiri ebweru we—okuggyako nga bw'okiraba okuyita mu maaso ge. Amaaso ga Katonda ge madirisa gokka mu nnyumba ye; nga bw'obiraba okuyita mu go, buli kintu kifaanana nga kya njawulo. Tulaba okugezesebwa ng'emikisa n'abalabe ng'emikwano egyeekwese. Tuliba bakkakkamu mu maaso g'okweraliikirira okw'obulamu. “Abantu bange balibeera mu kifo eky'emirembe eky'okubeeramu, mu bifo eby'obukuumi, ne mu bifo eby'okuwummuliramu ebiteefu” (Isaaya 32:18).
fields.body_text: “Ayi Mukama, ggwe obadde kifo kyaffe eky'okubeeramu mu mirembe gyonna” (Zabbuli 90:1). Okusanyuka oba obutasanyuka mu bulamu bwaffe obw'okungulu kusinga kwesigama ku kifo emibiri gyaffe gye gibeera; mu ngeri y'emu, okusanyuka oba obutasanyuka mu bulamu bwaffe obw'omunda kwesigama ku kifo emmeeme zaffe gye zibeera. Ekifo kyaffe eky'okubeeramu kye kifo mwe tubeera ddala, so si kifo kye tukyalira buikyalira. Kye maka gaffe. Ebintu byonna ebitufaako mu bulamu bwaffe obw'oku nsi bisibiddwa mu maka gaffe, era tukola kyonna kye tusobola okugafuula agasanyusa era agawummuza. Naye emmeeme zaffe zeetaaga ekifo eky'okubeeramu ekiwummuza n'okusinga emibiri gyaffe. Okuwummula okw'omunda kusinga nnyo obukulu okuwummula okw'okungulu; emmeeme bw'ejjula emirembe n'essanyu, ebitwetoolodde eby'omubiri tebifaayo nnyo. Kale, kikulu nnyo tumanye bulungi ekifo emmeeme zaffe gye zibeera. Mukama alangirira nti ye abadde kifo kyaffe eky'okubeeramu mu byafaayo byonna, naye ekibuuzo kiri nti: Ddala tubeera mu kifo kyaffe eky'okubeeramu? Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli ayogera ku baana ba Isirayiri nti “baabuulukuka mu ddungu awatali kkubo, ne batalaba kibuga eky'okubeeramu; enjala n'ennyonta ne bibaluma, emmeeme zaabwe ne ziggwaamu amaanyi munda yaabwe” (Zabbuli 107:4-5). Ntya nti waliwo emmeeme nnyingi ez'okubuulukuka mu kkanisa leero ze ebigambo bino bye bituukirira ddala. Mu bulamu bwabwe bwonna obw'Ekikristaayo babadde babuulukuka mu ddungu ery'omwoyo, ne batalaba maka ga lubeerera, era emmeeme zaabwe zaggwaamu amaanyi olw'enjala n'ennyonta. Naye mu kiseera ekyo kyonna, ekifo kya Katonda eky'okubeeramu kibadde kigguddwawo, nga kibayita bajje munda babeeremu emirembe gyonna. Mukama waffe yennyini atukubiriza okuyitibwa kuno: “Mubeere mu nze, nange mbeere mu mmwe” (Yokaana 15:4). Ne yeeyongera okututegeeza ebibala ebirungi eby'okusigala eyo n'ebizibu ebinakuwaza eby'okuvaamu. Amazima gali nti, emmeeme zaffe zaakolerwa Katonda. Ye maka gaffe amatonde, era tetuyinza kufuna kuwummula wa walala wonna. “Emmeeme yange yeegomba, weewaawo, ezirika olw'empya za Mukama; omutima gwange n'omubiri gwange biyimba n'essanyu eri Katonda omulamu” (Zabbuli 84:2). Tujja kulumwa enjala era tujja kuzirika olw'empya za Mukama ekiseera kyonna kye tuteefuulira eyo maka gaffe. Katonda yekka ge maka g'ekitonde; Newankubadde ekkubo lizibu era lifunda, Naye tewali kirala kiyinza kumatiza Emmeeme eyeegomba Katonda. Tunaakuluma tutya ekifo kino ekiramu eky'okubeeramu? Dawudi akinnyonnyola bw'agamba nti: “Mukama lwe lwazi lwange, n'ekigo kyange, n'omununuzi wange; Katonda wange, lwe lwazi lwange, mwe neekweka; engabo yange, n'ejjembe ery'obulokozi bwange, ekigo kyange eky'amaanyi, n'obuddukiro bwange, omulokozi wange; onnyinunula eri obukambwe” (2 Samwiri 22:2-3). Kale tulaba nti ekifo kyaffe eky'okubeeramu kye kigo kyaffe, n'ekigo kyaffe ekiwanvu, n'olwazi lwaffe, n'obuddukiro bwaffe. Ffenna tumanyi ekigo kye kiri. Kye kifo eky'obukuumi abanafu era abatalina buyambi mwe balundibwa ne bakuumibwa okuva eri omulabe. Bwe tugambibwa nti Katonda kye kigo kyaffe, kitegeeza kimu kyokka: bwe tubeera mu Ye, tujja kuba mu bukuumi obutuukiridde okuva eri buli mulabe yenna. “Kubanga alinkweka mu weema ye ku lunaku olw'okulabiralaba; alinkweka mu kifo eky'ekisiikirize eky'eweema ye; aliwanika ku lwazi” (Zabbuli 27:5). “Abeera mu kifo eky'ekisiikirize eky'Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo, anaabeeranga mu kisiikirize eky'Ayinzabyonna” (Zabbuli 91:1). “Mu kifo eky'okuweeza obwenyi bwo obakweka eri enkwe z'abantu; obakuuma mu weema yo eri okuyomba kw'ennimi” (Zabbuli 31:20). Mu “kifo eky'eweema ya Katonda,” tewali mulabe ayinza kutulaba era tewali buzibu buyinza kututuukako. Amalala g'abantu n'olugambo tebisobola kuyingira mu “kifo eky'ekisiikirize” ekya Katonda. “Ekifo eky'okuweeza obwenyi bwe” buddukiro obw'obukuumi obusinga Gibraltar lukumi. Sitegeeza nti tewali kugezesebwa kujja. Kuyinza kujja mu bungi, naye tekuyinza kuyingira mu watukuvu w'emmeeme. Tuyinza okubeera mu mirembe emituukiridde ne mu makkati g'omuyaga gw'obulamu ogusinga obukambwe. Naye, nga ffe abamanyi kino tuli batono! Tuyinza okukozesa olulimi lwa Dawudi, naye gye tuli, kifaananyi kya bigambo kyokka nga tekirimu mazima. Twogera ebigambo mu ddoboozi ery'obwannakyewa, ery'eddiini. “Weewaawo, mmanyi nti Mukama kye kifo kyange eky'okubeeramu, era nneewaddeyo mu bukuumi bwe, nga buli Mukristaayo bw'asaanidde. Naye—” era wano eddoboozi ery'obulijjo bwe likomawo— “naye siyinza kwerabira nti ndi muntu mwavu, atalina mugaso, atalina maanyi ga kuwangula kukemebwa. Sisobola kusuubira kukuumibwa mu bukuumi obutuukiridde Dawudi bw'ayogerako.” Awo ne wagoberera olugero olw'entiisa n'okweraliikirira, ng'ekifo kya Katonda eky'okubeeramu tekyali kiwuliddwako, era ng'emmeeme ebuulukuka yokka nga tekuumibwa mu nsi ey'akabi. Waliwo zabbuli gye nyita “Ekifo kya Katonda eky'Okubeeramu.” Ye Zabbuli ey'okulwenkumi mu emu, era ewa ennyonnyola ey'ekitalo ku maka gano bwe gali. “Abeera mu kifo eky'ekisiikirize eky'Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo, anaabeeranga mu kisiikirize eky'Ayinzabyonna. Nnaagamba Mukama nti, ‘Obuddukiro bwange n'ekigo kyange, Katonda wange, gwe neesiga’” (Zabbuli 91:1-2). Endowooza yaffe ku kigo bulijjo kya kizimbe eky'amayinja, omuntu w'abeera mu bukuumi naye ng'era tawummulamu. Naye waliwo ebigo ebirala ebigonvu, ebiweweevu, era ebijjudde okuwummula. Zabbuli eno ebinnyonnyola nti: “Alikubikka n'ebyoya bye, era wansi w'ebiwaawaatiro bye onoofuna obuddukiro” (Zabbuli 91:4), nga enkoko enkazi bw'ebikka ku baana baayo abanafu n'ebiwaawaatiro byayo ebibuguma. Ekigo eky'omutima gwa nnyina—oba wa muntu, oba wa nnyonyi, oba n'ogwa tiger—kye kigo ekisinga amaanyi mu nsi, naye ate kye kisinga obuweweevu. Kino kye kika ky'ekigo Mukama ky'ali. “Aliriisa ekisibo kye ng'omusumba; alikuŋŋaanya abaana b'endiga mu mikono gye; alibisitula mu kifuba kye” (Isaaya 40:11). “Katonda ow'emirembe gyonna kye kifo kyo eky'okubeeramu, era wansi waliwo emikono egy'emirembe gyonna” (Ekyamateeka 33:27). Ebiwaawaatiro, ekifuba, emikono! Bino bigo bya mukisa nnyo! Buli kintu ekibumbibwa mu byo kiri mu bukuumi. Obutonde bujjudde ebyokulabirako ng'ebyo. Lowooza ku ekyo omuwandiisi omu ky'ayogera ku tiger omukazi. Abaana be bwe bazaalibwa, amaanyi gamuyigiriza okuba omuwombeefu—omwoyo gw'atasobola kuziyiza, kubanga gwe mwoyo gw'Omutonzi we. Kya buzaaliranwa eri tiger okusunguwalira okunyigirizibwa. Singa omusika ebyoya oba n'omukuba, yandikutaaguddetaagudde. Naye okusunguwalira okunyigirizibwa si gwe mpaka ze ez'amaanyi ennyo. Tunuulira obwana obwo obunafu nga bumuzannyisa. Bunafu nnyo nga okwenyeenya kw'ekigere kye ekinene singa kubuzikiriza, naye takola kwenyeenya kwonna okw'obutafaayo. Bumuleetera obulumi obusinga okukubwa, naye tawoolera ggwanga. Abuwuubaawuuba n'okwagala mu maaso ge era akomba abo abamubonyaabonya abato. Okwagala kufuula okusinda kwe okw'obulumi obw'omubiri okuba amaloboozi ag'essanyu. Anyeenya omutwe gwe omunene mu ngeri eraga nti Katonda oyo omu eyakugamba “okukyusa oluba olulala” ye yamutonda. Bw'afuna amaanyi agamala okugolokoka, afuluma okwewaayo ku lwa babe. Alisiiba enjala baleme kukula. Wa ntiisa ku lw'abaana be abato, nga Katonda bw'ali ow'entiisa ku lw'ababe. Tulabye “ebigo bya bannyaabwe” bino emirundi ebikumi ne tubiyita ebifaanana nga Katonda. Omuntu yandirowoozezza nti okulaba kuno kwandituleetedde okudduka eri obuddukiro bwaffe mu Katonda ne tuleka okutya kwonna ebweru! Naye ekizibu kiri nti, tugaana ddala okukkiriza nti Bayibuli ategeeza amawulire amalungi ng'ago. Si mu bigambo, oboolyawo, naye mu bikolwa twogera nti, “Emikono gya Mukama tegyesigika nga egy'omuntu nnyina; omutima gwa Mukama teguweweevu nga ogwa tiger; ebiwaawaatiro bya Mukama tebikuuma nga eby'enkoko enkazi.” Tumanyi nti ye yakola ebigo bino eby'oku nsi, naye tetusobola kukkiriza nti yenkanankana nabyo. Okuba naye ng'ekigo kyaffe tekituwulira mu bukuumi oba mu buweweevu wadde ekitundu ng'okuba ne nnyaffe ng'ekigo kyaffe. Kale, bannyaabwe bwe beesigibwa, naye Katonda teyeesigibwa! Naye laba omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli bw'alangirira ekifo kino eky'obwakatonda eky'okubeeramu bwe kiri eky'obukuumi. Agamba nti ffe abali mu maka gano tetulitya kintu kyonna—si ntiisa ya kiro, si musaale ogw'emisana, si kawumpuli ali mu kizikiza, si kuzikiriza okw'omu ttuntu. Enkumi ziyinza okugwa okutwetooloola, naye tewali kabi kalibaawo eri emmeeme ekwekeddwa mu Katonda. Tewali kawumpuli alisembera abo abafudde Katonda “ekifo kyabwe eky'okubeeramu.” Entiisa zonna ezifudde obulamu bwaffe obw'eddiini nga tebuwummula ziriiriddwa wano. Tulinunulibwa okuva mu zo zonna bwe tunaafuula Mukama maka gaffe. Kino tekitegeeza nti tetuliba na kugezesebwa kwa kungulu. Kawumpuli ayinza okulumba omubiri gwo oba ebintu byo, naye ebintu ebyo si ggwe. Tewali kiyinza kusembera ggwe ow'amazima ow'omunda ng'okyabeera mu Katonda. Ekitundu ekinene eky'obulumi obw'obulamu kiva mu “kutya akabi” okutabula. Obulamu bwaffe bujjudde ebigambo nti “singa kiba kityo.” Ka tugambe nti kino kibaawo, oba kiri kibaawo—twandikoze ki? Twandikigumiikirizza tutya? Naye bwe tuba tubeera mu “kigo ekiwanvu” ekya Katonda, “singa” zino zonna zivaamu mu bulamu bwaffe. Tulibeera “mu mirembe, awatali kutya kabi” (Engero 1:33), kubanga tewali ntiisa ya kabi eyinza okuyingira mu kigo kya Katonda. Ne bw'aba atambula mu kiwonvu eky'ekisiikirize eky'okufa, omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli yasobola okugamba nti, “Siritya kabi” (Zabbuli 23:4); bwe tuba tubeera mu Katonda, naffe tuyinza okukigamba. Naye oyinza okubuuza engeri y'okuyingira mu kifo kino eky'obwakatonda eky'okubeeramu. Okuddamu kwange kwe kuno: yingiramu buyingizi. Singa mukwano gwaffe atupangisizza ennyumba n'agamba nti eteekateekeddwa, era endagaano ng'esseeko omukono era nga ya mateeka, tetwandibuuzizza ngeri ya kuyingiramu—twandisibye ebintu byaffe ne tujjulukuka. Kitugwanidde okukola bwe kityo wano. Katonda agamba nti ye kifo kyaffe eky'okubeeramu. Bayibuli erimu empapula zonna ezeetaagisa, nga zisseeko omukono era nga ziriko abajulizi. Mukama waffe atuyita—mu butuufu, atulagira—okuyingira n'okusigala. Agamba nti, “Katonda ge maka go; kakasa nti obeera eyo. Yingiramu.” Oyingiramu otya? Olw'okukkiriza. Katonda agambye nti ye kifo kyo eky'okubeeramu; kaakano naawe kikugwanidde okukigamba. “Nnaagamba Mukama nti, ‘Obuddukiro bwange n'ekigo kyange, Katonda wange, gwe neesiga’” (Zabbuli 91:2). Okukkiriza kutoola Ekigambo kya Katonda ne kukakasa nti kya mazima. Kristo agamba nti, “Mubeere,” era kitugwanidde okugamba nti, “Nnaabeera.” Tumufuula “ekifo kyaffe eky'okubeeramu” nga tukkiriza nti ye maka gaffe era nga tukirangirira bulijjo. Nga omuyimbi Coleridge bwe yagamba: Okukkiriza kwe kukakasa n'ekikolwa, Ekiragira amazima ag'emirembe gyonna okuba amazima agaliwo kaakano. Kitugwanidde okufuula amazima ag'emirembe gyonna nti Mukama kye kifo kyaffe eky'okubeeramu okuba amazima agaliwo kaakano nga tugakakasa n'okukkiriza kwaffe era nga tukwata ebirowoozo n'ebikolwa ebiva mu kubeera mu maaso ga Katonda. Ekimu ku bintu ebisooka bye twandikoze kwe kuleka okweraliikirira n'obukwakkalimu emirembe gyonna. Tekirowoozeka nti okweraliikirira kwandiyingidde mu kifo kya Katonda eky'okubeeramu; bwe tuyingira, kitugwanidde okukulekera emabega. Twogera ku kugondera ebiragiro bya Mukama era tussa essira ku mirimu egy'okungulu, so nga tunyooma ebiragiro ebikwata ku bulamu obw'omunda ebisinga obukulu emirundi lukumi. “Emitima gyammwe gireme kweraliikirira, so tegiretye” (Yokaana 14:27) kye kiragiro kya Mukama waffe ekitagonderwa ku nsi yonna. Naye nsuubira nti tewali kujeema kulala kunyiiza mutima gwe nga kuno. Nkakasa nti nnandinyiize nnyo singa omwana wange tanneesiga n'awulira ng'ebimufaako tebiri mu bukuumi mu mikono gyange okusinga singa yanjeemera mu kaseera k'okukemebwa. Nkakasibwa nti tetutegeera bwe kikwasa ebiwundu Mukama waffe abantu be bwe batawulira mu bukuumi naye. Tuyinza okutegeera kino okuva mu bulamu bwaffe ffennyini. Ka tugambe nti mukwano gwaffe yatuwa ekintu okumukuumira, ne tumukakasa mu buli ngeri nti kijja kubeera mu bukuumi. Awo mukwano gwaffe n'agenda n'akyeraliikirira, ng'ayolesa eri abalala okweraliikirira kwe kumu kwe twolesa ku bintu bye twawa Katonda. Twandiwulidde tutya? Twandinyiize nnyo. Ku nkomerero, twandigambye nti, “Okuva bw'olabika nga tonneesiga, kirungi weekuumire ebintu byo wekka.” Kya kitalo nti abaana ba Katonda baguma ne beeraliikirira nga bamaze okumuwa ensonga; kunyooma nnyo empisa ze. Ab'ebweru bakiraba ne balowooza nti okuba ne Mukama ng'ekifo eky'okubeeramu tekiteekwa kutegeeza kintu kinene, kubanga singa si bwe kiri tetwandibadde beeraliikirivu bwe tutyo. Oyo afaayo ku nkazaluggya era abala enviiri ez'oku mitwe gyaffe tasobola n'akatono okututtya. Ye kigo ekitamenyeka omutayinza kuyingira kabi wadde omulabe. Nkitwala ng'amazima ag'olwatu: mu kiseera we mmaze okuwaayo ekintu kyonna eri ekifo kino eky'obwakatonda eky'okubeeramu, okweraliikirira kwonna kusaanidde okukoma. Bwe nkuuma ebintu mu bujjuvu bwange, nnina ensonga ey'okukankana, kubanga tebiri mu bukuumi. Naye mu bujjuvu bwa Katonda, obukuumi butuukiridde. “Erinnya lya Mukama kigo eky'amaanyi; omutuukirivu adukira omwo n'aba mu bukuumi” (Engero 18:10). Kale, ekigendererwa kyokka kwe “kudukira” mu kigo kino n'osigala omwo emirembe gyonna. Kyandibadde busirusiru okuyimirira ebweru w'ekigo ng'omulabe akwetoolodde, ng'okaaba ng'oyagala obukuumi. Bwe njagala okuba mu bukuumi, nsaanidde okuyingira munda. “Ayi Yerusaalemi, Yerusaalemi... Emirundi emeka gye nnandyagadde okukuŋŋaanya abaana bo ng'enkoko bw'ekuŋŋaanya obwana bwayo wansi w'ebiwaawaatiro byayo, naye ne mutayagala!” (Matayo 23:37). Akayana bwe kaba kaagala okuba mu bukuumi, kasaanidde okudduka eri ebiwaawaatiro bya nnyina. Abantu bangi basigala ebweru w'ekifo kya Katonda eky'okubeeramu kubanga bawulira nga tebasaanira oba nga banafu nnyo okuyingira. Twandirowoozezza ki ku kayana akalaba enkwazi ng'ejja, ne kawulira nnyina ng'akoowoola, naye ne kasigala ebweru nga kakankana nga kagamba nti, “Ndi kayana kanafu, katalina buyambi, ekikuŋŋaanyisa okuyingira wansi w'ebiwaawaatiro ebyo”? Singa enkoko enkazi eyinza okwogera, yandigambye nti, “Ggwe kasirusiru, olw'okuba nga oli munafu era nga tolina buyambi kye njagalira wano. Singa wali sseggwanga ennene ery'amaanyi erisobola okwerabirira, saayagalidde kukukuŋŋaanya n'akatono.” Nkyetaaga okunnyonnyola ekigendererwa? Naye tetusaanidde “kudukira” mu kifo kyaffe eky'okubeeramu kyokka. “Ka mbeere mu weema yo emirembe gyonna! Ka nneekweke wansi w'ekisiikirize eky'ebiwaawaatiro byo!” (Zabbuli 61:4). Kitugwanidde okukola bwe kityo. Okubeera mu weema ye emirembe gyonna, nkkiriza nti, oluusi kizibu nnyo. Kyangu okutwala eddaawo ery'okukkiriza, naye kizibu nnyo okusigala mu kifo ekyo. Abantu bangi badukira mu kigo kya Katonda ku Ssande ne bafuluma nate amangu ddala ng'obudde bw'oku Balaza obw'enkya butuuse. Abamu badukira mu kyo bwe bafukamira okusaba okw'akawungeezi ne bafuluma edakiika ttaano oluvannyuma nga bagalamidde ku kitanda. Buno busirusiru bwereere. Toyinza kulowooza munoonyi w'obubudamu ng'adukira mu kigo ku lunaku olumu n'addamu okudduka okudda eri omulabe ku lunaku olulala. Twandirowoozezza nti bagudde eddalu. Naye si busirusiru busingawo eri emmeeme? Abalabe baffe tebakola nnyo ku Balaza? Tusobola okubakwatagana obulungi nga tweebase okusinga nga tusaba? Ekibuuzo kiri nti: Twagala kukyalira Katonda buikyalira, oba twagala kubeera eyo? Twagala kwekweka leero ne tuvuunulwa eri abalabe enkya?
