Agamba nti tuteekwa okukuba “nze” waffe ono omunene omugongo, ne tumugamba nti, “Sikumanyi, so sfaayo ku ggwe, era ngaana okukussaako amaaso n’akatono.” Naye ffe fennyini bulijjo tuli bamalirivu okufuna essira, era twandisinze okulowoozebwako obubi okusinga obutalowoozebwako n’akatono. N’okwekebera, n’obunaku bwakwo bwonna, oluusi kuwa obulamu obwa nafeeka mu ffe okusanyufu okw’engeri embi; era n’okulimba omuntu ow’edda okulowooza nti wa kwetoowaza era wa kutya Katonda mu ngeri eyo. Ekkubo lyokka eddungi era ery’Ekyawandiikibwa kwe butaba na kye tukolagana n’omuntu ow’edda n’akatono, oba n’omuntu omulungi oba n’omuntu omubi, wabula okwerabira ffe fennyini ddala; n’okussa amaaso gaffe, n’ebirowoozo byaffe, n’okusuubira kwaffe, ku Mukama, era ku ye yekka. Tuteekwa okwawaŋŋanya n’ebiraga nnannyini bino “nze,” “nze bennyini,” ne “ebyange,” ebiraga nnannyini “ye,” “oyo,” ne “bibye”; era tuteekwa okwebuuza, si nti “nze ndi mulungi?” wabula “ye mulungi?” Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli agamba nti, “Amaaso gange bulijjo gali eri Mukama, kubanga y’alissa ebigere byange mu kutega” (Zabbuli 25:15). Ng’amaaso gaffe gakyali eri ebigere byaffe, n’eri akatego mwe geesibye, tweyongera bwokka mu bizibu ebisingako. Naye bwe tukuuma amaaso gaffe eri Mukama, aggya ebigere byaffe mu katego. Kino kye kimu mu bumanyirivu obw’omu mpisa kye ŋŋezezzaako emirundi ebikumi, era mmanyi nti kya mazima. Ka nkwatibwe mu kizibu kya ngeri ki, ekya munda oba ekya kungulu, bulijjo nzudde nti, nga nkuuma amaaso gange ku kizibu ne ngezaako okukisumulula, kyeyongera kwonoonekera; naye, bwe nziggya amaaso gange ku kizibu ne ngassa ku Mukama, ye bulijjo, oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera, akisumulula n’amponya. Wali walabako omulimi ng’alima ennimiro? Bw’oba wali walaba, wandiraba nti, okusobola okulima olukuubo olugolokofu, kimugwanira okussa amaaso ge ku muti, oba ku mpagi mu lukomera, oba ku kintu ekirala ku ludda olw’ennimiro olusingako obuwanvu, n’oluvannyuma n’aluŋŋamya ekyuma kye eky’okulimisa nga tanyega eri ekintu ekyo. Bw’atandika okutunula ennyuma ku lukuubo lwe alimye okulaba oba alimye olukuubo olugolokofu, ekyuma kye eky’okulimisa kitandika okuweza ku njuyi zombi, n’olukuubo lw’alima lufuuka olukyamu. Bwe twagala okwekolera amakubo amagolokofu ag’ebigere byaffe, tuteekwa okukola Omutume kye yagamba nti yakola; tuteekwa nga “nneerabira ebiri emabega ne ngoba ebiri mu maaso, nnyiikira okulaga ku kigendererwa, olw’empeera ey’okuyitibwa okw’eggulu okwa Katonda mu Kristo Yesu” (Abafiripi 3:13-14). Okwerabira ebintu ebiri emabega kitundu kikulu eky’okugoba ebiri mu maaso eri empeera ey’okuyitibwa kwaffe okw’oku ntikko; era nkakasa nti empeera eno teyinza kutuukibwako okuggyako nga tukkiriza okwerabira kuno. Bwe tukkiriza kwe, tusembera kumpi n’okukomya okwekebera kwaffe kwonna; kubanga bwe tutasobola kutunula nate ku byonoono byaffe eby’emabega, tunaasanga emmere ntono ennyo ey’ebikolwa eby’okwerowoozaako. Twemulugunya olw’enjala ey’omwoyo ne twejjusa okumanya ensonga lwaki enjala yaffe tekkuta. Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli agamba nti, “Amaaso ga byonna gakutunuulira, era obiwa emmere yaabyo mu biseera byabyo” (Zabbuli 145:15). Okuba n’amaaso gaffe ku ffe fennyini, ne ku njala yaffe, tekugenda kuleeta mmere ya mwoyo. Omuntu awakke emmere n’afa enjala, amaaso ge tegatunuulira bwereere bwa tterekero lye, wabula gakyusizza eri ensulo gy’asuubira oba gy’alindirira okufuna emmere. Okwekebera ffe fennyini kwe kufaanana ng’omuntu ayinza okumala ekiseera kye ng’akebera etterekero lye eritaliimu, mu kifo ky’okugenda ku katale okufuna eby’okulijjuza. Si kya kwewuunya nga Abakristaayo abenkana awo balabika ng’abafa enjala wakati mu bujjuvu bwonna obuli eri bo mu Kristo. Tebalaba bujjuvu obwo, kubanga tebabutunuulira; era nziramu okwogera nti ekintu kye tutunuulira kye kintu kye tulaba. Mpulira ng’eŋŋanda okuddiŋŋana amazima gano ag’olwatu emirundi mingi ennyo, kubanga mu ngeri emu abantu balabika ng’abateeka wabbali amagezi gaabwe bwe batuuka ku nsonga y’eddiini, era balabika ng’basuubira okulaba ebintu bye baakuba omugongo mu bugenderevu. Bakaaba nti, “Ayi Mukama, weeyolese;” naye, mu kifo ky’okumutunuulira, beetunuulira bo bennyini era bakuuma okulaba kwabwe nga kunywevu ku nneewulira zaabwe ez’omunda, olwo ne beewuunya “ebikolwa ebitategeerekeka” ebya Katonda mu kubakweka amaaso ge okuva ku kusaba kwabwe okunyiikivu. Naye bayinza batya okulaba kye batatunuulira? Si Katonda addatukweka amaaso ge, wabula bulijjo ffe abakweka amaaso gaffe okuva gy’ali, nga “bankyusiza ennyuma so si maaso” (Yeremiya 32:33). Nnabbi anenya abaana ba Isirayiri olw’ekyo, era ayongerako nti “basimbye ebyenyinyalwa byabwe mu nnyumba etuumiddwa erinnya lyange” (Yeremiya 32:34). Abakristaayo bwe bamala ekiseera kyabwe nga bekenneenya embeera yaabwe, nga bakuŋŋaanya ebibi byabwe byonna, era nga bemulugunya olw’obutasobola kwabwe, kino kye ki okuggyako okusimba “eky’ekivve” eky’omuntu waabwe ow’ekibi ku kifo ekisinga obukulu mu mitima gyabwe, n’okukifuula ekifo eky’obulamu bwabwe bwonna obw’eddiini, n’okulabirira kwabwe n’okufuba kwabwe kwonna? Batunuulira “nze” ono omunene, era omunaku, okutuusa lwe ijjuza eggulu lyabwe lyonna, ne “bakuba omugongo” Mukama, okutuusa lw’abula okulabika ddala. Nnaakivumirira okwogera nti waliwo Abakristaayo bangi, ku buli kutunula kumu eri Mukama, banaawaayo okutunula lukumi eri bo bennyini, era, ku buli ssaawa emu abamala mu kusanyukira mu ye, banaamala ssaawa nkumi mu kwemulugunyiza. Tetulagirwa wamu wonna kutunuulira nneewulira zaffe, oba okumanyisibwa kwaffe, wadde ebibi byaffe, wabula tulagirwa okukuba omugongo bino byonna, n’“okulaba, Omwana gw’Endiga owa Katonda, aggyawo ekibi ky’ensi!” (Yokaana 1:29). Okutunula kumu ku Kristo kusinga omuwendo eri obulokozi okusinga okutunula obukadde eri ffe fennyini; kyokka, endowooza zaffe nga bwe zaakyama, tulabika ng’abatasobola kwewala kulowooza nti obunaku obuva mu kwekebera buteekwa okubaamu amaanyi agalokola, kubanga butufuula abanaku ennyo; kubanga tuteekwa okutambula olugendo oluwanvu mu lugendo lwaffe olw’eggulu nga tetunnaba kuyiga bulungi nti tewali maanyi galokola mu bunaku, era nti okukkiriza okusanyufu era okw’obwesige ye ngeri yokka ennungi eri omwoyo oguwulira okwegomba eby’omu ggulu. Mu Isaaya tulaba abantu ba Katonda nga beemulugunya nti baasiiba naye n’atalaba, era baabonyaabonya emyoyo gyabwe naye n’atamanya; era Katonda n’abaddamu eky’amakulu kino nti, “Okusiiba kwe nasiima kwe kuno, olunaku omuntu okwetoowaza yekka? Kwe kukotola omutwe gwe ng’olumuli, n’okwaliira ebibukutu n’evvu wansi we? Ojja kuyita kuno okusiiba, n’olunaku olusiimibwa Mukama?” (Isaaya 58:5). Ka abalala baba basiima obunaku bw’okwekebera kwaffe, kya mazima nnyo nti Katonda tabusiima. Tayagala tukotole emitwe gyaffe ng’olumuli, nga bwe yali tayagala abantu be ab’edda okukikola; era atuyita, nga bwe yayita abo, okwerabira ffe fennyini abanaku n’okugenda okukola okukendeeza ku bunaku bw’abalala. “Okusiiba kwe nasiima si kuno: okusumulula ebisiba eby’obutali butuukirivu, okwabya emigwa gy’ekikoligo, okuta ababonyaabonyezebwa nga ba ddembe, n’okumenya buli kikoligo? Si kwe kugabana omugaati gwo n’omuyala n’okuyingiza abaavu abatalina we bakwatira mu nnyumba yo; bw’olaba obwereere, okumubikka?” (Isaaya 58:6-7). Obuweereza buno eri abalala bwa muwendo mungi ennyo eri Mukama okusinga ebiseera ebisinga obuwanvu eby’okwekebera n’okwetoowaza; era nkakasa nti atulaze wano ekkubo erisinga obutereevu ery’okununulibwa okuva mu ttosi ery’obunaku empisa zaffe ez’okwekebera lye zaatusuulamu. Alangirira mu bujjuvu nti bwe tunaakuuma “okusiiba” kw’asiima, nga tuleka “okusiiba” kwaffe ffe okw’okubonyaabonya emyoyo gyaffe n’okukotola emitwe gyaffe ng’olumuli, ne mu kifo kyakwo “ofukirira omuyala ekiri mu mmeeme yo n’okkusa emmeeme ebonyaabonyezebwa, olwo omusana gwo ne guvaayo mu kizikiza n’ekizikiza kyo ne kiba ng’ettuntu. Era Mukama anaakuluŋŋamya bulijjo, n’akkusa emmeeme yo mu bifo ebyokye, n’anyweza amagumba go; era onooba ng’ennimiro efukiriddwa, ng’ensulo ey’amazzi, agataakala” (Isaaya 58:10-11). Bino byonna bye bituufu bye tubadde tulwanira okuvuunika, naye okulwanira kwaffe kubadde mu ngeri yaffe, so si eya Katonda. “Okusiiba” kwe tweronderayo kubadde kwa kubonyaabonya emyoyo gyaffe, n’okukotola emitwe gyaffe ng’emimuli, n’okutuula mu bibukutu n’evvu; era, olw’ekyo, mu kifo ky’amagumba gaffe okunywezebwa n’emyoyo gyaffe okuddamu obuggya ng’ennimiro efukiriddwa, tuzudde bwokka okukogga, n’ennyonta, n’obunaku. “Okusiiba” kwaffe ffe, ka kukolebwe n’obunyiikivu bwonna, ka kubeeko okusinda n’amaziga ameka, tekuyinza kutuleetera kintu kirala. Kaakano ka tugezeeko “okusiiba” kwa Katonda. Ka tusse wabbali okwefaako ffe fennyini kwonna ne tufaayo mu kifo kyakyo ku baganda baffe n’abaganda baffe abaavu. Ka tulekere awo okugezaako okukola ekintu ku bulamu bwaffe obwa nafeeka obunaku, ne tutandika okugezaako okukola ekintu okuyamba obulamu obw’omwoyo obw’abalala. Ka twekusize okufuba kwaffe okutalina ssuubi okuzuula ekintu mu ffe fennyini eky’okusanyukira, ne tusanyukira mu Mukama yekka ne mu buweereza bwe. Bwe tunaakola bwokka bino, ennaku zonna ez’obunaku bwaffe ziriggwaawo. Naye abamu bayinza okubuuza oba tekyetaagisa kwekebera ffe fennyini okuzuula ekikyamu era ekyetaaga okuddaabirizibwa. Kino kyandibadde kyetaagisa singa tuli mulimu gwaffe ffe fennyini, naye kubanga tuli mulimu gwa Katonda so si gwaffe ffe fennyini, ye y’asaanira okutwekenneenya, kubanga y’omu yekka ayinza okutegeera ekikyamu. Omuntu akola essaawa y’omu asaanira okwekenneenya essaawa bw’eba yonoonese n’okugiŋŋamya. Tulina amagezi mangi ennyo okwewaayo ku ssaawa zaffe; lwaki tetulina magezi mangi bimala okulekera awo okwewaayo ku ffe fennyini? Ddala tuteekwa okulaba nti okwekenneenya kwa Mukama kwe kwekenneenya kwokka okugasa. Okwekenneenya kwe kufaanana ng’okw’omusawo, akebera okusobola okuwonya; ate okwekebera kwaffe ffe kufaanana ng’okw’omulwadde, ayeeyongera bwokka okwetiisatiisa endwadde gy’alina ng’eyeeyongera okukebera obubonero bw’endwadde ye. Naye ekibuuzo kiyinza okubuuzibwa oba, bwe wabaawo ekibi ekikoleddwa ddala, tekigwanidde kubaawo kwekebera n’okwenenya, wadde okumala akaseera. Kino kya bulimba ekilimba bangi. Kirabika ng’ekisukkuma okukkiriza nti tuyinza okusonyiyibwa nga tetusoose kuyita mu kiseera eky’okwenenya. Naye Bayibuli eyigiriza ki? Yokaana atugamba nti “Bwe twatula ebibi byaffe, ye mwesigwa era wa bwenkanya okutusonyiwa ebibi byaffe n’okututukuza obutali butuukirivu bwonna” (1 Yokaana 1:9). Katonda ky’ayagala kyokka kwe tumukyukire mangu ne twatula ekibi kyaffe ne tukkiriza obusonyi bwe; era buli ddakiika gye tulwawo okukola kino, okusobola okumala ekiseera mu kwekebera n’okwenenya, tugatta bwokka ekibi ekirala ku ekyo kye twakola dda. Bwe wabaawo kye twetaaga okuggya amaaso gaffe ku ffe fennyini n’okugakyusa eri Mukama, kwe kuba nnyini bwe tuba tumanyi nti twonoonye gy’ali. Ekibinja eky’abalabe baffe bwe gyeyongera obungi, gye twetaaga Katonda okusingawo era mangu ddala. Mu Bayibuli yonna, tuyigirizibwa essomo lino ery’okufa eri ffe fennyini n’obulamu mu Kristo yekka. “Si nze nkyaba omulamu, wabula Kristo abeera omulamu mu nze” (Abaggalatiya 2:20) tekyagenderwa kuba bumanyirivu bwa Pawulo yekka, wabula kyali kulangirira bwokka ku ekyo ekyandibadde obumanyirivu bwa buli Mukristaayo. Oluusi tuyimba nti, “Ggwe, Ayi Kristo, ggw’ekintu kyonna kye njagala,” naye mu butuufu, twagala ebintu ebirala bingi ennyo. Twagala embeera ez’ebirowoozo n’enneewulira ennungi; twagala obunyiikivu n’okufuba; twagala okulaba n’obumanyirivu obumatiza; era bulijjo twekebera okugezaako okuzuula ensonga lwaki tetulina bino. Tulowooza nti singa tusobola okuzuula ebifo byaffe eby’okugwa, twandisobodde okubiŋŋamya. Naye tewali maanyi galwonya oba agakyusa mu kutunuulira okugwa kwaffe. Ekkubo lyokka eri okufaanana Kristo kwe kutunuulira, si obubi bwaffe, wabula obulungi bwe n’obulungi bw’endabika ye. Tukula okufaanana kye tutunuulira, era bwe tumala obulamu bwaffe nga tutunuulira ffe fennyini abakyayibwa, tunaayeyongera okukyayibwa. Tetuzuula nga kya mazima nti okwekebera, mu kifo ky’okutufuula abalungi, bulijjo kirabika ng’okitufuula ababi? Olw’okutunuulira ffe fennyini, tweyongera okukyusibwa okufuuka ekifaananyi kya ffe fennyini. Ku luuyi olulala, bwe tumala ekiseera kyaffe nga tutunuulira ekitiibwa kya Mukama—kwe kugamba, nga tuleka ebirowoozo byaffe okubeera ku bulungi bwe n’okwagala kwe, era nga tugezaako okunywa omwoyo gwe—ekiva mu ekyo ekitayinzika kwewalibwa kwe kuba nti tunaakyusibwa, mpozzi mpola naye ddala, okufuuka ekifaananyi kya Mukama gwe tutunuulira. Fénelon agamba nti tetusaana kwewaayo mu bikolwa byonna eby’okwerowoozaako, oba eby’okunyiigira okugwa kwaffe oba eby’okweyagaza olw’obuwanguzi bwaffe. Mu kifo kyakyo, tuteekwa okuwaayo bulijjo ffe fennyini n’ebikolwa byaffe byonna mu kwerabirwa era tuteekwa okukuuma amaaso gaffe ag’omunda ku Mukama yekka. Kizibu nnyo mu kwekebera obutagezaako kuzuula kya kwewolereza olw’ensobi zaffe, era ebikolwa byaffe eby’okwerowoozaako bulijjo biri mu kabi ak’okukyusibwa okufuuka eby’okweyimusa. Ekkubo lyokka kwe kwerabira ffe fennyini ddala n’okwerabira nti waliwo omuntu ng’oyo mu bulamu. Tewali n’omu atategeera kino ayinza okusiima okusanyusa n’okuwummula okuli mu kuggwaako ffe fennyini n’ebikolwa byonna eby’okwerowoozaako. Mmanyi abakozi Abakristaayo abalamu gyabadde okubonaabona okumu okuwanvu olw’ebikolwa bino; era nkakasa nti “Enkya Enzirugavu,” ez’abakulembeze b’eddiini bangi ze beemulugunyako, si kirala okuggyako ekiva mu kwewaayo mu bikolwa eby’okwerowoozaako ku buweereza bwabwe mu kkanisa olunaku olwayita. Ekkubo lyokka ery’okuyisaamu engeri zonna ez’ebikolwa eby’okwerowoozaako, ez’engeri yonna, kwe kubireka bwereere. Bulijjo bikola bubi so si bulungi. Biteekwa okuvaamu ekimu ku bibiri: oba bitujjuza okweyagaza n’okwematira, oba bitusuula mu buziba obw’obuggwaamu essuubi n’okuggwaamu amaanyi. Ka kibeere kimu ku byo, omwoyo teguyinza kwewala kuggalirwa bweru w’okulaba kwonna Katonda n’obulokozi bwe. Ekimu ku ngeri ezisinga obuyambi ez’okuwangula empisa eno kwe kuteeka etteeka nti, buli lwe tukemebwa okwekebera, bulijjo tunaatandika mangu okwekenneenya Mukama mu kifo kyaffe. Tuteekwa okuleka ebirowoozo ku kwagala kwe n’okumala kwe okwa buli ngeri okuggyawo ebirowoozo byonna eby’obutasaanira bwaffe oba obutasobola kwaffe. Nnkoze ekigezo mu kitabo kino okuteeka Mukama mu maaso gaffe mu bulungi bwonna obw’empisa ze n’amakubo ge, nga nsuubira nti okulaba kunaaba okuwuubaala nnyo okutuggya amaaso ku buli kintu ekirala. Naye tewali kubikkulirwa kwa Katonda kunaagasa singa tetunaakutunuulira, wabula ne tweyongera okukuba omugongo ekyo ekibikkuliddwa ne tutunuulira obumanyirivu bwaffe obw’omunda. Kubanga nziramu okwogera nti tetuyinza kulaba ffe fennyini ne tulaba Mukama mu kiseera kye kimu, era nga twekebera ffe fennyini, tetuyinza kuba nga tumutunuulira. Fénelon agamba ku kwekebera nti: “Waliwo ekintu ekikwekeddwa nnyo era ekirimba nnyo mu kubonaabona kwe kuleeta; kubanga ne bw’oba weerabika nga weewaddeyo kyonna ku kitiibwa kya Katonda, munda mu mmeeme yo ekitundu ffe fennyini kyokka kye kileeta obuzibu bwo bwonna. Ddala oyagala Katonda aweebwe ekitiibwa, naye oyagala kibaawo olw’okutuukirira kwo, olwo n’oyagalira mu nneewulira ez’okweyagala. Kya kwewolereza bwokka okukukumira mu ffe fennyini... Kya bukuusa eri okukkiriza okwangu bwe twagala okukakasibwa bulijjo nti tukola bulungi. Kya mazima, kwagala kwa kumanya kye tukola, kye tutaamanye, era Katonda ky’ayagala tetukimanya. Kya kuzannya mu kkubo, okusobola okuwakanya ku kkubo. Ekkubo erisinga obukuumi era erisinga obumpi kwe kwegaana, okwerabira, n’okuleka ffe fennyini, era, olw’obwesigwa eri Katonda, obutaddayo kukirowoozaako. Kuno kwe kutuukirira kw’eddiini yonna—okuva mu ffe fennyini n’okweyagala, okusobola okuyingira mu Katonda.” Kye tuteekwa okukola, kale, kwe kuggalawo oluggi mu bujjuvu era nga tetuddamu, omulundi gumu ogw’emirembe gyonna, eri ffe fennyini n’obumanyirivu bwaffe bwonna, ka bube bulungi oba bubi. Tuteekwa okwogera n’Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli nti, “Ntadde Mukama mu maaso gange bulijjo; kubanga ali ku mukono gwange ogwa ddyo, siriseeseetuka. Kyekivudde ku, omutima gwange gusanyuka, n’ekitiibwa kyange kijaguza; era omubiri gwange gunaabeera mu mirembe” (Zabbuli 16:8-9).

fields.title: Ebintu Ebitayinza Kunyeenyezebwa
fields.body_html:
"Ekigambo kino, 'Omulundi gumu nate,' kiraga okuggyibwawo kw'ebintu ebinyeenyezebwa—kwe kugamba, ebintu ebyakolebwa—ebintu ebitayinza kunyeenyezebwa bisigalewo" (Abaebbulaniya 12:27).

Oluvannyuma lwa byonna bye tubadde tulowoozaako ku kwagala kwa Katonda okutategeerekeka n'okulabirira kwe, kiyinza okulabika eri abo abatategeera amakubo ga mu kwagala ag'ekyama nti tewali kugezesebwa oba obuzibu bwe buyinza okujja mu bulamu bw'abaana be. Naye bwe twenetegereza ensonga eno mu buziba, tujja kulaba nti emirundi mingi okwagala kwennyini kwe kuleeta obuzibu. "Kubanga Mukama akangavvula gw'ayagala, era akuba buli mwana gw'asembeza. Mugumiikirize olw'okukangavvulwa; Katonda abayisa nga abaana. Kubanga mwana ki kitaawe gw'atakangavvula? Naye bwe muba awatali kukangavvulwa, okwo bonna kwe bagabana, kale muli baana ba buwemu so si baana ntuufu" (Abaebbulaniya 12:6-8).

Okwagala bwe kulaba abo kwe kwagala nga bakyama, olw'okwagala kwennyini, kirina okukola kye kisobola okubalokola; n'okwagala okulemererwa okukola kino kwe kwefaako kwokka. Kale nno, olw'okwagala kwe okutategeerekeka, Katonda ow'okwagala—bw'alaba abaana be nga bawummuza emyoyo gyabwe ku bintu ebiyinza okunyeenyezebwa—kimugwanira okuggya ebintu ebyo mu bulamu bwabwe balyoke bawalirizibwe okuwummulira ku bintu ebitayinza kunyeenyezebwa byokka. Enkola eno ey'okuggyawo oluusi eba nzibu nnyo.

Ffenna tujja kukkiriza, ndowooza, nti emyoyo gyaffe bwe giba giwummulira mu mirembe n'okusanyusibwa, kiyinza kwokka okuba ku misingi egitanyeenyezebwa. Tekisoboka omwoyo kubeera mu ddembe nga gugezaako okuwummulira ku 'bintu ebiyinza okunyeenyezebwa,' nga bwe kitasoboka eri omubiri. Tewali ayinza kuwummulira mu ddembe ku kitanda ekinyeenya oba okutuula mu ddembe ku ntebe eyuuguuma.

Emisingi, okuba egyesigwa, bulijjo giteekwa okuba egitanyeenyezebwa. "Buli muntu awulira ebigambo byange bino n'abikola alifaananyizibwa n'omusajja ow'amagezi eyazimba ennyumba ye ku lwazi. Enkuba n'etonnya, emigga ne gijjula, empewo n'ekunta n'ekuba ku nnyumba eyo, naye teyagwa, kubanga yali ezimbiddwa ku lwazi. Na buli muntu awulira ebigambo byange bino n'atabikola alifaananyizibwa n'omusajja omusirusiru eyazimba ennyumba ye ku musenyu. Enkuba n'etonnya, emigga ne gijjula, empewo n'ekunta n'ekuba ku nnyumba eyo, n'egwa, era okugwa kwayo kwali kunene" (Matayo 7:24-27).

Kisoboka nnyo mu bulamu bw'Ekikristaayo okuzimba ennyumba yo ey'omwoyo ku misingi egitanywevu, olwo ebibuyaga bwe bikuba ku yo, okuzikirira kw'ennyumba eyo ne kuba kunene. Obumanyirivu bungi obw'eddiini obwabadde bulabika nga bulungi ng'ebintu byonna bigenda bulungi mu bulamu bwatenderera ne bugwa ebigezo bwe byajja, kubanga emisingi gyabwo tegyali minywevu. Noolwekyo kya mugaso mungi eri buli omu ku ffe okwerabirira nti obulamu bwaffe obw'eddiini buzimbiddwa ku 'bintu ebitayinza kunyeenyezebwa.'

Mazima ddala, ekirowoozo ekyanguwa okujja mu buli mutwe kiri nti eteekwa okuzimbibwa ku Lwazi, Kristo Yesu. Kino kya mazima; naye ensonga enkulu kwe kutegeera ekigambo ekyo kye kitegeeza. Kimu ku bigambo ebyo eby'eddiini ebitera okukozesebwa ng'empisa awatali makulu ga ddala oba amazima agasibiddwako. Mu mpisa, tukkiriza nti Kristo ye Lwazi lwokka kwe tuzimba, naye mu bikolwa—wadde nga oboolyawo nga tetumanyi—tukkiriza nti okusobola okufuna olwazi olwo ku lwennaaba kya bukuumi ddala okuzimba, ebintu ebirala bingi biteekwa okwongerwa ku Kristo. Tulowooza, ng'ekyokulabirako, nti embeera ennungi ez'omwoyo n'enneewulira ziteekwa okwongerwa, oba enjigiriza entuufu oba enzikiriza, oba kyonna ekirala ekiyinza okulabika eri buli omu ku ffe nga kye kituukiriza omutindo ogw'obukuumi ogwetaagisa. Era singa twali beesimbu ddala eri ffennyini, ndowooza nti emirundi mingi twandizudde nti okwesiga kwaffe kwali kwesigamye ku bintu bino bye tweyongerako, era nti Kristo yennyini, ng'olwazi lwaffe kwe twesiga, yali wa mugaso gwa kubiri ddala.

Kye tusaanidde okutegeeza bwe twogera ku kuzimba ku Lwazi, Kristo Yesu, kye ngezaako mu kitabo kino kyonna okwolesa: nti Mukama amala olw'obulokozi bwaffe—Mukama yekka, awatali kwongerako kwaffe kwonna. Ye Mukama yennyini, nga bw'ali mu butonde bwe yennyini, Omutonzi waffe n'Omununuzi waffe, n'omugabo gwaffe ogumala byonna.

"Naye omusingi gwa Katonda omunywevu gunywera" (2 Timoseewo 2:19), era gwe musingi gwokka ogunywera.

Noolwekyo, twetaaga 'okunyeenyezebwa' okuva ku musingi gwonna omulala tulyoke tuwalirizibwe okuwummulira ku musingi gwa Katonda yekka. Kino kinnyonnyola obwetaavu bw''okunyeenya' okwo Abakristaayo bangi kwe balabika okuyitamu. Mukama alaba nga bazimba ennyumba zaabwe ez'omwoyo ku misingi eminafu egitaliyinza kugumira 'omugga ogwakuba ku nnyumba eyo' (Lukka 6:48) mu bibuyaga eby'obulamu. Si mu busungu, wabula mu kwagala okw'ekisa ennyo, anyeenya ensi yaffe n'eggulu lyaffe okutuusa ng'ebyo byonna 'ebiyinza okunyeenyezebwa' biggiddwawo, era 'ebintu ebitayinza kunyeenyezebwa' byokka bye bisigalawo.

Omutume atugamba nti ebintu ebinyeenyezebwa bye 'bintu ebyakolebwa' (Abaebbulaniya 12:27); kwe kugamba, ebintu ebikolebwa olw'okufuba kwaffe ffennyini—enneewulira ze tutuumbula, enjigiriza ze tunyweza, n'ebikolwa ebirungi bye tukola. Si nti bino bibi mu byo byennyini. Wabula omwoyo bwe gutandika okuwummulira ku byo mu kifo ky'okuwummulira ku Mukama, olwo n'awalirizibwa 'okututunyeenya' okuva ku byo. Era okunyeenya kuno, tutegeezebwa nti, tekukoma ku 'nsi yokka wabula n'eggulu' (Abaebbulaniya 12:26). Kino kitegeeza, nkakasa, nti kisoboka okuba n''ebintu ebyakolebwa' ne mu nsonga z'eddiini. Eddiini eyeeyita ey'Abakristaayo bangi ng'ebeeramu bimeka mu 'bintu bino ebyakolebwa,' siyinza kugamba; naye oluusi ndowooza nti okuvuunikibwa n'okusuulibwa okunene mu nsonga z'okukkiriza, okunyimaanya nnyo Abakristaayo mu biseera bino, kuyinza okuba kwokka kwe kunyeenya okwetaagisa okw''ebintu ebyakolebwa,' ekiri 'ekitayinza kunyeenyezebwa' kyokka kiryoke kisigalewo.

Waliwo ebiseera, oboolyawo, mu bulamu bwaffe obw'eddiini, obumanyirivu bwaffe lwe bulabika nga bunywevu era nga tebunyeenyezebwa ng'emirandira gy'ensozi ez'olubeerera. Naye olwo ne wajja okuyuuguuma; emisingi gyaffe gyonna ne ginyeenyezebwa ne gisuulibwa wansi, era ne tuba beetegefu okuggwaamu essuubi n'okwebuuza obanga tuyinza n'okuba Abakristaayo. Oluusi kuba kuyuuguuma mu mbeera zaffe ez'ebweru, era oluusi kuba mu bumanyirivu bwaffe obw'omunda. Abantu bwe baba bawummulidde ku bikolwa byabwe ebirungi n'obuweereza bwabwe obw'obwesigwa, Mukama emirundi mingi awalirizibwa okuggyawo amaanyi gonna ag'okukola oba omukisa gwonna, omwoyo gulyoke guvebwe mu kifo kyagwo eky'obulimba ne guwalirizibwa okuwummulira mu Mukama yekka.

Oluusi okwesiga kuba ku nneewulira ennungi oba ku mmeeme ez'okutya Katonda, era omwoyo guteekwa okuggyibwako bino nga tegunnayiga kwesiga Katonda yekka. Oluusi okwesiga kuteekebwa ku 'njigiriza entuufu,' era omuntu awulira ng'ali mu kifo ekitaliiko busobozi bwa kulumbibwa kubanga 'endowooza' ze ntuufu nnyo era enjigiriza ze 'ntuufu' nnyo. Olwo Mukama awalirizibwa 'okunyeenya' enjigiriza ezo n'okusuula omuntu oyo, oboolyawo, mu kutabukatabuka n'ekizikiza ku 'ndowooza' ze. Kyali mu kaseera nga kano omwoyo gwange gwennyini lwe gwafuna okulaba kwagwo okusooka okwa nnamaddala okwa Katonda; ekyali kirabise ng'okuzikirira n'okuwangulwa okw'omwoyo okukakafu ne kifuuka obuwanguzi obw'amaanyi ennyo.

Oba kiyinza okuba nti okuyuuguuma kujja mu mbeera zaffe ez'ebweru. Buli kimu kibadde kirabika nga kinywezeddwa nnyo mu bugagga nga tewali kirooto kya kabi kitutabula. Erinnya lyaffe likakasibwa, omulimu gwaffe gukulaakulanye, okufuba kwaffe kwonna kuwanguddwa okusukka essuubi lyaffe, era omwoyo gwaffe guli mu ddembe; obwetaavu bwa Katonda buli mu kabi ak'okufuuka obwewala era obutategeerekeka. Olwo Mukama awalirizibwa okukomya byonna. Obugagga bwaffe bumenyeka okwetooloola ng'ennyumba eyazimbibwa ku musenyu, era tukemebwa okulowooza nti atunyiigidde. Naye mu mazima, si busungu, wabula kwagala okw'ekisa ennyo. Okwagala kwe kwennyini kumuwaliriza okuggyawo obugagga obw'ebweru obuziyiza emyoyo gyaffe okuyingira obwakabaka obw'omunda obw'omwoyo bwe tuyaayaanira.

"Newankubadde omutiini teguliba na kimuli, so tewaabe bibala ku mizabbibu, ebibala by'omuzeeyituuni ne bibula, n'ennimiro ne zitabala mmere, endiga ne zisalibwa mu kisibo, so tewaabe nte mu biraalo, kyokka nnaasanyukira mu Mukama; nnaajaguza mu Katonda ow'obulokozi bwange" (Kabakuuku 3:17-18).

Olwo, era emirundi mingi si nga tekinnaba kutuuka awo, emyoyo gyaffe lwe girayiga okusanyukira mu Mukama yekka.

Pawulo yalangirira nti 'yabala byonna okuba okufaafaaganirwa olw'obukulu obusukkiridde obw'okumanya Kristo Yesu Mukama wange' (Abafiripi 3:8). Bwe tuyiga okwogera bwe kimu, emirembe n'essanyu enjiri bye yasuubiza bifuuka obugagga bwaffe obutaggwaawo.

"Bakitammwe baazuula bulimba ki mu nze, ne banvaako wala, ne bagoberera ebitaliimu, nabo ne bafuuka abataliimu?" bw'abuuza Mukama abaana ba Isirayiri (Yeremiya 2:5).

"Kubanga abantu bange bakoze ebibi bibiri: banvaako, nze ensulo y'amazzi amalamu, ne beesimira ebidiba, ebidiba ebyatiseemu ebitayinza kutereka mazzi" (Yeremiya 2:13).

Nga Abaisirayiri, naffe tuva ku nsulo y'amazzi amalamu ne tugezaako okusima ebidiba bye tweyiiyiza ffennyini. Tunoonya okumaliza ennyonta yaffe n'obumanyirivu bwaffe oba emirimu gyaffe, oluvannyuma ne twewuunya lwaki tukyalina ennyonta. Olw'okutulokola tuleme okufa olw'obwetaavu bw'amazzi, Mukama kyava alaba nga kyetaagisa okuzikiriza ebidiba byaffe ebyatise; olwo lwe tuyinza okuwalirizibwa okunywa ku nsulo y'amazzi amalamu.

Tutegeezebwa nti bwe 'twesiga obwereere,' olwo 'obwereere bwe buliba empeera yaffe' (Yobu 15:31), era emirundi mingi twakizudde nga kya mazima. Wali osomose ekisaalu eky'akabi ekijjudde omusenyu oguminya, buli kigere we kyali akabi? Obusozi obw'okulabika obunywevu bwakulimbanga bulijjo mu kwesiga okw'obulimba, ne bukusennyisa mu ttosi n'amazzi agakwekeddwa wansi waabwo. Bw'oba wali okoze bw'otyo, ojja kutegeera amakulu g''okwesiga obwereere,' era ojja kusiima omukisa gw'embeera yonna eyoolesa obuvundu bw'okwesiga kwo okw'obulimba n'ekukuwaliriza okwesiga ekyo ekitali kya bulabe era eky'olubeerera. Ebigere byaffe bwe biba bitambulira mu 'ttosi eminya,' tusaanidde okwaniriza Omukulembeze ow'omu ggulu atuggya mu ttosi 'n'assa ebigere byange ku lwazi, n'anyweza amakubo gange' (Zabbuli 40:2), wadde ng'amakubo g'atuyita okutambulirako gayinza okulabika nga makumpanyi era nga magumu.

Nnabbi Yeremiya, bw'akungubagira ebibi by'abantu be, agamba nti, 'twefudde eby'obulimba okuba obuddukiro bwaffe, era mu bukuusa mwe twekwese' (Isaaya 28:15). Ayongerako nti Mukama yalangirira nti, 'omuzira gulyera obuddukiro obw'obulimba, era amazzi galyanjaala ekifo eky'okwekweka' (Isaaya 28:17). Kiyinza okulabika ng'obusungu bwa Katonda bwe bukola kino, era Abakristaayo bangi abatidde balowooza nti bwe bwe butyo; naye obusungu bwe buli ku buddukiro obw'obulimba bwokka, si ku ffe. Okwagala tekwandikoze kitono okusinga okuzikiriza obuddukiro buno tulyoke tununulibwe.

Mukwano gwange omukadde omwagalwa, eyali afaayo nnyo ku bulungi bw'omwoyo gwange, lumu yampa akatabo akayitibwa The Seventeen False Rests of the Soul (Obuwummulo Ekkumi n'omusanvu obw'Obulimba obw'Omwoyo). Kirabika yali awulira nti nnali mu kabi ak'okuwummulira ku bumu ku buwummulo buno obw'obulimba. Akatabo kannyonnyola, mu lulimi olukadde olw'ekyewuunyisa, nti omwoyo gukemebwa bulijjo okutuula ku kintu eky'obulimba nga kye kiddukiro kyagwo eky'enkomerero. Olwo Katonda awalirizibwa bulijjo 'okuggya ekituusi' mu bifo byonna ebyo eby'obulimba, nga bwe kiba omuntu ayinza okuggya entebe ku ntebe n'aleka atudde okugwira munda. Obuwummulo bwonna obw'obulimba ekkumi n'omusanvu bwannyonnyolwa, nga bulaga engeri omwoyo—nga 'guggyibwako ekituusi' ku buli bumu mu ngeri yaabwo—bwe gwatuula ku nkomerero ku buwummulo bwokka obwa nnamaddala mu Katonda.

Okuggyako ekituusi kuno kigambo kirala kyokka olw''okunyeenya' n''okwesuula' kwe mbadde mpandiikako. Bulijjo nkola nzibu era emirundi mingi eggwaamu amaanyi. Buli kimu kirabika nga tekinywevu, era okuwummula kulabika nga tekusoboka n'akatono. Nga tetunnaba kuzuula bumanyirivu oba njigiriza gye tulowooza nti tuyinza okuwummuliramu ddala, amangwago 'okunyeenya' okunene ne kujja ne tuwalirizibwa okufuluma nate. Enkola eno eteekwa okweyongera okutuusa nga byonna ebiyinza okunyeenyezebwa biggiddwawo, era 'ebintu ebyo ebitayinza kunyeenyezebwa' byokka bye bisigalawo. Emirundi mingi eky'okuddamu okusaba kwaffe okw'amaanyi ennyo olw'okununulwa kijja mu ngeri eraga nga 'n'emisingi gy'ensozi gyakankana ne giyuuguuma' (Zabbuli 18:7). Tetulaba bulijjo okusooka nti kuyita mu kunyeenya kuno kwennyini okununulwa kwe twasaba kwe kutuukirizibwa, nga kututwala mu 'kifo ekigazi' (Zabbuli 18:19) kye tuyaayaanira.

Ab'edda abanoonyi b'ebyama baayigirizanga kye baayita 'okwawulibwa,' ekitegeeza okusumulula omwoyo okuva ku byonna ebiyinza okugukugira okuva ku Katonda. Obwetaavu buno obw'okwawulibwa kye kyama ky''okunyeenya' kwaffe okungi. Tetuyinza kugoberera Mukama mu bujjuvu ng'ekyakubadde tusibiddwa nnyo ku kintu kyonna ekirala, nga n'eryato bwe litayinza kuseeyeeya mu nnyanja etaliiko nkomerero nga lisibiddwa ku lukalu.

Bwe tuba twagala okutuuka mu 'kibuga ekirina emisingi, omutonzi n'omuzimbi waakyo Katonda' (Abaebbulaniya 11:10), tuteekwa okufuluma nga Ibulayimu okuva mu bibuga ebirala byonna n'okwawulibwa okuva ku buli kisiba eky'ensi.

Buli kimu mu bulamu bwa Ibulayimu ekyayinzika okunyeenyezebwa kyanyeenyezebwa. Yali, nga bwe kyali, afukibwa okuva mu kibya okudda mu kibya—wano leero n'agenda enkya. Ebifo bye byonna eby'okuwummuliramu byatabulwa, nga tewali kutereera oba kusanyusibwa wonna. Ffe, nga Ibulayimu, tunoonya ekibuga ekirina emisingi, noolwekyo naffe tujja kwetaaga okufukibwa okuva mu kibya okudda mu kibya. Tekitutegeerekeka kino, era okunyeenya bwe kujja, tuggwaamu essuubi, nga tulowooza nti tetugenda kutuuka ku kibuga ekyo n'akatono. Naye kwe kunyeenya kuno kwennyini kutusobozesa okukituukako.

Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli yali ayize kino, era oluvannyuma lw'okunyeenya kwonna okw'obulamu bwe obw'ebyafaayo, yakaaba nti, 'Ggwe mwoyo gwange, lindirira Katonda yekka mu kasiriikiriro, kubanga essuubi lyange liva gy'ali. Ye yekka lwe lwazi lwange n'obulokozi bwange, ekigo kyange; siinyeenyezebwa. Obulokozi bwange n'ekitiibwa kyange biri ku Katonda; olwazi lwange olw'amaanyi, obuddukiro bwange, Katonda' (Zabbuli 62:5-7). Ku nkomerero, Katonda yali buli kimu gy'ali; era n'alyoka azuula nti Katonda amala.

Bwe kityo bwe kiri ne ffe. Buli kimu mu bulamu bwaffe ne mu bumanyirivu bwaffe bwe kinyeenyezebwa ekiyinza okunyeenyezebwa, era ekyo ekitayinza kunyeenyezebwa kyokka ne kisigalawo, tuleetebwa okulaba nti Katonda yekka lwe lwazi lwaffe n'omusingi gwaffe. Tuyiga okuba n'okusuubira kwaffe okuva gy'ali yekka. "Noolwekyo tetulitya newankubadde ensi yeeggyawo, newankubadde ensozi zisindikibwa mu mutima gw'ennyanja, newankubadde amazzi gaayo gawuluguma ne gabimba ejjovu, newankubadde ensozi zikankana olw'okuzimba kwago... Katonda ali wakati mu ye; taliseesebwa; Katonda alimuyamba obudde nga bukya" (Zabbuli 46:2-3, 5).

"Taliseesebwa"—nga kye kirangiriro ekizzaamu amaanyi! Kiyinza okusoboka nti ffe, abaseesebwa mangu ennyo olw'ebintu eby'ensi, tuyinza okutuuka mu kifo omutali kintu kiyinza kunyiiza mmeeme yaffe oba okutabula obukkakkamu bwaffe? Yee, kisoboka; era Omutume Pawulo yali akimanyi. Bwe yali ku lugendo lwe okugenda e Yerusaalemi, gye yalabira edda nga 'okusibwa n'okubonaabona' bimulindiridde, yasobola okwogera n'obuwanguzi nti, 'Naye sibala bulamu bwange kuba kya muwendo oba kya mugaso gye ndi' (Ebikolwa 20:23-24). Mu lulimi olukadde, yagamba nti, 'Tewali ku bintu bino kinseesa.' Buli kimu mu bulamu bwa Pawulo ekyayinzika okunyeenyezebwa kyali kinyeenyeziddwa. Bwe tuleka Katonda n'atukolako nga bw'ayagala, tuyinza okutuuka mu kifo kye kimu. Wadde obunyiiza obutono obw'obulamu oba ebigezo byabwo ebinene tebiriba na maanyi ga kutuseesa kutuggya mu 'mirembe gya Katonda egisukka okutegeera kwonna' (Abafiripi 4:7), egy'omugabo gw'abo abaayiga okuwummulira ku Katonda yekka.

Mu Kubikkulirwa okwaweebwa Yokaana ku kizinga Patumo, Omwoyo agamba ekkanisa ebirindiridde abo abawangula: 'Oyo awangula, ndimufuula empagi mu yeekaalu ya Katonda wange.

Talivaamu emirembe gyonna' (Okubikkulirwa 3:12). Okuba nga tonyeenyezebwa ng'empagi mu nnyumba ya Katonda waffe kye kigendererwa omuntu ky'ayinza okugumiikiriza n'essanyu 'okunyeenya' kwonna 'n'okuggyibwako ekituusi' okwetaagisa okutuuka eyo!

"Noolwekyo ka twebaze olw'okufuna obwakabaka obutayinza kunyeenyezebwa, era bwe tutyo ka tuwe Katonda okusinza okukkirizibwa, n'okumussaamu ekitiibwa n'okutya, kubanga Katonda waffe muliro ogwokya" (Abaebbulaniya 12:28-29). Abantu bangi nnyo batya omuliro gwa Katonda ogwokya, naye ekyo kiba lwa kubanga tebategeera kye guli. Gwe muliro gw'okwagala kwa Katonda oguteekwa, olw'obutonde bwagwo bwennyini, okwokya buli kimu ekiyinza okukola akabi eri abantu be. Emitima gyaffe bwe giteekebwa okuba nga bwe kwagala kwa Katonda kwe kwagala tube, omuliro gwe kintu kye tunaayaniriza n'essanyu mu kifo ky'okugutya.

"Okwagala tekukkakkanyizibwa.

Abalabe bayinza okugulwa oba okusendebwasendebwa okuva ku kigendererwa kyabwe ekibi; Naye oyo amalirira ekisa tamalibwa busungu."

Kale ka twebaze Katonda nti 'amalirira ekisa' gye tuli, era nti omuliro gw'okwagala kwe ogwokya teguligaana kubuubuuka okutuusa nga gutulongoosezza nga effeeza bw'elongoosebwa. Kubanga ekisuubizo kiri nti 'alituula ng'omulongoosa era omutukuza wa ffeeza, era alitukuza abaana ba Leevi, n'abalongoosa nga zaabu ne ffeeza, era baliwaayo eri Mukama ebiweebwayo mu butuukirivu' (Malaki 3:3). Atuwa obukakafu buno obuzzaamu amaanyi: bwe tunaagondera enkola eno ey'okutukuza, tujja kufuuka 'abasanyusa Mukama' (Malaki 3:4). 'Awo amawanga gonna galikuyita ow'omukisa, kubanga oliba ensi ey'essanyu, bw'ayogera Mukama ow'eggye' (Malaki 3:12).

Okuba 'abasanyusa' era 'essanyu' eri Mukama kiyinza okulabika ng'ekitasoboka gye tuli bwe tutunuulira ebbula lyaffe n'obutasaanira bwaffe. Naye bwe tulowooza ku muliro guno omulungi ogwokya ogw'okwagala kwa Katonda, tuyinza okuguma omwoyo n'okuba abavumu. Taliremererwa oba okuggwaamu amaanyi okutuusa ng'amasengejjero gaffe gonna n'effeeza yaffe embi biggiddwawo ne byokebwa, era ffe ffennyini ne tuvaayo nga tufaananye ye, nga tufaananyizibwa mu kifaananyi kye.

Emyoyo gyaffe giyaayaanira 'obwakabaka obutayinza kunyeenyezebwa' (Abaebbulaniya 12:28). Oyo 'amalirira ekisa,' bwe tumukkiriza, alinyeenya buli kimu mu bulamu bwaffe ekiyinza okunyeenyezebwa. Alituggyako ekituusi okuva ku buwummulo bwonna obw'obulimba okutuusa ng'ekyo ekitayinza kunyeenyezebwa kyokka kye kisigalawo.

Kimu ku bibuulirwa ebyankwatako ennyo bye nnali mpulirako kyabuulirwa omukyala omukadde Omukwaka ow'amaaso ag'ekisa. Yayimuka mu kasiriikiriro n'agamba nti, 'Jjo, mwannyinaze Tabisa yamenya buli akatti kange akasinga obulungi aka china n'akafuula ebifiififi. Naye Mukama, gwe nneesiga, yakuuma omwoyo gwange mu mirembe emituukirivu era n'ansobozesa obutayogera n'ekigambo n'ekimu eky'okunenya.' Ekyo kye kyali kyokka; ekibuulirwa kyaggwa. Naye mu buli mutima ne muyingira okutegeera kye kyandibadde okutegeeza okukuumibwa mu bwakabaka obutaseesebwa obw'okwagala kwa Katonda. Obwakabaka buno buyinza okuba amaka gaffe bwe tunaagondera bwokka okunyeenya kwa Katonda ne tuyiga okuwummulira ku ye yekka era bulijjo.

Ayanguyize olunaku olwo eri buli omu ku ffe!
fields.body_text: "Ekigambo kino, 'Omulundi gumu nate,' kiraga okuggyibwawo kw'ebintu ebinyeenyezebwa—kwe kugamba, ebintu ebyakolebwa—ebintu ebitayinza kunyeenyezebwa bisigalewo" (Abaebbulaniya 12:27). Oluvannyuma lwa byonna bye tubadde tulowoozaako ku kwagala kwa Katonda okutategeerekeka n'okulabirira kwe, kiyinza okulabika eri abo abatategeera amakubo ga mu kwagala ag'ekyama nti tewali kugezesebwa oba obuzibu bwe buyinza okujja mu bulamu bw'abaana be. Naye bwe twenetegereza ensonga eno mu buziba, tujja kulaba nti emirundi mingi okwagala kwennyini kwe kuleeta obuzibu. "Kubanga Mukama akangavvula gw'ayagala, era akuba buli mwana gw'asembeza. Mugumiikirize olw'okukangavvulwa; Katonda abayisa nga abaana. Kubanga mwana ki kitaawe gw'atakangavvula? Naye bwe muba awatali kukangavvulwa, okwo bonna kwe bagabana, kale muli baana ba buwemu so si baana ntuufu" (Abaebbulaniya 12:6-8). Okwagala bwe kulaba abo kwe kwagala nga bakyama, olw'okwagala kwennyini, kirina okukola kye kisobola okubalokola; n'okwagala okulemererwa okukola kino kwe kwefaako kwokka. Kale nno, olw'okwagala kwe okutategeerekeka, Katonda ow'okwagala—bw'alaba abaana be nga bawummuza emyoyo gyabwe ku bintu ebiyinza okunyeenyezebwa—kimugwanira okuggya ebintu ebyo mu bulamu bwabwe balyoke bawalirizibwe okuwummulira ku bintu ebitayinza kunyeenyezebwa byokka. Enkola eno ey'okuggyawo oluusi eba nzibu nnyo. Ffenna tujja kukkiriza, ndowooza, nti emyoyo gyaffe bwe giba giwummulira mu mirembe n'okusanyusibwa, kiyinza kwokka okuba ku misingi egitanyeenyezebwa. Tekisoboka omwoyo kubeera mu ddembe nga gugezaako okuwummulira ku 'bintu ebiyinza okunyeenyezebwa,' nga bwe kitasoboka eri omubiri. Tewali ayinza kuwummulira mu ddembe ku kitanda ekinyeenya oba okutuula mu ddembe ku ntebe eyuuguuma. Emisingi, okuba egyesigwa, bulijjo giteekwa okuba egitanyeenyezebwa. "Buli muntu awulira ebigambo byange bino n'abikola alifaananyizibwa n'omusajja ow'amagezi eyazimba ennyumba ye ku lwazi. Enkuba n'etonnya, emigga ne gijjula, empewo n'ekunta n'ekuba ku nnyumba eyo, naye teyagwa, kubanga yali ezimbiddwa ku lwazi. Na buli muntu awulira ebigambo byange bino n'atabikola alifaananyizibwa n'omusajja omusirusiru eyazimba ennyumba ye ku musenyu. Enkuba n'etonnya, emigga ne gijjula, empewo n'ekunta n'ekuba ku nnyumba eyo, n'egwa, era okugwa kwayo kwali kunene" (Matayo 7:24-27). Kisoboka nnyo mu bulamu bw'Ekikristaayo okuzimba ennyumba yo ey'omwoyo ku misingi egitanywevu, olwo ebibuyaga bwe bikuba ku yo, okuzikirira kw'ennyumba eyo ne kuba kunene. Obumanyirivu bungi obw'eddiini obwabadde bulabika nga bulungi ng'ebintu byonna bigenda bulungi mu bulamu bwatenderera ne bugwa ebigezo bwe byajja, kubanga emisingi gyabwo tegyali minywevu. Noolwekyo kya mugaso mungi eri buli omu ku ffe okwerabirira nti obulamu bwaffe obw'eddiini buzimbiddwa ku 'bintu ebitayinza kunyeenyezebwa.' Mazima ddala, ekirowoozo ekyanguwa okujja mu buli mutwe kiri nti eteekwa okuzimbibwa ku Lwazi, Kristo Yesu. Kino kya mazima; naye ensonga enkulu kwe kutegeera ekigambo ekyo kye kitegeeza. Kimu ku bigambo ebyo eby'eddiini ebitera okukozesebwa ng'empisa awatali makulu ga ddala oba amazima agasibiddwako. Mu mpisa, tukkiriza nti Kristo ye Lwazi lwokka kwe tuzimba, naye mu bikolwa—wadde nga oboolyawo nga tetumanyi—tukkiriza nti okusobola okufuna olwazi olwo ku lwennaaba kya bukuumi ddala okuzimba, ebintu ebirala bingi biteekwa okwongerwa ku Kristo. Tulowooza, ng'ekyokulabirako, nti embeera ennungi ez'omwoyo n'enneewulira ziteekwa okwongerwa, oba enjigiriza entuufu oba enzikiriza, oba kyonna ekirala ekiyinza okulabika eri buli omu ku ffe nga kye kituukiriza omutindo ogw'obukuumi ogwetaagisa. Era singa twali beesimbu ddala eri ffennyini, ndowooza nti emirundi mingi twandizudde nti okwesiga kwaffe kwali kwesigamye ku bintu bino bye tweyongerako, era nti Kristo yennyini, ng'olwazi lwaffe kwe twesiga, yali wa mugaso gwa kubiri ddala. Kye tusaanidde okutegeeza bwe twogera ku kuzimba ku Lwazi, Kristo Yesu, kye ngezaako mu kitabo kino kyonna okwolesa: nti Mukama amala olw'obulokozi bwaffe—Mukama yekka, awatali kwongerako kwaffe kwonna. Ye Mukama yennyini, nga bw'ali mu butonde bwe yennyini, Omutonzi waffe n'Omununuzi waffe, n'omugabo gwaffe ogumala byonna. "Naye omusingi gwa Katonda omunywevu gunywera" (2 Timoseewo 2:19), era gwe musingi gwokka ogunywera. Noolwekyo, twetaaga 'okunyeenyezebwa' okuva ku musingi gwonna omulala tulyoke tuwalirizibwe okuwummulira ku musingi gwa Katonda yekka. Kino kinnyonnyola obwetaavu bw''okunyeenya' okwo Abakristaayo bangi kwe balabika okuyitamu. Mukama alaba nga bazimba ennyumba zaabwe ez'omwoyo ku misingi eminafu egitaliyinza kugumira 'omugga ogwakuba ku nnyumba eyo' (Lukka 6:48) mu bibuyaga eby'obulamu. Si mu busungu, wabula mu kwagala okw'ekisa ennyo, anyeenya ensi yaffe n'eggulu lyaffe okutuusa ng'ebyo byonna 'ebiyinza okunyeenyezebwa' biggiddwawo, era 'ebintu ebitayinza kunyeenyezebwa' byokka bye bisigalawo. Omutume atugamba nti ebintu ebinyeenyezebwa bye 'bintu ebyakolebwa' (Abaebbulaniya 12:27); kwe kugamba, ebintu ebikolebwa olw'okufuba kwaffe ffennyini—enneewulira ze tutuumbula, enjigiriza ze tunyweza, n'ebikolwa ebirungi bye tukola. Si nti bino bibi mu byo byennyini. Wabula omwoyo bwe gutandika okuwummulira ku byo mu kifo ky'okuwummulira ku Mukama, olwo n'awalirizibwa 'okututunyeenya' okuva ku byo. Era okunyeenya kuno, tutegeezebwa nti, tekukoma ku 'nsi yokka wabula n'eggulu' (Abaebbulaniya 12:26). Kino kitegeeza, nkakasa, nti kisoboka okuba n''ebintu ebyakolebwa' ne mu nsonga z'eddiini. Eddiini eyeeyita ey'Abakristaayo bangi ng'ebeeramu bimeka mu 'bintu bino ebyakolebwa,' siyinza kugamba; naye oluusi ndowooza nti okuvuunikibwa n'okusuulibwa okunene mu nsonga z'okukkiriza, okunyimaanya nnyo Abakristaayo mu biseera bino, kuyinza okuba kwokka kwe kunyeenya okwetaagisa okw''ebintu ebyakolebwa,' ekiri 'ekitayinza kunyeenyezebwa' kyokka kiryoke kisigalewo. Waliwo ebiseera, oboolyawo, mu bulamu bwaffe obw'eddiini, obumanyirivu bwaffe lwe bulabika nga bunywevu era nga tebunyeenyezebwa ng'emirandira gy'ensozi ez'olubeerera. Naye olwo ne wajja okuyuuguuma; emisingi gyaffe gyonna ne ginyeenyezebwa ne gisuulibwa wansi, era ne tuba beetegefu okuggwaamu essuubi n'okwebuuza obanga tuyinza n'okuba Abakristaayo. Oluusi kuba kuyuuguuma mu mbeera zaffe ez'ebweru, era oluusi kuba mu bumanyirivu bwaffe obw'omunda. Abantu bwe baba bawummulidde ku bikolwa byabwe ebirungi n'obuweereza bwabwe obw'obwesigwa, Mukama emirundi mingi awalirizibwa okuggyawo amaanyi gonna ag'okukola oba omukisa gwonna, omwoyo gulyoke guvebwe mu kifo kyagwo eky'obulimba ne guwalirizibwa okuwummulira mu Mukama yekka. Oluusi okwesiga kuba ku nneewulira ennungi oba ku mmeeme ez'okutya Katonda, era omwoyo guteekwa okuggyibwako bino nga tegunnayiga kwesiga Katonda yekka. Oluusi okwesiga kuteekebwa ku 'njigiriza entuufu,' era omuntu awulira ng'ali mu kifo ekitaliiko busobozi bwa kulumbibwa kubanga 'endowooza' ze ntuufu nnyo era enjigiriza ze 'ntuufu' nnyo. Olwo Mukama awalirizibwa 'okunyeenya' enjigiriza ezo n'okusuula omuntu oyo, oboolyawo, mu kutabukatabuka n'ekizikiza ku 'ndowooza' ze. Kyali mu kaseera nga kano omwoyo gwange gwennyini lwe gwafuna okulaba kwagwo okusooka okwa nnamaddala okwa Katonda; ekyali kirabise ng'okuzikirira n'okuwangulwa okw'omwoyo okukakafu ne kifuuka obuwanguzi obw'amaanyi ennyo. Oba kiyinza okuba nti okuyuuguuma kujja mu mbeera zaffe ez'ebweru. Buli kimu kibadde kirabika nga kinywezeddwa nnyo mu bugagga nga tewali kirooto kya kabi kitutabula. Erinnya lyaffe likakasibwa, omulimu gwaffe gukulaakulanye, okufuba kwaffe kwonna kuwanguddwa okusukka essuubi lyaffe, era omwoyo gwaffe guli mu ddembe; obwetaavu bwa Katonda buli mu kabi ak'okufuuka obwewala era obutategeerekeka. Olwo Mukama awalirizibwa okukomya byonna. Obugagga bwaffe bumenyeka okwetooloola ng'ennyumba eyazimbibwa ku musenyu, era tukemebwa okulowooza nti atunyiigidde. Naye mu mazima, si busungu, wabula kwagala okw'ekisa ennyo. Okwagala kwe kwennyini kumuwaliriza okuggyawo obugagga obw'ebweru obuziyiza emyoyo gyaffe okuyingira obwakabaka obw'omunda obw'omwoyo bwe tuyaayaanira. "Newankubadde omutiini teguliba na kimuli, so tewaabe bibala ku mizabbibu, ebibala by'omuzeeyituuni ne bibula, n'ennimiro ne zitabala mmere, endiga ne zisalibwa mu kisibo, so tewaabe nte mu biraalo, kyokka nnaasanyukira mu Mukama; nnaajaguza mu Katonda ow'obulokozi bwange" (Kabakuuku 3:17-18). Olwo, era emirundi mingi si nga tekinnaba kutuuka awo, emyoyo gyaffe lwe girayiga okusanyukira mu Mukama yekka. Pawulo yalangirira nti 'yabala byonna okuba okufaafaaganirwa olw'obukulu obusukkiridde obw'okumanya Kristo Yesu Mukama wange' (Abafiripi 3:8). Bwe tuyiga okwogera bwe kimu, emirembe n'essanyu enjiri bye yasuubiza bifuuka obugagga bwaffe obutaggwaawo. "Bakitammwe baazuula bulimba ki mu nze, ne banvaako wala, ne bagoberera ebitaliimu, nabo ne bafuuka abataliimu?" bw'abuuza Mukama abaana ba Isirayiri (Yeremiya 2:5). "Kubanga abantu bange bakoze ebibi bibiri: banvaako, nze ensulo y'amazzi amalamu, ne beesimira ebidiba, ebidiba ebyatiseemu ebitayinza kutereka mazzi" (Yeremiya 2:13). Nga Abaisirayiri, naffe tuva ku nsulo y'amazzi amalamu ne tugezaako okusima ebidiba bye tweyiiyiza ffennyini. Tunoonya okumaliza ennyonta yaffe n'obumanyirivu bwaffe oba emirimu gyaffe, oluvannyuma ne twewuunya lwaki tukyalina ennyonta. Olw'okutulokola tuleme okufa olw'obwetaavu bw'amazzi, Mukama kyava alaba nga kyetaagisa okuzikiriza ebidiba byaffe ebyatise; olwo lwe tuyinza okuwalirizibwa okunywa ku nsulo y'amazzi amalamu. Tutegeezebwa nti bwe 'twesiga obwereere,' olwo 'obwereere bwe buliba empeera yaffe' (Yobu 15:31), era emirundi mingi twakizudde nga kya mazima. Wali osomose ekisaalu eky'akabi ekijjudde omusenyu oguminya, buli kigere we kyali akabi? Obusozi obw'okulabika obunywevu bwakulimbanga bulijjo mu kwesiga okw'obulimba, ne bukusennyisa mu ttosi n'amazzi agakwekeddwa wansi waabwo. Bw'oba wali okoze bw'otyo, ojja kutegeera amakulu g''okwesiga obwereere,' era ojja kusiima omukisa gw'embeera yonna eyoolesa obuvundu bw'okwesiga kwo okw'obulimba n'ekukuwaliriza okwesiga ekyo ekitali kya bulabe era eky'olubeerera. Ebigere byaffe bwe biba bitambulira mu 'ttosi eminya,' tusaanidde okwaniriza Omukulembeze ow'omu ggulu atuggya mu ttosi 'n'assa ebigere byange ku lwazi, n'anyweza amakubo gange' (Zabbuli 40:2), wadde ng'amakubo g'atuyita okutambulirako gayinza okulabika nga makumpanyi era nga magumu. Nnabbi Yeremiya, bw'akungubagira ebibi by'abantu be, agamba nti, 'twefudde eby'obulimba okuba obuddukiro bwaffe, era mu bukuusa mwe twekwese' (Isaaya 28:15). Ayongerako nti Mukama yalangirira nti, 'omuzira gulyera obuddukiro obw'obulimba, era amazzi galyanjaala ekifo eky'okwekweka' (Isaaya 28:17). Kiyinza okulabika ng'obusungu bwa Katonda bwe bukola kino, era Abakristaayo bangi abatidde balowooza nti bwe bwe butyo; naye obusungu bwe buli ku buddukiro obw'obulimba bwokka, si ku ffe. Okwagala tekwandikoze kitono okusinga okuzikiriza obuddukiro buno tulyoke tununulibwe. Mukwano gwange omukadde omwagalwa, eyali afaayo nnyo ku bulungi bw'omwoyo gwange, lumu yampa akatabo akayitibwa The Seventeen False Rests of the Soul (Obuwummulo Ekkumi n'omusanvu obw'Obulimba obw'Omwoyo). Kirabika yali awulira nti nnali mu kabi ak'okuwummulira ku bumu ku buwummulo buno obw'obulimba. Akatabo kannyonnyola, mu lulimi olukadde olw'ekyewuunyisa, nti omwoyo gukemebwa bulijjo okutuula ku kintu eky'obulimba nga kye kiddukiro kyagwo eky'enkomerero. Olwo Katonda awalirizibwa bulijjo 'okuggya ekituusi' mu bifo byonna ebyo eby'obulimba, nga bwe kiba omuntu ayinza okuggya entebe ku ntebe n'aleka atudde okugwira munda. Obuwummulo bwonna obw'obulimba ekkumi n'omusanvu bwannyonnyolwa, nga bulaga engeri omwoyo—nga 'guggyibwako ekituusi' ku buli bumu mu ngeri yaabwo—bwe gwatuula ku nkomerero ku buwummulo bwokka obwa nnamaddala mu Katonda. Okuggyako ekituusi kuno kigambo kirala kyokka olw''okunyeenya' n''okwesuula' kwe mbadde mpandiikako. Bulijjo nkola nzibu era emirundi mingi eggwaamu amaanyi. Buli kimu kirabika nga tekinywevu, era okuwummula kulabika nga tekusoboka n'akatono. Nga tetunnaba kuzuula bumanyirivu oba njigiriza gye tulowooza nti tuyinza okuwummuliramu ddala, amangwago 'okunyeenya' okunene ne kujja ne tuwalirizibwa okufuluma nate. Enkola eno eteekwa okweyongera okutuusa nga byonna ebiyinza okunyeenyezebwa biggiddwawo, era 'ebintu ebyo ebitayinza kunyeenyezebwa' byokka bye bisigalawo. Emirundi mingi eky'okuddamu okusaba kwaffe okw'amaanyi ennyo olw'okununulwa kijja mu ngeri eraga nga 'n'emisingi gy'ensozi gyakankana ne giyuuguuma' (Zabbuli 18:7). Tetulaba bulijjo okusooka nti kuyita mu kunyeenya kuno kwennyini okununulwa kwe twasaba kwe kutuukirizibwa, nga kututwala mu 'kifo ekigazi' (Zabbuli 18:19) kye tuyaayaanira. Ab'edda abanoonyi b'ebyama baayigirizanga kye baayita 'okwawulibwa,' ekitegeeza okusumulula omwoyo okuva ku byonna ebiyinza okugukugira okuva ku Katonda. Obwetaavu buno obw'okwawulibwa kye kyama ky''okunyeenya' kwaffe okungi. Tetuyinza kugoberera Mukama mu bujjuvu ng'ekyakubadde tusibiddwa nnyo ku kintu kyonna ekirala, nga n'eryato bwe litayinza kuseeyeeya mu nnyanja etaliiko nkomerero nga lisibiddwa ku lukalu. Bwe tuba twagala okutuuka mu 'kibuga ekirina emisingi, omutonzi n'omuzimbi waakyo Katonda' (Abaebbulaniya 11:10), tuteekwa okufuluma nga Ibulayimu okuva mu bibuga ebirala byonna n'okwawulibwa okuva ku buli kisiba eky'ensi. Buli kimu mu bulamu bwa Ibulayimu ekyayinzika okunyeenyezebwa kyanyeenyezebwa. Yali, nga bwe kyali, afukibwa okuva mu kibya okudda mu kibya—wano leero n'agenda enkya. Ebifo bye byonna eby'okuwummuliramu byatabulwa, nga tewali kutereera oba kusanyusibwa wonna. Ffe, nga Ibulayimu, tunoonya ekibuga ekirina emisingi, noolwekyo naffe tujja kwetaaga okufukibwa okuva mu kibya okudda mu kibya. Tekitutegeerekeka kino, era okunyeenya bwe kujja, tuggwaamu essuubi, nga tulowooza nti tetugenda kutuuka ku kibuga ekyo n'akatono. Naye kwe kunyeenya kuno kwennyini kutusobozesa okukituukako. Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli yali ayize kino, era oluvannyuma lw'okunyeenya kwonna okw'obulamu bwe obw'ebyafaayo, yakaaba nti, 'Ggwe mwoyo gwange, lindirira Katonda yekka mu kasiriikiriro, kubanga essuubi lyange liva gy'ali. Ye yekka lwe lwazi lwange n'obulokozi bwange, ekigo kyange; siinyeenyezebwa. Obulokozi bwange n'ekitiibwa kyange biri ku Katonda; olwazi lwange olw'amaanyi, obuddukiro bwange, Katonda' (Zabbuli 62:5-7). Ku nkomerero, Katonda yali buli kimu gy'ali; era n'alyoka azuula nti Katonda amala. Bwe kityo bwe kiri ne ffe. Buli kimu mu bulamu bwaffe ne mu bumanyirivu bwaffe bwe kinyeenyezebwa ekiyinza okunyeenyezebwa, era ekyo ekitayinza kunyeenyezebwa kyokka ne kisigalawo, tuleetebwa okulaba nti Katonda yekka lwe lwazi lwaffe n'omusingi gwaffe. Tuyiga okuba n'okusuubira kwaffe okuva gy'ali yekka. "Noolwekyo tetulitya newankubadde ensi yeeggyawo, newankubadde ensozi zisindikibwa mu mutima gw'ennyanja, newankubadde amazzi gaayo gawuluguma ne gabimba ejjovu, newankubadde ensozi zikankana olw'okuzimba kwago... Katonda ali wakati mu ye; taliseesebwa; Katonda alimuyamba obudde nga bukya" (Zabbuli 46:2-3, 5). "Taliseesebwa"—nga kye kirangiriro ekizzaamu amaanyi! Kiyinza okusoboka nti ffe, abaseesebwa mangu ennyo olw'ebintu eby'ensi, tuyinza okutuuka mu kifo omutali kintu kiyinza kunyiiza mmeeme yaffe oba okutabula obukkakkamu bwaffe? Yee, kisoboka; era Omutume Pawulo yali akimanyi. Bwe yali ku lugendo lwe okugenda e Yerusaalemi, gye yalabira edda nga 'okusibwa n'okubonaabona' bimulindiridde, yasobola okwogera n'obuwanguzi nti, 'Naye sibala bulamu bwange kuba kya muwendo oba kya mugaso gye ndi' (Ebikolwa 20:23-24). Mu lulimi olukadde, yagamba nti, 'Tewali ku bintu bino kinseesa.' Buli kimu mu bulamu bwa Pawulo ekyayinzika okunyeenyezebwa kyali kinyeenyeziddwa. Bwe tuleka Katonda n'atukolako nga bw'ayagala, tuyinza okutuuka mu kifo kye kimu. Wadde obunyiiza obutono obw'obulamu oba ebigezo byabwo ebinene tebiriba na maanyi ga kutuseesa kutuggya mu 'mirembe gya Katonda egisukka okutegeera kwonna' (Abafiripi 4:7), egy'omugabo gw'abo abaayiga okuwummulira ku Katonda yekka. Mu Kubikkulirwa okwaweebwa Yokaana ku kizinga Patumo, Omwoyo agamba ekkanisa ebirindiridde abo abawangula: 'Oyo awangula, ndimufuula empagi mu yeekaalu ya Katonda wange. Talivaamu emirembe gyonna' (Okubikkulirwa 3:12). Okuba nga tonyeenyezebwa ng'empagi mu nnyumba ya Katonda waffe kye kigendererwa omuntu ky'ayinza okugumiikiriza n'essanyu 'okunyeenya' kwonna 'n'okuggyibwako ekituusi' okwetaagisa okutuuka eyo! "Noolwekyo ka twebaze olw'okufuna obwakabaka obutayinza kunyeenyezebwa, era bwe tutyo ka tuwe Katonda okusinza okukkirizibwa, n'okumussaamu ekitiibwa n'okutya, kubanga Katonda waffe muliro ogwokya" (Abaebbulaniya 12:28-29). Abantu bangi nnyo batya omuliro gwa Katonda ogwokya, naye ekyo kiba lwa kubanga tebategeera kye guli. Gwe muliro gw'okwagala kwa Katonda oguteekwa, olw'obutonde bwagwo bwennyini, okwokya buli kimu ekiyinza okukola akabi eri abantu be. Emitima gyaffe bwe giteekebwa okuba nga bwe kwagala kwa Katonda kwe kwagala tube, omuliro gwe kintu kye tunaayaniriza n'essanyu mu kifo ky'okugutya. "Okwagala tekukkakkanyizibwa. Abalabe bayinza okugulwa oba okusendebwasendebwa okuva ku kigendererwa kyabwe ekibi; Naye oyo amalirira ekisa tamalibwa busungu." Kale ka twebaze Katonda nti 'amalirira ekisa' gye tuli, era nti omuliro gw'okwagala kwe ogwokya teguligaana kubuubuuka okutuusa nga gutulongoosezza nga effeeza bw'elongoosebwa. Kubanga ekisuubizo kiri nti 'alituula ng'omulongoosa era omutukuza wa ffeeza, era alitukuza abaana ba Leevi, n'abalongoosa nga zaabu ne ffeeza, era baliwaayo eri Mukama ebiweebwayo mu butuukirivu' (Malaki 3:3). Atuwa obukakafu buno obuzzaamu amaanyi: bwe tunaagondera enkola eno ey'okutukuza, tujja kufuuka 'abasanyusa Mukama' (Malaki 3:4). 'Awo amawanga gonna galikuyita ow'omukisa, kubanga oliba ensi ey'essanyu, bw'ayogera Mukama ow'eggye' (Malaki 3:12). Okuba 'abasanyusa' era 'essanyu' eri Mukama kiyinza okulabika ng'ekitasoboka gye tuli bwe tutunuulira ebbula lyaffe n'obutasaanira bwaffe. Naye bwe tulowooza ku muliro guno omulungi ogwokya ogw'okwagala kwa Katonda, tuyinza okuguma omwoyo n'okuba abavumu. Taliremererwa oba okuggwaamu amaanyi okutuusa ng'amasengejjero gaffe gonna n'effeeza yaffe embi biggiddwawo ne byokebwa, era ffe ffennyini ne tuvaayo nga tufaananye ye, nga tufaananyizibwa mu kifaananyi kye. Emyoyo gyaffe giyaayaanira 'obwakabaka obutayinza kunyeenyezebwa' (Abaebbulaniya 12:28). Oyo 'amalirira ekisa,' bwe tumukkiriza, alinyeenya buli kimu mu bulamu bwaffe ekiyinza okunyeenyezebwa. Alituggyako ekituusi okuva ku buwummulo bwonna obw'obulimba okutuusa ng'ekyo ekitayinza kunyeenyezebwa kyokka kye kisigalawo. Kimu ku bibuulirwa ebyankwatako ennyo bye nnali mpulirako kyabuulirwa omukyala omukadde Omukwaka ow'amaaso ag'ekisa. Yayimuka mu kasiriikiriro n'agamba nti, 'Jjo, mwannyinaze Tabisa yamenya buli akatti kange akasinga obulungi aka china n'akafuula ebifiififi. Naye Mukama, gwe nneesiga, yakuuma omwoyo gwange mu mirembe emituukirivu era n'ansobozesa obutayogera n'ekigambo n'ekimu eky'okunenya.' Ekyo kye kyali kyokka; ekibuulirwa kyaggwa. Naye mu buli mutima ne muyingira okutegeera kye kyandibadde okutegeeza okukuumibwa mu bwakabaka obutaseesebwa obw'okwagala kwa Katonda. Obwakabaka buno buyinza okuba amaka gaffe bwe tunaagondera bwokka okunyeenya kwa Katonda ne tuyiga okuwummulira ku ye yekka era bulijjo. Ayanguyize olunaku olwo eri buli omu ku ffe!

fields.title: Ekigambo eri Abo Abawuubaala
fields.body_html:
"Naye asabe mu kukkiriza, nga tabuusabuusa; kubanga abuusabuusa afaanana ng'ejjengo ery'ennyanja erifuumuulibwa empewo ne lisuukundibwa. Kubanga omuntu oyo aleme okulowooza nti aliweebwa ekintu kyonna okuva eri Mukama" (Yakobo 1:6-7).

Kizibu okulaba ekintu kyonna ekireeta okutabukatabuka mu bulamu obw'eddiini okusinga okukkiriza okuwuubaala. Ekifaananyi Omutume Yakobo ky'atuwa kikinnyonnyola bulungi ddala: "ejjengo ery'ennyanja... erifuumuulibwa ne lisuukundibwa." Nga bwe kitasoboka omutambuze okutuuka we yagenda ng'olunaku olumu agenda mu maaso ate olulala n'akyuka n'addayo emabega, bwe kityo n'emmeeme ewuubaala teyinza kutuuka mu kifo eky'emirembe egitereedde ng'ekyeyongera okuwuubaala.

Mu ssuula yaffe eyayita, twalowooza ku kunyeenya kwa Katonda. Kiyinza okulowoozebwa nti okuwuubaala kwaffe kufaanana n'okunyeenya kwe, naye bya njawulo nnyo. Okunyeenya kwa Katonda kuva mu kwagala kwe okutuleetera omukisa; bulijjo kutuusa mu kuwummula n'emirembe. Okuwuubaala kwaffe kuva mu kubulwa okukkiriza kwaffe; bulijjo kutuusa mu kutabukatabuka n'oluyombo.

Omukristaayo awuubaala ye muntu eyeesiga okwagala kwa Katonda olunaku olumu ate n'akubuusabuusa olulala, era ekivaamu asanyuka oba anakuwala ng'emirundi bwe gyawukana. Balinnya ku ntikko y'olusozi olw'essanyu mu kaseera akamu, ne baserengeta mu kiwonvu eky'okuggwaamu essuubi mu kaseera akaddirira. Bawuubibwa eno n'eri buli "mpewo ya njigiriza," nga bulijjo bafuba naye tebatuuka ku kintu. Bafuuka omunyago gwa buli kikyusa ekyawukana—oba bwe buba obulamu bwabwe obw'omubiri, oba abantu ababeetoolodde, oba n'obudde bwennyini.

Wandirowoozezza nti n'omwana wa Katonda atamanyidde nnyo yandimanyi nti engeri eno ey'obulamu si ntuufu. Okuwuubaala mu kukkiriza mu ngeri eyo kuswaza Mukama nnyo, kubanga kubuusabuusa amazima ge n'obwesigwa bwe. Naye Abakristaayo bangi bazibiddwa amaaso ne balowooza nti okuwuubaala kuno kabonero ka kwetoowaza. Batwala buli kulumba kwa kubuusabuusa okupya ng'ekirungi eky'okutya Katonda.

Omukristaayo awuubaala ayinza okwogera mu bwewombeefu nti, "Naye mmanyi nti sisaanira nnyo, kyeva kiba kituufu gye ndi okubuusabuusa." Batera okuwooza nti singa oyo abawuliriza yeetoowaza ddala, naye yandibuusizzaabuusizza. Nnali nzize omukristaayo omwewaayo eyalina obulamu obw'eddiini obwali bujjudde okubuusabuusa okutamala. Bwe namukubiriza okuba n'okukkiriza okusingako, yaŋŋamba n'obunkenke bwonna nti, "Munnange omwagalwa, singa nnandibadde ne malala okuwulira nga nkakasa nti Katonda anjagala, nnandikakasizza nti ndi ku kkubo eritereevu erigenda mu ggeyeena."

Kyali kya lwatu nti yalowooza nti obwesige ng'obwo bwandivudde bwokka mu kuwulira nti ye yali "mulungi bumala" okusaanira okwagala kwa Katonda. Yali mutuufu nti okulowooza nti tusaanira okwagala kwa Katonda kwe kwemanya.

Naye omusingi gw'obwesige bwaffe teguva mu bulungi bwaffe ffe, wabula guva mu bulungi bwa Katonda. Newankubadde nga tetusaanidde kumatira mu bulungi bwaffe ffe, tewali kubuusabuusa—eri omuntu yenna akkiriza Bayibuli—ku bwenkerezo obw'obulungi bwe.

Okulaba engeri embi gy'eri endowooza eno ey'okubuusabuusa, lowooza engeri gye yandikoledde mu nkolagana z'abantu.

Teebereza obufumbo, oba enkolagana wakati w'omwana n'omuzadde—byombi Mukama by'akozesa ng'obubonero obw'enkolagana yaffe naye. Singa omukyala oba omwami yandibadde n'obulamu obuwuubaala obw'obwesige eri munne—ng'amwesiga olunaku olumu ate ng'amubuusabuusa olulala—kino kyandirabise ng'akabonero k'okwetoowaza oba ng'ekirungi eky'okulondoola? Mu ngeri y'emu, singa abaana bawuubaala mu bwesige eri abazadde baabwe nga Abakristaayo bwe bakola eri Kitaabwe ali mu ggulu, kigambo ki ekyandimazze okunenya empisa eyo etasaanira mwana? Mu nkolagana z'abantu, okuwuubaala ng'okwo kwandisonyiyibbwa singa omuntu omu yali tasaanira kwesigibwa mazima. Naye eri Katonda, tewali nsonga ya ngeri eyo. Okukkiriza okuwuubaala okw'abaana be kuyinza n'okuleetera ab'ebweru okusalawo nti tasaanira kwesigibwa nnyo.

Twanditidde nnyo okuleetera abantu okulowooza obubi ku mpisa za Katonda. Naye bwe tuba abeesimbu, tuteekwa okukkiriza nti okukkiriza okuwuubaala kuleeta ekirowoozo ekyo ekituufu. Mu bwannamaddala, kwe kutaba beesigwa eri Katonda omwesigwa, era kwandirabiddwa ng'ekibi ekinene.

Amazima gali nti okuwuubaala kwaffe kuva mu ngeri ey'amalala amakwafu, emirundi mingi agatamanyiddwa, so si mu kwetoowaza. Okwetoowaza okw'amazima kukkiriza okwagala n'ebirabo ebikuweebwa n'okwebaza okuwombeefu era okusanyusa. Amalala go, ku luuyi olulala, gatya okukkiriza ekisa era gatya okukkiriza obulungi obutali bwa kwefaako obw'oyo awa. Singa twali beetoowaze ddala, twandikkirizza okwagala kwa Katonda n'obuwombeefu obw'okwebaza. Nga bwe tukkiriza obutasaana kwaffe, twandikirabidde ng'ekintu ekyokka ekyoleka ekisa kye n'obulungi bwe mu kutulonda.

Okukkiriza okuwuubaala si kwa butaba beesigwa eri Katonda kwokka, wabula kwe nsibuko y'ennaku ennene gye tuli. Tekuyinza kutumbula bikwata ku by'omwoyo byaffe; kuyinza kubiziyiza kwokka. Omutume atugamba nti "kubanga tufuuse ba mugabo wamu ne Kristo, oba nga tunywerera ku bwesige bwaffe obw'olubereberye okutuusa ku nkomerero" (Abaebbulaniya 3:14). Okunywerera kwe kwawukana ddala ennyo okuva mu kuwuubaala. Okusuubira ebibala eby'okunywerera nga owuubaala kya busirusiru nga bw'oyagala okutuuka ku ntikko y'olusozi ng'okyusakyusa wakati w'okulinnya okumpi n'okuseerera okuwanvu okw'akabi okudda emabega.

Naye abantu bangi basuubira ekyo ekituufu. Batandika "entandikwa y'obwesige," era ng'obuggya bukyaliwo, bajjula essanyu. Oluvannyuma okugezesebwa n'okukemebwa bijja, n'okubuusabuusa kutandika okuyingira. Mu kifo ky'okutwala okubuusabuusa kuno ng'abalabe ab'okuziyizibwa, bakwaniriza ng'emikwano.

Nga tewannaba kuyita bbanga, batandika okuwuubaala mu kukkiriza n'obwesigwa bwabwe, n'emirembe gyabwe ne giggwaawo. Obulamu bwe bumasamasa, okukkiriza kwabwe kuzzibwamu obulamu; ebintu bwe bigenda obubi, okubuusabuusa kuwangula ne bawuubaala nate.

Nnali njogedde n'omuwabuzi wa Katonda ow'ekitiibwa ku bwa nsobola bw'obulamu obw'eddiini obw'emirembe eginywevu.

Yaŋŋamba mu bwesimbu nti yalowooza nti tekisoboka era nti obulamu bwa Bakristaayo obusinga bwali ng'obubwe. "Bwe njagala okuwandiika ebyokwogera byange," bwe yagamba, "ntuuka ku ntikko y'olusozi nga mpita mu kusaba n'okufuba. Nteeka ekigere kyange ku kisuubizo ekimu ate ku kirala okutuusa lwe ntuuka ku ntikko ne nsobola okutandika.

Kigenda bulungi okumala akaseera, naye oluvannyuma okusookonkerwa kujja—ekizibu n'abaana bange oba oluyombo ne muliraanwa—ne ngwa wansi. Nsobola okudda emabega nga mpita mu kulinnya okulala okukooya. Nnyinza okusigala ku ntikko okumala ennaku ntono, oba omulundi ogumu mu bbanga eddene, wiiki ntono. Naye ku bikwata ku 'kubeerera' awo obutasalako, siyinza kukikkiriza."

Kino kinnyonnyola obulamu bw'abaana ba Katonda bangi abayaayaanira emirembe Kristo gye yasuubiza naye nga bagifuna buseera busere bwokka. Bafuna akatangaala k'okukkiriza, naye oluvannyuma okubuusabuusa okw'edda ne kudda. "Tunuulira omutima gwo," bagamba; "laba nga bwe guli omunnyogovu era ogutafaayo. Oyinza otya okukkiriza nti Katonda ayagala ekitonde ekyavu, ekitasaanira nga ggwe?" Kiwulikika nga kya kkalakkalirye nnyo ne kibasuula nate mu kizikiza.

Obuzibu bwonna buva mu kubulwa okukkiriza. Mu bulamu obw'omwoyo, bulijjo kiba ng'okukkiriza kwaffe bwe kuli. Lino tteeka lya mwoyo eritayinza kubuusibwa oba kwewalibwa. Liri mu buzaaliranwa bw'ebintu, kyeliva litakyusibwa. Mu ngeri y'emu, oba bwe kinaaba ng'okukkiriza kwaffe bwe kuli, era kinaaba gye tuli ng'okubuusabuusa kwaffe bwe kuli.

Ensonga y'okuwuubaala kwaffe si bibi byaffe, wabula okubuusabuusa kwaffe. Okubuusabuusa kukola olwago olutasomokeka wakati w'emmeeme zaffe ne Mukama, nga bwe kukola wakati waffe ne mikwano gyaffe. Tewali bunyiikivu bwonna obuyinza okusembeza olwago olwo. "Kubanga omuntu oyo aleme okulowooza nti aliweebwa ekintu kyonna okuva eri Mukama" (Yakobo 1:7). Kino tekiri bwe kityo olwa Katonda okusunguwala; kiri bwe kityo olw'obuzaaliranwa bw'ebintu obufuula okubuusabuusa n'obwesige okuba nga tebiyinza kubeera wamu. "Era baani be yalayirira nti tebaliyingira mu kiwummulo kye, wabula abo abateegonza? Bwe tutyo tulaba nga tebaayinza kuyingira olw'obutakkiriza" (Abaebbulaniya 3:18-19). Tekyali nti Katonda teyandibaganyizza okuyingira ng'ekibonerezo; kyali nti tebaayinza kuyingira. Kyali kitasoboka. Okukkiriza kwe luggi lwokka olw'okuyingira mu Bwakabaka obw'omu Ggulu, so tewali lulala. Bwe tutayingira nga tuyita mu luggi olwo, tetuyinza kuyingira n'akatono, kubanga tewali kkubo ddala.

Obulokozi bwa Katonda si kya kugula, so si mpeera ya kukola, so si ntikko ya kulinnya, so si mulimu gwa kutuukiriza; wabula kirabo kyokka eky'okukkiriza, era kiyinza kukkirizibwa okuyita mu kukkiriza kwokka. Okukkiriza kye kintu ekyetaagisa mu kukkiriza ekirabo kyonna, oba eky'ensi oba eky'omu ggulu. Mikwano gyange bayinza okuteeka ebirabo byabwe ku mmeeza yange, oba n'okubiteeka mu kifuba kyange, naye nga sikkirizza obukwano bwabwe n'obwesimbu bw'ekigendererwa kyabwe okumala okukkiriza ebirabo bino, tebiyinza kufuuka byange mazima.

Kyeva kiba kya lwatu nti Bayibuli erangirira buzaaliranwa bw'ebintu, nga bulijjo bw'ekola, bw'egamba nti, "Kibe gye muli ng'okukkiriza kwammwe bwe kuli" (Matayo 9:29). Gye tunaasooka okukkiriza kino, gye kirungi. Okuwuubaala kwaffe kwonna kuva mu kuba nga tetukkiriza tteeka lino. Tukkiriza, weewaawo, nti liri mu Bayibuli, naye tulowooza nti teliyinza kutegeeza ekyo kye ligamba. Tulowooza nti wateekwa okubaawo ebyongerwako, gamba nga "ng'obunyiikivu bwaffe bwe buli kifuuke gye tuli," oba "ng'okugumira kwaffe bwe kuli," oba "ng'obusaanira bwaffe bwe buli."

Bwe tuba twogera amazima gonna, twerabira okulowooza nti ebyongerwako bino ebyaffe, bwe wandibadde ekintu, gye biri eby'omugaso ennyo okusingira ddala. Ekivaamu, obwesigwa bwaffe businga kwolekezebwa ku kutereeza ensonga zino. Twekaliriza embeera zaffe ez'omutima n'enneewulira, ne tunoonyereza mu busaanira bwaffe oba obutasaanira n'obunyiikivu obungi ne kituusa nga twerabidde ddala musingi ogumu ogusookerwako ogw'okukkiriza, ogutaliiwo tewali kiyinza kukolebwa. Ate era, kubanga embeera zaffe n'enneewulira zaffe bye bintu ebisinga okukyukakyuka mu bwengula bwonna, era n'okuwulira kwaffe okw'obusaanira kukyukira wamu n'enneewulira eyo, obulamu bwaffe tebuyinza butawuubaala. Obusobozi obw'okukkiriza okunywevu bugenda ne buseeteka wala mu maaso. Mu bumpi, tufuula obwesigwa bwa Katonda n'amazima g'ekigambo kye okusinziira ku mbeera y'enneewulira zaffe.

Nkakasa nti singa omu ku mikwano gyaffe yatuyisa mu ngeri eno ey'okubuusabuusa, twandinnyiikadde ne tunyiiga okusukka ekigero. Tewali kuwulira kwa butasaana ku luuyi lwabwe okwandibasonyiye mu maaso gaffe olw'okuwuubaala okw'obwesige bwabwe gye tuli. Mu butuufu, twandisinze okwagala nti mikwano gyaffe gitwonoona okusinga okutubuusabuusa. Tewali ngeri ya kibi eyali eziyizza Mukama Yesu ng'akyali ku nsi okukola emirimu gye emikulu. Ekintu ekyokka ekyamuziyiza kwali kutakkiriza. Mu kibuga kye ye, wakati wa baliraanwa be ne mikwano gye gye yandyagadde okukola eby'amagero, tugambibwa nti "teyakolerayo byamagero bingi olw'obutakkiriza bwabwe" (Matayo 13:58). Tekyali nti teyandyagadde, wabula nti teyayinza. Era tayinza mu mbeera yaffe, nga bwe kyali gye bali.

Naye ntya nti abamu ku mmwe muyinza okulowooza nti nkola nsobi. Muyinza okulowooza nti, newankubadde nga Katonda ky'agambye, omuntu akukkiriza kwe kuwuubaala akyayinza okufuna ekintu okuva eri Mukama singa aba munyiikivu era omwesimbu bumala. Ekyo kyanditegeezezza nti temukkiriza nti Katonda ategeera amateeka g'obwakabaka bwe okusinga bwe mugategeera, era nti kirungi okugoberera endowooza zammwe okusinga ekigambo kye. Naye musaana okumanya nti, okutuusa kati, okubuusabuusa kwammwe tekubaleeteredde kya mu kizikiza n'ennaku. Jjukira ennaku, wiiki, oba n'emyaka egy'obulamu obw'eddiini obulwana, obwesittala, obutasanyusa, weebuuze mu bwesimbu oba ensonga y'ebyo byonna teri okukkiriza kwammwe okuwuubaala.

Bw'okkiriza olunaku olumu nti Katonda akwagala era ali ku luuyi lwo, ate olulala n'obuusabuusa okwagala kwe n'otya nti akusunguwalidde, tekiri kya bwenkanya nti obulamu bwo buteekwa okuwuubaala okuva mu ssanyu okudda mu nnaku? Okukkiriza okunywevu kwokka mu kwagala kwe n'okulabirira kwe kwe kwandikuwadde obulamu obutawuubaala.

Ekibuuzo ekimu, kale, eri abo bonna abakukkiriza kwabwe kuwuubaala, kwe ngeri gy'oyinza okumalirawo ddala okuwuubaala okwo. Wano, nsiima okugamba nti, mmanyi eddagala erimalirawo ddala. Ekintu ekyokka ky'oteekwa okukola KWE KUKUVAAKO. Okuwuubaala kwo kuva mu kubuusabuusa kwo, so si mu kintu kirala. Leka okubuusabuusa kwo, n'okuwuubaala kwo kunaakoma. Weeyongere n'okubuusabuusa kwo, n'okuwuubaala kwo kunaayongera. Ensonga yonna eri lwatu ng'obudde obw'emisana, era okulonda kuli mu mikono gyo ggwe.

Oyinza okulowooza nti kuno kwogera kwa kusukka, kubanga oboolyawo tekimbagga mu mutwe gwo nti oyinza okuleka okubuusabuusa okuli kwonna. Naye nkakasa nti osobola. Osobola bugobozi okugaana okubuusabuusa.

Osobola okuggalira oluggi eri buli kiteeso ky'okubuusabuusa ekijja, era ng'oyita mu kukkiriza, olangirire ekituufu ekikontanya ddala. Okubuusabuusa kwo kugamba nti, "Katonda tasonyiwa bibi byange." Okukkiriza kwo kuteekwa okugamba nti, "Ansonyiwa; agamba nti akola bw'atyo, era nsalawo okumukkiriza. Ndi mwana we asonyiyiddwa." Oteekwa okukikakasa n'obunywevu okutuusa okubuusabuusa kwo kwonna lwe kunaggwaawo. Toli na ddembe lya kugamba nti oli "wa mpisa ya kubuusabuusa" n'olemererwa okubuusabuusa okusinga okugamba nti oli "wa mpisa ya bubbi" n'olemererwa okubba. Ekimu kikoledwa okufuga nga bwe kiri ekirala. Oteekwa okuleka okubuusabuusa kwo nga bwe wandirese okubba. Oteekwa okuyisa okukemebwa okw'okubuusabuusa nga omuntu alwanagana n'omwenge bw'ateekwa okuyisa okukemebwa okw'okunywa; oteekwa okwerayirira okukugaana.

Enkola gye nkkiriza nti y'esinga okukola, kwe kussa okubuusabuusa kwaffe—nga bwe tussa ebibi byaffe ebirala—ku kyoto kya Katonda ne tukwewaayo kwonna. Tuteekwa okuleka eddembe lyonna ery'okubuusabuusa era tuteekwa okuwaayo obusobozi bwaffe obw'okukkiriza gy'ali, nga tumwesiga okutukuuma nga tumwesiga. Tuteekwa okufuula okukkiriza kwaffe mu kigambo kye ekintu ekitasoboka kwewala nga bwe kuli okugonda kwaffe eri okwagala kwe. Tuteekwa okuba abeesigwa eri Omukwano gwaffe ow'omu ggulu nga bwe tuli eri mikwano gyaffe egy'ensi. Tuteekwa okugaana okukkiriza obusobozi bw'okubuuza oba okubuusabuusa okwagala kwe oba obwesigwa bwe.

Mazima ddala, okukemebwa okw'okuwuubaala kunaajja. Emirundi egimu kinaalabika ng'ekitasoboka nti Mukama ayinza okwagala ebitonde ebitasanyusa era ebitasaanira nga bwe twewulira. Naye tuteekwa okuggalira amatu eri okwoggaana kuno okulwanyisa okwagala kwa Katonda nga bwe twandiggalidde amatu eri olugambo lwonna ku mukwano gwaffe omwagalwa ennyo. Olutalo okukola kino oluusi luyinza okuba oluzibu nnyo era luyinza n'okulabika ng'olutayinza kugumiikirizika. Naye okulangirira kwaffe okutakyuka kuteekwa okuba bulijjo nti: "Newankubadde anzita, nnaamwesiga" (Yobu 13:15). Okukkiriza kwaffe okunywevu kunaatuleetera obuwanguzi obw'ekitiibwa awatali kulemererwa.

Emirundi mingi kinaalabika ng'ekintu "eky'obutuukirivu"—olw'obulema bwaffe obungi—okuwuubaala mu kukkiriza kwaffe n'okubuuza oba obulokozi bwatuteekerwa. Naye bwe tutegeera obulokozi bwa Mukama Yesu Kristo kye buli, tuteekwa okukiraba nti bino byonna kukemebwa kwokka. Tuteekwa okusitula obutakoowa "engabo ey'okukkiriza, gye tunaayinza okuzikiza obusaale bwonna obwaka obw'oyo omubi" (Abaefeso 6:16).

Omwoyo gwa Katonda tewali we guteesa kubuusabuusa kwagala kwa Katonda mu mbeera yonna. Wonna okubuusabuusa gye kuva, ekintu kimu kya lwatu: tekuva mu ggulu. Okubuusabuusa kwonna kuva mu nsibuko embi era kuteekwa okutwalibwa ng'ebiteeso eby'omulabe. Weewaawo, tetuyinza kuziyiza biteeso by'okubuusabuusa kwewuliza mu mitima gyaffe, nga bwe tutayinza kuziyiza matu gaffe kuwulira kuvvoola mu nguudo. Naye nga bwe tuyinza okugaana okukkiriza oba okwegatta ku njogera eyo, bwe tutyo tuyinza okugaana okussaayo omwoyo ku biteeso bino eby'okubuusabuusa. Embeera z'enfaanana ddala. Newankubadde nga tumanyi nti kyandibadde kibi okwegatta ku kuvvoola, emirundi mingi tulina okuwulira okusigaddewo nti okubuusabuusa kuyinza okuba "kwa kutya Katonda" era kusaana okukubirizibwa. Nkkiriza nti okumu kunyiiza Katonda nga bwe kiri okulala.

Nate, nnandiddiŋŋanye: engeri yokka ey'okuyisaamu okubuusabuusa okukuwuubaaza kwe kukuleka.

Okwewaayo okulambulukufu kwe ddagala lyokka. Nga omuntu alwanagana n'omwenge, ebipimo ebya wakati tebiriiko mugaso. Okwewala kwonna kwokka kwe ssuubi.

Engeri esinga obulungi ey'okukola kino kwe kusisinkana buli kubuusabuusa n'okugaana okutereevu era n'okutwala olutalo mu nsi y'omulabe ng'olangirira okukkiriza mu maanyi. Okugeza, singa okubuusabuusa kujja oba Katonda ayinza okwagala omuntu omwonoonyi era atali mwesigwa nga bwe weewulira, oteekwa amangwago okukakasa mu mutima gwo—era bwe kiba kisoboka, mu ddoboozi ery'engulu eri omuntu omulala—nti Katonda akwagala.

Agamba nti akola bw'atyo, era ekigambo kye kisaanira okwesigibwa emirundi obukadde obuwerako okusinga enneewulira zo zonna. Bw'oba tosobola kufuna muntu yenna gw'oyinza okugamba kino, kiwandiike mu bbaluwa oba kigambe mu ddoboozi ery'engulu ggwe kennyini era eri Katonda. Kikakase ddala.

Oba mu kintu kyonna wafunamu "entandikwa y'obwesige," oba wali okwatako ku kisuubizo kyonna ekya Mukama, kwatirira ku kisuubizo ekyo n'obunywevu awatali kuwuubaala, ne bwe kinaaba nga kiruwa.

Tewayinza kubaawo kifo kya wakati. Bwe kyali kya mazima omulundi ogumu, kikyali kya mazima ne kati, kubanga Katonda takyukakyuka. Ekintu ekyokka ekiyinza okukuggyako kyo kwe kutakkiriza kwo. Ng'okyakkiriza, okirina. "Kyenva mbagamba nti, byonna bye musaba nga musaba, mukkirize nti mubifunye, era binaabeera byammwe" (Makko 11:24).

Toleka kintu kyonna kunyeenya kukkiriza kwo. Ne bwe kinaaba nti ekibi kikubuutikira mu nnaku, tokkiriza kikuleetere kubuusabuusa. Amangu ago, bw'ozuula ekibi kyonna, kolera ku mazima nti "Bwe twatula ebibi byaffe, ye mwesigwa era wa butuukirivu okutusonyiwa ebibi byaffe n'okututukuza mu butali butuukirivu bwonna" (1 Yokaana 1:9).

Tula ekibi kyo amangu era okkirize amangu nti Katonda akisonyiwa, nga bw'alangirira, era akutukuza nate. Tewali kibi, ne bwe kyandibadde kizibu kitya, ekiyinza okutwawula ku Katonda n'akaseera kamu oluvannyuma lw'okuba nga kiyisiddwa mu ngeri eno. Okuleka ekibi okuleetera okukkiriza kwo okuwuubaala kwe kwongera ekibi ekipya ku kiri ekimaze okukolebwa. Ddayo amangu eri Katonda mu ngeri Bayibuli gy'eyigiriza era leka okukkiriza kwo kunywerere ku kigambo kye. Kikkirize, si lwa kubanga okiwulira oba okiraba, wabula kubanga akyogera. Kikkirize n'obunyiikivu era n'obunywevu, mu kizikiza ne mu kitangaala, mu kwelinnya ne mu kuserengeta, mu biseera eby'okusanyusibwa ne mu biseera eby'okuggwaamu essuubi, era nkusuubiza nti obulamu bwo obuwuubaala bunaakoma.

"Kale, baganda bange abaagalwa, mube banywevu, abatasagaasagana, nga mweyongera bulijjo mu mulimu gwa Mukama, nga mumanyi nti okutegana kwammwe mu Mukama tekuli kwa bwereere" (1 Abakkolinso 15:58). Okuba "atanyeenyezebwa" mu bulamu bw'eddiini kye kikontanya ddala n'okuwuubaala. Mu Zabbuli ey'amakumi ana mu mukaaga, tuyinza okulaba kye kiri. Ensi eyinza okuggwaawo n'ensozi zibbulukusibwe zisukibwe wakati mu nnyanja; ensi yaffe yonna eyinza okulabika ng'esaanyeewo; naye nga twesiga Mukama, "tetulinyeenyezebwa" (Zabbuli 46:5).

Omuntu awuubaala mu kukkiriza kwe anyiizibwa ebintu ebisinga obutono; omuntu anywerera mu kukkiriza kwe ayinza okutunula mu mirembe ne ku kusaanawo kw'ensi ye. Okuba nga atanyeenyezebwa bw'atyo mukisa ogusaana okwegombebwa ennyo, era guyinza okuba gwaffe bwe tunaakwatirira entandikwa y'obwesige bwaffe nga tunywevu okutuuka ku nkomerero.

"Okukkiriza kwe kusinza okusinga obuwoomi eri oyo ayagala nnyo Okukweka obulungi bwo obutagumiikizika mu kizikiza; N'okwesiga ekigambo kyo, Mukama omwagalwa ennyo, kwe kwagala okw'amazima, Kubanga okusaba okwo okusinga okuweebwa kwe kulabika ng'okusinga okugaanibwa.

N'okukkiriza kufuluma emikono gyakwo okwetooloola byonna by'okugambye, Ne nga kusobola okukwata n'ebisingako, kunakuwala kwokka; Kwandikwasizza wekka ggwe omukulu, Mukama! singa wandikibikkuliddewo, N'okwagala kukuleetera okwegomba okuba n'ebisingako okukkiriza."
fields.body_text: "Naye asabe mu kukkiriza, nga tabuusabuusa; kubanga abuusabuusa afaanana ng'ejjengo ery'ennyanja erifuumuulibwa empewo ne lisuukundibwa. Kubanga omuntu oyo aleme okulowooza nti aliweebwa ekintu kyonna okuva eri Mukama" (Yakobo 1:6-7). Kizibu okulaba ekintu kyonna ekireeta okutabukatabuka mu bulamu obw'eddiini okusinga okukkiriza okuwuubaala. Ekifaananyi Omutume Yakobo ky'atuwa kikinnyonnyola bulungi ddala: "ejjengo ery'ennyanja... erifuumuulibwa ne lisuukundibwa." Nga bwe kitasoboka omutambuze okutuuka we yagenda ng'olunaku olumu agenda mu maaso ate olulala n'akyuka n'addayo emabega, bwe kityo n'emmeeme ewuubaala teyinza kutuuka mu kifo eky'emirembe egitereedde ng'ekyeyongera okuwuubaala. Mu ssuula yaffe eyayita, twalowooza ku kunyeenya kwa Katonda. Kiyinza okulowoozebwa nti okuwuubaala kwaffe kufaanana n'okunyeenya kwe, naye bya njawulo nnyo. Okunyeenya kwa Katonda kuva mu kwagala kwe okutuleetera omukisa; bulijjo kutuusa mu kuwummula n'emirembe. Okuwuubaala kwaffe kuva mu kubulwa okukkiriza kwaffe; bulijjo kutuusa mu kutabukatabuka n'oluyombo. Omukristaayo awuubaala ye muntu eyeesiga okwagala kwa Katonda olunaku olumu ate n'akubuusabuusa olulala, era ekivaamu asanyuka oba anakuwala ng'emirundi bwe gyawukana. Balinnya ku ntikko y'olusozi olw'essanyu mu kaseera akamu, ne baserengeta mu kiwonvu eky'okuggwaamu essuubi mu kaseera akaddirira. Bawuubibwa eno n'eri buli "mpewo ya njigiriza," nga bulijjo bafuba naye tebatuuka ku kintu. Bafuuka omunyago gwa buli kikyusa ekyawukana—oba bwe buba obulamu bwabwe obw'omubiri, oba abantu ababeetoolodde, oba n'obudde bwennyini. Wandirowoozezza nti n'omwana wa Katonda atamanyidde nnyo yandimanyi nti engeri eno ey'obulamu si ntuufu. Okuwuubaala mu kukkiriza mu ngeri eyo kuswaza Mukama nnyo, kubanga kubuusabuusa amazima ge n'obwesigwa bwe. Naye Abakristaayo bangi bazibiddwa amaaso ne balowooza nti okuwuubaala kuno kabonero ka kwetoowaza. Batwala buli kulumba kwa kubuusabuusa okupya ng'ekirungi eky'okutya Katonda. Omukristaayo awuubaala ayinza okwogera mu bwewombeefu nti, "Naye mmanyi nti sisaanira nnyo, kyeva kiba kituufu gye ndi okubuusabuusa." Batera okuwooza nti singa oyo abawuliriza yeetoowaza ddala, naye yandibuusizzaabuusizza. Nnali nzize omukristaayo omwewaayo eyalina obulamu obw'eddiini obwali bujjudde okubuusabuusa okutamala. Bwe namukubiriza okuba n'okukkiriza okusingako, yaŋŋamba n'obunkenke bwonna nti, "Munnange omwagalwa, singa nnandibadde ne malala okuwulira nga nkakasa nti Katonda anjagala, nnandikakasizza nti ndi ku kkubo eritereevu erigenda mu ggeyeena." Kyali kya lwatu nti yalowooza nti obwesige ng'obwo bwandivudde bwokka mu kuwulira nti ye yali "mulungi bumala" okusaanira okwagala kwa Katonda. Yali mutuufu nti okulowooza nti tusaanira okwagala kwa Katonda kwe kwemanya. Naye omusingi gw'obwesige bwaffe teguva mu bulungi bwaffe ffe, wabula guva mu bulungi bwa Katonda. Newankubadde nga tetusaanidde kumatira mu bulungi bwaffe ffe, tewali kubuusabuusa—eri omuntu yenna akkiriza Bayibuli—ku bwenkerezo obw'obulungi bwe. Okulaba engeri embi gy'eri endowooza eno ey'okubuusabuusa, lowooza engeri gye yandikoledde mu nkolagana z'abantu. Teebereza obufumbo, oba enkolagana wakati w'omwana n'omuzadde—byombi Mukama by'akozesa ng'obubonero obw'enkolagana yaffe naye. Singa omukyala oba omwami yandibadde n'obulamu obuwuubaala obw'obwesige eri munne—ng'amwesiga olunaku olumu ate ng'amubuusabuusa olulala—kino kyandirabise ng'akabonero k'okwetoowaza oba ng'ekirungi eky'okulondoola? Mu ngeri y'emu, singa abaana bawuubaala mu bwesige eri abazadde baabwe nga Abakristaayo bwe bakola eri Kitaabwe ali mu ggulu, kigambo ki ekyandimazze okunenya empisa eyo etasaanira mwana? Mu nkolagana z'abantu, okuwuubaala ng'okwo kwandisonyiyibbwa singa omuntu omu yali tasaanira kwesigibwa mazima. Naye eri Katonda, tewali nsonga ya ngeri eyo. Okukkiriza okuwuubaala okw'abaana be kuyinza n'okuleetera ab'ebweru okusalawo nti tasaanira kwesigibwa nnyo. Twanditidde nnyo okuleetera abantu okulowooza obubi ku mpisa za Katonda. Naye bwe tuba abeesimbu, tuteekwa okukkiriza nti okukkiriza okuwuubaala kuleeta ekirowoozo ekyo ekituufu. Mu bwannamaddala, kwe kutaba beesigwa eri Katonda omwesigwa, era kwandirabiddwa ng'ekibi ekinene. Amazima gali nti okuwuubaala kwaffe kuva mu ngeri ey'amalala amakwafu, emirundi mingi agatamanyiddwa, so si mu kwetoowaza. Okwetoowaza okw'amazima kukkiriza okwagala n'ebirabo ebikuweebwa n'okwebaza okuwombeefu era okusanyusa.
