Amalala go, ku luuyi olulala, gatya okukkiriza ekisa era gatya okukkiriza obulungi obutali bwa kwefaako obw'oyo awa. Singa twali beetoowaze ddala, twandikkirizza okwagala kwa Katonda n'obuwombeefu obw'okwebaza. Nga bwe tukkiriza obutasaana kwaffe, twandikirabidde ng'ekintu ekyokka ekyoleka ekisa kye n'obulungi bwe mu kutulonda. Okukkiriza okuwuubaala si kwa butaba beesigwa eri Katonda kwokka, wabula kwe nsibuko y'ennaku ennene gye tuli. Tekuyinza kutumbula bikwata ku by'omwoyo byaffe; kuyinza kubiziyiza kwokka. Omutume atugamba nti "kubanga tufuuse ba mugabo wamu ne Kristo, oba nga tunywerera ku bwesige bwaffe obw'olubereberye okutuusa ku nkomerero" (Abaebbulaniya 3:14). Okunywerera kwe kwawukana ddala ennyo okuva mu kuwuubaala. Okusuubira ebibala eby'okunywerera nga owuubaala kya busirusiru nga bw'oyagala okutuuka ku ntikko y'olusozi ng'okyusakyusa wakati w'okulinnya okumpi n'okuseerera okuwanvu okw'akabi okudda emabega. Naye abantu bangi basuubira ekyo ekituufu. Batandika "entandikwa y'obwesige," era ng'obuggya bukyaliwo, bajjula essanyu. Oluvannyuma okugezesebwa n'okukemebwa bijja, n'okubuusabuusa kutandika okuyingira. Mu kifo ky'okutwala okubuusabuusa kuno ng'abalabe ab'okuziyizibwa, bakwaniriza ng'emikwano. Nga tewannaba kuyita bbanga, batandika okuwuubaala mu kukkiriza n'obwesigwa bwabwe, n'emirembe gyabwe ne giggwaawo. Obulamu bwe bumasamasa, okukkiriza kwabwe kuzzibwamu obulamu; ebintu bwe bigenda obubi, okubuusabuusa kuwangula ne bawuubaala nate. Nnali njogedde n'omuwabuzi wa Katonda ow'ekitiibwa ku bwa nsobola bw'obulamu obw'eddiini obw'emirembe eginywevu. Yaŋŋamba mu bwesimbu nti yalowooza nti tekisoboka era nti obulamu bwa Bakristaayo obusinga bwali ng'obubwe. "Bwe njagala okuwandiika ebyokwogera byange," bwe yagamba, "ntuuka ku ntikko y'olusozi nga mpita mu kusaba n'okufuba. Nteeka ekigere kyange ku kisuubizo ekimu ate ku kirala okutuusa lwe ntuuka ku ntikko ne nsobola okutandika. Kigenda bulungi okumala akaseera, naye oluvannyuma okusookonkerwa kujja—ekizibu n'abaana bange oba oluyombo ne muliraanwa—ne ngwa wansi. Nsobola okudda emabega nga mpita mu kulinnya okulala okukooya. Nnyinza okusigala ku ntikko okumala ennaku ntono, oba omulundi ogumu mu bbanga eddene, wiiki ntono. Naye ku bikwata ku 'kubeerera' awo obutasalako, siyinza kukikkiriza." Kino kinnyonnyola obulamu bw'abaana ba Katonda bangi abayaayaanira emirembe Kristo gye yasuubiza naye nga bagifuna buseera busere bwokka. Bafuna akatangaala k'okukkiriza, naye oluvannyuma okubuusabuusa okw'edda ne kudda. "Tunuulira omutima gwo," bagamba; "laba nga bwe guli omunnyogovu era ogutafaayo. Oyinza otya okukkiriza nti Katonda ayagala ekitonde ekyavu, ekitasaanira nga ggwe?" Kiwulikika nga kya kkalakkalirye nnyo ne kibasuula nate mu kizikiza. Obuzibu bwonna buva mu kubulwa okukkiriza. Mu bulamu obw'omwoyo, bulijjo kiba ng'okukkiriza kwaffe bwe kuli. Lino tteeka lya mwoyo eritayinza kubuusibwa oba kwewalibwa. Liri mu buzaaliranwa bw'ebintu, kyeliva litakyusibwa. Mu ngeri y'emu, oba bwe kinaaba ng'okukkiriza kwaffe bwe kuli, era kinaaba gye tuli ng'okubuusabuusa kwaffe bwe kuli. Ensonga y'okuwuubaala kwaffe si bibi byaffe, wabula okubuusabuusa kwaffe. Okubuusabuusa kukola olwago olutasomokeka wakati w'emmeeme zaffe ne Mukama, nga bwe kukola wakati waffe ne mikwano gyaffe. Tewali bunyiikivu bwonna obuyinza okusembeza olwago olwo. "Kubanga omuntu oyo aleme okulowooza nti aliweebwa ekintu kyonna okuva eri Mukama" (Yakobo 1:7). Kino tekiri bwe kityo olwa Katonda okusunguwala; kiri bwe kityo olw'obuzaaliranwa bw'ebintu obufuula okubuusabuusa n'obwesige okuba nga tebiyinza kubeera wamu. "Era baani be yalayirira nti tebaliyingira mu kiwummulo kye, wabula abo abateegonza? Bwe tutyo tulaba nga tebaayinza kuyingira olw'obutakkiriza" (Abaebbulaniya 3:18-19). Tekyali nti Katonda teyandibaganyizza okuyingira ng'ekibonerezo; kyali nti tebaayinza kuyingira. Kyali kitasoboka. Okukkiriza kwe luggi lwokka olw'okuyingira mu Bwakabaka obw'omu Ggulu, so tewali lulala. Bwe tutayingira nga tuyita mu luggi olwo, tetuyinza kuyingira n'akatono, kubanga tewali kkubo ddala. Obulokozi bwa Katonda si kya kugula, so si mpeera ya kukola, so si ntikko ya kulinnya, so si mulimu gwa kutuukiriza; wabula kirabo kyokka eky'okukkiriza, era kiyinza kukkirizibwa okuyita mu kukkiriza kwokka. Okukkiriza kye kintu ekyetaagisa mu kukkiriza ekirabo kyonna, oba eky'ensi oba eky'omu ggulu. Mikwano gyange bayinza okuteeka ebirabo byabwe ku mmeeza yange, oba n'okubiteeka mu kifuba kyange, naye nga sikkirizza obukwano bwabwe n'obwesimbu bw'ekigendererwa kyabwe okumala okukkiriza ebirabo bino, tebiyinza kufuuka byange mazima. Kyeva kiba kya lwatu nti Bayibuli erangirira buzaaliranwa bw'ebintu, nga bulijjo bw'ekola, bw'egamba nti, "Kibe gye muli ng'okukkiriza kwammwe bwe kuli" (Matayo 9:29). Gye tunaasooka okukkiriza kino, gye kirungi. Okuwuubaala kwaffe kwonna kuva mu kuba nga tetukkiriza tteeka lino. Tukkiriza, weewaawo, nti liri mu Bayibuli, naye tulowooza nti teliyinza kutegeeza ekyo kye ligamba. Tulowooza nti wateekwa okubaawo ebyongerwako, gamba nga "ng'obunyiikivu bwaffe bwe buli kifuuke gye tuli," oba "ng'okugumira kwaffe bwe kuli," oba "ng'obusaanira bwaffe bwe buli." Bwe tuba twogera amazima gonna, twerabira okulowooza nti ebyongerwako bino ebyaffe, bwe wandibadde ekintu, gye biri eby'omugaso ennyo okusingira ddala. Ekivaamu, obwesigwa bwaffe businga kwolekezebwa ku kutereeza ensonga zino. Twekaliriza embeera zaffe ez'omutima n'enneewulira, ne tunoonyereza mu busaanira bwaffe oba obutasaanira n'obunyiikivu obungi ne kituusa nga twerabidde ddala musingi ogumu ogusookerwako ogw'okukkiriza, ogutaliiwo tewali kiyinza kukolebwa. Ate era, kubanga embeera zaffe n'enneewulira zaffe bye bintu ebisinga okukyukakyuka mu bwengula bwonna, era n'okuwulira kwaffe okw'obusaanira kukyukira wamu n'enneewulira eyo, obulamu bwaffe tebuyinza butawuubaala. Obusobozi obw'okukkiriza okunywevu bugenda ne buseeteka wala mu maaso. Mu bumpi, tufuula obwesigwa bwa Katonda n'amazima g'ekigambo kye okusinziira ku mbeera y'enneewulira zaffe. Nkakasa nti singa omu ku mikwano gyaffe yatuyisa mu ngeri eno ey'okubuusabuusa, twandinnyiikadde ne tunyiiga okusukka ekigero. Tewali kuwulira kwa butasaana ku luuyi lwabwe okwandibasonyiye mu maaso gaffe olw'okuwuubaala okw'obwesige bwabwe gye tuli. Mu butuufu, twandisinze okwagala nti mikwano gyaffe gitwonoona okusinga okutubuusabuusa. Tewali ngeri ya kibi eyali eziyizza Mukama Yesu ng'akyali ku nsi okukola emirimu gye emikulu. Ekintu ekyokka ekyamuziyiza kwali kutakkiriza. Mu kibuga kye ye, wakati wa baliraanwa be ne mikwano gye gye yandyagadde okukola eby'amagero, tugambibwa nti "teyakolerayo byamagero bingi olw'obutakkiriza bwabwe" (Matayo 13:58). Tekyali nti teyandyagadde, wabula nti teyayinza. Era tayinza mu mbeera yaffe, nga bwe kyali gye bali. Naye ntya nti abamu ku mmwe muyinza okulowooza nti nkola nsobi. Muyinza okulowooza nti, newankubadde nga Katonda ky'agambye, omuntu akukkiriza kwe kuwuubaala akyayinza okufuna ekintu okuva eri Mukama singa aba munyiikivu era omwesimbu bumala. Ekyo kyanditegeezezza nti temukkiriza nti Katonda ategeera amateeka g'obwakabaka bwe okusinga bwe mugategeera, era nti kirungi okugoberera endowooza zammwe okusinga ekigambo kye. Naye musaana okumanya nti, okutuusa kati, okubuusabuusa kwammwe tekubaleeteredde kya mu kizikiza n'ennaku. Jjukira ennaku, wiiki, oba n'emyaka egy'obulamu obw'eddiini obulwana, obwesittala, obutasanyusa, weebuuze mu bwesimbu oba ensonga y'ebyo byonna teri okukkiriza kwammwe okuwuubaala. Bw'okkiriza olunaku olumu nti Katonda akwagala era ali ku luuyi lwo, ate olulala n'obuusabuusa okwagala kwe n'otya nti akusunguwalidde, tekiri kya bwenkanya nti obulamu bwo buteekwa okuwuubaala okuva mu ssanyu okudda mu nnaku? Okukkiriza okunywevu kwokka mu kwagala kwe n'okulabirira kwe kwe kwandikuwadde obulamu obutawuubaala. Ekibuuzo ekimu, kale, eri abo bonna abakukkiriza kwabwe kuwuubaala, kwe ngeri gy'oyinza okumalirawo ddala okuwuubaala okwo. Wano, nsiima okugamba nti, mmanyi eddagala erimalirawo ddala. Ekintu ekyokka ky'oteekwa okukola KWE KUKUVAAKO. Okuwuubaala kwo kuva mu kubuusabuusa kwo, so si mu kintu kirala. Leka okubuusabuusa kwo, n'okuwuubaala kwo kunaakoma. Weeyongere n'okubuusabuusa kwo, n'okuwuubaala kwo kunaayongera. Ensonga yonna eri lwatu ng'obudde obw'emisana, era okulonda kuli mu mikono gyo ggwe. Oyinza okulowooza nti kuno kwogera kwa kusukka, kubanga oboolyawo tekimbagga mu mutwe gwo nti oyinza okuleka okubuusabuusa okuli kwonna. Naye nkakasa nti osobola. Osobola bugobozi okugaana okubuusabuusa. Osobola okuggalira oluggi eri buli kiteeso ky'okubuusabuusa ekijja, era ng'oyita mu kukkiriza, olangirire ekituufu ekikontanya ddala. Okubuusabuusa kwo kugamba nti, "Katonda tasonyiwa bibi byange." Okukkiriza kwo kuteekwa okugamba nti, "Ansonyiwa; agamba nti akola bw'atyo, era nsalawo okumukkiriza. Ndi mwana we asonyiyiddwa." Oteekwa okukikakasa n'obunywevu okutuusa okubuusabuusa kwo kwonna lwe kunaggwaawo. Toli na ddembe lya kugamba nti oli "wa mpisa ya kubuusabuusa" n'olemererwa okubuusabuusa okusinga okugamba nti oli "wa mpisa ya bubbi" n'olemererwa okubba. Ekimu kikoledwa okufuga nga bwe kiri ekirala. Oteekwa okuleka okubuusabuusa kwo nga bwe wandirese okubba. Oteekwa okuyisa okukemebwa okw'okubuusabuusa nga omuntu alwanagana n'omwenge bw'ateekwa okuyisa okukemebwa okw'okunywa; oteekwa okwerayirira okukugaana. Enkola gye nkkiriza nti y'esinga okukola, kwe kussa okubuusabuusa kwaffe—nga bwe tussa ebibi byaffe ebirala—ku kyoto kya Katonda ne tukwewaayo kwonna. Tuteekwa okuleka eddembe lyonna ery'okubuusabuusa era tuteekwa okuwaayo obusobozi bwaffe obw'okukkiriza gy'ali, nga tumwesiga okutukuuma nga tumwesiga. Tuteekwa okufuula okukkiriza kwaffe mu kigambo kye ekintu ekitasoboka kwewala nga bwe kuli okugonda kwaffe eri okwagala kwe. Tuteekwa okuba abeesigwa eri Omukwano gwaffe ow'omu ggulu nga bwe tuli eri mikwano gyaffe egy'ensi. Tuteekwa okugaana okukkiriza obusobozi bw'okubuuza oba okubuusabuusa okwagala kwe oba obwesigwa bwe. Mazima ddala, okukemebwa okw'okuwuubaala kunaajja. Emirundi egimu kinaalabika ng'ekitasoboka nti Mukama ayinza okwagala ebitonde ebitasanyusa era ebitasaanira nga bwe twewulira. Naye tuteekwa okuggalira amatu eri okwoggaana kuno okulwanyisa okwagala kwa Katonda nga bwe twandiggalidde amatu eri olugambo lwonna ku mukwano gwaffe omwagalwa ennyo. Olutalo okukola kino oluusi luyinza okuba oluzibu nnyo era luyinza n'okulabika ng'olutayinza kugumiikirizika. Naye okulangirira kwaffe okutakyuka kuteekwa okuba bulijjo nti: "Newankubadde anzita, nnaamwesiga" (Yobu 13:15). Okukkiriza kwaffe okunywevu kunaatuleetera obuwanguzi obw'ekitiibwa awatali kulemererwa. Emirundi mingi kinaalabika ng'ekintu "eky'obutuukirivu"—olw'obulema bwaffe obungi—okuwuubaala mu kukkiriza kwaffe n'okubuuza oba obulokozi bwatuteekerwa. Naye bwe tutegeera obulokozi bwa Mukama Yesu Kristo kye buli, tuteekwa okukiraba nti bino byonna kukemebwa kwokka. Tuteekwa okusitula obutakoowa "engabo ey'okukkiriza, gye tunaayinza okuzikiza obusaale bwonna obwaka obw'oyo omubi" (Abaefeso 6:16). Omwoyo gwa Katonda tewali we guteesa kubuusabuusa kwagala kwa Katonda mu mbeera yonna. Wonna okubuusabuusa gye kuva, ekintu kimu kya lwatu: tekuva mu ggulu. Okubuusabuusa kwonna kuva mu nsibuko embi era kuteekwa okutwalibwa ng'ebiteeso eby'omulabe. Weewaawo, tetuyinza kuziyiza biteeso by'okubuusabuusa kwewuliza mu mitima gyaffe, nga bwe tutayinza kuziyiza matu gaffe kuwulira kuvvoola mu nguudo. Naye nga bwe tuyinza okugaana okukkiriza oba okwegatta ku njogera eyo, bwe tutyo tuyinza okugaana okussaayo omwoyo ku biteeso bino eby'okubuusabuusa. Embeera z'enfaanana ddala. Newankubadde nga tumanyi nti kyandibadde kibi okwegatta ku kuvvoola, emirundi mingi tulina okuwulira okusigaddewo nti okubuusabuusa kuyinza okuba "kwa kutya Katonda" era kusaana okukubirizibwa. Nkkiriza nti okumu kunyiiza Katonda nga bwe kiri okulala. Nate, nnandiddiŋŋanye: engeri yokka ey'okuyisaamu okubuusabuusa okukuwuubaaza kwe kukuleka. Okwewaayo okulambulukufu kwe ddagala lyokka. Nga omuntu alwanagana n'omwenge, ebipimo ebya wakati tebiriiko mugaso. Okwewala kwonna kwokka kwe ssuubi. Engeri esinga obulungi ey'okukola kino kwe kusisinkana buli kubuusabuusa n'okugaana okutereevu era n'okutwala olutalo mu nsi y'omulabe ng'olangirira okukkiriza mu maanyi. Okugeza, singa okubuusabuusa kujja oba Katonda ayinza okwagala omuntu omwonoonyi era atali mwesigwa nga bwe weewulira, oteekwa amangwago okukakasa mu mutima gwo—era bwe kiba kisoboka, mu ddoboozi ery'engulu eri omuntu omulala—nti Katonda akwagala. Agamba nti akola bw'atyo, era ekigambo kye kisaanira okwesigibwa emirundi obukadde obuwerako okusinga enneewulira zo zonna. Bw'oba tosobola kufuna muntu yenna gw'oyinza okugamba kino, kiwandiike mu bbaluwa oba kigambe mu ddoboozi ery'engulu ggwe kennyini era eri Katonda. Kikakase ddala. Oba mu kintu kyonna wafunamu "entandikwa y'obwesige," oba wali okwatako ku kisuubizo kyonna ekya Mukama, kwatirira ku kisuubizo ekyo n'obunywevu awatali kuwuubaala, ne bwe kinaaba nga kiruwa. Tewayinza kubaawo kifo kya wakati. Bwe kyali kya mazima omulundi ogumu, kikyali kya mazima ne kati, kubanga Katonda takyukakyuka. Ekintu ekyokka ekiyinza okukuggyako kyo kwe kutakkiriza kwo. Ng'okyakkiriza, okirina. "Kyenva mbagamba nti, byonna bye musaba nga musaba, mukkirize nti mubifunye, era binaabeera byammwe" (Makko 11:24). Toleka kintu kyonna kunyeenya kukkiriza kwo. Ne bwe kinaaba nti ekibi kikubuutikira mu nnaku, tokkiriza kikuleetere kubuusabuusa. Amangu ago, bw'ozuula ekibi kyonna, kolera ku mazima nti "Bwe twatula ebibi byaffe, ye mwesigwa era wa butuukirivu okutusonyiwa ebibi byaffe n'okututukuza mu butali butuukirivu bwonna" (1 Yokaana 1:9). Tula ekibi kyo amangu era okkirize amangu nti Katonda akisonyiwa, nga bw'alangirira, era akutukuza nate. Tewali kibi, ne bwe kyandibadde kizibu kitya, ekiyinza okutwawula ku Katonda n'akaseera kamu oluvannyuma lw'okuba nga kiyisiddwa mu ngeri eno. Okuleka ekibi okuleetera okukkiriza kwo okuwuubaala kwe kwongera ekibi ekipya ku kiri ekimaze okukolebwa. Ddayo amangu eri Katonda mu ngeri Bayibuli gy'eyigiriza era leka okukkiriza kwo kunywerere ku kigambo kye. Kikkirize, si lwa kubanga okiwulira oba okiraba, wabula kubanga akyogera. Kikkirize n'obunyiikivu era n'obunywevu, mu kizikiza ne mu kitangaala, mu kwelinnya ne mu kuserengeta, mu biseera eby'okusanyusibwa ne mu biseera eby'okuggwaamu essuubi, era nkusuubiza nti obulamu bwo obuwuubaala bunaakoma. "Kale, baganda bange abaagalwa, mube banywevu, abatasagaasagana, nga mweyongera bulijjo mu mulimu gwa Mukama, nga mumanyi nti okutegana kwammwe mu Mukama tekuli kwa bwereere" (1 Abakkolinso 15:58). Okuba "atanyeenyezebwa" mu bulamu bw'eddiini kye kikontanya ddala n'okuwuubaala. Mu Zabbuli ey'amakumi ana mu mukaaga, tuyinza okulaba kye kiri. Ensi eyinza okuggwaawo n'ensozi zibbulukusibwe zisukibwe wakati mu nnyanja; ensi yaffe yonna eyinza okulabika ng'esaanyeewo; naye nga twesiga Mukama, "tetulinyeenyezebwa" (Zabbuli 46:5). Omuntu awuubaala mu kukkiriza kwe anyiizibwa ebintu ebisinga obutono; omuntu anywerera mu kukkiriza kwe ayinza okutunula mu mirembe ne ku kusaanawo kw'ensi ye. Okuba nga atanyeenyezebwa bw'atyo mukisa ogusaana okwegombebwa ennyo, era guyinza okuba gwaffe bwe tunaakwatirira entandikwa y'obwesige bwaffe nga tunywevu okutuuka ku nkomerero. "Okukkiriza kwe kusinza okusinga obuwoomi eri oyo ayagala nnyo Okukweka obulungi bwo obutagumiikizika mu kizikiza; N'okwesiga ekigambo kyo, Mukama omwagalwa ennyo, kwe kwagala okw'amazima, Kubanga okusaba okwo okusinga okuweebwa kwe kulabika ng'okusinga okugaanibwa. N'okukkiriza kufuluma emikono gyakwo okwetooloola byonna by'okugambye, Ne nga kusobola okukwata n'ebisingako, kunakuwala kwokka; Kwandikwasizza wekka ggwe omukulu, Mukama! singa wandikibikkuliddewo, N'okwagala kukuleetera okwegomba okuba n'ebisingako okukkiriza."

fields.title: Okuggwaamu Amaanyi
fields.body_html:
"Emmeeme y'abantu n'eggwaamu nnyo amaanyi olw'ekkubo" (Okubala 21:4).

Ekkanisa ya Kristo ejjudde abantu "abaggwaamu amaanyi olw'ekkubo." Oba munda oba kungulu — era emirundi mingi byombi — ebintu birabika bubi, tewabaawo kirabika ky'okuwona, era obulamu bwabwe obw'eddiini bujjudde obutabeera bulungi. Tewali kimalamu amaanyi ng'okuggwaamu essuubi, era tewali kirala kireeta okuwangulwa okusinga kino. Ekyama ky'okugwa oba okuwangula kisinga kubeera mu ndabika ey'omunda ey'emmeeme okusinga ensonga endala yonna. Kiri mu tteeka ery'obuzaale bwaffe nti "omuntu ow'omunda" asinga omugaso mu buli lutalo okusinga ekintu kyonna omuntu ow'ebweru ky'ayinza okukola oba ky'alina.

Tewali we kino kiri kya mazima okusinga mu bulamu obw'omwoyo. Ebyawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu byatula okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero nti okukkiriza lye tteeka ery'obulamu obw'omwoyo, era "kibe gye muli ng'okukkiriza kwammwe bwe kuli" (Matayo 9:29).

Olw'okuba nti okukkiriza n'okuggwaamu amaanyi tebiyinza kubeerawo wamu, okuggwaamu amaanyi kuziyiza ddala okukkiriza. Okuggwaamu amaanyi we kufuga, tekiibe gye tuli ng'okukkiriza kwaffe bwe kuli, wabula ng'okuggwaamu amaanyi kwaffe bwe kuli.

Mu butuufu, nga obuvumu bwe buli okukkiriza mu birungi, okuggwaamu amaanyi kwe kukkiriza mu bibi. Ng'obuvumu buggulawo oluggi eri ebirungi, okuggwaamu amaanyi kubuggulira ebibi. Olugero lwe nawulira nga nkyakula mu bulamu bwange obw'Ekikristaayo lubadde lusigala mu kujjukira kwange nga kya kulabula, ng'ebipande biri eby'abeebagala amagaali ku ntikko y'olusozi: "Olusozi luno lwa kabi."

Olugero lwogera ku lukiiko Setaani lwe yayita okusalawo engeri gy'ayinza okutega omukozi wa Kristo omwewaayo.

Dayimooni omu yeeyanjula okusiiga essanyu ery'ekibi mu langi ennungi ennyo. Setaani n'anyeenya omutwe: "Omuntu ono agezezzaako ekibi era amanyi nti kitwala mu kuzikirira." Omulala n'ayanjula okukubira ebifaananyi eby'okugezesebwa n'okwefiiriza okw'obulamu obutuukirivu, asobole okumufuula omwegombi ow'okubidduka. "Nedda," Setaani bw'agamba, "amanyi nti amakubo ag'obutuukirivu ge makubo ag'emirembe." Awo dayimooni owookusatu n'agolokoka: "Nze nnaamalamu emmeeme ye amaanyi." "Ekyo kijja kukola!" Setaani n'aleekaana. "Ojja kuwangula."

Omukwakeri omu edda yagamba nti, "Okuggwaamu amaanyi kwonna kuva eri Setaani." Nzikiriza nti kino ky'amazima amawanvu.

Okuggwaamu amaanyi tekuyinza kuba n'ensibuko yaakwo mu Katonda. Eddiini ya Yesu ya kukkiriza, essanyu, n'essuubi. "Ggwaamu amaanyi," obuzaale bwaffe obwa wansi bwe bugamba, "kubanga ensi kifo kya kukemebwa." "Mu nsi mulibaamu okubonaabona. Naye mugume omwoyo; nze mpangudde ensi" (Yokaana 16:33).

Tewali kifo kya kuggwaamu amaanyi mu nsi Kristo gy'awangudde.

Kale tuteekwa okukikakasa nti: okuggwaamu amaanyi bulijjo kuva mu nsibuko embi. Emirundi mingi twekakasa nti okuggwaamu amaanyi mbeera ya mwoyo "ey'okutya Katonda" oba akabonero k'obwetoowaze, naye ensonga ze twerowoozaako nti za mazima emirundi mingi bwokutunula kwa maaso mu bumpi.

Ensonga esinga okwolekagana bwe butasobola bwaffe. Tulowooza nti kituufu okumalibwamu amaanyi kubanga tuli "ebitonde ebitaliiko kye bigasa." Musa akyoolesa kino bulungi ddala. Katonda bwe yamuyita okukulembera Isirayiri okuva mu Misiri, Musa yatunula ku bunafu bwe: "Ayi Mukama wange, siri wa bigambo...

naye ndi wa lulimi oluzito n'akamwa akazito" (Okuva 4:10). Mu butonde bwaffe, tulowooza nti Musa yalina ensonga ey'okuggwaamu amaanyi. Naye laba okuddamu kwa Katonda. Teyagezaako kukakasa Musa nti mu butuufu yali wa bigambo. Yagamba busimba nti: "Ani eyakola akamwa k'omuntu? Oba ani afuula omuntu okuba kasiru, oba kiggala, oba alaba, oba muzibe w'amaaso? Si nze, Mukama? Kale kaakano genda, nange nnaabeera n'akamwa ko, ne nkuyigiriza ky'onooyogera" (Okuva 4:11-12).

Ekigambo kya Mukama bwe kyajjira Yeremiya, yeewulira nga tasaanira mulimu ogwo: "Ayi Mukama Katonda!

Laba, simanyi kwogera, kubanga ndi mwana muto" (Yeremiya 1:6). Naye Mukama n'addamu: "Toyogera nti, 'Ndi mwana muto'; kubanga bonna be nnaakutuma gy'oli, onoogenda... Tobatya, kubanga ndi wamu naawe okukununula" (Yeremiya 1:7-8).

Gidiyoni ky'akyokelesa ekirala. Bwe yayitibwa okununula Isirayiri okuva mu bantu b'e Midiyaani, Mukama n'amugamba: "Genda mu maanyi go ago olokole Isirayiri... Si nze nkutuma?" (Balamuzi 6:14). Gidiyoni yatunula ku butaba na kitiibwa kwe: "Nkwegayiridde, Mukama wange, nnyinza ntya okulokola Isirayiri? Laba, ekika kyange kye kisinga obunafu mu Manase, era nze nsembayo obuto mu nnyumba ya kitange" (Balamuzi 6:15). Nga bino biwulikika bulungi eri abo abagwiddwa okuggwaamu amaanyi! Naye Mukama yagamba busimba nti: "Naye nnaabeera naawe, era olikuba abantu b'e Midiyaani ng'omuntu omu" (Balamuzi 6:16).

Katonda talituwa "kubuutikira" ku bikwata ku busobozi bwaffe. Atuwa kigambo kyereere: "Nnaabeera naawe." Okuddamu kuno kuggyawo empaka zonna. Nze, Omutonzi wo, amaanyi go, n'amagezi go, nnaabeera naawe.

Newakubadde bwe kiri kityo, okuggwaamu amaanyi kwa bukujjukujju. Tulowooza nti "empisa yaffe" ekifuula ekituufu gye tuli okuggwaamu amaanyi. Tulowooza nti tuli banafu nnyo okulwanyisa abalabe. Era twandibadde batuufu — singa ffe twennyini be tuluwana entalo. Naye Mukama bw'aba y'atulwanirira, obutaba na busobozi bwaffe bufuuka enkizo. "Kubanga bwe mba omunafu, olwo ne mba wa maanyi" (2 Abakkolinso 12:10).

Abaana ba Isirayiri batuwa okulabula wano. Ku nsalo z'ensi eyasuubizibwa, Musa yabakuutira: "Temutya so temuggwaamu maanyi" (Ekyamateeka 1:21). Naye baawulira nga tebasobola, ne beemulugunya nti Katonda ateekwa okuba abakyawa. Baagamba: "Tugenda wa? Baganda baffe basaanuusizza emitima gyaffe, nga bagamba nti, 'Abantu ba maanyi era bawanvu okutusinga. Ebibuga binene era biriko bbugwe ayimuse okutuuka mu ggulu'" (Ekyamateeka 1:28). Guno gwe ddoboozi ery'okuggwaamu amaanyi — okutunula ku "basajja abawanvu" mu kifo ky'okutunula ku Katonda ali naffe. Bwe tusoma ebyo abakessi bye baaleeta, tetuyinza kwewuunya kuggwaamu kwabwe amaanyi. Mu butuufu, twandiyinza n'okuwulira nti obuvumu mu mbeera ng'eyo bwandibadde bwa busiru. "Ensi gye tuyisemu okugiketta, nsi eryamu abagituulamu," abakessi bwe baalangirira, "n'abantu bonna be twalabamu bawanvu nnyo. Era eyo twalabamu Abanefirimu... ne twefaananya ng'enzige, era bwe tutyo bwe twali mu maaso gaabwe" (Okubala 13:32-33).

Tewali kiyinza kulabika kya bwetoowaze okusinga okwerowooza nga bo bennyini nga nzige empombo ezitaliiko kye zigasa; obwetoowaze obw'amazima bwandirabise ng'obuyigiriza nti kyandibadde kya malala ddala enzige okugezaako okuwangula abasajja abawanvu. Naffe emirundi mingi tweyisa ng'enzige mu maaso g'abasajja abawanvu ab'okukemebwa n'ennaku ebitulumba, ne twerowooza nti tulina ensonga ey'okuggwaamu amaanyi. Naye ekibuuzo si nti ffe tuli nzige, wabula oba Katonda y'enzige; kubanga si ffe abateekwa okulwana n'abasajja bano abawanvu, wabula Katonda.

Musa yagezaako obwereere okubijjukiza Abaisirayiri. Yabakakasa obwereere nti tebaaliko nsonga ya kutya, wadde batabani ba Anaki, kubanga "Mukama Katonda wammwe abakulembera y'anaabalwanirira" (Ekyamateeka 1:30). N'okubajjukiza yabajjukiza obulokozi obwayita, ng'ababuuza obanga tebajjukira engeri "mu ddungu... Mukama Katonda wammwe bwe yabeetikka, ng'omusajja bw'aseetula omwana we, mu lugendo lwonna lwe mwatambula" (Ekyamateeka 1:31). Naye baali bakyaggweddemu amaanyi nnyo okukkiriza. Ekyavaamu kwe kuba nti tewaali n'omu ku "mulembe ogwo omubi" eyakkirizibwa okulaba ensi eyasuubizibwa, okuggyako Kalebu ne Yoswa, abaanywerera ku kukkiriza nti Katonda yasobola era yandibayingizza.

Bino bye bibala eby'okuwaayo omutima eri okuggwaamu amaanyi, era guno gwe mpeera ey'okukkiriza okunywevu.

Omutume, bw'ayogera ku lugero luno, abuuza nti: "Era baani be yalayirira nti tebaliyingira mu kiwummulo kye, wabula abo abataagonda? Bwe tutyo tulaba nti tebaasobola kuyingira olw'obutakkiriza" (Abaebbulaniya 3:18-19).

Tewali kufaanagana wano n'embeera yaffe ffe? Tetutunula ku bunafu bwaffe mu kifo ky'okutunula ku maanyi ga Mukama? Oluusi tetuggwaamu amaanyi ne tugwa mu "kunyolwa kw'omwoyo" (Okuva 6:9) nga tetuyinza n'okuwuliriza Mukama ng'alangirira nti y'anaatulwanirira n'atuwa obuwanguzi? Emmeeme zaffe zeegomba okuyingira mu kiwummulo Mukama kye yasuubiza, naye abasajja abawanvu n'ebibuga "ebiriko bbugwe ayimuse okutuuka mu ggulu" birabika ng'ebiyimiridde mu kkubo lyaffe, era tutya okukkiriza. Bwe tutyo naffe, ng'Abaisirayiri, tetuyinza kuyingira olw'obutakkiriza.

Kyandibadde kya njawulo nnyo singa twetaaga okukkiriza okumala okugamba n'Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli nti: "Newakubadde eggye linaasiisira okunnwanyisa, omutima gwange tegulitya; newakubadde entalo zinaagolokoka okunnumba, ne mu ekyo nnaaba n'obwesige...

Kubanga alinkweka mu weema ye ku lunaku olw'akabi; alinkweka mu kifo eky'ekyama eky'eweema ye; alinnyimusa waggulu ku lwazi" (Zabbuli 27:3, 5). Nga twandiyingidde mu kiwummulo n'essanyu era n'obuwanguzi singa luno lwe lubadde olulimi lwaffe.

Ensonga endala ey'okuggwaamu amaanyi ey'obukujjukujju eri mu "kutya abantu." Mu nsi muno mulimu ekibiina ky'abantu ekiyitibwa "bo" abafuga obulamu n'omukono ogw'ekyuma.

Bo balyogera ki? Bo balirowooza ki? Bino bye bimu ku bibuuzo ebisinga okulumba emmeeme entiitiizi. Buli we tukyuka, ono "bo" ali wonna ayimirira mu kkubo lyaffe okutumalamu amaanyi.

Engeri eno ey'okuggwaamu amaanyi emirundi mingi yeeyambisa ekyambalo "eky'okussaayo omwoyo ku balala," naye ya kabi nnyo kubanga egulumiza "bo" mu kifo kya Katonda. Eddagala lyokka kwe kwejjukanyiza obutakoowa nti Katonda ali naffe. "Tobatya, kubanga ndi wamu naawe okukununula, bw'ayogera Mukama" (Yeremiya 1:8). "Mukama ye mubeezi wange; siritya; omuntu anaankola ki?" (Abaebbulaniya 13:6).

Kyokka, waliwo engeri emu ey'okuggwaamu amaanyi eya bulijjo era erabika ng'eteekwa okuba entuufu: okuggwaamu amaanyi okuva mu kugwa kwaffe ffe. Kino kye kyatuukako abaana ba Isirayiri oluvannyuma lw'okuwangulwa e Ayi. Baali "bamenye endagaano" era "kyekivudde abaana ba Isirayiri tebasobola kuyimirira mu maaso g'abalabe baabwe" (Yoswa 7:11-12). Okuggwaamu amaanyi kwabwe kwali kunene nnyo n'okuba nti "emitima gy'abantu ne gisaanuuka ne giba ng'amazzi," era Yoswa "yagwa wansi ku maaso ge ku ttaka mu maaso g'essanduuko ya Mukama okutuusa akawungeezi" (Yoswa 7:5-6).

Abantu ba Katonda bwe "bakuba amabega mu maaso g'abalabe baabwe," omuntu ayinza okulowooza nti basaana okugalamira ku maaso gaabwe mu kwesittala. Naye Mukama yalowooza mu ngeri endala, kubanga yagamba Yoswa nti, "Golokoka! Kiki ekikugwisizza wansi ku maaso go?" (Yoswa 7:10). Ekituufu eky'okukola oluvannyuma lw'okugwa si kwewaayo eri okuggwaamu amaanyi, wadde nga kirabika ng'obwetoowaze, wabula okwolekera ekibi, okukiggyawo, era amangwago ne twetukuza buggya eri Mukama. "Golokoka, otukuze abantu" (Yoswa 7:13) bulijjo lye kiragiro kya Katonda. "Galamira oggweemu amaanyi" bulijjo kwe kukemebwa kwaffe.

Oyinza okubuuza obanga okuwulira ekibi okukolebwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu tekusaana kuleeta kuggwaamu amaanyi. Bwe nneeraba nga ndi mwonoonyi, nnyinza ntya obutakikola? Eri kino nziramu nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu tatumatiza bikwata ku kibi kutumalamu maanyi, wabula kutuzzaamu amaanyi. Atulaga ekibi kyaffe si tulyoke tugalamire mu kwesittala, wabula tulyoke tukiggyeewo. Maama omulungi alaga abaana be ensobi zaabwe abayambe okuzitereeza. Okukkakkanyizibwa lwa mukisa; kitegeeza nti obulokozi bujja.

Omukyala omulungi ow'awaka azuula ebbala ku ngoye ze si aleke kuzisuula, wabula azoozeewo. Bw'aba n'omwozi omulungi, tajja kuggwaamu amaanyi wadde ng'ebbala libi nnyo. Kale mazima ddala, Katonda bw'agamba nti, "wadde ebibi byammwe nga bimyufu ng'olugoye olumyufu, birifuuka byeru ng'omuzira" (Isaaya 1:18), kwe kutakkiriza kwereere okuggwaamu amaanyi olw'okugwa kwaffe. "Okunaaza kwa Katonda okw'okuzaalibwa obuggya" kukola nnyo okusinga okufuba kw'omuntu kwonna.

Fénelon agamba nti: "Kikulu nnyo okwekuuma obuteggwaamu amaanyi olw'ensobi zaffe.

Okuggwaamu amaanyi si kibala kya bwetoowaze, wabula kya malala... Kuva mu kwagala kwaffe okw'ekyama okw'obulungi bwaffe ffe. Tunyolwa okwewulira nga bwe tuli... Obutonde obunafu bwegomba olw'okwagala okwennyini okwerabako nga bwe butuukiridde; buba busunguwavu kubanga tebuli butyo; bunyiiga, bulina amalala, era buba n'obusungu eri bwo bwennyini n'eri buli omu."

Okuggwaamu amaanyi kutwala abantu mu "kwemulugunya" n'"okwogera obubi ku Katonda." Abaisirayiri bwe baali "baggweddemu amaanyi olw'ekkubo," "baayogera obubi ku Katonda" (Okubala 21:4-5). Okuggwaamu amaanyi, mu bulamu bwakwo, kwe kugamba nti Katonda alemereddwa okutuukiriza ebisuubizo bye. Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli agamba nti: "Baayogera obubi ku Katonda, nga bagamba nti, 'Katonda ayinza okwaliira emmeeza mu ddungu?'" (Zabbuli 78:19). N'ebibuuzo byaffe "ebirimu ensonga" ku kwagala kwa Katonda okutuyamba kwe kwogera obubi ku Katonda kubanga biraga nti "tetwakkiriza Katonda so tetwesiga bulokozi bwe" (Zabbuli 78:22).

Engeri endala embi ey'okuggwaamu amaanyi bwe busiige bwakwo. Tewali kirala kikwata amangu okusinga kuno.

Abakessi Musa be yatuma bwe baakomyawo "amawulire amabi" ag'ensi eyasuubizibwa ne boogera ku basajja abawanvu abaali eyo, ne "basaanuusa omutima gw'abantu" (Yoswa 14:8) n'okutuuka nti abantu "bayimusa amaloboozi gaabwe ne bakaaba" (Okubala 14:1) ne bagaana ddala okuyingira ensi Mukama gye yali abawadde. "Amawulire amabi" abakristaayo bangi ge baleeta ku kugwa kwabwe n'okusuubira okwabwe okwakoma kwe kimu ku bintu ebisinga okumalamu amaanyi mu bumu bwaffe. Emitima gy'abakristaayo abato emirundi mingi giggweemu amaanyi olw'abakkiriza abakadde abatamanyi bulungi akabi ke bakola n'ebyafaayo byabwe ebinakuwavu eby'ennaku ez'ekkubo.

Sisobola kutunula mu byafaayo awatali nsonyi ku kiseera lwe "nnamalamu amaanyi omutima" gw'omukwano gwange omuto olw'"amawulire amabi" ge nnamuwa ku basajja abawanvu ab'okubuusabuusa be nnasisinkana. Oluvannyuma, okukkiriza okw'amaanyi bwe kwannunula okuva mu kutya okwo, nasanga nti amawulire gange ag'edda gaali gamuggyeemu amaanyi nnyo n'okutuusa nti kyatwala ebbanga ddene nga tannaagonza kuwuliriza mawulire malungi ge nnalina okumuleetera.

Mukama yakiraba nga kikulu nnyo nti tewabaawo n'omu aggyamu munne amaanyi, n'okutuusa nti yawa etteeka lino ery'olutalo: "Ani omuntu atya era alina omutima ogunafu? Ka addeyo mu nnyumba ye, aleme okusaanuusa omutima gwa banne nga ogugwe" (Ekyamateeka 20:8). Abaggweddemu amaanyi, bwe kiba kya nzizizi okuggwaamu amaanyi, waakiri bakuume kino nga kya kyama munda mu bifuba byabwe.

Tumanyi nti obuvumu bwa busiige; emmeeme emu ey'obuvumu esobola okuwonya ekibiina okuva mu ntiisa. Naye twerabira nti omuntu omu ow'omutima omunafu asobola okusiiga ekibiina okutya. Era, eky'okwewuunya, tuyimba okuggwaamu amaanyi kwaffe mu nnyimba zaffe: "Omukisa gwe nnamanya guli ludda wa Bwe nnasooka okulaba Mukama?

...Naye kaakano nsanga ekifo ekyereere ekirumya, Ensi ky'eteyinza kujjuza."

Oba luno: "Era tunaabeeranga emirembe gyonna Ku mutindo guno omunafu ogufa...

Ozanna zeeggwa ku nnimi zaffe, N'okusinza kwaffe ne kufa."

Okuyimba ennyimba ng'ezo kirabika ng'okunyooma okusinza. Bwe wabaawo "ebifo ebyereere ebirumya" mu bulamu bwaffe, ka tukikuume mu ffe. Mazima tekiyinza kusanyusa Katonda okuwulira okwemulugunya nga kugulumizibbwa mu kifo kya Ozanna. Twandirowoozezza ki ku bakyala abakuŋŋaanira wamu okuyimba ebintu ng'ebyo ku baami baabwe? Tebandigumiikirizibbwa n'olunaku lumu.

Singa Ekkanisa yaggyawo ennyimba zonna ez'okuggwaamu amaanyi n'ekkiriza ennyimba z'obuvumu n'essanyu zokka, okukkiriza kw'abakristaayo kwandyambuse n'amaanyi mangi. "Guma omwoyo," kye kiragiro kya Mukama, ekisinzidde ku mazima nti "nze mpangudde ensi" (Yokaana 16:33).

Wandyagadde okuba ani? Abakessi abaaleeta amawulire amabi, oba Kalebu ne Yoswa, abaa "sirisa abantu mu maaso ga Musa ne bagamba nti, 'Twambuke amangu tugirye, kubanga tusobola okugiwangula'" (Okubala 13:30)? Musa yayogera ku Kalebu ng'omuntu "eyagoberera Mukama n'omutima gwe gwonna" (Ekyamateeka 1:36). "Okugoberera n'omutima gwonna" kuno kwali mu kigambo kimu nti Kalebu yaleeta amawulire amalungi.

Kyandibadde kya njawulo nnyo singa okuggwaamu amaanyi kwalabibwa mu butuufu bwakwo — ng'"okwogera obubi ku Katonda." Mu bunnabbi bwa Isaaya, ayogera ku bantu ba Katonda: "Buli muntu ayamba muliraanwa we, era agamba muganda we nti, 'Guma omwoyo!' Omuweesi anywezezza omuweesi wa zaabu, n'oyo aweweeza n'ennyondo anywezezza oyo akuba ku katondwe" (Isaaya 41:6-7). Ka tugoberere ekyokulabirako kyabwe?

Bwe mbuuzibwa engeri y'okuggyawo okuggwaamu amaanyi, nsobola kugamba busimba nti: kulekere awo. Tekigasa kuwakana nakwo. Dawudi bwe yasanga ekibuga kye nga kyokebbwa era abasajja be nga boogera ku kumukuba amayinja, "Dawudi ne yeezzaamu amaanyi mu Mukama Katonda we" (1 Samwiri 30:6). Ekyavaamu kwe kuba obuwanguzi obw'ekitalo.

Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli yeebuuza nti: "Lwaki oweddemu amaanyi, ggwe emmeeme yange, era lwaki oteganyizibwa munda yange?" (Zabbuli 42:11). N'addamu n'ensonga ya Katonda: "Suubira mu Katonda; kubanga ndimutendereza nate, obulokozi bwange era Katonda wange." Teyeekenneenya kutabuka kwe; yakyukira Mukama n'atandika okutendereza. Okukkiriza kudduka okuggwaamu amaanyi bwe kulabika, era okuggwaamu amaanyi kudduka okukkiriza we kulabika. Oteekwa okulonda wakati waabwe.
fields.body_text: "Emmeeme y'abantu n'eggwaamu nnyo amaanyi olw'ekkubo" (Okubala 21:4). Ekkanisa ya Kristo ejjudde abantu "abaggwaamu amaanyi olw'ekkubo." Oba munda oba kungulu — era emirundi mingi byombi — ebintu birabika bubi, tewabaawo kirabika ky'okuwona, era obulamu bwabwe obw'eddiini bujjudde obutabeera bulungi. Tewali kimalamu amaanyi ng'okuggwaamu essuubi, era tewali kirala kireeta okuwangulwa okusinga kino. Ekyama ky'okugwa oba okuwangula kisinga kubeera mu ndabika ey'omunda ey'emmeeme okusinga ensonga endala yonna. Kiri mu tteeka ery'obuzaale bwaffe nti "omuntu ow'omunda" asinga omugaso mu buli lutalo okusinga ekintu kyonna omuntu ow'ebweru ky'ayinza okukola oba ky'alina. Tewali we kino kiri kya mazima okusinga mu bulamu obw'omwoyo. Ebyawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu byatula okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero nti okukkiriza lye tteeka ery'obulamu obw'omwoyo, era "kibe gye muli ng'okukkiriza kwammwe bwe kuli" (Matayo 9:29). Olw'okuba nti okukkiriza n'okuggwaamu amaanyi tebiyinza kubeerawo wamu, okuggwaamu amaanyi kuziyiza ddala okukkiriza. Okuggwaamu amaanyi we kufuga, tekiibe gye tuli ng'okukkiriza kwaffe bwe kuli, wabula ng'okuggwaamu amaanyi kwaffe bwe kuli. Mu butuufu, nga obuvumu bwe buli okukkiriza mu birungi, okuggwaamu amaanyi kwe kukkiriza mu bibi. Ng'obuvumu buggulawo oluggi eri ebirungi, okuggwaamu amaanyi kubuggulira ebibi. Olugero lwe nawulira nga nkyakula mu bulamu bwange obw'Ekikristaayo lubadde lusigala mu kujjukira kwange nga kya kulabula, ng'ebipande biri eby'abeebagala amagaali ku ntikko y'olusozi: "Olusozi luno lwa kabi." Olugero lwogera ku lukiiko Setaani lwe yayita okusalawo engeri gy'ayinza okutega omukozi wa Kristo omwewaayo. Dayimooni omu yeeyanjula okusiiga essanyu ery'ekibi mu langi ennungi ennyo. Setaani n'anyeenya omutwe: "Omuntu ono agezezzaako ekibi era amanyi nti kitwala mu kuzikirira." Omulala n'ayanjula okukubira ebifaananyi eby'okugezesebwa n'okwefiiriza okw'obulamu obutuukirivu, asobole okumufuula omwegombi ow'okubidduka. "Nedda," Setaani bw'agamba, "amanyi nti amakubo ag'obutuukirivu ge makubo ag'emirembe." Awo dayimooni owookusatu n'agolokoka: "Nze nnaamalamu emmeeme ye amaanyi." "Ekyo kijja kukola!" Setaani n'aleekaana. "Ojja kuwangula." Omukwakeri omu edda yagamba nti, "Okuggwaamu amaanyi kwonna kuva eri Setaani." Nzikiriza nti kino ky'amazima amawanvu. Okuggwaamu amaanyi tekuyinza kuba n'ensibuko yaakwo mu Katonda. Eddiini ya Yesu ya kukkiriza, essanyu, n'essuubi. "Ggwaamu amaanyi," obuzaale bwaffe obwa wansi bwe bugamba, "kubanga ensi kifo kya kukemebwa." "Mu nsi mulibaamu okubonaabona. Naye mugume omwoyo; nze mpangudde ensi" (Yokaana 16:33). Tewali kifo kya kuggwaamu amaanyi mu nsi Kristo gy'awangudde. Kale tuteekwa okukikakasa nti: okuggwaamu amaanyi bulijjo kuva mu nsibuko embi. Emirundi mingi twekakasa nti okuggwaamu amaanyi mbeera ya mwoyo "ey'okutya Katonda" oba akabonero k'obwetoowaze, naye ensonga ze twerowoozaako nti za mazima emirundi mingi bwokutunula kwa maaso mu bumpi. Ensonga esinga okwolekagana bwe butasobola bwaffe. Tulowooza nti kituufu okumalibwamu amaanyi kubanga tuli "ebitonde ebitaliiko kye bigasa." Musa akyoolesa kino bulungi ddala. Katonda bwe yamuyita okukulembera Isirayiri okuva mu Misiri, Musa yatunula ku bunafu bwe: "Ayi Mukama wange, siri wa bigambo... naye ndi wa lulimi oluzito n'akamwa akazito" (Okuva 4:10). Mu butonde bwaffe, tulowooza nti Musa yalina ensonga ey'okuggwaamu amaanyi. Naye laba okuddamu kwa Katonda. Teyagezaako kukakasa Musa nti mu butuufu yali wa bigambo. Yagamba busimba nti: "Ani eyakola akamwa k'omuntu? Oba ani afuula omuntu okuba kasiru, oba kiggala, oba alaba, oba muzibe w'amaaso? Si nze, Mukama? Kale kaakano genda, nange nnaabeera n'akamwa ko, ne nkuyigiriza ky'onooyogera" (Okuva 4:11-12). Ekigambo kya Mukama bwe kyajjira Yeremiya, yeewulira nga tasaanira mulimu ogwo: "Ayi Mukama Katonda! Laba, simanyi kwogera, kubanga ndi mwana muto" (Yeremiya 1:6). Naye Mukama n'addamu: "Toyogera nti, 'Ndi mwana muto'; kubanga bonna be nnaakutuma gy'oli, onoogenda... Tobatya, kubanga ndi wamu naawe okukununula" (Yeremiya 1:7-8). Gidiyoni ky'akyokelesa ekirala. Bwe yayitibwa okununula Isirayiri okuva mu bantu b'e Midiyaani, Mukama n'amugamba: "Genda mu maanyi go ago olokole Isirayiri... Si nze nkutuma?" (Balamuzi 6:14). Gidiyoni yatunula ku butaba na kitiibwa kwe: "Nkwegayiridde, Mukama wange, nnyinza ntya okulokola Isirayiri? Laba, ekika kyange kye kisinga obunafu mu Manase, era nze nsembayo obuto mu nnyumba ya kitange" (Balamuzi 6:15). Nga bino biwulikika bulungi eri abo abagwiddwa okuggwaamu amaanyi! Naye Mukama yagamba busimba nti: "Naye nnaabeera naawe, era olikuba abantu b'e Midiyaani ng'omuntu omu" (Balamuzi 6:16). Katonda talituwa "kubuutikira" ku bikwata ku busobozi bwaffe. Atuwa kigambo kyereere: "Nnaabeera naawe." Okuddamu kuno kuggyawo empaka zonna. Nze, Omutonzi wo, amaanyi go, n'amagezi go, nnaabeera naawe. Newakubadde bwe kiri kityo, okuggwaamu amaanyi kwa bukujjukujju. Tulowooza nti "empisa yaffe" ekifuula ekituufu gye tuli okuggwaamu amaanyi. Tulowooza nti tuli banafu nnyo okulwanyisa abalabe. Era twandibadde batuufu — singa ffe twennyini be tuluwana entalo. Naye Mukama bw'aba y'atulwanirira, obutaba na busobozi bwaffe bufuuka enkizo. "Kubanga bwe mba omunafu, olwo ne mba wa maanyi" (2 Abakkolinso 12:10). Abaana ba Isirayiri batuwa okulabula wano. Ku nsalo z'ensi eyasuubizibwa, Musa yabakuutira: "Temutya so temuggwaamu maanyi" (Ekyamateeka 1:21). Naye baawulira nga tebasobola, ne beemulugunya nti Katonda ateekwa okuba abakyawa. Baagamba: "Tugenda wa? Baganda baffe basaanuusizza emitima gyaffe, nga bagamba nti, 'Abantu ba maanyi era bawanvu okutusinga. Ebibuga binene era biriko bbugwe ayimuse okutuuka mu ggulu'" (Ekyamateeka 1:28). Guno gwe ddoboozi ery'okuggwaamu amaanyi — okutunula ku "basajja abawanvu" mu kifo ky'okutunula ku Katonda ali naffe. Bwe tusoma ebyo abakessi bye baaleeta, tetuyinza kwewuunya kuggwaamu kwabwe amaanyi. Mu butuufu, twandiyinza n'okuwulira nti obuvumu mu mbeera ng'eyo bwandibadde bwa busiru. "Ensi gye tuyisemu okugiketta, nsi eryamu abagituulamu," abakessi bwe baalangirira, "n'abantu bonna be twalabamu bawanvu nnyo. Era eyo twalabamu Abanefirimu... ne twefaananya ng'enzige, era bwe tutyo bwe twali mu maaso gaabwe" (Okubala 13:32-33). Tewali kiyinza kulabika kya bwetoowaze okusinga okwerowooza nga bo bennyini nga nzige empombo ezitaliiko kye zigasa; obwetoowaze obw'amazima bwandirabise ng'obuyigiriza nti kyandibadde kya malala ddala enzige okugezaako okuwangula abasajja abawanvu. Naffe emirundi mingi tweyisa ng'enzige mu maaso g'abasajja abawanvu ab'okukemebwa n'ennaku ebitulumba, ne twerowooza nti tulina ensonga ey'okuggwaamu amaanyi. Naye ekibuuzo si nti ffe tuli nzige, wabula oba Katonda y'enzige; kubanga si ffe abateekwa okulwana n'abasajja bano abawanvu, wabula Katonda. Musa yagezaako obwereere okubijjukiza Abaisirayiri. Yabakakasa obwereere nti tebaaliko nsonga ya kutya, wadde batabani ba Anaki, kubanga "Mukama Katonda wammwe abakulembera y'anaabalwanirira" (Ekyamateeka 1:30). N'okubajjukiza yabajjukiza obulokozi obwayita, ng'ababuuza obanga tebajjukira engeri "mu ddungu... Mukama Katonda wammwe bwe yabeetikka, ng'omusajja bw'aseetula omwana we, mu lugendo lwonna lwe mwatambula" (Ekyamateeka 1:31). Naye baali bakyaggweddemu amaanyi nnyo okukkiriza. Ekyavaamu kwe kuba nti tewaali n'omu ku "mulembe ogwo omubi" eyakkirizibwa okulaba ensi eyasuubizibwa, okuggyako Kalebu ne Yoswa, abaanywerera ku kukkiriza nti Katonda yasobola era yandibayingizza. Bino bye bibala eby'okuwaayo omutima eri okuggwaamu amaanyi, era guno gwe mpeera ey'okukkiriza okunywevu. Omutume, bw'ayogera ku lugero luno, abuuza nti: "Era baani be yalayirira nti tebaliyingira mu kiwummulo kye, wabula abo abataagonda? Bwe tutyo tulaba nti tebaasobola kuyingira olw'obutakkiriza" (Abaebbulaniya 3:18-19). Tewali kufaanagana wano n'embeera yaffe ffe? Tetutunula ku bunafu bwaffe mu kifo ky'okutunula ku maanyi ga Mukama? Oluusi tetuggwaamu amaanyi ne tugwa mu "kunyolwa kw'omwoyo" (Okuva 6:9) nga tetuyinza n'okuwuliriza Mukama ng'alangirira nti y'anaatulwanirira n'atuwa obuwanguzi? Emmeeme zaffe zeegomba okuyingira mu kiwummulo Mukama kye yasuubiza, naye abasajja abawanvu n'ebibuga "ebiriko bbugwe ayimuse okutuuka mu ggulu" birabika ng'ebiyimiridde mu kkubo lyaffe, era tutya okukkiriza. Bwe tutyo naffe, ng'Abaisirayiri, tetuyinza kuyingira olw'obutakkiriza. Kyandibadde kya njawulo nnyo singa twetaaga okukkiriza okumala okugamba n'Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli nti: "Newakubadde eggye linaasiisira okunnwanyisa, omutima gwange tegulitya; newakubadde entalo zinaagolokoka okunnumba, ne mu ekyo nnaaba n'obwesige... Kubanga alinkweka mu weema ye ku lunaku olw'akabi; alinkweka mu kifo eky'ekyama eky'eweema ye; alinnyimusa waggulu ku lwazi" (Zabbuli 27:3, 5). Nga twandiyingidde mu kiwummulo n'essanyu era n'obuwanguzi singa luno lwe lubadde olulimi lwaffe. Ensonga endala ey'okuggwaamu amaanyi ey'obukujjukujju eri mu "kutya abantu." Mu nsi muno mulimu ekibiina ky'abantu ekiyitibwa "bo" abafuga obulamu n'omukono ogw'ekyuma. Bo balyogera ki? Bo balirowooza ki? Bino bye bimu ku bibuuzo ebisinga okulumba emmeeme entiitiizi. Buli we tukyuka, ono "bo" ali wonna ayimirira mu kkubo lyaffe okutumalamu amaanyi. Engeri eno ey'okuggwaamu amaanyi emirundi mingi yeeyambisa ekyambalo "eky'okussaayo omwoyo ku balala," naye ya kabi nnyo kubanga egulumiza "bo" mu kifo kya Katonda. Eddagala lyokka kwe kwejjukanyiza obutakoowa nti Katonda ali naffe. "Tobatya, kubanga ndi wamu naawe okukununula, bw'ayogera Mukama" (Yeremiya 1:8). "Mukama ye mubeezi wange; siritya; omuntu anaankola ki?" (Abaebbulaniya 13:6). Kyokka, waliwo engeri emu ey'okuggwaamu amaanyi eya bulijjo era erabika ng'eteekwa okuba entuufu: okuggwaamu amaanyi okuva mu kugwa kwaffe ffe. Kino kye kyatuukako abaana ba Isirayiri oluvannyuma lw'okuwangulwa e Ayi. Baali "bamenye endagaano" era "kyekivudde abaana ba Isirayiri tebasobola kuyimirira mu maaso g'abalabe baabwe" (Yoswa 7:11-12). Okuggwaamu amaanyi kwabwe kwali kunene nnyo n'okuba nti "emitima gy'abantu ne gisaanuuka ne giba ng'amazzi," era Yoswa "yagwa wansi ku maaso ge ku ttaka mu maaso g'essanduuko ya Mukama okutuusa akawungeezi" (Yoswa 7:5-6). Abantu ba Katonda bwe "bakuba amabega mu maaso g'abalabe baabwe," omuntu ayinza okulowooza nti basaana okugalamira ku maaso gaabwe mu kwesittala. Naye Mukama yalowooza mu ngeri endala, kubanga yagamba Yoswa nti, "Golokoka! Kiki ekikugwisizza wansi ku maaso go?" (Yoswa 7:10). Ekituufu eky'okukola oluvannyuma lw'okugwa si kwewaayo eri okuggwaamu amaanyi, wadde nga kirabika ng'obwetoowaze, wabula okwolekera ekibi, okukiggyawo, era amangwago ne twetukuza buggya eri Mukama. "Golokoka, otukuze abantu" (Yoswa 7:13) bulijjo lye kiragiro kya Katonda. "Galamira oggweemu amaanyi" bulijjo kwe kukemebwa kwaffe. Oyinza okubuuza obanga okuwulira ekibi okukolebwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu tekusaana kuleeta kuggwaamu amaanyi. Bwe nneeraba nga ndi mwonoonyi, nnyinza ntya obutakikola? Eri kino nziramu nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu tatumatiza bikwata ku kibi kutumalamu maanyi, wabula kutuzzaamu amaanyi. Atulaga ekibi kyaffe si tulyoke tugalamire mu kwesittala, wabula tulyoke tukiggyeewo. Maama omulungi alaga abaana be ensobi zaabwe abayambe okuzitereeza. Okukkakkanyizibwa lwa mukisa; kitegeeza nti obulokozi bujja. Omukyala omulungi ow'awaka azuula ebbala ku ngoye ze si aleke kuzisuula, wabula azoozeewo. Bw'aba n'omwozi omulungi, tajja kuggwaamu amaanyi wadde ng'ebbala libi nnyo. Kale mazima ddala, Katonda bw'agamba nti, "wadde ebibi byammwe nga bimyufu ng'olugoye olumyufu, birifuuka byeru ng'omuzira" (Isaaya 1:18), kwe kutakkiriza kwereere okuggwaamu amaanyi olw'okugwa kwaffe. "Okunaaza kwa Katonda okw'okuzaalibwa obuggya" kukola nnyo okusinga okufuba kw'omuntu kwonna. Fénelon agamba nti: "Kikulu nnyo okwekuuma obuteggwaamu amaanyi olw'ensobi zaffe. Okuggwaamu amaanyi si kibala kya bwetoowaze, wabula kya malala... Kuva mu kwagala kwaffe okw'ekyama okw'obulungi bwaffe ffe. Tunyolwa okwewulira nga bwe tuli... Obutonde obunafu bwegomba olw'okwagala okwennyini okwerabako nga bwe butuukiridde; buba busunguwavu kubanga tebuli butyo; bunyiiga, bulina amalala, era buba n'obusungu eri bwo bwennyini n'eri buli omu." Okuggwaamu amaanyi kutwala abantu mu "kwemulugunya" n'"okwogera obubi ku Katonda." Abaisirayiri bwe baali "baggweddemu amaanyi olw'ekkubo," "baayogera obubi ku Katonda" (Okubala 21:4-5). Okuggwaamu amaanyi, mu bulamu bwakwo, kwe kugamba nti Katonda alemereddwa okutuukiriza ebisuubizo bye. Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli agamba nti: "Baayogera obubi ku Katonda, nga bagamba nti, 'Katonda ayinza okwaliira emmeeza mu ddungu?'" (Zabbuli 78:19). N'ebibuuzo byaffe "ebirimu ensonga" ku kwagala kwa Katonda okutuyamba kwe kwogera obubi ku Katonda kubanga biraga nti "tetwakkiriza Katonda so tetwesiga bulokozi bwe" (Zabbuli 78:22). Engeri endala embi ey'okuggwaamu amaanyi bwe busiige bwakwo. Tewali kirala kikwata amangu okusinga kuno. Abakessi Musa be yatuma bwe baakomyawo "amawulire amabi" ag'ensi eyasuubizibwa ne boogera ku basajja abawanvu abaali eyo, ne "basaanuusa omutima gw'abantu" (Yoswa 14:8) n'okutuuka nti abantu "bayimusa amaloboozi gaabwe ne bakaaba" (Okubala 14:1) ne bagaana ddala okuyingira ensi Mukama gye yali abawadde. "Amawulire amabi" abakristaayo bangi ge baleeta ku kugwa kwabwe n'okusuubira okwabwe okwakoma kwe kimu ku bintu ebisinga okumalamu amaanyi mu bumu bwaffe. Emitima gy'abakristaayo abato emirundi mingi giggweemu amaanyi olw'abakkiriza abakadde abatamanyi bulungi akabi ke bakola n'ebyafaayo byabwe ebinakuwavu eby'ennaku ez'ekkubo. Sisobola kutunula mu byafaayo awatali nsonyi ku kiseera lwe "nnamalamu amaanyi omutima" gw'omukwano gwange omuto olw'"amawulire amabi" ge nnamuwa ku basajja abawanvu ab'okubuusabuusa be nnasisinkana. Oluvannyuma, okukkiriza okw'amaanyi bwe kwannunula okuva mu kutya okwo, nasanga nti amawulire gange ag'edda gaali gamuggyeemu amaanyi nnyo n'okutuusa nti kyatwala ebbanga ddene nga tannaagonza kuwuliriza mawulire malungi ge nnalina okumuleetera. Mukama yakiraba nga kikulu nnyo nti tewabaawo n'omu aggyamu munne amaanyi, n'okutuusa nti yawa etteeka lino ery'olutalo: "Ani omuntu atya era alina omutima ogunafu? Ka addeyo mu nnyumba ye, aleme okusaanuusa omutima gwa banne nga ogugwe" (Ekyamateeka 20:8). Abaggweddemu amaanyi, bwe kiba kya nzizizi okuggwaamu amaanyi, waakiri bakuume kino nga kya kyama munda mu bifuba byabwe. Tumanyi nti obuvumu bwa busiige; emmeeme emu ey'obuvumu esobola okuwonya ekibiina okuva mu ntiisa. Naye twerabira nti omuntu omu ow'omutima omunafu asobola okusiiga ekibiina okutya. Era, eky'okwewuunya, tuyimba okuggwaamu amaanyi kwaffe mu nnyimba zaffe: "Omukisa gwe nnamanya guli ludda wa Bwe nnasooka okulaba Mukama? ...Naye kaakano nsanga ekifo ekyereere ekirumya, Ensi ky'eteyinza kujjuza." Oba luno: "Era tunaabeeranga emirembe gyonna Ku mutindo guno omunafu ogufa... Ozanna zeeggwa ku nnimi zaffe, N'okusinza kwaffe ne kufa." Okuyimba ennyimba ng'ezo kirabika ng'okunyooma okusinza. Bwe wabaawo "ebifo ebyereere ebirumya" mu bulamu bwaffe, ka tukikuume mu ffe. Mazima tekiyinza kusanyusa Katonda okuwulira okwemulugunya nga kugulumizibbwa mu kifo kya Ozanna. Twandirowoozezza ki ku bakyala abakuŋŋaanira wamu okuyimba ebintu ng'ebyo ku baami baabwe? Tebandigumiikirizibbwa n'olunaku lumu. Singa Ekkanisa yaggyawo ennyimba zonna ez'okuggwaamu amaanyi n'ekkiriza ennyimba z'obuvumu n'essanyu zokka, okukkiriza kw'abakristaayo kwandyambuse n'amaanyi mangi. "Guma omwoyo," kye kiragiro kya Mukama, ekisinzidde ku mazima nti "nze mpangudde ensi" (Yokaana 16:33). Wandyagadde okuba ani? Abakessi abaaleeta amawulire amabi, oba Kalebu ne Yoswa, abaa "sirisa abantu mu maaso ga Musa ne bagamba nti, 'Twambuke amangu tugirye, kubanga tusobola okugiwangula'" (Okubala 13:30)? Musa yayogera ku Kalebu ng'omuntu "eyagoberera Mukama n'omutima gwe gwonna" (Ekyamateeka 1:36). "Okugoberera n'omutima gwonna" kuno kwali mu kigambo kimu nti Kalebu yaleeta amawulire amalungi. Kyandibadde kya njawulo nnyo singa okuggwaamu amaanyi kwalabibwa mu butuufu bwakwo — ng'"okwogera obubi ku Katonda." Mu bunnabbi bwa Isaaya, ayogera ku bantu ba Katonda: "Buli muntu ayamba muliraanwa we, era agamba muganda we nti, 'Guma omwoyo!' Omuweesi anywezezza omuweesi wa zaabu, n'oyo aweweeza n'ennyondo anywezezza oyo akuba ku katondwe" (Isaaya 41:6-7). Ka tugoberere ekyokulabirako kyabwe? Bwe mbuuzibwa engeri y'okuggyawo okuggwaamu amaanyi, nsobola kugamba busimba nti: kulekere awo. Tekigasa kuwakana nakwo. Dawudi bwe yasanga ekibuga kye nga kyokebbwa era abasajja be nga boogera ku kumukuba amayinja, "Dawudi ne yeezzaamu amaanyi mu Mukama Katonda we" (1 Samwiri 30:6). Ekyavaamu kwe kuba obuwanguzi obw'ekitalo. Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli yeebuuza nti: "Lwaki oweddemu amaanyi, ggwe emmeeme yange, era lwaki oteganyizibwa munda yange?" (Zabbuli 42:11). N'addamu n'ensonga ya Katonda: "Suubira mu Katonda; kubanga ndimutendereza nate, obulokozi bwange era Katonda wange." Teyeekenneenya kutabuka kwe; yakyukira Mukama n'atandika okutendereza. Okukkiriza kudduka okuggwaamu amaanyi bwe kulabika, era okuggwaamu amaanyi kudduka okukkiriza we kulabika. Oteekwa okulonda wakati waabwe.

fields.title: Okuleekaana kw'Okukkiriza
fields.body_html:
"Awo bwe muliwulira eddoboozi ly'ekkondeere, abantu bonna balyoke baleekaane n'oluyoogaano olunene, era bbugwe w'ekibuga aligwa wansi" (Yoswa 6:5).

Okuleekaana kw'okukkiriza okunywevu kwawukana nnyo ku kusinda kw'okukkiriza okusagaasagana oba ku kukaaba kw'omutima ogwaggwaamu essuubi. Mu byafaayo bya Isirayiri, emirundi mingi baamalanga ebiseera nga bakaaba ne kibaleetera okuzikirira; naye ku lulundi lumu, baaleekaana oluleekaana olw'ekitalo olwaleeta obuwanguzi obw'ekitiibwa.

Kino kyaliwo nga bamaze okusomoka Yoludaani. Katonda yali agambye Yoswa nti: "Buli kifo ekigere kyo kye kirinnyako nkiwadde ggwe" (Yoswa 1:3). Baayingira ensi nga basuubira okugyefunira, naye amangwago ne basisinkana Yeriko—ekibuga "ekinene era ekyazimbibwako bbugwe okutuuka mu ggulu." Eri eriiso ery'omubiri, tewaali ssuubi lyonna erya kukiwangula.

Naye Mukama n'agamba nti: "Laba, Yeriko ngiwaddeyo mu mukono gwo" (Yoswa 6:2). Teyagamba nti "Ndigiwaayo," wabula "Ngiwaddeyo." Kyali kyabwe dda; baali bayitiddwa okugyefunira kyokka. Enteekateeka ya Katonda yali ey'ekitalo: oluvannyuma lw'okutambula n'okufuuwa amakondeere, "abantu bonna balyoke baleekaane n'oluyoogaano olunene; era bbugwe w'ekibuga aligwa wansi."

Ne kituukirira nga Mukama bwe yagamba. Yoswa n'agamba abantu nti, "Muleekaane, kubanga Mukama abawadde ekibuga" (Yoswa 6:16). Bwe baaleekaana, bbugwe n'agwa wansi. Tewali n'omu alowooza nti oluyoogaano lw'okuleekaana lwe lwagwisa bbugwe. Ekyama kyali mu nsonga nti kwali kuleekaana kw'okukkiriza okwagumira, ku buyinza bw'ekigambo kya Katonda kyokka, okulanga obuwanguzi ng'obubonero bwabwo tebunnabaawo n'akatono.

Okukkiriza kwabala ekigambo kya Katonda okuba ekituufu. Obutakkiriza bwandyogedde nti, "Linda okuleekaana okutuusa bbugwe lw'aligwa ddala, tuleme kulabika ng'abasirusiru." Naye okukkiriza kwasekerera "amagezi" ago ne kuleekaana oluleekaana olw'obuwanguzi bbugwe nga akyayimiridde. "Olw'okukkiriza bbugwe wa Yeriko yagwa nga bamaze okwetooloola ekibuga ennaku musanvu" (Abaebbulaniya 11:30).

"Okukkiriza, okukkiriza okw'amaanyi, kulaba ekisuubizo, era kutunuulira ekyo kyokka; kusekerera ebitasoboka, ne kwogera nti, Kirikolebwa."

Yekosafaati ye kyokulabirako ekirala. Ekibiina kinene ne kimulumba, n'ategeera nti talina "maanyi" era nga tamanyi "kya kukola." Teyafuja budde ku byokulwanyisa; wabula "n'ateeka amaaso ge okunoonya Mukama" (2 Ebyomumirembe 20:3). N'ayimirira mu maaso g'abantu n'asaba nti: "Tetulina maanyi kulwanyisa kibiina kino ekinene... tetumanyi kya kukola, naye amaaso gaffe gali ku ggwe" (2 Ebyomumirembe 20:12).

Mukama n'addamu nti: "Temutya so temutekemuka olw'ekibiina kino ekinene, kubanga olutalo si lwammwe wabula lwa Katonda... Temuliba na kwetaaga kulwana mu lutalo luno. Muyimirire nga munywevu, mube mu bifo byammwe, mulabe obulokozi bwa Mukama" (2 Ebyomumirembe 20:15, 17).

Awatali kubuusabuusa n'akatono, Yekosafaati n'abaana ba Isirayiri baakkiriza ekigambo kya Mukama era amangwago ne batandika okumutendereza olw'obuwanguzi bwe baali bakakasizza nti bujja. Enkeera baagolokoka mu makya ne bafuluma okusisinkana omulabe waabwe. Yekosafaati, mu kifo ky'okubakubiriza okwesiga ebyokulwanyisa byabwe n'okuba abazira mu lutalo nga Omukulu w'eggye bwe yandikoze, yabakoowoola busa okuba n'okukkiriza okw'obuvumu. "Mumpulire, mmwe Yuda n'abatuuze ba Yerusaalemi!

Mukkirize Mukama Katonda wammwe, munaanywezebwa; mukkirize bannabbi be, munaalaba omukisa" (2 Ebyomumirembe 20:20).

Yekosafaati n'ateesa n'abantu; era okukkiriza kwabwe bwe kwenkanankana n'okukwe, ne balonda abayimbi okukulembera eggye nga bayimba ennyimba ez'okutendereza nga bagenda okusisinkana omulabe. Ne kituukirira nti bwe baatandika okuyimba n'okutendereza, Mukama n'ateegera omulabe olukwe, ne battagana bokka na bokka. Abaana ba Isirayiri bwe baatuuka ku munaala ogw'okukuuma mu ddungu, gye baasobola okulaba ekibiina ekinene ekyali kibalumbye, "laba, waaliwo emirambo nga gigudde wansi; tewaali n'omu eyawona" (2 Ebyomumirembe 20:24).

Olw'engeri eno ey'ekitalo ey'okulwana ne bafuuka "bawanguzi okusukkiridde"; kubanga baamala "ennaku ssatu nga banyaga omunyago, kubanga gwali mungi nnyo" (2 Ebyomumirembe 20:25).

Okulwana kwa Dawudi ne Goliyaasi kye kyokulabirako ekirala eky'engeri eno ey'obuwanguzi. Eri eriiso ery'omubiri, Dawudi teyalina ssuubi n'erimu erya kuwangula omusajja omuwanvu ow'amaanyi eyali avuma amaggye ga Isirayiri. Naye Dawudi, ng'atunula n'eriiso ery'okukkiriza, yasobola okulaba amaanyi ga Katonda agatalabika nga galwana ku ludda lwe. Sawulo bwe yamugamba nti, "Toyinza kulumba Mufirisuuti ono kulwana naye, kubanga oli mulenzi bulenzi, ate ye abadde musajja wa lutalo okuva mu buvubuka bwe," Dawudi n'anywerera mu kukkiriza kwe. Bwe yamala okwogera ku kununulibwa kwe okwayita, n'ayogera n'obukkakkamu nti, "Mukama eyandokola mu kikonde ky'empologoma ne mu kikonde ky'eddubu, y'alindokola mu mukono gw'Omufirisuuti ono" (1 Samwiri 17:33, 37).

Sawulo, ng'okukkiriza kuno okw'amaanyi kumukkakkanyizza katono, n'agamba nti, "Genda, era Mukama abeere naawe!" Kyokka teyasobola kuleka kwesiga byakulwanyisa bye yali amanyidde; n'ayambaza Dawudi enkuufiira ey'ekikomo, ekizibaawo eky'ebyuma, n'ekitala kye eky'amaanyi. Dawudi "n'agezaako okutambula naye n'alemwa," kubanga yali tabimanyidde. N'abiggyako n'addira mu kifo kyabyo ebyokulwanyisa ebyangu Mukama bye yali awezze edda: omuggo gwe, envuumuulo ye, n'amayinja ataano amaweweevu ag'omu mugga. Bwe yeetegeka bw'atyo, n'asemberera omuwanvu.

Omuwanvu bwe yalaba omuvubuka eyali azze okumulwanyisa, n'amunyooma n'ayogera n'okusekerera nti, "Sembera gye ndi, nange ndiwa ennyama yo ennyonyi ez'omu bbanga n'ensolo ez'omu nsiko" (1 Samwiri 17:44). Eri eriiso ery'omubiri, kyalabika ng'eno ye nkomerero ey'olutalo olutenkanankana bwe lutyo. Naye okukkiriza kwa Dawudi kwawangula, n'aleekaana oluleekaana olw'obuwanguzi olutalo nga terunnatandika. "Ojja gye ndi n'ekitala n'effumu n'ekasaali," n'ayogera, "naye nze nzija gy'oli mu linnya lya Mukama ow'eggye, Katonda w'amaggye ga Isirayiri, gw'ovumye. Leero Mukama alikuwaayo mu mukono gwange... ensi yonna eryoke etegeere nti mwe muli Katonda mu Isirayiri, era ekibiina kino kyonna kitegeere nti Mukama talokola na kitala wadde effumu. Kubanga olutalo lwa Mukama, era alikuwaayo mu mukono gwaffe" (1 Samwiri 17:45-47).

Mu maaso g'okukkiriza okufaanana bwe kutyo, omuwanvu yandikoze ki? Buli kigambo ky'oluleekaana luli olw'obuwanguzi ne kituukirira, era omulabe ow'amaanyi n'aweebwayo mu mikono gy'omuvubuka gwe yali anyoomye. Era bwe kityo bwe kinaabanga bulijjo. Tewali kisobola kuziyiza kukkiriza okuwangula okwennyunga ku buyinza obutakoma. Kubanga "buno bwe buwanguzi obuwangudde ensi—kwe kukkiriza kwaffe" (1 Yokaana 5:4).

Ekyama ky'okulwana kwonna okuwangula kiri mu kuleekaana kuno okw'okukkiriza. Kyama ekitategeerekeka eri abo abatamanyi kintu ku maanyi ga Katonda agatalabika agalindirira ebyetaagisa by'okukkiriza; kyama ekiteekwa okulabika bulijjo ng'obusirusiru obw'ekitalo eri abo abatakitegeera.

Ffenna tuyitiddwa okuba "omuserikale omulungi owa Kristo Yesu" (2 Timoseewo 2:3) n'okulwana "olutalo olulungi olw'okukkiriza" (1 Timoseewo 6:12) nga tulwanyisa abalabe ababi okusinga abo abaalumba Abaisirayiri. Abalabe baffe bali munda, era omuwanvu atuvuma ge maanyi g'okukemebwa kwaffe n'obunafu bw'amaanyi gaffe ku kuziyiza. Lwe lutalo oluzibu era emirundi mingi olumalamu essuubi.

Abaana ba Katonda bangi baayonoona, ne beenenya, ne bamalirira emirundi mingi ne batalaba ssuubi lya buwanguzi. Bakyawa ekibi era baagala obutuukirivu, naye "ekirungi kye njagala okukola sikikola, wabula ekibi kye sanjagala kukola—kye nkola bulijjo" (Abaruumi 7:19). Mu bigambo by'Omutume, basanga etteeka mu bitundu byabwe eby'omubiri nga lirwanyisa etteeka ery'omu magezi gaabwe. Bamanyi nti basaanidde okuwangula, naye tebamanyi ngeri. Abantu bano be kino ekitundu kye kiwandiikiddwa. Bwe basobola okuvumbula ekyama ky'okuleekaana kuno okw'okukkiriza, balimanya engeri, kubanga tekulemwa kuleeta buwanguzi.

Mu Yokaana 16:33, Mukama waffe alaga omusingi gw'oluleekaana luno olw'obuwanguzi: "Mugume omwoyo; nze mpangudde ensi." Si "Ndiwangula," wabula "Mpangudde." Kimaze okukolebwa; twetaaga bwetaazi kuyingira mu maanyi gaakyo. Yoswa teyagamba nti, "Muleekaane, kubanga Mukama alibawa ekibuga," wabula "Muleekaane, kubanga Mukama abawadde ekibuga" (Yoswa 6:16). Kiteekwa kwali kwetaagisa obuyinza bwa Yoswa bwonna okwogera ekigambo ng'ekyo nga bbugwe w'ekibuga akyayimiridde nga munene nnyo nga bulijjo. Naye Katonda yali wa mazima eri Yoswa, era teyatya kulanga buwanguzi nga tebunnalabika.

Waliwo enjawulo nnene wakati w'okwogera nti "Mukama aliwa" n'okwogera nti "Mukama awadde." Obuwanguzi obusuubizibwa mu biseera eby'omu maaso buyinza okuziyizibwa ebintu enkumi n'enkumi, naye obuwanguzi obumaze okutuukirira tebuyinza kuggyibwawo. Mukama waffe bw'atukakasa nti amaze okuwangula ensi, atuwa omusingi ogunywevu ogw'oluleekaana olw'obuwanguzi. Okuva kaakano, amaanyi g'ekibi mulabe eyawangulwa. Bwe tukkiriza ebigambo bya Kristo, tusobola okugasisinkana awatali kutya, kubanga tufuuliddwa "bawanguzi okusukkiridde ku bw'oyo eyatwagala" (Abaruumi 8:37).

Kimanyiddwa bulungi nti eggye eriwangulwa bwe liba likyasobola okukweka okuwangulwa kwalyo, lisobola okulaga okuziyiza okumu. Naye amangu ddala nga litegeeddewo nti okuwangulwa kwalyo kumanyiddwa, liggwaamu omwoyo gwonna ne litasigazaamu kya kukola okuggyako kudduka. Ekyama kiri wano: tuteekwa okusisinkana ekibi si nga omulabe akyalina okuwangulwa, wabula nga oyo eyamala okuwangulwa. Lakabu bwe yayamba abakessi okuwona, yaatula nti: "Mmanyi nga Mukama abawadde ensi... era nga abatuuze bonna ab'ensi basaanuukira mu maaso gammwe" (Yoswa 2:9). Singa twalina amaaso okulaba obwakabaka obw'obubi obutalabika, nzikiriza nti twandisanze nti entiisa egudde ku maanyi gonna ag'ekitundu ekyo, era nti balaba mu buli muntu ow'okukkiriza omuwanguzi ow'ekitiibwa.

Omukristaayo gwe mmanyi, eyali akemebwa nnyo n'entiisa, yategeezebwa ekyama kino. Kyamuleetera okukkiriza amangwago, n'agenda mu lutalo olupya ng'akakasizza obuwanguzi obumaze okutuukirira. Oluvannyuma yagamba nti kyali kirabika ng'ayinza okuwulira omukemi ng'ayogera nga bw'aluka nga agenda, "Woowe! Avumbudde ekyama. Amanyi nti nze ndi mulabe eyamala okuwangulwa!"

Tubuulirwa nti "Ensonga lwaki Omwana wa Katonda yalabika kwe kuzikiriza emirimu gya Setaani" (1 Yokaana 3:8); ate era, "yalabika okuggyawo ebibi" (1 Yokaana 3:5); ne "yalabika omulundi gumu okumalirawo ddala ku nkomerero y'emirembe okuggyawo ekibi nga yeewaayo yekka" (Abaebbulaniya 9:26).

Tuteekwa okukkiriza ng'amazima nti ekibi gye tuli mulabe eyawangulwa. Okukkiriza kwaffe bwe kunaanyweza kino ne tweebala "ng'abafu eri ekibi" (Abaruumi 6:11), ne kuvuma okuyimusa oluleekaana olw'obuwanguzi okukemebwa bwe kujja, tujja kulaba nga buli bbugwe agwa wansi!

Abalabe baffe "bawanvu" kaakano nga bwe baali mu biseera bya Isirayiri, era ebibuga ebinene nga Yeriko bitwolekera. Nga Abaisirayiri, tetulina byakulwanyisa bya bantu bya kuwangula. Ebyokulwanyisa byaffe biteekwa okuba "ebyokulwanyisa bya Katonda" (Abaefeso 6:11). Engabo yaffe y'engabo y'okukkiriza y'emu etalabika, era ekitala kyaffe kye "kitala ky'Omwoyo, kye kigambo kya Katonda" (Abaefeso 6:17). Naye engeri yaffe eya bulijjo ey'okulwana nga ya njawulo! Mu kifo ky'oluleekaana olw'obuwanguzi, tusisinkana okukemebwa n'enteekateeka ennafu, empaka ez'obwereere, oba okusaba okw'okuggwaamu essuubi. "Ayi Mukama, ndokola!" bwe tukaaba.

Bwe wataba kununulibwa kulabika ne tuwangulwa, tukaaba nti Katonda atulemereddwa. Naye kye tusaanidde okukola kwe kutegeera ekibi ng'omulabe eyawangulwa n'okukisisinkana n'oluleekaana olw'obuwanguzi.

Mu kifo mwe twasabira edda nti Mukama anaatulokola, kaakano tuteekwa okwogera nga tukakasa nti atulokola, era nti atulokola kaakano. Tuteekwa okukyusa ekigambo okuva ku "alilokola" okutuuka ku "alokola kaakano," ne tukifuula eky'ekiseera kya kaakano.

Bbugwe ayinza okulabika nga muwanvu nga bulijjo, era amagezi gayinza okugamba nti si kirungi kuleekaana okutuusa obuwanguzi lwe bunaafunibwa. Naye okukkiriza okusobola okuleekaana wakati mu kukemebwa nti, "Yesu andokola; andokola kaakano!" kwe kukkiriza okulifuna obuwanguzi obw'ekitiibwa era obw'amangu.

Abaana ba Katonda bangi bagezezzaako enteekateeka eno ne bagisanga nga ekola okusukka nnyo bye baali basuubidde.

Okukemebwa kuzze ng'amataba—okukemebwa okw'obusungu, ebirowoozo ebibi, obukyayi bw'omwoyo, oba ebintu ebirala enkumi n'enkumi. Baalaba akabi, era enneewulira zaabwe ne zoogera nti tewaali ssuubi lya kuwona.

Naye okukkiriza kwabwe kwanywerera ku mazima amakulu nti Kristo awangudde. Baateeka amaaso gaabwe ku maanyi ag'obulokozi bwa Katonda agatalabika ne baleekaana oluleekaana lwabwe olw'obuwanguzi: "Mukama alokola! Andokola kaakano! Ndi muwanguzi okusukkiridde ku bw'oyo eyatwagala" (Abaruumi 8:37). Ekivaamu bulijjo buwanguzi bwa kitiibwa.

Oluusi kiyinza okulabika nga tekisoboka nnyo nti Mukama ayinza okulokola, ebigambo ne bitayinza "kweyogera" munda. Biteekwa okwogerwa mu ddoboozi ery'oku ggulu, ng'oweweeliriza emimwa gyo okubyogera emirundi n'emirundi, ng'oggalawo amaaso n'amatu go eri buli kirowoozo kya kubuusabuusa. Okulangirira kuno okw'okukkiriza emirundi mingi kulabika ng'"obulimba" ku lubereberye kubanga ensonga ez'okuggwaamu essuubi zirabika nga za mazima. Naye amazima agatalabika ga mazima okusinga ago agalabika. Okukkiriza bwe kunyweererwamu, amazima gano tegalemwa kweraga. "Nga okukkiriza kwo bwe kuli kikukolerwe" (Matayo 9:29). Bwe tuleekaana oluleekaana olw'okukkiriza, Mukama bulijjo awa obuwanguzi obw'okukkiriza.

Nnali mmanyi Omukristaayo eyavuganga eddaali (omuvuzi) eyalina obusungu obw'obutonde. Mu mulimu gwe ogwa buli lunaku wakati mu banne abatatya Katonda, yakemebwanga nnyo okugukkiriza. Yalwana n'obuvumu naye nga bwa bwereere. Olumu ku makya, yagamba omusumba we ng'aweddemu essuubi nti, "Oyinza okuntegeeza ekkubo eriyimpi ery'obuwanguzi—ekintu kye nnyinza okukwata ku kiseera we kyetaagirwa?"

"Yee," omusumba n'addamu. "Okukemebwa bwe kujja, amangwago yimusa omutima gwo era wewole obuwanguzi obwasuubizibwa. Leekaana oluleekaana olw'okukkiriza, n'okukemebwa kulidduka."

Omuvuzi yategeera nti ekibi mulabe eyamala okuwangulwa. Ku lunaku olwo mu sitegini, banne abavuzi ne bamuduula ne bamusindiikiriza okuva mu kifo kye ekituufu. Okukemebwa okw'obusungu kwali kusukkiridde. Naye, ng'afunye emikono gye, n'ayogera munda emirundi n'emirundi nti, "Yesu andokola; andokola kaakano!" Amangwago omutima gwe ne gujjula emirembe. Oluvannyuma, essanduuko enzito n'egwa ku kigere kye, ne kimuluma nnyo. Nate n'afunya emikono gye n'addamu oluleekaana lwe olw'obuwanguzi, era buli kimu ne kiba kya mirembe. Ekiro ne kimusanga nga muwanguzi okusukkiridde, era ne banne ne bawalirizibwa okukkiriza amazima g'eddiini eyayinza okuwangula bwe kityo okulumba kwabwe.

Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli, bwe yamala okwogera ku balabe abaagezaako okumumira, n'alangirira nti: "Awo abalabe bange baliddayo ennyuma ku lunaku lwe ndikoowoola. Kino nkimanyi, nti Katonda ali ku ludda lwange" (Zabbuli 56:9).

Omanyi ekyo Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli kye yamanya? Omanyi nti Katonda ali ku ludda lwo? Bw'oba okimanyi, kale fuluma osisinkane okukemebwa kwo ng'oyimba oluyimba olw'obuwanguzi. Ku kusemberera kw'okukemebwa okusooka, tandika okwebaza olw'obuwanguzi. Wewole nti oli muwanguzi okusukkiridde. Leekaana oluleekaana olw'okukkiriza awamu ne Yoswa, Yekosafaati, Dawudi, ne Pawulo. Bw'oleekaana, Mukama "aliteega enkwe," era abalabe bo baligwa.

Yekosafaati, mu kifo ky'okubakubiriza okwesiga ebyokulwanyisa byabwe n'okuba abazira mu lutalo nga Omukulu w'eggye bwe yandikoze, yabakoowoola busa okuba n'okukkiriza okw'obuvumu. "Mumpulire, mmwe Yuda n'abatuuze ba Yerusaalemi! Mukkirize Mukama Katonda wammwe, munaanywezebwa; mukkirize bannabbi be, munaalaba omukisa" (2 Ebyomumirembe 20:20). Yekosafaati n'ateesa n'abantu; era okukkiriza kwabwe bwe kwenkanankana n'okukwe, ne balonda abayimbi okukulembera eggye nga bayimba ennyimba ez'okutendereza nga bagenda okusisinkana omulabe. Ne kituukirira nti bwe baatandika okuyimba n'okutendereza, Mukama n'ateegera omulabe olukwe, ne battagana bokka na bokka. Abaana ba Isirayiri bwe baatuuka ku munaala ogw'okukuuma mu ddungu, gye baasobola okulaba ekibiina ekinene ekyali kibalumbye, "laba, waaliwo emirambo nga gigudde wansi; tewaali n'omu eyawona" (2 Ebyomumirembe 20:24). Olw'engeri eno ey'ekitalo ey'okulwana ne bafuuka "bawanguzi okusukkiridde"; kubanga baamala "ennaku ssatu nga banyaga omunyago, kubanga gwali mungi nnyo" (2 Ebyomumirembe 20:25). Okulwana kwa Dawudi ne Goliyaasi kye kyokulabirako ekirala eky'engeri eno ey'obuwanguzi. Eri eriiso ery'omubiri, Dawudi teyalina ssuubi n'erimu erya kuwangula omusajja omuwanvu ow'amaanyi eyali avuma amaggye ga Isirayiri. Naye Dawudi, ng'atunula n'eriiso ery'okukkiriza, yasobola okulaba amaanyi ga Katonda agatalabika nga galwana ku ludda lwe. Sawulo bwe yamugamba nti, "Toyinza kulumba Mufirisuuti ono kulwana naye, kubanga oli mulenzi bulenzi, ate ye abadde musajja wa lutalo okuva mu buvubuka bwe," Dawudi n'anywerera mu kukkiriza kwe. Bwe yamala okwogera ku kununulibwa kwe okwayita, n'ayogera n'obukkakkamu nti, "Mukama eyandokola mu kikonde ky'empologoma ne mu kikonde ky'eddubu, y'alindokola mu mukono gw'Omufirisuuti ono" (1 Samwiri 17:33, 37). Sawulo, ng'okukkiriza kuno okw'amaanyi kumukkakkanyizza katono, n'agamba nti, "Genda, era Mukama abeere naawe!" Kyokka teyasobola kuleka kwesiga byakulwanyisa bye yali amanyidde; n'ayambaza Dawudi enkuufiira ey'ekikomo, ekizibaawo eky'ebyuma, n'ekitala kye eky'amaanyi. Dawudi "n'agezaako okutambula naye n'alemwa," kubanga yali tabimanyidde. N'abiggyako n'addira mu kifo kyabyo ebyokulwanyisa ebyangu Mukama bye yali awezze edda: omuggo gwe, envuumuulo ye, n'amayinja ataano amaweweevu ag'omu mugga. Bwe yeetegeka bw'atyo, n'asemberera omuwanvu. Omuwanvu bwe yalaba omuvubuka eyali azze okumulwanyisa, n'amunyooma n'ayogera n'okusekerera nti, "Sembera gye ndi, nange ndiwa ennyama yo ennyonyi ez'omu bbanga n'ensolo ez'omu nsiko" (1 Samwiri 17:44). Eri eriiso ery'omubiri, kyalabika ng'eno ye nkomerero ey'olutalo olutenkanankana bwe lutyo. Naye okukkiriza kwa Dawudi kwawangula, n'aleekaana oluleekaana olw'obuwanguzi olutalo nga terunnatandika. "Ojja gye ndi n'ekitala n'effumu n'ekasaali," n'ayogera, "naye nze nzija gy'oli mu linnya lya Mukama ow'eggye, Katonda w'amaggye ga Isirayiri, gw'ovumye. Leero Mukama alikuwaayo mu mukono gwange... ensi yonna eryoke etegeere nti mwe muli Katonda mu Isirayiri, era ekibiina kino kyonna kitegeere nti Mukama talokola na kitala wadde effumu. Kubanga olutalo lwa Mukama, era alikuwaayo mu mukono gwaffe" (1 Samwiri 17:45-47). Mu maaso g'okukkiriza okufaanana bwe kutyo, omuwanvu yandikoze ki? Buli kigambo ky'oluleekaana luli olw'obuwanguzi ne kituukirira, era omulabe ow'amaanyi n'aweebwayo mu mikono gy'omuvubuka gwe yali anyoomye. Era bwe kityo bwe kinaabanga bulijjo. Tewali kisobola kuziyiza kukkiriza okuwangula okwennyunga ku buyinza obutakoma. Kubanga "buno bwe buwanguzi obuwangudde ensi—kwe kukkiriza kwaffe" (1 Yokaana 5:4). Ekyama ky'okulwana kwonna okuwangula kiri mu kuleekaana kuno okw'okukkiriza. Kyama ekitategeerekeka eri abo abatamanyi kintu ku maanyi ga Katonda agatalabika agalindirira ebyetaagisa by'okukkiriza; kyama ekiteekwa okulabika bulijjo ng'obusirusiru obw'ekitalo eri abo abatakitegeera. Ffenna tuyitiddwa okuba "omuserikale omulungi owa Kristo Yesu" (2 Timoseewo 2:3) n'okulwana "olutalo olulungi olw'okukkiriza" (1 Timoseewo 6:12) nga tulwanyisa abalabe ababi okusinga abo abaalumba Abaisirayiri. Abalabe baffe bali munda, era omuwanvu atuvuma ge maanyi g'okukemebwa kwaffe n'obunafu bw'amaanyi gaffe ku kuziyiza. Lwe lutalo oluzibu era emirundi mingi olumalamu essuubi. Abaana ba Katonda bangi baayonoona, ne beenenya, ne bamalirira emirundi mingi ne batalaba ssuubi lya buwanguzi. Bakyawa ekibi era baagala obutuukirivu, naye "ekirungi kye njagala okukola sikikola, wabula ekibi kye sanjagala kukola—kye nkola bulijjo" (Abaruumi 7:19). Mu bigambo by'Omutume, basanga etteeka mu bitundu byabwe eby'omubiri nga lirwanyisa etteeka ery'omu magezi gaabwe. Bamanyi nti basaanidde okuwangula, naye tebamanyi ngeri. Abantu bano be kino ekitundu kye kiwandiikiddwa. Bwe basobola okuvumbula ekyama ky'okuleekaana kuno okw'okukkiriza, balimanya engeri, kubanga tekulemwa kuleeta buwanguzi. Mu Yokaana 16:33, Mukama waffe alaga omusingi gw'oluleekaana luno olw'obuwanguzi: "Mugume omwoyo; nze mpangudde ensi." Si "Ndiwangula," wabula "Mpangudde." Kimaze okukolebwa; twetaaga bwetaazi kuyingira mu maanyi gaakyo. Yoswa teyagamba nti, "Muleekaane, kubanga Mukama alibawa ekibuga," wabula "Muleekaane, kubanga Mukama abawadde ekibuga" (Yoswa 6:16). Kiteekwa kwali kwetaagisa obuyinza bwa Yoswa bwonna okwogera ekigambo ng'ekyo nga bbugwe w'ekibuga akyayimiridde nga munene nnyo nga bulijjo. Naye Katonda yali wa mazima eri Yoswa, era teyatya kulanga buwanguzi nga tebunnalabika. Waliwo enjawulo nnene wakati w'okwogera nti "Mukama aliwa" n'okwogera nti "Mukama awadde." Obuwanguzi obusuubizibwa mu biseera eby'omu maaso buyinza okuziyizibwa ebintu enkumi n'enkumi, naye obuwanguzi obumaze okutuukirira tebuyinza kuggyibwawo. Mukama waffe bw'atukakasa nti amaze okuwangula ensi, atuwa omusingi ogunywevu ogw'oluleekaana olw'obuwanguzi. Okuva kaakano, amaanyi g'ekibi mulabe eyawangulwa. Bwe tukkiriza ebigambo bya Kristo, tusobola okugasisinkana awatali kutya, kubanga tufuuliddwa "bawanguzi okusukkiridde ku bw'oyo eyatwagala" (Abaruumi 8:37). Kimanyiddwa bulungi nti eggye eriwangulwa bwe liba likyasobola okukweka okuwangulwa kwalyo, lisobola okulaga okuziyiza okumu. Naye amangu ddala nga litegeeddewo nti okuwangulwa kwalyo kumanyiddwa, liggwaamu omwoyo gwonna ne litasigazaamu kya kukola okuggyako kudduka. Ekyama kiri wano: tuteekwa okusisinkana ekibi si nga omulabe akyalina okuwangulwa, wabula nga oyo eyamala okuwangulwa. Lakabu bwe yayamba abakessi okuwona, yaatula nti: "Mmanyi nga Mukama abawadde ensi... era nga abatuuze bonna ab'ensi basaanuukira mu maaso gammwe" (Yoswa 2:9). Singa twalina amaaso okulaba obwakabaka obw'obubi obutalabika, nzikiriza nti twandisanze nti entiisa egudde ku maanyi gonna ag'ekitundu ekyo, era nti balaba mu buli muntu ow'okukkiriza omuwanguzi ow'ekitiibwa. Omukristaayo gwe mmanyi, eyali akemebwa nnyo n'entiisa, yategeezebwa ekyama kino. Kyamuleetera okukkiriza amangwago, n'agenda mu lutalo olupya ng'akakasizza obuwanguzi obumaze okutuukirira. Oluvannyuma yagamba nti kyali kirabika ng'ayinza okuwulira omukemi ng'ayogera nga bw'aluka nga agenda, "Woowe! Avumbudde ekyama. Amanyi nti nze ndi mulabe eyamala okuwangulwa!" Tubuulirwa nti "Ensonga lwaki Omwana wa Katonda yalabika kwe kuzikiriza emirimu gya Setaani" (1 Yokaana 3:8); ate era, "yalabika okuggyawo ebibi" (1 Yokaana 3:5); ne "yalabika omulundi gumu okumalirawo ddala ku nkomerero y'emirembe okuggyawo ekibi nga yeewaayo yekka" (Abaebbulaniya 9:26). Tuteekwa okukkiriza ng'amazima nti ekibi gye tuli mulabe eyawangulwa. Okukkiriza kwaffe bwe kunaanyweza kino ne tweebala "ng'abafu eri ekibi" (Abaruumi 6:11), ne kuvuma okuyimusa oluleekaana olw'obuwanguzi okukemebwa bwe kujja, tujja kulaba nga buli bbugwe agwa wansi! Abalabe baffe "bawanvu" kaakano nga bwe baali mu biseera bya Isirayiri, era ebibuga ebinene nga Yeriko bitwolekera. Nga Abaisirayiri, tetulina byakulwanyisa bya bantu bya kuwangula. Ebyokulwanyisa byaffe biteekwa okuba "ebyokulwanyisa bya Katonda" (Abaefeso 6:11). Engabo yaffe y'engabo y'okukkiriza y'emu etalabika, era ekitala kyaffe kye "kitala ky'Omwoyo, kye kigambo kya Katonda" (Abaefeso 6:17). Naye engeri yaffe eya bulijjo ey'okulwana nga ya njawulo! Mu kifo ky'oluleekaana olw'obuwanguzi, tusisinkana okukemebwa n'enteekateeka ennafu, empaka ez'obwereere, oba okusaba okw'okuggwaamu essuubi. "Ayi Mukama, ndokola!" bwe tukaaba. Bwe wataba kununulibwa kulabika ne tuwangulwa, tukaaba nti Katonda atulemereddwa. Naye kye tusaanidde okukola kwe kutegeera ekibi ng'omulabe eyawangulwa n'okukisisinkana n'oluleekaana olw'obuwanguzi. Mu kifo mwe twasabira edda nti Mukama anaatulokola, kaakano tuteekwa okwogera nga tukakasa nti atulokola, era nti atulokola kaakano. Tuteekwa okukyusa ekigambo okuva ku "alilokola" okutuuka ku "alokola kaakano," ne tukifuula eky'ekiseera kya kaakano. Bbugwe ayinza okulabika nga muwanvu nga bulijjo, era amagezi gayinza okugamba nti si kirungi kuleekaana okutuusa obuwanguzi lwe bunaafunibwa. Naye okukkiriza okusobola okuleekaana wakati mu kukemebwa nti, "Yesu andokola; andokola kaakano!" kwe kukkiriza okulifuna obuwanguzi obw'ekitiibwa era obw'amangu. Abaana ba Katonda bangi bagezezzaako enteekateeka eno ne bagisanga nga ekola okusukka nnyo bye baali basuubidde. Okukemebwa kuzze ng'amataba—okukemebwa okw'obusungu, ebirowoozo ebibi, obukyayi bw'omwoyo, oba ebintu ebirala enkumi n'enkumi. Baalaba akabi, era enneewulira zaabwe ne zoogera nti tewaali ssuubi lya kuwona. Naye okukkiriza kwabwe kwanywerera ku mazima amakulu nti Kristo awangudde. Baateeka amaaso gaabwe ku maanyi ag'obulokozi bwa Katonda agatalabika ne baleekaana oluleekaana lwabwe olw'obuwanguzi: "Mukama alokola! Andokola kaakano! Ndi muwanguzi okusukkiridde ku bw'oyo eyatwagala" (Abaruumi 8:37). Ekivaamu bulijjo buwanguzi bwa kitiibwa. Oluusi kiyinza okulabika nga tekisoboka nnyo nti Mukama ayinza okulokola, ebigambo ne bitayinza "kweyogera" munda. Biteekwa okwogerwa mu ddoboozi ery'oku ggulu, ng'oweweeliriza emimwa gyo okubyogera emirundi n'emirundi, ng'oggalawo amaaso n'amatu go eri buli kirowoozo kya kubuusabuusa. Okulangirira kuno okw'okukkiriza emirundi mingi kulabika ng'"obulimba" ku lubereberye kubanga ensonga ez'okuggwaamu essuubi zirabika nga za mazima. Naye amazima agatalabika ga mazima okusinga ago agalabika. Okukkiriza bwe kunyweererwamu, amazima gano tegalemwa kweraga. "Nga okukkiriza kwo bwe kuli kikukolerwe" (Matayo 9:29). Bwe tuleekaana oluleekaana olw'okukkiriza, Mukama bulijjo awa obuwanguzi obw'okukkiriza. Nnali mmanyi Omukristaayo eyavuganga eddaali (omuvuzi) eyalina obusungu obw'obutonde. Mu mulimu gwe ogwa buli lunaku wakati mu banne abatatya Katonda, yakemebwanga nnyo okugukkiriza. Yalwana n'obuvumu naye nga bwa bwereere. Olumu ku makya, yagamba omusumba we ng'aweddemu essuubi nti, "Oyinza okuntegeeza ekkubo eriyimpi ery'obuwanguzi—ekintu kye nnyinza okukwata ku kiseera we kyetaagirwa?" "Yee," omusumba n'addamu. "Okukemebwa bwe kujja, amangwago yimusa omutima gwo era wewole obuwanguzi obwasuubizibwa. Leekaana oluleekaana olw'okukkiriza, n'okukemebwa kulidduka." Omuvuzi yategeera nti ekibi mulabe eyamala okuwangulwa. Ku lunaku olwo mu sitegini, banne abavuzi ne bamuduula ne bamusindiikiriza okuva mu kifo kye ekituufu. Okukemebwa okw'obusungu kwali kusukkiridde. Naye, ng'afunye emikono gye, n'ayogera munda emirundi n'emirundi nti, "Yesu andokola; andokola kaakano!" Amangwago omutima gwe ne gujjula emirembe. Oluvannyuma, essanduuko enzito n'egwa ku kigere kye, ne kimuluma nnyo. Nate n'afunya emikono gye n'addamu oluleekaana lwe olw'obuwanguzi, era buli kimu ne kiba kya mirembe. Ekiro ne kimusanga nga muwanguzi okusukkiridde, era ne banne ne bawalirizibwa okukkiriza amazima g'eddiini eyayinza okuwangula bwe kityo okulumba kwabwe. Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli, bwe yamala okwogera ku balabe abaagezaako okumumira, n'alangirira nti: "Awo abalabe bange baliddayo ennyuma ku lunaku lwe ndikoowoola. Kino nkimanyi, nti Katonda ali ku ludda lwange" (Zabbuli 56:9). Omanyi ekyo Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli kye yamanya? Omanyi nti Katonda ali ku ludda lwo? Bw'oba okimanyi, kale fuluma osisinkane okukemebwa kwo ng'oyimba oluyimba olw'obuwanguzi. Ku kusemberera kw'okukemebwa okusooka, tandika okwebaza olw'obuwanguzi. Wewole nti oli muwanguzi okusukkiridde. Leekaana oluleekaana olw'okukkiriza awamu ne Yoswa, Yekosafaati, Dawudi, ne Pawulo. Bw'oleekaana, Mukama "aliteega enkwe," era abalabe bo baligwa.

fields.title: Okwebaza Mu Kifo ky’Okwemulugunya
fields.body_html:
“Mwebazenga mu buli kintu; kubanga kino Katonda ky’abaagaliza mu Kristo Yesu” (1 Abasessaloniki 5:18).

Okwebaza n’okwemulugunya mpisa bbiri ez’okwawukana. Emmeeme eyeebaza esobola okufuna ekiweweevu mu buli kintu; naye emmeeme eyeemulugunya teyinza kufuna kiweweevu mu kintu kyonna.

Ekiragiro kya Katonda kyogera nti, “Mu buli kintu mwebazenga.” Kiragiro kikakafu. Bwe tuba twagala okugondera Katonda, tuteekwa okwebaza mu buli kintu. Tewali kkubo lya kukyewala. Naye Abakristaayo bangi bakitunuulira ng’“amagezi ag’obutuukirivu obungi ennyo” omuntu obuntu bw’atayinza kutuukako. Awatali kumanya, bakyusa ebigambo mu kyama ne bafuula “okugumiikiriza” mu kifo ky’“okwebaza,” ne “mu bintu bitono” mu kifo ky’“mu buli kintu.”

Bawakana nti, “Singa buli kintu kivudde butereevu eri Katonda, nnandikikoze, naye ebintu ebisinga obungi bituuka gye ndi nga biyita mu bantu oba mu kibi.” Nziramu bwe nti: tetuyinza bulijjo kwebaza olw’ebintu byennyini, naye tuyinza bulijjo okwebaza olw’okwagala kwa Katonda okuli mu bintu ebyo. Ali mu byo wamu, ng’akaka n’ebisinga obungi okuba eby’ennaku okukolera awamu okutuviiramu obulungi. Okukkiriza tekulaba “ebivaako eby’okubiri” (abantu oba ensobi ezituluma); kulaba mukono gwa Katonda gwokka oguli emabega waabyo. Ebizibu bwe biba bituuse gye tuli, biba bifuuse kye Katonda ky’ayagala gye tuli era tuteekwa okubikkiriza nga biva mu mikono gye.

Olugero lwa Yusufu lwe lubeera ekyokulabirako. Tewali kyandifaananye nga kikontana n’ekyo Katonda ky’ayagala okusinga Yusufu okutundibwa mu buddu baganda be. Naye singa yali amanyi enkomerero okuva ku ntandikwa, yandijjudde okwebaza. Obuddu bwe bwali oluggi olw’obutereevu olwamutuusa ku mikisa egisinga obukulu mu bulamu bwe.
