Ku nkomerero, Yusufu yasobola okugamba nti, “Mmwe mwanteeseza akabi, naye Katonda yakifuula akalungi” (Olubereberye 50:20). Eri eriiso ery’omubiri, baganda be be baamusindika e Misiri; naye eri eriiso ery’okukkiriza, “Katonda ye yantuma” (Olubereberye 45:7).

Nzijukira ekigezo mu bulamu bwange kye naaleeterwa omuntu omulala. Najjula obujeemu obukaawa ne sirabamu kya kwebazaako. Naye ekigezo ekyo kyennyini kye kyanviiramu emikisa egisinga obugagga mu bulamu bwange. Singa nnali nnina okukkiriza okumala okwebaza okuva ku lubereberye, nnandyewalidde ennaku nnyingi nnyo.

Ntya nti ekisingako waggulu Abakristaayo bangi kye batuukako kwe “kufuba okugumiikiriza” ebintu bye batayinza kukyusa. Okwebaza kumpi n’okuba omuzannyo ogutamanyiddwa. Mu nsi, kitwalibwa ng’ekitali kya mpisa okuweebwa ekirabo n’oba tewebazza; sirina kye ndaba ekyandifudde nga si kitali kya mpisa mu ngeri y’emu eri Katonda. Tetwandiroota kwerabira kuwandiikira mukwano gwaffe omuntu ebbaluwa ey’okwebaza olw’ekirabo ekitono, naye tulemwa okwebaza Katonda olw’emikisa egitabalika gy’atuyiwako.

Ekisingako obubi, bangi beeganya okwemulugunya n’okuninnira. Tubuulirwa nti “abantu ne beemulugunya nga Mukama awulira ku bizibu byabwe, awo Mukama bwe yakiwulira, obusungu bwe ne bubuubuuka” (Okubala 11:1). Tukemebwa okulowooza nti okwemulugunya kwaffe okw’“eby’omwoyo” tekumunyiiza—nti kabonero ka bunyiikivu oba ka kutegeera kungi. Naye okwemulugunya kye kikontana n’okukkiriza okusanyusa Katonda.

Naye okwemulugunya bulijjo kufaanana, ka kube ku mutindo ogw’ensi oba ogw’omwoyo. Bulijjo kulimu akaseera ak’okunoonya ensobi. Webster agamba nti okwemulugunya kitegeeza “okuleeta omusango oba okuloopa.” Si kwakukyawa kyokka ekyo kye tuteekwa okugumira; kwe kunoonya ensobi mu kigere ekiri emabega waakyo. Bwe twekenneenya n’obwegendereza omunda gw’okwemulugunya kwaffe, awamu tujja kusanga nti kusibuka ku kunoonya ensobi mu Katonda mu ngeri ey’ekyama. Mu kyama twewulira nga ye y’alina omusango, ne tumuvunaana mu mitima gyaffe.

Ku luuyi olulala, okwebaza bulijjo kuzingiramu okutendereza Omuwi. Wali okabanjabye engeri gye tukubirizibwamu ennyo mu Baibuli “okutendereza Mukama”? Kwali kitundu kikulu mu kusinza kwa Isiraeri: “Mutendereze Mukama, kubanga Mukama mulungi; muyimbe ku linnya lye, kubanga kisanyusa!” (Zabbuli 135:3). Nzikiriza nti singa tubibala, twandisanze ebiragiro eby’okwebaza “bulijjo olwa buli kintu” nga bisinga obungi ebiragiro eby’ekikolwa ekirala kyonna. Kya lwatu nti Mukama ayagala okwebazibwa n’okutenderezebwa nga naffe bwe tuyagala. Kimuleetera essanyu ery’amazima, era okulemwa kwaffe okumwebaza olw’“ebirabo bye ebirungi era ebituukiridde” (Yakobo 1:17) kunuubula omutima gwe, nga n’egyaffe bwe ginuubulwa abo be twagala bwe balemwa okusiima kye tubawa.

Omutume bw’atukubiriza okuba “abagoberezi ba Katonda, ng’abaana abaagalwa,” azingiramu kino: “nga mwebaza bulijjo olwa buli kintu eri Katonda Kitaffe mu linnya lya Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo” (Abaefeso 5:1, 20). “Bulijjo olwa buli kintu” kigambo ekibuna byonna. Kiteekwa okutegeeza nti tewali kintu mu bulamu bwaffe—ka kiyite mu ngeri yonna—ekitalimu mukisa ogukwekeddwa oguva eri Katonda.

Omutume atugamba nti “buli kitonde kya Katonda kirungi, era tewali kya kugaanibwa singa kitwalibwa n’okwebaza” (1 Timoseewo 4:4). Naye kizibu okukkiriza nti ebintu birungi nga tebifaanana bwe bityo. Emirundi mingi, ebirabo bya Katonda bifaanana ng’ebikolimo eri abo abalaba kungulu kwokka.

Ebirabo “ebirungi era ebituukiridde” bimeka bye twatunuulira ng’ebikolimo? Bimeka bye tweebaza ffekka, oba mikwano gyaffe, oba embeera zaffe, awatali kutunula emabega w’abawi ab’ensi okutuuka ku Muwi ow’omu ggulu? Kiba nga twebaza omubaka naye ne tutatuusa bubaka eri mukwano gwaffe eyaweereza ekirabo.

Ne bwe tutegeera nti ebintu biva eri Katonda, kizibu okumwebaza olw’ekyo ekituluma. Naye twebaza omusawo omukugu olw’obujjanjabi, ne bwe buba obukakali. Tetusaanira kwebaza Musawo waffe ow’omu ggulu bw’atuwa eddagala eddulu okuwonya endwadde ey’omwoyo, oba bw’atukolako omulimu ogw’obulumi okutuggyako ekintu ekyonoona?

Mu kifo ky’okumwebaza, tweemulugunya. Emirundi mingi okwemulugunya kwaffe tetukwolekeza Musawo, naye tukwolekeza “eccupa” mwe yaweerezza eddagala. “Eccupa” eno emirundi mingi muntu buntu, obutali bwa kisa oba okwerabira kwe kwatuleetera okubonaabona—naye be “kivaako eky’okubiri” Katonda kye yakozesa okutuwonya. Amagezi agalungi gatugamba nti kya busirusiru okuvuma eccupa y’eddagala; era kya busirusiru kye kimu okuvuma “ebivaako eby’okubiri” ebyagenderera okuyigiriza emmeeme zaffe.

Abaisiraeri bwe baali batambulatambula, “beemulugunya ku Musa ne Alooni” (Okuva 16:2). Naye mu mazima, okwemulugunya kwabwe kwali kukolebwa ku Katonda, kubanga ye yali abaleese eyo. Omuzabbuli akiyita “okwogera obubi ku Katonda” (Zabbuli 78:19). Ebyafaayo eby’obwakatonda tebifaayo ku bivaako eby’okubiri; bidda butereevu ku Kivaako ekituufu ekiri emabega waabyo.

Kale tuyinza okukikakasa nti okwemulugunya kwonna kwe “kwogera obubi ku Katonda.” Ebivaako eby’okubiri tebiyinza kukolako wabula Katonda ng’akkirizza; ekyo ky’akkiriza kifuuka kye yategese. Mukama yasunguwalira abeemulugunya “kubanga tebaakkiriza Katonda so tebeesiga bulokozi bwe” (Zabbuli 78:22). Mu ntobo, okwemulugunya kwonna kutegeeza nti tetwesiga bulokozi bwe.

Omuzabbuli agamba nti, “Nnaatendereza erinnya lya Katonda n’oluyimba; nnaamugulumiza n’okwebaza. Kino kirisanyusa Mukama okusinga ente oba seddume” (Zabbuli 69:30-31). Bangi beetegefu okuwaayo ssaddaaka nnene, naye okutendereza okutono okw’amazima kwandimusanyusizza okusingawo.

Baibuli akuyita “ssaddaaka ey’okwebaza” (Ebyabaleevi 7:12). Kikolwa kya kusinza. “Bawengayo ssaddaaka ez’okwebaza, era boogere ku bikolwa bye mu nnyimba ez’essanyu!” (Zabbuli 107:22). Kya bwangu okuwaayo, naye singa okusaba kw’Abakristaayo kwabalibwa olunaku lumu, ntya nti twandisanze—nga bwe kyali ku bagenge ekkumi—nti mu kkumi omwenda tebaawaayo kwebaza kwa mazima.

Mukama waffe yanakuwazibwa abagenge abo abataasiima: “Ekkumi tebaalongoosebwa? Ab’omwenda bali ludda wa?

Tewaliiwo n’omu eyalabise okudda okwebaza Katonda okuggyako omugwira ono?” (Lukka 17:17-18). Anaatubuuza kye kimu? Twewuunya obutasiima bwabwe, naye obwaffe bugenda butya? Tetuyita ku mikisa egitabalika ne tussa amaaso gaffe ku “bufiirwa” bwaffe okutuusa ng’eggulu lyaffe lyonna lijjudde bwo?

Tuyinza okulaba engeri kino gye kiteekwa okunakuwaza Mukama nga twesunga ku nneewulira zaffe. Omwana eyeemulugunya ku ebyo omuzadde bye yamuteekerateekera anuubula omutima gw’omuzadde oyo emirundi mingi okusukka ebigambo. Ffenna tumanyi abantu abeemulugunya bulijjo—tewali kibasanyusa, era tewali kisa kye basiima.

Tumanyi engeri okubeera nabo gye kutuleetera obutabeera bulungi, ate ku luuyi olulala, engeri obulamu gye bumasamasizibwa omuntu asanga eky’okusanyukira mu buli kituuka. Nzikiriza nti ennaku ennyingi ennyo eziletebwa mu mitima gy’abantu okuninnira kw’abo be baagala okusinga bwe tulowooza; era nzikiriza nti okunuubula kwe tutalowoozaako kuweebwa omutima gwa Kitaffe ali mu ggulu olw’okwemulugunya okutakoma okw’abaana be.

Emirundi emeka bwe kigambibwa ku bantu abeeraliikirira nti, “Tewali kirituusa kubamalako?” Era emirundi emeka Katonda gy’ateekwa okukyuka, ng’anakuwazibwa okwemulugunya kwaffe, ate ng’okwagala kwe atuyiiseeko emikisa egitabalika. Oluusi ndowoozezza nti singa tukitegeera, twandiziyizza ennaku yaffe ey’ekitalo ne ku kufiirwa abo be twagala, ne tugezaako, ku lulwe, okuba abasanyufu era abamativu ne mu mbeera yaffe ey’obwannamunigina.

Nzijukira okuwulira ku muwala eyayita mu bujjanjabi obw’obulumi bungi ennyo. Abasawo baatya nti anaakaaba nnyo, naye ne beewuunya bwe wataavaamu wadde okusinda. Yamwenyerera kitaawe kyokka. Bwe baamubuuza engeri gye yakikola, yagamba nti: “Namanya nnyo kitange bwe yanjagala, era namanya nga bwe yandibonyeebonye singa yandindabye nga mbonaabona, kyennava ngezaako okukikweka; ne nseka nsobozese kitange okulowooza nti sikifaako.” Waliwo ku ffe ayinza okukolera Kitaffe ali mu ggulu kino?

Yobu yali mwemulugunya mukulu, era tuyinza okulowooza nti yalina ensonga ennungi. Yagamba nti, “Nkyawa obulamu bwange; kyenva nzita okwemulugunya kwange n’okwogera nga nva mu bukaawu bw’emmeeme yange” (Yobu 10:1). Tetuyinza kwewuunya nnyo. Naye singa yali asobodde okulaba oludda olw’obwakatonda, yandimanyi nti ebizibu bye baabikkiriza mu kwagala okusinga obuwewevu okumuleetera okubikkulirwa kwa Katonda kwe yandifunye mu ngeri endala yonna. Singa yalaba enkomerero okuva ku ntandikwa, okwebaza kwandikitutte ekifo ky’okwemulugunya.

Abaana ba Isiraeri baali beemulugunya bulijjo. Beemulugunya bwe baabulwa amazzi, ate amazzi bwe gaaweebwa, ne beemulugunya nti gaali gakaawa. Naffe tukola bwe tutyo “amazzi” gaffe ag’omwoyo bwe gafaanana ng’agakaawa—emikolo egy’eddiini bwe gifaanana ng’egyetamiddwa era egitamalako. Tuva ku “nsulo z’amazzi amalamu” ne twemulugunya olw’“ebidiba ebyatika” bye tweyasimira, olw’okuba tebikwata mazzi (Yeremiya 2:13).

Abaisiraeri beemulugunya ku mmere yaabwe, nga batya enjala, ate ne beemulugunya emanu bwe yaweebwa kubanga “bakyawa emmere eno etaliimu” (Okubala 21:5). Naffe tweemulugunya ku mmere yaffe ey’omwoyo—nti omubuulizi waffe tatuliisa oba nti tetulina birungi abalala bye balina. Tusaba emmere ate ne twemulugunya nti atuwadde ejjinja. Naye Musawo waffe ow’obwakatonda amanyi emmere n’ekyokunywa ebisinga okutugwanira. Ekyewuunyisa kiri nti tetusobola kukkiriza, awatali kulinda nkomerero, nti Omusumba amanyi eddundiro erisingira ddala obulungi.

Yona atuwa ekyokulabirako ekirungi ennyo. Okusaba kwe okw’okwebaza kwava mu “lubuto lwa Sheoli”: “Nakoowoola Mukama nga ndi mu nnaku yange, n’anziramu... Naye nze n’eddoboozi ery’okwebaza nnaakuwaayo ssaddaaka” (Yona 2:2, 9). Tewali buziba bwa nnaku obusinga obunene ku ssaddaaka ey’okwebaza. Tetwebaza Katonda olw’ennaku, naye mu nnaku, nga tumanyi nti ali eyo okutuyamba n’okutuwa omukisa.

Si lwa kuba nti ebintu birungi kyetuva twebaza Mukama, wabula lwa kuba nti ye mulungi. Tetuliimu magezi gamala kusalawo oba embeera nsanyu oba nnaku mu ntobo yaayo, naye tumanyi nti obulungi bwe bukakasa nti ekyo ky’akkiriza kiteekwa okuba olw’obulungi bwaffe obw’enkomerero.

Mu katabo akayitibwa “Essanduuko y’Obwamisoni eya Mukyala Pickett,” omukazi eyali yeemulugunya obulamu bwe bwonna yasoomozebwa okuteeka essente mu ssanduuko olwa buli mukisa gwe yandizudde. Yagamba nti: “‘Emikisa emikulu nnina!’ bwe njogera... ‘Ndowooza abakaafiiri tebagenda kufuna kintu kingi ku nze.’ Nasalawo okubala, okwerabisa nzekka nga bwe nnina emikisa mitono.”

Naye ng’atudde ku madaala ge, ng’awulira ku bakazi mu nsi endala abaali bafa enjala era abaabonyaabonyezebwa, yayogera mangu nti: “Bw’oba nga ndi nnamwandu, nsiima nga ndi mu kifo we nsobolera okwefunira ekyokulya kyange!” Mwana wa mwannyina n’amugamba nti ogwo gwe gwali omukisa gwe ogusooka. Yateeka wansi essente. N’ateekawo endala kubanga teyali Muchayina. Oluvannyuma n’atunda amagi—“essente ez’okutunda amagi”—era bwe yagezaako okugamba nti gwali si mukisa gwa Mukama, mwana wa mwannyina n’ayimba nti: “Ekisa kya Katonda kye kisa kyokka, era ekisa kyonna kya Katonda.”

Mu bbanga ttono, yali anoonya ebintu by’ayinza okwebazaako, era essanduuko teyawuuma nnyo bwe yagisuukundanga.

Waliwo Zabbuli gye mpita Zabbuli yaffe ey’Emikisa. Ye ya 103, era eyogera ku mikisa egimu Mukama gy’atuyiiseeko, n’atukubiriza obutagyerabira. “Weebaze Mukama, ggwe emmeeme yange, so toyerabira mikisa gye gyonna” (Zabbuli 103:2). Essanduuko y’Emikisa eya mwannyinaffe omwagalwa yali emuyigirizza ekimu ku makulu ga Zabbuli eno. Obulamu bwe bwonna yali yerabidde emikisa Mukama gye yali amuyiseeko, naye kaakati yali atandika okugijjukira.

Ffe tutandise okujjukira egyaffe?

Singa mu mwaka oguwedde twali tubaze emikisa egyo gye twali twebazizza mu mazima, essente meka, neebuuza, ze zandibadde mu ssanduuko zaffe?

Oluusi tuyimba mu nkuŋŋaana z’obwamisoni oluyimba olw’okwebaza, olulina ekitundu eky’okuddiŋŋana nti, “Bala emikisa gyo emingi, ogibale kimu kimu, era kijja kukwewuunyisa Mukama ky’akoze.” Era oluusi neebuuza oba waliwo ku ffe abaali baluyimba n’omutima gwonna eyali akutte akalambulambu ka mikisa gye, oba mu mazima eyali amanyi nti alina gyonna.

Kubanga ekizibu kiri nti emirundi mingi ebirabo bya Katonda bituuka gye tuli nga bisabikiddwa mu bibikka ebikakanyavu, ne tukemebwa okubigaana ng’ebitaliimu mugaso; oba ababaka ababireeta bajja mu kifaananyi ky’abalabe, ne twagala okubaggalirawo oluggi, obutabayingiza. Naye tufiirwa ebisinga bwe tuli bye tumanyi bwe tugaana n’ebisinga obutasuubirwa.

“Obubi buddu bwa bulungi bwokka, N’ennaku ye muweereza w’essanyu: N’emmeeme eba ya ddalu egaana emmere Eva mu asinga wansi mu abo Katonda b’akozesa.”

Tulagirwa okuyingira mu miryango gye n’okwebaza, ne mu mpya ze n’okutendereza, era nkakasa nti okwebaza gwe guddaano oguggulawo emiryango gino amangu okusinga ekintu ekirala kyonna. Kigezeeko, omusomi omwagalwa. Omulundi oguddako bw’onoowulira ng’ofudde, era ng’onnyogoga, era ng’oweddemu amaanyi, tandika okutendereza n’okwebaza Mukama. Weebalire wekka emikisa gy’akuyiseeko, omwebaze n’omutima gwonna olwa buli gumu, olabe oba omwoyo gwo teguba gutandika kwesitula, n’omutima gwo ne gubugumira. Oluusi, kiyinzika, oba weewulira ng’oweddemu amaanyi okusaba; kale gezaako okwebaza mu kifo; era nga tonnaba na kukimanya, ojja kwezuula ng’“osanyuse” mu bungi bw’ekisa kye n’okusaasira kwe.

Omu ku mikwano gyange yaŋŋamba nti omwana we omulenzi ekiro kimu yagaana kirungullu okusaba. Yagamba nti tewali n’ekintu na kimu mu nsi yonna kye yali ayagala, era teyalaba magezi ga kusaba bintu by’atali kwagala. Ekirowoozo eky’essanyu kyajjira nnyina, n’agamba nti, “Kale, Charlie, ka twebaze olwa byonna by’olina.” Ekirowoozo ekyo kyasanyusa omwana, n’afukamira n’essanyu, n’atandika okwebaza. Yebaza Katonda olw’ensolo ze ez’omuzannyo, n’olw’akapiira akaggya akaali kaakamuweereddwa, n’olw’amagulu ge amaanyi agaali gasobola okudduka wala, n’olw’okuba nga si muzibe ng’omulenzi omulala gwe yamanyi, n’olw’kitaawe ne nnyina ab’ekisa, n’olw’ekitanda kye ekirungi, n’olw’omukisa ne gumu ku gumu, okutuusa olukalala bwe lwawanvuwa nnyo n’oyogera nti alowooza tewali we linaakoma. Era bwe baagolokoka okuva mu kufukamira, yagamba nnyina, ng’amaaso ge gamasamasa n’essanyu, nti, “Owange, maama, saamanyangako nti Katonda mulungi bw’atyo n’ekitalo!” Era nzikiriza nti singa oluusi tugoberera ekyokulabirako ky’omulenzi ono omuto, naffe twandizudde, nga bwe tutakozangako, obulungi bwa Katonda waffe.

Kya kwewuunya nnyo okulaba engeri okwebaza gye kwakolagana n’okuzimba Yeekaalu.

Bwe baali bamaze okukuŋŋaanya eby’obugagga olwa Yeekaalu, Dawudi yeebaza Mukama olw’okubasobozesa okukikola. Yeekaalu bwe yaggwa, ne beebaza nate. Awo ekintu eky’ekitalo ne kibaawo, kubanga kyali bwe kityo, abafuuwa amakondeere n’abayimbi bwe baali ng’omuntu omu, okuvaamu eddoboozi limu okuwulirwa nga batendereza era nga bebaza Mukama... awo ennyumba n’ejjula ekire, ye nnyumba ya Mukama, abakabona ne balemwa okuyimirira okuweereza olw’ekire; kubanga ekitiibwa kya Mukama kyali kijjudde ennyumba ya Katonda. Abantu bwe baatendereza ne bebaza, awo ennyumba n’ejjula ekitiibwa kya Mukama. Era tuyinza okukakasa nti ensonga lwaki emitima gyaffe tegijjula “ekitiibwa kya Mukama” emirundi mingi, kwe kuba nti tetutuusa amaloboozi gaffe kuwulirwa mu kutendereza n’okwebaza Ye emirundi emingi.

Obanga okwebaza kwe kkubo ery’okuggulawo emiryango gya Mukama, ku luuyi olulala okwemulugunya kuggalawo emiryango gino. Yuda ayogera obunnabbi bwa Enoka obukwata ku baninnizi: “okulamula bonna n’okuvumirira aboonoonyi bonna olw’ebikolwa byabwe byonna eby’obumenyi bwe baakola mu ngeri ey’obumenyi, n’olw’ebigambo byonna eby’obukambwe aboonoonyi abamenyi bye baayogedde ku ye. Bano be beemulugunya, abanyiigira, abagoberera okwegomba kwabwe okubi” (Yuda 1:15-16). Abantu “abaninnira” n’“abeemulugunya,” mu kwemulugunya kwabwe, boogera “ebigambo eby’obukambwe” ku Mukama ebisinga bye bandiyagadde okwatula, oba bye baliyagala okwolekagana nabyo ku lunaku olw’enkomerero. Era si kya kwewuunya nti omusango gwa Katonda, mu kifo ky’“ekitiibwa kya Katonda,” gwe guvaamu.

Nnandyagadde okuba n’ebbanga okujuliza ebyawandiikibwa byonna mu Baibuli ebikwata ku kwebaza n’okutendereza Mukama. Kya bwesige okugamba nti biri bikumi na bikumi; era kya kwewuunya engeri gye byabuusibwa amaaso n’obunyiikivu. Nkwegayirira osome Zabbuli omusanvu ez’enkomerero, olabe ky’olowooza. Zijjudde okukulukuta olukalala lw’ebintu Omuzabbuli by’atukubiriza okwebazaako; byonna bikwata ku ngeri n’amakubo ga Katonda, bye tutayinza kuwakanya. Mu bungi bwazo si mikisa gyaffe egy’ekyama, wabula mikisa gya bulijjo egy’abantu bonna, era egirimu buli mukisa gwaffe ogw’ekyama gwe twetaaga. Naye mikisa gye twerabira bulijjo, kubanga tugitwala ng’egya bwereere, era tetugifaako, so tetugyebalizaako.

Naye Omuzabbuli yamanyi “okubala emikisa gye emingi, n’okugibala kimu kimu,” era ayagala naffe tukole bwe tutyo. Kigezeeko, omusomi omwagalwa, era ojja kwewuunya ddala okulaba Mukama ky’akoze. Yita mu Zabbuli zino olunyiriri ku lunyiriri, n’omukisa ku mukisa, olabe oba, ng’omulenzi omuto ow’olugero lwaffe, tosatulisibwa nti tewali we wamanyira nti “Katonda bw’asinga obulungi.”

Olunyiriri olw’enkomerero mu Kitabo ky’Ezabbuli, nga lugattiddwa ku kwolesebwa kwa Yokaana mu Kitabo ky’Okubikkulirwa, lwa makulu mangi nnyo. Omuzabbuli agamba nti, “Buli kirina omukka kitendereze Mukama!” (Zabbuli 150:6). Ate mu Kitabo ky’Okubikkulirwa, Yokaana, eyeeyita muganda waffe era munnaffe mu kubonaabona, atugamba nti yakiwulira nga kikolebwa: “Ne mpulira buli kitonde ekiri mu ggulu ne ku nsi ne wansi w’ensi ne mu nnyanja, ne byonna ebibirimu, nga bagamba nti, ‘Oyo atudde ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka n’Omwana gw’Endiga, baweebwe omukisa n’ekitiibwa n’ettendo n’obuyinza emirembe n’emirembe!’” (Okubikkulirwa 5:13). Ekiseera eky’okutendereza okw’ensi yonna kya lwatu okujja olunaku olumu. Ka tutandike okukola ekitundu kyaffe kaakati.

Nawulira lumu ku musajja atamativu, eyeemulugunya, eyafuuka omusanyufu era omuwoomu, ng’ajjudde okwebaza, ne kyewuunyisa mikwano gye. Bwe baamala okumwekaliriza akaseera, ne bakakasa nti enkyukakyuka yali ya lubeerera, ne bamubuuza ekyaliwo. “Owange,” yaddamu, “nakyusa ekifo we mbeera. Nnali mbeera mu Luguudo lw’Okwemulugunya, naye kaakati nzewukidde ne nsengukira mu Kifo eky’Okwebaza, era nsanga nga ndi mugagga nnyo mu mikisa nga bulijjo ndi musanyufu.”

Ka buli omu ku ffe asenguke kaakati?
fields.body_text: “Mwebazenga mu buli kintu; kubanga kino Katonda ky’abaagaliza mu Kristo Yesu” (1 Abasessaloniki 5:18). Okwebaza n’okwemulugunya mpisa bbiri ez’okwawukana. Emmeeme eyeebaza esobola okufuna ekiweweevu mu buli kintu; naye emmeeme eyeemulugunya teyinza kufuna kiweweevu mu kintu kyonna. Ekiragiro kya Katonda kyogera nti, “Mu buli kintu mwebazenga.” Kiragiro kikakafu. Bwe tuba twagala okugondera Katonda, tuteekwa okwebaza mu buli kintu. Tewali kkubo lya kukyewala. Naye Abakristaayo bangi bakitunuulira ng’“amagezi ag’obutuukirivu obungi ennyo” omuntu obuntu bw’atayinza kutuukako. Awatali kumanya, bakyusa ebigambo mu kyama ne bafuula “okugumiikiriza” mu kifo ky’“okwebaza,” ne “mu bintu bitono” mu kifo ky’“mu buli kintu.” Bawakana nti, “Singa buli kintu kivudde butereevu eri Katonda, nnandikikoze, naye ebintu ebisinga obungi bituuka gye ndi nga biyita mu bantu oba mu kibi.” Nziramu bwe nti: tetuyinza bulijjo kwebaza olw’ebintu byennyini, naye tuyinza bulijjo okwebaza olw’okwagala kwa Katonda okuli mu bintu ebyo. Ali mu byo wamu, ng’akaka n’ebisinga obungi okuba eby’ennaku okukolera awamu okutuviiramu obulungi. Okukkiriza tekulaba “ebivaako eby’okubiri” (abantu oba ensobi ezituluma); kulaba mukono gwa Katonda gwokka oguli emabega waabyo. Ebizibu bwe biba bituuse gye tuli, biba bifuuse kye Katonda ky’ayagala gye tuli era tuteekwa okubikkiriza nga biva mu mikono gye. Olugero lwa Yusufu lwe lubeera ekyokulabirako. Tewali kyandifaananye nga kikontana n’ekyo Katonda ky’ayagala okusinga Yusufu okutundibwa mu buddu baganda be. Naye singa yali amanyi enkomerero okuva ku ntandikwa, yandijjudde okwebaza. Obuddu bwe bwali oluggi olw’obutereevu olwamutuusa ku mikisa egisinga obukulu mu bulamu bwe. Ku nkomerero, Yusufu yasobola okugamba nti, “Mmwe mwanteeseza akabi, naye Katonda yakifuula akalungi” (Olubereberye 50:20). Eri eriiso ery’omubiri, baganda be be baamusindika e Misiri; naye eri eriiso ery’okukkiriza, “Katonda ye yantuma” (Olubereberye 45:7). Nzijukira ekigezo mu bulamu bwange kye naaleeterwa omuntu omulala. Najjula obujeemu obukaawa ne sirabamu kya kwebazaako. Naye ekigezo ekyo kyennyini kye kyanviiramu emikisa egisinga obugagga mu bulamu bwange. Singa nnali nnina okukkiriza okumala okwebaza okuva ku lubereberye, nnandyewalidde ennaku nnyingi nnyo. Ntya nti ekisingako waggulu Abakristaayo bangi kye batuukako kwe “kufuba okugumiikiriza” ebintu bye batayinza kukyusa. Okwebaza kumpi n’okuba omuzannyo ogutamanyiddwa. Mu nsi, kitwalibwa ng’ekitali kya mpisa okuweebwa ekirabo n’oba tewebazza; sirina kye ndaba ekyandifudde nga si kitali kya mpisa mu ngeri y’emu eri Katonda. Tetwandiroota kwerabira kuwandiikira mukwano gwaffe omuntu ebbaluwa ey’okwebaza olw’ekirabo ekitono, naye tulemwa okwebaza Katonda olw’emikisa egitabalika gy’atuyiwako. Ekisingako obubi, bangi beeganya okwemulugunya n’okuninnira. Tubuulirwa nti “abantu ne beemulugunya nga Mukama awulira ku bizibu byabwe, awo Mukama bwe yakiwulira, obusungu bwe ne bubuubuuka” (Okubala 11:1). Tukemebwa okulowooza nti okwemulugunya kwaffe okw’“eby’omwoyo” tekumunyiiza—nti kabonero ka bunyiikivu oba ka kutegeera kungi. Naye okwemulugunya kye kikontana n’okukkiriza okusanyusa Katonda. Naye okwemulugunya bulijjo kufaanana, ka kube ku mutindo ogw’ensi oba ogw’omwoyo. Bulijjo kulimu akaseera ak’okunoonya ensobi. Webster agamba nti okwemulugunya kitegeeza “okuleeta omusango oba okuloopa.” Si kwakukyawa kyokka ekyo kye tuteekwa okugumira; kwe kunoonya ensobi mu kigere ekiri emabega waakyo. Bwe twekenneenya n’obwegendereza omunda gw’okwemulugunya kwaffe, awamu tujja kusanga nti kusibuka ku kunoonya ensobi mu Katonda mu ngeri ey’ekyama. Mu kyama twewulira nga ye y’alina omusango, ne tumuvunaana mu mitima gyaffe. Ku luuyi olulala, okwebaza bulijjo kuzingiramu okutendereza Omuwi. Wali okabanjabye engeri gye tukubirizibwamu ennyo mu Baibuli “okutendereza Mukama”? Kwali kitundu kikulu mu kusinza kwa Isiraeri: “Mutendereze Mukama, kubanga Mukama mulungi; muyimbe ku linnya lye, kubanga kisanyusa!” (Zabbuli 135:3). Nzikiriza nti singa tubibala, twandisanze ebiragiro eby’okwebaza “bulijjo olwa buli kintu” nga bisinga obungi ebiragiro eby’ekikolwa ekirala kyonna. Kya lwatu nti Mukama ayagala okwebazibwa n’okutenderezebwa nga naffe bwe tuyagala. Kimuleetera essanyu ery’amazima, era okulemwa kwaffe okumwebaza olw’“ebirabo bye ebirungi era ebituukiridde” (Yakobo 1:17) kunuubula omutima gwe, nga n’egyaffe bwe ginuubulwa abo be twagala bwe balemwa okusiima kye tubawa. Omutume bw’atukubiriza okuba “abagoberezi ba Katonda, ng’abaana abaagalwa,” azingiramu kino: “nga mwebaza bulijjo olwa buli kintu eri Katonda Kitaffe mu linnya lya Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo” (Abaefeso 5:1, 20). “Bulijjo olwa buli kintu” kigambo ekibuna byonna. Kiteekwa okutegeeza nti tewali kintu mu bulamu bwaffe—ka kiyite mu ngeri yonna—ekitalimu mukisa ogukwekeddwa oguva eri Katonda. Omutume atugamba nti “buli kitonde kya Katonda kirungi, era tewali kya kugaanibwa singa kitwalibwa n’okwebaza” (1 Timoseewo 4:4). Naye kizibu okukkiriza nti ebintu birungi nga tebifaanana bwe bityo. Emirundi mingi, ebirabo bya Katonda bifaanana ng’ebikolimo eri abo abalaba kungulu kwokka. Ebirabo “ebirungi era ebituukiridde” bimeka bye twatunuulira ng’ebikolimo? Bimeka bye tweebaza ffekka, oba mikwano gyaffe, oba embeera zaffe, awatali kutunula emabega w’abawi ab’ensi okutuuka ku Muwi ow’omu ggulu? Kiba nga twebaza omubaka naye ne tutatuusa bubaka eri mukwano gwaffe eyaweereza ekirabo. Ne bwe tutegeera nti ebintu biva eri Katonda, kizibu okumwebaza olw’ekyo ekituluma. Naye twebaza omusawo omukugu olw’obujjanjabi, ne bwe buba obukakali. Tetusaanira kwebaza Musawo waffe ow’omu ggulu bw’atuwa eddagala eddulu okuwonya endwadde ey’omwoyo, oba bw’atukolako omulimu ogw’obulumi okutuggyako ekintu ekyonoona? Mu kifo ky’okumwebaza, tweemulugunya. Emirundi mingi okwemulugunya kwaffe tetukwolekeza Musawo, naye tukwolekeza “eccupa” mwe yaweerezza eddagala. “Eccupa” eno emirundi mingi muntu buntu, obutali bwa kisa oba okwerabira kwe kwatuleetera okubonaabona—naye be “kivaako eky’okubiri” Katonda kye yakozesa okutuwonya. Amagezi agalungi gatugamba nti kya busirusiru okuvuma eccupa y’eddagala; era kya busirusiru kye kimu okuvuma “ebivaako eby’okubiri” ebyagenderera okuyigiriza emmeeme zaffe. Abaisiraeri bwe baali batambulatambula, “beemulugunya ku Musa ne Alooni” (Okuva 16:2). Naye mu mazima, okwemulugunya kwabwe kwali kukolebwa ku Katonda, kubanga ye yali abaleese eyo. Omuzabbuli akiyita “okwogera obubi ku Katonda” (Zabbuli 78:19). Ebyafaayo eby’obwakatonda tebifaayo ku bivaako eby’okubiri; bidda butereevu ku Kivaako ekituufu ekiri emabega waabyo. Kale tuyinza okukikakasa nti okwemulugunya kwonna kwe “kwogera obubi ku Katonda.” Ebivaako eby’okubiri tebiyinza kukolako wabula Katonda ng’akkirizza; ekyo ky’akkiriza kifuuka kye yategese. Mukama yasunguwalira abeemulugunya “kubanga tebaakkiriza Katonda so tebeesiga bulokozi bwe” (Zabbuli 78:22). Mu ntobo, okwemulugunya kwonna kutegeeza nti tetwesiga bulokozi bwe. Omuzabbuli agamba nti, “Nnaatendereza erinnya lya Katonda n’oluyimba; nnaamugulumiza n’okwebaza. Kino kirisanyusa Mukama okusinga ente oba seddume” (Zabbuli 69:30-31). Bangi beetegefu okuwaayo ssaddaaka nnene, naye okutendereza okutono okw’amazima kwandimusanyusizza okusingawo. Baibuli akuyita “ssaddaaka ey’okwebaza” (Ebyabaleevi 7:12). Kikolwa kya kusinza. “Bawengayo ssaddaaka ez’okwebaza, era boogere ku bikolwa bye mu nnyimba ez’essanyu!” (Zabbuli 107:22). Kya bwangu okuwaayo, naye singa okusaba kw’Abakristaayo kwabalibwa olunaku lumu, ntya nti twandisanze—nga bwe kyali ku bagenge ekkumi—nti mu kkumi omwenda tebaawaayo kwebaza kwa mazima. Mukama waffe yanakuwazibwa abagenge abo abataasiima: “Ekkumi tebaalongoosebwa? Ab’omwenda bali ludda wa? Tewaliiwo n’omu eyalabise okudda okwebaza Katonda okuggyako omugwira ono?” (Lukka 17:17-18). Anaatubuuza kye kimu? Twewuunya obutasiima bwabwe, naye obwaffe bugenda butya? Tetuyita ku mikisa egitabalika ne tussa amaaso gaffe ku “bufiirwa” bwaffe okutuusa ng’eggulu lyaffe lyonna lijjudde bwo? Tuyinza okulaba engeri kino gye kiteekwa okunakuwaza Mukama nga twesunga ku nneewulira zaffe. Omwana eyeemulugunya ku ebyo omuzadde bye yamuteekerateekera anuubula omutima gw’omuzadde oyo emirundi mingi okusukka ebigambo. Ffenna tumanyi abantu abeemulugunya bulijjo—tewali kibasanyusa, era tewali kisa kye basiima. Tumanyi engeri okubeera nabo gye kutuleetera obutabeera bulungi, ate ku luuyi olulala, engeri obulamu gye bumasamasizibwa omuntu asanga eky’okusanyukira mu buli kituuka. Nzikiriza nti ennaku ennyingi ennyo eziletebwa mu mitima gy’abantu okuninnira kw’abo be baagala okusinga bwe tulowooza; era nzikiriza nti okunuubula kwe tutalowoozaako kuweebwa omutima gwa Kitaffe ali mu ggulu olw’okwemulugunya okutakoma okw’abaana be. Emirundi emeka bwe kigambibwa ku bantu abeeraliikirira nti, “Tewali kirituusa kubamalako?” Era emirundi emeka Katonda gy’ateekwa okukyuka, ng’anakuwazibwa okwemulugunya kwaffe, ate ng’okwagala kwe atuyiiseeko emikisa egitabalika. Oluusi ndowoozezza nti singa tukitegeera, twandiziyizza ennaku yaffe ey’ekitalo ne ku kufiirwa abo be twagala, ne tugezaako, ku lulwe, okuba abasanyufu era abamativu ne mu mbeera yaffe ey’obwannamunigina. Nzijukira okuwulira ku muwala eyayita mu bujjanjabi obw’obulumi bungi ennyo. Abasawo baatya nti anaakaaba nnyo, naye ne beewuunya bwe wataavaamu wadde okusinda. Yamwenyerera kitaawe kyokka. Bwe baamubuuza engeri gye yakikola, yagamba nti: “Namanya nnyo kitange bwe yanjagala, era namanya nga bwe yandibonyeebonye singa yandindabye nga mbonaabona, kyennava ngezaako okukikweka; ne nseka nsobozese kitange okulowooza nti sikifaako.” Waliwo ku ffe ayinza okukolera Kitaffe ali mu ggulu kino? Yobu yali mwemulugunya mukulu, era tuyinza okulowooza nti yalina ensonga ennungi. Yagamba nti, “Nkyawa obulamu bwange; kyenva nzita okwemulugunya kwange n’okwogera nga nva mu bukaawu bw’emmeeme yange” (Yobu 10:1). Tetuyinza kwewuunya nnyo. Naye singa yali asobodde okulaba oludda olw’obwakatonda, yandimanyi nti ebizibu bye baabikkiriza mu kwagala okusinga obuwewevu okumuleetera okubikkulirwa kwa Katonda kwe yandifunye mu ngeri endala yonna. Singa yalaba enkomerero okuva ku ntandikwa, okwebaza kwandikitutte ekifo ky’okwemulugunya. Abaana ba Isiraeri baali beemulugunya bulijjo. Beemulugunya bwe baabulwa amazzi, ate amazzi bwe gaaweebwa, ne beemulugunya nti gaali gakaawa. Naffe tukola bwe tutyo “amazzi” gaffe ag’omwoyo bwe gafaanana ng’agakaawa—emikolo egy’eddiini bwe gifaanana ng’egyetamiddwa era egitamalako. Tuva ku “nsulo z’amazzi amalamu” ne twemulugunya olw’“ebidiba ebyatika” bye tweyasimira, olw’okuba tebikwata mazzi (Yeremiya 2:13). Abaisiraeri beemulugunya ku mmere yaabwe, nga batya enjala, ate ne beemulugunya emanu bwe yaweebwa kubanga “bakyawa emmere eno etaliimu” (Okubala 21:5). Naffe tweemulugunya ku mmere yaffe ey’omwoyo—nti omubuulizi waffe tatuliisa oba nti tetulina birungi abalala bye balina. Tusaba emmere ate ne twemulugunya nti atuwadde ejjinja. Naye Musawo waffe ow’obwakatonda amanyi emmere n’ekyokunywa ebisinga okutugwanira. Ekyewuunyisa kiri nti tetusobola kukkiriza, awatali kulinda nkomerero, nti Omusumba amanyi eddundiro erisingira ddala obulungi. Yona atuwa ekyokulabirako ekirungi ennyo. Okusaba kwe okw’okwebaza kwava mu “lubuto lwa Sheoli”: “Nakoowoola Mukama nga ndi mu nnaku yange, n’anziramu... Naye nze n’eddoboozi ery’okwebaza nnaakuwaayo ssaddaaka” (Yona 2:2, 9). Tewali buziba bwa nnaku obusinga obunene ku ssaddaaka ey’okwebaza. Tetwebaza Katonda olw’ennaku, naye mu nnaku, nga tumanyi nti ali eyo okutuyamba n’okutuwa omukisa. Si lwa kuba nti ebintu birungi kyetuva twebaza Mukama, wabula lwa kuba nti ye mulungi. Tetuliimu magezi gamala kusalawo oba embeera nsanyu oba nnaku mu ntobo yaayo, naye tumanyi nti obulungi bwe bukakasa nti ekyo ky’akkiriza kiteekwa okuba olw’obulungi bwaffe obw’enkomerero. Mu katabo akayitibwa “Essanduuko y’Obwamisoni eya Mukyala Pickett,” omukazi eyali yeemulugunya obulamu bwe bwonna yasoomozebwa okuteeka essente mu ssanduuko olwa buli mukisa gwe yandizudde. Yagamba nti: “‘Emikisa emikulu nnina!’ bwe njogera... ‘Ndowooza abakaafiiri tebagenda kufuna kintu kingi ku nze.’ Nasalawo okubala, okwerabisa nzekka nga bwe nnina emikisa mitono.” Naye ng’atudde ku madaala ge, ng’awulira ku bakazi mu nsi endala abaali bafa enjala era abaabonyaabonyezebwa, yayogera mangu nti: “Bw’oba nga ndi nnamwandu, nsiima nga ndi mu kifo we nsobolera okwefunira ekyokulya kyange!” Mwana wa mwannyina n’amugamba nti ogwo gwe gwali omukisa gwe ogusooka. Yateeka wansi essente. N’ateekawo endala kubanga teyali Muchayina. Oluvannyuma n’atunda amagi—“essente ez’okutunda amagi”—era bwe yagezaako okugamba nti gwali si mukisa gwa Mukama, mwana wa mwannyina n’ayimba nti: “Ekisa kya Katonda kye kisa kyokka, era ekisa kyonna kya Katonda.” Mu bbanga ttono, yali anoonya ebintu by’ayinza okwebazaako, era essanduuko teyawuuma nnyo bwe yagisuukundanga. Waliwo Zabbuli gye mpita Zabbuli yaffe ey’Emikisa. Ye ya 103, era eyogera ku mikisa egimu Mukama gy’atuyiiseeko, n’atukubiriza obutagyerabira. “Weebaze Mukama, ggwe emmeeme yange, so toyerabira mikisa gye gyonna” (Zabbuli 103:2). Essanduuko y’Emikisa eya mwannyinaffe omwagalwa yali emuyigirizza ekimu ku makulu ga Zabbuli eno. Obulamu bwe bwonna yali yerabidde emikisa Mukama gye yali amuyiseeko, naye kaakati yali atandika okugijjukira. Ffe tutandise okujjukira egyaffe? Singa mu mwaka oguwedde twali tubaze emikisa egyo gye twali twebazizza mu mazima, essente meka, neebuuza, ze zandibadde mu ssanduuko zaffe? Oluusi tuyimba mu nkuŋŋaana z’obwamisoni oluyimba olw’okwebaza, olulina ekitundu eky’okuddiŋŋana nti, “Bala emikisa gyo emingi, ogibale kimu kimu, era kijja kukwewuunyisa Mukama ky’akoze.” Era oluusi neebuuza oba waliwo ku ffe abaali baluyimba n’omutima gwonna eyali akutte akalambulambu ka mikisa gye, oba mu mazima eyali amanyi nti alina gyonna. Kubanga ekizibu kiri nti emirundi mingi ebirabo bya Katonda bituuka gye tuli nga bisabikiddwa mu bibikka ebikakanyavu, ne tukemebwa okubigaana ng’ebitaliimu mugaso; oba ababaka ababireeta bajja mu kifaananyi ky’abalabe, ne twagala okubaggalirawo oluggi, obutabayingiza. Naye tufiirwa ebisinga bwe tuli bye tumanyi bwe tugaana n’ebisinga obutasuubirwa. “Obubi buddu bwa bulungi bwokka, N’ennaku ye muweereza w’essanyu: N’emmeeme eba ya ddalu egaana emmere Eva mu asinga wansi mu abo Katonda b’akozesa.” Tulagirwa okuyingira mu miryango gye n’okwebaza, ne mu mpya ze n’okutendereza, era nkakasa nti okwebaza gwe guddaano oguggulawo emiryango gino amangu okusinga ekintu ekirala kyonna. Kigezeeko, omusomi omwagalwa. Omulundi oguddako bw’onoowulira ng’ofudde, era ng’onnyogoga, era ng’oweddemu amaanyi, tandika okutendereza n’okwebaza Mukama. Weebalire wekka emikisa gy’akuyiseeko, omwebaze n’omutima gwonna olwa buli gumu, olabe oba omwoyo gwo teguba gutandika kwesitula, n’omutima gwo ne gubugumira. Oluusi, kiyinzika, oba weewulira ng’oweddemu amaanyi okusaba; kale gezaako okwebaza mu kifo; era nga tonnaba na kukimanya, ojja kwezuula ng’“osanyuse” mu bungi bw’ekisa kye n’okusaasira kwe. Omu ku mikwano gyange yaŋŋamba nti omwana we omulenzi ekiro kimu yagaana kirungullu okusaba. Yagamba nti tewali n’ekintu na kimu mu nsi yonna kye yali ayagala, era teyalaba magezi ga kusaba bintu by’atali kwagala. Ekirowoozo eky’essanyu kyajjira nnyina, n’agamba nti, “Kale, Charlie, ka twebaze olwa byonna by’olina.” Ekirowoozo ekyo kyasanyusa omwana, n’afukamira n’essanyu, n’atandika okwebaza. Yebaza Katonda olw’ensolo ze ez’omuzannyo, n’olw’akapiira akaggya akaali kaakamuweereddwa, n’olw’amagulu ge amaanyi agaali gasobola okudduka wala, n’olw’okuba nga si muzibe ng’omulenzi omulala gwe yamanyi, n’olw’kitaawe ne nnyina ab’ekisa, n’olw’ekitanda kye ekirungi, n’olw’omukisa ne gumu ku gumu, okutuusa olukalala bwe lwawanvuwa nnyo n’oyogera nti alowooza tewali we linaakoma. Era bwe baagolokoka okuva mu kufukamira, yagamba nnyina, ng’amaaso ge gamasamasa n’essanyu, nti, “Owange, maama, saamanyangako nti Katonda mulungi bw’atyo n’ekitalo!” Era nzikiriza nti singa oluusi tugoberera ekyokulabirako ky’omulenzi ono omuto, naffe twandizudde, nga bwe tutakozangako, obulungi bwa Katonda waffe. Kya kwewuunya nnyo okulaba engeri okwebaza gye kwakolagana n’okuzimba Yeekaalu. Bwe baali bamaze okukuŋŋaanya eby’obugagga olwa Yeekaalu, Dawudi yeebaza Mukama olw’okubasobozesa okukikola. Yeekaalu bwe yaggwa, ne beebaza nate. Awo ekintu eky’ekitalo ne kibaawo, kubanga kyali bwe kityo, abafuuwa amakondeere n’abayimbi bwe baali ng’omuntu omu, okuvaamu eddoboozi limu okuwulirwa nga batendereza era nga bebaza Mukama... awo ennyumba n’ejjula ekire, ye nnyumba ya Mukama, abakabona ne balemwa okuyimirira okuweereza olw’ekire; kubanga ekitiibwa kya Mukama kyali kijjudde ennyumba ya Katonda. Abantu bwe baatendereza ne bebaza, awo ennyumba n’ejjula ekitiibwa kya Mukama. Era tuyinza okukakasa nti ensonga lwaki emitima gyaffe tegijjula “ekitiibwa kya Mukama” emirundi mingi, kwe kuba nti tetutuusa amaloboozi gaffe kuwulirwa mu kutendereza n’okwebaza Ye emirundi emingi. Obanga okwebaza kwe kkubo ery’okuggulawo emiryango gya Mukama, ku luuyi olulala okwemulugunya kuggalawo emiryango gino. Yuda ayogera obunnabbi bwa Enoka obukwata ku baninnizi: “okulamula bonna n’okuvumirira aboonoonyi bonna olw’ebikolwa byabwe byonna eby’obumenyi bwe baakola mu ngeri ey’obumenyi, n’olw’ebigambo byonna eby’obukambwe aboonoonyi abamenyi bye baayogedde ku ye. Bano be beemulugunya, abanyiigira, abagoberera okwegomba kwabwe okubi” (Yuda 1:15-16). Abantu “abaninnira” n’“abeemulugunya,” mu kwemulugunya kwabwe, boogera “ebigambo eby’obukambwe” ku Mukama ebisinga bye bandiyagadde okwatula, oba bye baliyagala okwolekagana nabyo ku lunaku olw’enkomerero. Era si kya kwewuunya nti omusango gwa Katonda, mu kifo ky’“ekitiibwa kya Katonda,” gwe guvaamu. Nnandyagadde okuba n’ebbanga okujuliza ebyawandiikibwa byonna mu Baibuli ebikwata ku kwebaza n’okutendereza Mukama. Kya bwesige okugamba nti biri bikumi na bikumi; era kya kwewuunya engeri gye byabuusibwa amaaso n’obunyiikivu. Nkwegayirira osome Zabbuli omusanvu ez’enkomerero, olabe ky’olowooza. Zijjudde okukulukuta olukalala lw’ebintu Omuzabbuli by’atukubiriza okwebazaako; byonna bikwata ku ngeri n’amakubo ga Katonda, bye tutayinza kuwakanya. Mu bungi bwazo si mikisa gyaffe egy’ekyama, wabula mikisa gya bulijjo egy’abantu bonna, era egirimu buli mukisa gwaffe ogw’ekyama gwe twetaaga. Naye mikisa gye twerabira bulijjo, kubanga tugitwala ng’egya bwereere, era tetugifaako, so tetugyebalizaako. Naye Omuzabbuli yamanyi “okubala emikisa gye emingi, n’okugibala kimu kimu,” era ayagala naffe tukole bwe tutyo. Kigezeeko, omusomi omwagalwa, era ojja kwewuunya ddala okulaba Mukama ky’akoze. Yita mu Zabbuli zino olunyiriri ku lunyiriri, n’omukisa ku mukisa, olabe oba, ng’omulenzi omuto ow’olugero lwaffe, tosatulisibwa nti tewali we wamanyira nti “Katonda bw’asinga obulungi.” Olunyiriri olw’enkomerero mu Kitabo ky’Ezabbuli, nga lugattiddwa ku kwolesebwa kwa Yokaana mu Kitabo ky’Okubikkulirwa, lwa makulu mangi nnyo. Omuzabbuli agamba nti, “Buli kirina omukka kitendereze Mukama!” (Zabbuli 150:6). Ate mu Kitabo ky’Okubikkulirwa, Yokaana, eyeeyita muganda waffe era munnaffe mu kubonaabona, atugamba nti yakiwulira nga kikolebwa: “Ne mpulira buli kitonde ekiri mu ggulu ne ku nsi ne wansi w’ensi ne mu nnyanja, ne byonna ebibirimu, nga bagamba nti, ‘Oyo atudde ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka n’Omwana gw’Endiga, baweebwe omukisa n’ekitiibwa n’ettendo n’obuyinza emirembe n’emirembe!’” (Okubikkulirwa 5:13). Ekiseera eky’okutendereza okw’ensi yonna kya lwatu okujja olunaku olumu. Ka tutandike okukola ekitundu kyaffe kaakati. Nawulira lumu ku musajja atamativu, eyeemulugunya, eyafuuka omusanyufu era omuwoomu, ng’ajjudde okwebaza, ne kyewuunyisa mikwano gye. Bwe baamala okumwekaliriza akaseera, ne bakakasa nti enkyukakyuka yali ya lubeerera, ne bamubuuza ekyaliwo. “Owange,” yaddamu, “nakyusa ekifo we mbeera. Nnali mbeera mu Luguudo lw’Okwemulugunya, naye kaakati nzewukidde ne nsengukira mu Kifo eky’Okwebaza, era nsanga nga ndi mugagga nnyo mu mikisa nga bulijjo ndi musanyufu.” Ka buli omu ku ffe asenguke kaakati?

fields.title: Okufaananyizibwa Ekifaananyi kya Kristo
fields.body_html:
Kubanga abo be yamanya olubereberye, era yabateekateeka okufaananyizibwa ekifaananyi ky'Omwana we, alyoke abeere omubereberye mu booluganda abangi (Abaruumi 8:29).

Ekigendererwa kya Katonda ekisembayo mu kututonda kyali nti oluvannyuma tulyoke tufaananyizibwe ekifaananyi kya Kristo. Kristo yali wa kubeera omubereberye mu booluganda abangi, ne booluganda be baali ba kufaanana nga ye. Okukangavvulwa n'okutendekebwa kwonna okw'obulamu bwaffe kutunuulira ekigendererwa kino; era Katonda yateeka mu buli mutima gw'omuntu okuyaayaanira, ne bwe kuba nga tekutegeerekeka wadde okwogerwa, ekintu ekisinga obulungi n'obw'ekitiibwa kye kimanyi.

Kristo ye kyokulabirako kya buli omu ku ffe kye tuli ba kubeera nga tumaze okukolebwa. Twateekebwateekebwa okufaananyizibwa ekifaananyi kye, alyoke abeere omubereberye mu booluganda abangi. Tuli ba kubeera abagabanyi mu buntu bwa Katonda (2 Peetero 1:4) wamu ne Kristo; tuli ba kujjuzibwa omwoyo gwa Kristo; tuli ba kugabana obulamu bwe obw'okuzuukira, era n'okutambula nga bwe yatambula. Tuli ba kuba omu naye, nga bw'ali omu ne Kitaawe; n'ekitiibwa Katonda kye yamuwa, naye aki tuwa. Era bino byonna bwe biryakolebwa, olwo, so si nga tebinnaba kubaawo, ekigendererwa kya Katonda mu kututonda kiryatuukirira mu bujjuvu, ne tuyimirira nga tuli mu kifaananyi kye era nga tumufaanana.

Okufaanana kwaffe ekifaananyi kye kintu ekimaze okutuukirira mu birowoozo bya Katonda, naye, ka njogere bwe ntyo, tukyali mu kkolero, era Omukozi Omukulu Omukugu akyatukolako. Abaagalwa, kaakano tuli baana ba Katonda, era kye tuligenda okuba tekinnalabika; naye tumanyi nti bw'aliraga tuliba nga ye, kubanga tulimulaba nga bw'ali (1 Yokaana 3:2).

Era bwe kityo bwe kyawandiikibwa: Bwe kityo bwe kyawandiikibwa nti, Omuntu ow'olubereberye Adamu yafuuka omuntu omulamu; Adamu ow'oluvannyuma yafuuka omwoyo aleeta obulamu. Naye eky'omwoyo si kye kisooka wabula eky'obuntu, n'oluvannyuma eky'omwoyo. Omuntu ow'olubereberye yava mu nsi, muntu wa nfuufu; omuntu ow'okubiri ava mu ggulu. Nga bwe yali omuntu ow'enfuufu, era bwe batyo n'abo ab'enfuufu, era nga bw'ali omuntu ow'omu ggulu, era bwe batyo n'abo ab'omu ggulu. Nga bwe twambadde ekifaananyi ky'omuntu ow'enfuufu, era bwe tutyo tuliyambala ekifaananyi ky'omuntu ow'omu ggulu (1 Abakkolinso 15:45-49).

Kya njawulo nnyo okulaba nti enkola eno, eyatandika mu Olubereberye, egambibwa okutuukirizibwa mu Okubikkulirwa, omuntu eyafaanana ng'Omwana w'omuntu we yawa Yokaana obubaka buno obw'amakulu eri abawangula: Awangula, ndimufuula empagi mu yeekaalu ya Katonda wange. Talivaamu emirembe gyonna, era ndimuwandiikako erinnya lya Katonda wange, n'erinnya ery'ekibuga kya Katonda wange, Yerusaalemi omuggya, ekika okuva mu Katonda wange mu ggulu, n'erinnya lyange eriggya (Okubikkulirwa 3:12). Olw'okuba erinnya mu Baibuli bulijjo litegeeza empisa, obubaka buno tebusobola kutegeeza kirala okuggyako nti ekiseera ky'ekisembayo ekigendererwa kya Katonda kituukiridde, n'okukula kw'omwoyo okw'omuntu kutuukiridde, era afuuliddwa, Katonda kye yateekateeka okuva ku lubereberye, mu butuufu okumufaanana n'okuba ekifaananyi kye, ne kimusaanira okuwandiikibwako erinnya lya Katonda!

Ebigambo bibulwa maanyi mu maaso g'ekkomererero ery'ekitiibwa nga lino! Naye Mukama waffe akiraga edda mu kusaba kwe okw'ekyewuunyo, bw'asabira booluganda be nti bonna babeere omu, nga ggwe, Kitange, bw'oli mu nze, nange bwe ndi mu ggwe, nabo babeere mu ffe, ensi elyoke ekkirize nti ggwe wantuma.

Ekitiibwa kye wampa mbawadde bo, balyoke babeere omu nga ffe bwe tuli omu, nze mu bo naawe mu nze, balyoke batuukirire okuba omu (Yokaana 17:21-23). Obumu bwandibadde obwa kumpi oba obutuukiridde okusinga buno?

Paulo naye akiraga edda okutuukirira kuno okw'ekitiibwa bw'alangirira nti, bwe tubonaabona ne Kristo, era tuligulumizibwa wamu naye; era bw'akakasa nti okubonaabona okw'ekiseera kino ekya kaakano tekugeraageranyizika na kitiibwa ekiribikkulirwa gye tuli (Abaruumi 8:18).

Ebitonde byonna bilindirira okubikkulirwa kw'ekitiibwa kino; kubanga Paulo ayongera n'agamba nti ebitonde bilindirira n'okwegomba okungi okubikkulirwa kw'abaana ba Katonda (Abaruumi 8:19). Era ku nkomerero ayongerako nti so si bitonde byokka, wabula naffe, abalina ebibala ebibereberye eby'Omwoyo, tusinda munda mwaffe nga tulindirira n'essuubi okulongoosebwa okuba abaana, okununulibwa kw'emibiri gyaffe (Abaruumi 8:23).

Nga tutunuulira ekkomererero ery'ekitiibwa nga lino, lye sisobola kwogerako okusingawo ku kubukiriza, tetusaanidde na ssanyu okwaniriza enkola, wadde nga ziyinza okuba ez'obulumi, ze tugenda okutuukirira nazo? Era tetusaanidde kufuba n'obunyiikivu okuba nga tukola wamu naye (2 Abakkolinso 6:1) mu kuyamba okukituukiriza? Ye ye muzimbi omukulu omukugu, naye ayagala tumuyambeko mu kuzimba ekizimbe ky'empisa zaffe, era atukubiriza okwegendereza engeri gye tuzimbamu. Ffenna, mu buli kaseera k'obulamu bwaffe, tuli mu kuzimba kuno. Oluusi tuzimba n'embaawo z'omuwendo za zzaabu, na ffeeza, n'amayinja ag'omuwendo, ate oluusi tuzimba n'embaawo, n'essubi, n'ebisasiro. Era tulabulwa mu bukulu nti omulimu gwa buli omu gulyeraga, kubanga Olunaku lulugwolesa, kubanga gulibikkulwa n'omuliro, era omuliro guligezesa engeri y'omulimu buli omu gw'akoze (1 Abakkolinso 3:13). Tewali kwewala kino. Olunaku olwo bwe luliituuka, tetuyinza kusuubira kukweka mbaawo zaffe, na ssubi, na bisasiro, ne bwe tuba nga twakisobodde okukola bwe tutyo edda.

Mu ndowooza yange, tewali kifo kikakali mu Baibuli yonna okusinga ekiri mu Abaggalatiya ekigamba nti: Temulimbibwalimbibwa: Katonda tasekererwa, kubanga buli omuntu ky'asiga, era ky'alikungula. Kubanga asiga eri omubiri gwe, mu mubiri alikungula okuvunda, naye asiga eri Omwoyo, mu Mwoyo alikungula obulamu obutaggwaawo (Abaggalatiya 6:7-8). Bwe butakyukakyuka bw'ekintu kino bwe butiisa bwe butyo. Kikulu nnyo okusinga ekibonerezo kyonna eky'obuyinza obwereere; kubanga ekibonerezo oluusi kiyinza okwewalibwa, naye tewali ngeri ya kukyusaamu enkola y'etteeka ery'obutonde nga lino.

Mu Katekisimu gye nalaba gye buvuddeko waaliyo ebibuuzo n'ebiddibwamu bino: Kibuuzo: Empeera ey'obugabi kye ki?

Okuddamu: Obugabi obungi n'okusingawo.

Kibuuzo: Ekibonerezo eky'obukodo kye ki?

Okuddamu: Obukodo obungi n'okusingawo.

Tewali Katekisimu eyali yogedde bituufu okusingawo. Ffenna tukimanyi ku bwaffe. Mu lugero lw'ettalanta, Mukama waffe alaga etteeka lino eritayinza kwewalibwa. Okusalirwa omusango kw'omuddu atali mwesigwa oluusi kuyinza okuba nga kutulabikira ng'obutali bwenkanya, naye kwali kungula bukunguzi kw'ekyo omuddu oyo kye yali asize. Kale mumuggyeeko ettalanta mugiwe oyo alina ettalanta ekkumi. Kubanga buli alina aliweebwa n'asingawo, era aliba na bingi. Naye oyo atalina, n'ekyo ky'alina kirimuggyibwako (Matayo 25:28-29). Kino si kigambo kya buyinza bwereere, wabula kwe kubikkulirwa obuzaale bw'ebintu bwennyini, tewali n'omu ku ffe ayinza kubudduka.

Naye okuba abakozi wamu ne Katonda, tetuteekwa kuzimba na bikozesebwa bye byokka, wabula era ne mu nkola ze, era emirundi mingi tetuzimanyi. Endowooza yaffe ku kuzimba ya mulimu omuzibu, ogw'okuteganira, ogukolebwa n'entuuyo z'oku kyenyi kyaffe; naye endowooza ya Katonda ya njawulo nnyo. Paulo atubuulira kye kiri: Era ffe ffenna, nga tuli n'obwenyi obutabisiddwa, nga tutunuulira ekitiibwa kya Mukama, tufuulibwa ekifaananyi kye kimu, okuva ku kitiibwa okutuuka ku kirala. Kubanga kino kiva eri Mukama Omwoyo (2 Abakkolinso 3:18). Omulimu gwaffe kwe kutunuulira, era nga bwe tutunuulira, Mukama akola enkyukakyuka ey'ekitalo, ne tufuulibwa ekifaananyi kye kimu Omwoyo wa Mukama. Kino kitegeeza, mazima ddala, okutunuulira, si mu ngeri yaffe ey'ensi ey'okutunuulira obutunuulizi ekintu, wabula mu ngeri ey'obwakatonda ey'okukiraba ddala. Tuli ba kutunuulira ekitiibwa kya Mukama n'amaaso gaffe ag'omwoyo, era tuteekwa okugenda mu maaso nga tukitunuulira. Naye ekitiibwa kya Mukama tekitegeeza kumasamasa kunene oba engule ey'ekitangaala. Ekitiibwa kya Mukama ekituufu kye kitiibwa kya kye ali ne kye akola—ekitiibwa eky'empisa ze. Era kino kye tuli ba kutunuulira.

Ka mpe eky'okulabirako. Omuntu ansobya, ne nkemebwa okusunguwala n'okwesasuza.

Naye ntunuulira Kristo, ne ndowooza ku kyo kye yandikoze, ne nfumiitiriza ku bukkakkamu bwe n'obuwombeefu bwe, n'okwagala kwe eri omuntu oyo eyansobezza. Nga bwe ntunuulira, ntandika okwagala okuba nga ye, ne nsaba mu kukkiriza nfuulibwe omugabanyi mu buntu bwa Katonda (2 Peetero 1:4), n'obusungu n'okuwoolera eggwanga ne bifiira mu mutima gwange. Njagala omulabe wange era neegomba okumuweereza.

Kwe kutunuulira Kristo okwa ngeri eno kwe tuli ba kukyusibwa ne tufuuka ekifaananyi kye; era gye tweyongera okumusemberera, gye n'enkyukakyuka bw'eyongera okwanguwa.

Nawulira ku ndabirwamu ey'ekyewuunyo esayansi gy'emanyi eyitibwa endabirwamu ey'oluziga. Nsonda ya wolu ng'omunda gwayo gwonna gubikkiddwa endabirwamu. Erina amaanyi ag'okukuŋŋaanya emisinde gy'ekitangaala mu mitendera egy'enjawulo egy'amaanyi, okusinziira ku ngeri gye giba giri okumpi n'ekifo we gisisinkanira ku nkomerero ey'engulu ey'ensonda; amaanyi geeyongera okuba amangi nga ekifo eky'enkomerero we kisemberezebwa. Esayansi ezudde nti mu mutendera ogumu mu kutambula kuno okugenda ku kifo eky'omunda—embiriizi zonna ez'endabirwamu we zisisinkanira mu bumu obutuufu—amaanyi ag'okukuŋŋaanya gakuŋŋaanya ebintu byonna ebireeta ekitangaala eby'emisinde gy'enjuba ne bifuuka okumasamasa okw'amaanyi ennyo, ne kireeta ebintu okulabika ebitalabwangako maaso ga muntu. Kifuula n'omubiri okuba omutangaavu, ne kituyamba okulaba okuyita mu kibikka eky'oku ngulu eky'emibiri gyaffe okutuuka ku nkola ez'omunda wansi.

Nga tugenda katono mu maaso mu munda w'endabirwamu yaffe, ebintu eby'ebbugumu eby'emisinde gy'enjuba bikuŋŋaanyizibwa nnyo ne bivaamu ebbugumu erimala okusaanuusa ekyuma mu sikonda kkumi na mukaaga, n'okuggya ebitali byuma birungi mu zzaabu, ne kirekawo akatole akagumu ak'ekyuma ekirongoofu kyokka, mu sikonda kkumi na bina.

Nga tweyongera n'okugenda mu maaso, ebintu eby'okukuba ebifaananyi eby'ekitangaala ky'enjuba bikuŋŋaanyizibwa nnyo ne bissaako ekifaananyi eky'olubeerera eky'endabirwamu ku kintu kyonna ekiyisibwa mu kifo eky'okukuŋŋaanya okumala sikonda emu yokka.

Nga tweyongerayongera okugenda mu maaso, okumpi n'ekifo eky'obumu, amaanyi ag'okusika ag'ekitangaala gakuŋŋaanyizibwa nnyo ne kiba nti ekintu kyonna ekikibikkulirwako akaseera akatono ako kafuuka magineeti ow'amaanyi, oluvannyuma nga asika ebintu byonna gy'ali.

Ka kibe nga bino byonna bituufu mu sayansi oba nedda, sabaawo musayansi wa kumanya, naye wakiri kijja kukola ng'olugero okulaga enkulaakulana y'emmeeme, nga bw'ekyusibwa okuva ku kitiibwa okutuuka ku kitiibwa, mu nkula yaayo okufuuka ekifaananyi kye.

Ekisooka, nga bwe tutunuulira ekitiibwa kya Mukama ng'omu ndabirwamu, tutuuka ku kifo eky'okukuŋŋaanya ekitangaala, ekitulaga obwonoonyi bwaffe n'obwetaavu bwaffe. Yesu n'ayongera okwogera nabo, ng'agamba nti, Nze kitangaala ky'ensi.

Angoberera taritambulira mu kizikiza, wabula aliba n'ekitangaala eky'obulamu (Yokaana 8:12).

Eky'okubiri, nga bwe tusembera okumpi, tutuuka ku kifo eky'okukuŋŋaanya ebbugumu, obucaafu bwaffe bwonna ne ffeeza etaliimu mugaso we biriragalirwa. Kubanga afaanana ng'omuliro gw'omuweesi ow'okulongoosa n'ng'esabbuuni y'omwozi: Alituula ng'omuweesi era ng'omulongoosa wa ffeeza, era alitukuza abaana ba Leevi n'abalongoosa nga zzaabu ne ffeeza, era balireetera Mukama ebiweebwayo mu butuukirivu (Malaki 3:2-3).

Eky'okusatu, nga bwe tweyongera okusembera okumpi, tutuuka ku kifo eky'okukuŋŋaanya olw'okukuba ebifaananyi, ekifaananyi kya Kristo we kissibwa olw'olubeerera ku mmeeme zaffe, ne tufuulibwa okumufaanana kubanga tumulaba nga bw'ali.

Tumanyi nti bw'aliraga tuliba nga ye, kubanga tulimulaba nga bw'ali (1 Yokaana 3:2).

Eky'okuna era eky'enkomerero, nga bwe tutuuka ku kifo eky'obumu, tutuuka ku kifo eky'okusika, empisa zaffe we zifuulibwa okufaanana nnyo nga eza Kristo abantu, nga baziraba, ne basikibwa awatali kuziyizibwa okuwa Kitammwe ali mu ggulu ekitiibwa (Matayo 5:16).

Kale, bwe twagala okufuulibwa ekifaananyi kya Kristo, tuteekwa okubeera okumpi era okweyongera okumusemberera.

Tuteekwa okweyongera okumanya bulungi empisa ze n'amakubo ge; tuteekwa okutunuulira ebintu okuyita mu maaso ge n'okusalira ebintu byonna omusango okusinziira ku mitindo gye. Okufaanana kuno tekutuukirira lwa kufuba oba lwa kulwanirira; kutuukirira lwa kwefuulira. Okusinziira ku tteeka ery'obutonde, tukula ne tufaanana abo be tumala nabo ebiseera, era empisa ey'amaanyi ennyo bulijjo y'efuga. Era, olw'okuba etteeka ery'obwakatonda liri limu n'etteeka ery'obutonde—wabula likolera mu kitundu ekya waggulu era n'amaanyi agataziyizibwa—tekitusaanidde kutulabikira ng'ekyama nti tuli ba kufaanana Kristo olw'okwegatta naye mu mwoyo.

Naye nate nteekwa okuddamu okugamba nti okwegatta kuno ne Kristo tekuyinza kujja lwa kufuba kwaffe ffe, ne bwe kuba nga kwa maanyi kutya. Kristo ye wa kubeera mu mitima gyammwe olw'okukkiriza (Abaefeso 3:17), era teyinza kubeeramu mu ngeri ndala yonna. Paulo, bw'atubuulira nti yakomererwa ne Kristo, agamba nti: Nakomererwa wamu ne Kristo. Si nze nkyali mulamu, wabula Kristo abeera mu nze.

N'obulamu bwe mba nga mbaamu kaakano mu mubiri, mbulamu lwa kukkiriza mu Mwana wa Katonda, eyanjagala ne yeewaayo ku lwange (Abaggalatiya 2:20).

Kristo abeera mu nze—kino kye kyama eky'enkyukakyuka. Kristo bw'abeera mu nze, obulamu bwe, mu butonde bw'ebintu, buteekwa okweraga mu mubiri gwange, era siyinza kulema kukyusibwa okuva ku kitiibwa okutuuka ku kitiibwa ne mfuuka ekifaananyi kye. Okuyigiriza kwa Mukama waffe ku kino kwetegeevu nnyo: Beera mu nze, nange mbeere mu ggwe.

Ng'ettabi bwe litayinza kubala bibala lyokka, wabula bwe libeera mu muzabbibu, era nammwe bwe mutyo, wabula bwe mubeera mu nze. Nze muzabbibu; mmwe matabi. Abeera mu nze nange mu ye, oyo y'abala ebibala bingi, kubanga awatali nze temuyinza kukola kintu (Yokaana 15:4-5).

Kino kituufu ddala. Bwe tubeera mu ye, naye n'abeera mu ffe, tetuyinza kwewala kubala bibala bingi n'akatono, ng'amatabi g'omuzabbibu omulamu bwe gatayinza. Mu butonde bw'ebintu bwennyini, ebibala biteekwa okujja.

Naye tetuyinza kutwala omuntu ow'edda mu Kristo. Tuteekwa okwambula omuntu ow'edda n'ebikolwa bye nga tetunnaba kwambala Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo (Abaruumi 13:14). Omutume Paulo, bw'awandiikira Abakkolosaayi, azimba okugumya kwe okw'okubeera n'obulamu obutukuvu ku nsonga nti baali bamaze okukola kino: Temulimbagananga, kubanga mwambudde omuntu ow'edda n'ebikolwa bye, ne mwambala omuntu omuggya, akyusibwa okuba omuggya mu kumanya ng'ekifaananyi ky'eyamutonda bwe kiri (Abakkolosaayi 3:9-10).

Ekibi kiteekwa okubula Kristo bw'ayingira; tewali mmeeme etaali yeeteefuteefu kwewaayo buli kintu ekitakkiriziganya na kye ayagala eyinza kusuubira kumwaniriza. Omuntu ow'edda ateekwa okusuulibwa wabbali omuntu omuggya bw'aba wa kufuga. Naye byombi, okwambula n'okwambala, biteekwa okukolebwa lwa kukkiriza. Tewali kkubo lirala. Nga bwe ngezezzaako okunnyonnyola awalala, tuteekwa okuggya obuntu bwaffe, n'obwefaaza bwaffe, n'okwagala kwaffe mu ffe ne tubissa mu Kristo. Tuteekwa okwerowoozaako nga abafu eri ffe fennyini era abalamu eri Katonda yekka.

Bwe mutyo nammwe mwerowoozeeko nga abafu eri ekibi era abalamu eri Katonda mu Kristo Yesu. Kale ekibi kireme okufuga mu mubiri gwammwe ogufa, ne kibaleetera okugondera okwegomba kwagwo. Temuwaayo bitundu byammwe eri ekibi ng'ebyokukozesa eby'obutali butuukirivu, wabula mwewaayo mmwe eri Katonda ng'abo abaggyibwa mu kufa ne baleetebwa mu bulamu, n'ebitundu byammwe eri Katonda ng'ebyokukozesa eby'obutuukirivu (Abaruumi 6:11-13).

Okukkiriza okwo kwennyini okutusobozesa okukwata ku kusonyiyibwa kw'ebibi era kwe kuleeta okwegatta kuno ne Kristo. Eri abo abatategeera tteeka lya kukkiriza, kino awatali kubuusabuusa kijja kubeera kyama kinene nga bwe byali ebyama eby'amaanyi agasika ebintu wansi nga etteeka ery'okusikibwa wansi terinnazuulibwa. Naye eri abo abalitegeera, etteeka ery'okukkiriza likola awatali kukyamu era mu butuufu ng'etteeka ery'okusikibwa wansi, era livaamu ebibala byalyo mu butuufu bwe bumu. Tewali n'omu ayinza okusoma essuula ey'ekkumi n'emu ey'Abaebbulaniya n'alema okulaba nti okukkiriza ge maanyi agawangula byonna. Nze nzikiriza nti ge maanyi agatonda ensi yonna. Lye tteeka erya waggulu erifuga amateeka gonna aga wansi waalyo; ekyo ekirabika ng'ekyamagero mazima nkola ya tteeka lino erya waggulu erifuga.

Okukkiriza, nga bwe ngamba, lye tteeka ery'obutonde: Olw'okukkiriza tutegeera nti ensi zonna zaatondebwa n'ekigambo kya Katonda, ekyo ekirabika ne kitakolebwa mu bintu ebirabika (Abaebbulaniya 11:3). Tubuulirwa nti Katonda yayogera ne kikolebwa, yalagira ne kinywera. Era Mukama waffe atugamba nti bwe tuba n'okukkiriza, tuyinza okukola bwe kityo: Yesu n'abaddamu nti, Mube n'okukkiriza mu Katonda. Ddala ddala mbagamba nti, buli agamba olusozi luno nti, Situlibwe, osuulibwe mu nnyanja, n'atabuusabuusa mu mutima gwe, wabula n'akkiriza nti ky'ayogera kijja kubaawo, alikikolerwa. Kyenva mbagamba nti, buli kye musaba mu kusaba, mukkirize nti mukifunye, era kiriba kyammwe (Makko 11:22-24).

Okukkiriza, tubuulirwa, kuyita ebitaliiwo ne biba (Abaruumi 4:17). Olw'okubiyita, kubireeta mu bulamu. Kale, wadde nga tetuyinza kulaba kabonero konna ak'omubiri ak'enkyukakyuka nga olw'okukkiriza twambula omuntu ow'edda—ayonoonese ng'okwegomba okulimba bwe kuli—ne tulyoka twambala olw'okukkiriza omuntu omuggya—eyatondebwa ng'ekifaananyi kya Katonda mu butuukirivu obutuufu n'obutukuvu—wabula mu butuufu kikoleddwa. Okukkiriza kukituukirizza. Siyinza kunnyonnyola kino mu by'obwakabona, naye awatali kutya nsobola okukakasa nti mazima manene ag'omu bulamu. Emmeeme ezo ezirekera awo obulamu obw'okwefaako ne zeewaayo eri Mukama azitwaale ddala zizuula nti atwala ensulo ez'omunda ez'obulamu bwazo, era akola mu mmwe, okwagala n'okukola olw'okusiima kwe okulungi (Abafiripi 2:13).

Paulo yasabira Abaefeso Kristo abeere mu mitima gyammwe olw'okukkiriza (Abaefeso 3:17), era kino kye kyama kyonna eky'okufuulibwa ekifaananyi kye. Kristo bw'aba abeera mu mutima gwange, kwe kugamba nteekwa okufaanana Kristo. Siyinza kuba atali wa kisa, ow'obusungu, eyeenoonyereza, oba atali mwesigwa; wabula, obukkakkamu bwe, obuwoomerevu bwe, okusaasira kwe okw'ekisa, n'okugonda kwe okw'okwagala eri Kitaawe by'ayagala biteekwa okweraga mu ntambula yange eya buli lunaku n'emboozi yange.

Tetugenda kukyusibwa mu bujjuvu ne tufuuka ekifaananyi kya Kristo okutuusa lw'aliraga ne tumulaba nga bw'ali (1 Yokaana 3:2). Naye mu kiseera kino, ku kigero kyaffe ffennyini, obulamu bwa Yesu buteekwa okweraga mu mubiri gwaffe ogufa (2 Abakkolinso 4:11). Bweragibwa mu gwaffe? Tufuuliddwa nga tufaananyizibwa ekifaananyi kya Kristo abantu, nga batulaba, ne balaba akabonero ke era?

Mukyala w'omusumba Omumesodisiti yaŋŋamba nti lumu, bwe baali baakajja mu kifo ekiggya, omwana we omuto yayingira oluvannyuma lw'olunaku lwe olusooka olw'okuzannya n'aleekaana n'essanyu nti, Owaŋŋe maama, nsanze omuwala omuto omulungi ennyo, omwenkanyi, ow'okuzannya naye wano n'okwagala siyagala kuddayo mu maaso. Nsanyuse nnyo, munnange, bwe yaddamu maama omwagazi, ng'asanyukira essanyu ly'omwana we; omuwala omuto ye ani erinnya? Owaŋŋe, omwana n'addamu mu kiseera kimu ng'akakkanye, ndowooza erinnya lye ye Yesu. Ki, Furanka! maama eyeewuunya n'aleekaana, otegeeza ki? Kale, maama, n'addamu ng'yeewolereza, yali mulungi nnyo nga siyinza kumanya erinnya lye eddala okuggyako Yesu.

Obulamu bwaffe bufaanana Kristo bwe butyo omuntu yenna okusobola okutulowoozaako ekirowoozo ng'ekyo? Kya lwatu eri buli muntu atwetoolodde nti tubadde ne Yesu? Eky'ennaku, emirundi mingi si kya njawulo ddala? Abamu ku ffe si ba busungu era ba buzibu mu bulamu bwabwe nga kyandyogerwa ekya njawulo ddala ku ffe?

Paulo agamba nti tuli ba kubeera ebbaluwa eva eri Kristo... etaawandiikibwa na bwino wabula n'Omwoyo wa Katonda omulamu, si ku bipande eby'amayinja wabula ku bipande eby'emitima gy'abantu (2 Abakkolinso 3:3). Nzikiriza ddala nti buli mwana wa Katonda, mu nsi yonna, singa yatandika okuva leero okubeera ebbaluwa eva eri Kristo, ng'abeera n'obulamu obufaanana ddala Kristo eka ne bweru, tewandiyiseewo mwezi ng'amakanisa gajjudde abantu abaagala okumanya ebisingawo, nga bajja okulaba eddiini ki eyandifudde bwe kityo obuntu ne bufuuka ekintu eky'obwakatonda.

Ensi ejjudde abantu abatakkiriza mazima g'eddiini y'Ekikristaayo, era tewali kiribakkirizisa okuggyako ebituufu bye batayinza kuwakanya. Tuteekwa okubasisinkana n'obulamu obukyusibbwa. Bwe balaba nti edda twali ba busungu, kaakano tuli bawoomerevu; edda twali ba malala, kaakano tuli beetoowaze; edda twali beeraliikirivu, kaakano tuli bagumiikiriza era abateefu; era bwe tuba tusobola okukakasa nti y'eddiini ya Kristo evuddeko enkyukakyuka eno, tebayinza kwewala kukwatibwa.

Omusajja Omukristaayo eyali afunye ettutumu ery'okutya Katonda olw'omulimu gwe omunyiikivu, eky'ennaku era yalina n'ettutumu ery'obusungu obubi n'olulimi olwogi. Naye ku nkomerero, olw'ensonga gye tewali n'omu eyayinza kutegeera, enkyukakyuka yalabika ng'emujjidde. Obusungu bwe n'olulimi lwe ne bifuuka ebiwoomerevu era ebikkakkamu nga bwe byali edda eby'obukambwe era ebyogi. Mikwano gye ne balaba ne beewuunya, era ku nkomerero omu ku bo n'amubuuza obanga yali akyusizza eddiini ye. Nedda, omusajja n'addamu, sikyusizza ddiini yange, wabula ku nkomerero nkkirizza eddiini yange okunkyusa. Eddiini yaffe etukyusizza wa?

Kyangu nnyo okuba n'eddiini ey'omu kkanisa, eddiini ey'omu kukuŋŋaana okw'okusaba, oba eddiini ey'emirimu gy'Ekikristaayo, naye kintu kya njawulo ddala okuba n'eddiini eya buli lunaku. Okulaga okutya Katonda mu maka kye kimu ku bitundu ebisinga obukulu eby'Obukristaayo, naye era kya bulabe nnyo. Si kya bulijjo obutafuna Bakristaayo abakola obutuukirivu bwabwe mu maaso g'ab'ebweru balyoke balabibwe abantu, naye ababulwa nnyo okulaga okukkiriza kwabwe mu maka. Nnamanya lumu kitaawe w'abaana eyali ow'amaanyi nnyo mu kusaba mu kukuŋŋaana okwa buli wiiki era eyawuniikiriza nnyo mu kugumya bantu nga ekkanisa yonna yakwatibwa okutya Katonda kwe; naye bwe yaddayo eka oluvannyuma lw'enkuŋŋaana, yali munyiivu era mukambwe nnyo nga mukyala we n'ab'omu maka baali batya n'okwogera ekigambo mu maaso ge.

Era bwe musaba, temubanga ng'abannanfuusi. Kubanga baagala okuyimirira ne basaba mu makuŋŋaaniro ne ku nsonda z'enguudo, balyoke balabibwe abantu. Ddala ddala mbagamba nti, bafunye empeera yaabwe (Matayo 6:5). Ebigambo bino, bafunye empeera yaabwe, bindabikira nga bimu ku bikakali ennyo mu Baibuli. Kye tukola tulyoke tulabibwe abantu kirabibwa abantu, era ekyo kwe kukoma. Tewali kufaanana Kristo mu butuukirivu obwa ngeri eyo.

Obutuukirivu obufaanana Kristo bwe butuukirivu obugumira ebigezo ebya buli lunaku n'essanyu era obugumiikiriza wansi w'okusosonkerezebwa mu maka; obusasula obulungi olw'obubi era obusisinkana okukoonagana kwonna okw'obulamu obwa buli lunaku n'obuwoomerevu n'obukkakkamu. Bugumiikiriza era bwa kisa; okwagala tekukwatirwa buggya wadde okwenyumiriza; tekwegulumiza wadde okuba okw'ekyejo. Tekunoonya bibwo kwokka; tekusunguwala wadde okubiikira; tekusanyukira butali butuukirivu, wabula kusanyukira mazima. Okwagala kugumira byonna, kukkiriza byonna, kusuubira byonna, kugumiikiriza byonna (1 Abakkolinso 13:4-7).

Kino kye kitegeeza okufaananyizibwa ekifaananyi kya Kristo! Tumanyiiko ku butuukirivu obufaanana buno?

Oluusi twogera ku kutuukiriza kye tuyita emirimu gyaffe egy'eddiini, nga tutegeeza okuweereza mu kkanisa, ebiseera ebiteekeddwawo eby'okusinza, oba emirimu gy'Ekikristaayo. Tetulootako nti omulimu gwaffe ogw'eddiini gwa maanyi nnyo okusinga—okufaanana Kristo mu ntambula yaffe eya buli lunaku n'emboozi yaffe okusinga n'okuba abeesigwa mu bintu ebirala ebyo—wadde nga byegombebwa mu byo byennyini. Obutuukirivu bw'Abawandiisi n'Abafalisaayo bwali butuukirivu bwa bigambo n'ebigambo, n'obwa mikolo egy'obwedda; kino emirundi mingi kiwuniikiriza nnyo ab'ebweru. Naye, olw'okuba tekyali kirala, Mukama waffe akyenkanya n'ebigambo eby'amaanyi ennyo: Zibasanze mmwe, abawandiisi n'Abafalisaayo, bannanfuusi! Kubanga muwaayo ekimu eky'ekkumi ekya kaamintu, na diiri, na kamuni, ne muleka ebintu eby'etteeka ebisingako obuzito: obwenkanya, n'okusaasira, n'obwesigwa.

Bino mwandibikoze, awatali kuleka birala. Zibasanze mmwe, abawandiisi n'Abafalisaayo, bannanfuusi! Kubanga muli ng'amalaalo agasiigiddwa engobozi eyeeru, ku bweru agalabika amalungi, naye munda gajjudde amagumba g'abafu n'obucaafu bwonna (Matayo 23:23, 27). Era ayongerako nti, Bwe mutyo nammwe ku bweru mulabika ng'abatuukirivu eri abantu, naye munda mujjudde obunnanfuusi n'obujeemu (Matayo 23:28).

Kyangu nnyo okwogera ebintu ebirungi ku bulamu obw'eddiini, naye okuba mazima kye twogera nsonga ya njawulo ddala. Mmanyi omusomesa w'e Sunday School eyali ayigiriza abayizi be ennyo ku kusuula ebikweraliikiriza byonna ku Mukama n'okumwesiga mu biseera eby'okugezesebwa; baali bawuniikiridde nnyo. Naye ku nkomerero, akabi ne kajja mu bulamu bw'omusomesa ono, era abamu ku bayizi be ne bamulaba mu maka ge nga kikyaliwo. Mu kwewuunya kwabwe n'ennaku yaabwe, ne bamulaba ng'yeraliikirira, ng'atabusetabuse, ng'eeraliikirira, era ng'emulugunya; mu bufunze, ng'akola nga tewali Katonda wa kwesiga, oba ng'amakubo ge si makubo ga kwagala na bulungi. Kyali ekyokuyigirako eri abaana abo ekyayonoona obulungi bwonna okuyigiriza kw'omusomesa oyo okw'edda kwe kwali kulabika ng'okusobola okutuukiriza. Omu ku bo, eyali munyiikivu okwetegereza, yaŋŋamba n'obuwanguzi nti, Nnali ndowooza nti tekiyinza kuba kya mazima Muky'omuwala —— bw'atubuulira ku ngeri gye tuyinza okwesigamu Mukama mu buli kintu; ne kaakano ndaba nti kyali kwogera kwa kulaga bulungi kwokka, kubanga ye yennyini takikola.

Omukristaayo omunyiivu, oba eyeeraliikirira, Omukristaayo eyaggwaamu amaanyi, ow'ennaku, Omukristaayo abuusabuusa, Omukristaayo eyeemulugunya, Omukristaayo asaba nnyo, Omukristaayo omwefaako, omukambwe, ow'omutima omukakanyavu, Omukristaayo eyeefaako yekka, Omukristaayo ow'olulimi olwogi oba ow'omwoyo omukaawu—mu bufunze, Omukristaayo atafaanana Kristo—kya kumwenkanya okubuulira empewo n'okubuulira ab'omu maka ge oba mikwano gye abamulaba nga bw'ali. Tewali kudduka tteeka lino ery'ebintu eritayinza kwewalibwa, era kirungi tulikkirize amangu. Bwe twagala abaagalwa baffe okwesiga Mukama, ebitabo by'okwogera ku kino tebijja kubakkirizisa n'akatundu kamu ku lukumi ng'okulaba obwesige obutono obwa mazima ku ludda lwaffe mu kiseera eky'obwetaavu bwe kuli. Okusaba okusinga obuwanvu n'okubuulira okusinga eddoboozi tebigasa mu maka gonna, ne bwe byandikoze bulungi ku katebe k'okubuulira, wabula nga waliwo okubeera mu bulamu okw'olwatu okw'ebyo ebibuulirwa.

Abakristaayo abamu balabika ng'balowooza nti ebibala Baibuli by'esaba ngeri emu ey'emirimu gy'eddiini egy'okungulu, ng'okukuba enkuŋŋaana, okukyalira abaavu, oba okuddukanya ebitongole eby'obugabi.

Naye, amazima ge nti Baibuli tebyawa buwa bino ng'ebibala eby'Omwoyo, wabula egamba nti ekibala ky'Omwoyo kwe kwagala, essanyu, emirembe, obugumiikiriza, ekisa, obulungi, obwesigwa, obuwombeefu, okwefuga (Abaggalatiya 5:22-23). Empisa efaanana Kristo eteekwa okuba ekibala ky'okubeeramu kwa Kristo. Ebintu ebirala awatali kubuusabuusa biriva ku mpisa eno; naye ekisooka era ekisinga obukulu ye mpisa, oba ebirala byonna bijja kuba bikoola bwokka. Omuwandiisi ow'omu biseera bino yagamba nti: Omuntu tayinza kuba kisukka ku ekyo empisa ze kye zimufuula. Omuntu tayinza kukola kisingawo wadde ekisinga obulungi okusinga okuwaayo oba okulaga ekyo empisa ze kye ziri. Tewali kya muwendo kiyinza kuva mu muntu ekitasooka kubaamu mu muntu. Empisa eteekwa okuyimirira emabega n'okuwagira buli kintu—okubuulira, olunyiriri lw'ennyimba, ekifaananyi, ekitabo. Tewali na kimu ku byo kya muwendo awatali yo.

Okusobola okufaananyizibwa ekifaananyi kya Kristo, kya lubeerera tuteekwa okufuulibwa abagabanyi mu buntu bwa Katonda (2 Peetero 1:4). Era, bwe kiba bwe kityo, obuntu bwa Katonda obwo buteekwa okweraga. Ebitusanyusa, bye twegomba, n'ebigendererwa byaffe bijja kufaanana ebya Kristo; tujja kulaba ebintu okuyita mu maaso ge. Kino tekyewalika; kubanga obuntu bwa Katonda gye buli, ebibala byabwo tebiyinza kulema kweraga. Gye bitaba nga byeragidde, tuwalirizibwa okusalawo nti omuntu oyo, ne bw'aba alangirira atya n'eddoboozi, tannafuulibwa mugabanyi mu buntu bwa Katonda.

Nsobola okuwulira omuntu ng'abuuza nti, Naye otegeeza ddala okugamba nti, okusobola okufuulibwa abagabanyi mu buntu bwa Katonda, tuteekwa okulekera awo okufuba kwaffe ffennyini kwonna? Tuteekwa kwambala Kristo lwa kukkiriza kwokka, ne tumuleka abeere mu ffe era akole mu ffe okwagala n'okukola olw'okusiima kwe okulungi? Era okkiriza nti olwo alikikola ddala?

Ku kino nziramu n'amaanyi ennyo nti, yee, ntegeeza ekyo kyennyini. Ntegeeza nti bwe tweewaayo ffennyini eri ye ffenna, ajja n'abeera mu ffe era ye yennyini bwe bulamu bwaffe. Tuteekwa okuwaayo obulamu bwaffe bwonna eri ye: ebirowoozo byaffe, ebigambo byaffe, entambula yaffe eya buli lunaku, okutuula kwaffe n'okugolokoka kwaffe. Olw'okukkiriza tuteekwa okwewaayo ffennyini era, ka njogere bwe ntyo, okuyingira mu Kristo n'okubeera mu ye. Olw'okukkiriza tuteekwa okwambula omuntu ow'edda, era olw'okukkiriza tuteekwa okwambala omuntu omuggya. Olw'okukkiriza tuteekwa okwerowoozaako nga abafu eri ekibi era abalamu eri Katonda—nga abafu ddala nga bwe tuli abalamu.

Olw'okukkiriza tuteekwa okutegeera nti obulamu bwaffe obwa buli lunaku ye Kristo abeera mu ffe; era, nga tulekera awo emirimu gyaffe ffennyini, tuteekwa okumuleka akole mu ffe okwagala n'okukola olw'okusiima kwe okulungi. Si mazima agamukwatako ge gateekwa okujjuza emitima gyaffe, wabula ye yennyini—Kristo omulamu, omwagazi, ow'ekitiibwa—alikola, bwe tumuleka, mu butuufu n'atufuula ekifo kye eky'okubeeramu. Alifuga era alifuga munda mu ffe era ateekere ebintu byonna wansi we (Abafiripi 3:21). Kale, omuntu yenna bw'aba mu Kristo, aba kitonde kiggya. Eby'edda biweddewo; laba, ebiggya bizze (2 Abakkolinso 5:17).

Kyali si kigambo kya ngero busa Mukama waffe, mu Kubuulira okw'ekyewuunyo okw'oku Lusozi, bwe yagamba abayigirizwa be nti, Kale mmwe mube abatuukirivu, nga Kitammwe ali mu ggulu bw'ali omutuukirivu (Matayo 5:48). Yali ategeeza, mazima ddala, okusinziira ku busobozi bwaffe obw'obuntu, naye yali ategeeza amazima ago ag'okufaananyizibwa ekifaananyi kye kye twateekebwateekebwa. Era mu Bbaluwa eri Abaebbulaniya, tulagibwa engeri gye kiri okutuukirizibwa: Kale Katonda ow'emirembe eyakomyawo okuva mu bafu Mukama waffe Yesu, omusumba omukulu ow'endiga, olw'omusaayi ogw'endagaano etaggwaawo, abawe buli kintu ekirungi mulyoke mukole by'ayagala, ng'akola mu ffe ekyo ekimusanyusa mu maaso ge, ku bwa Yesu Kristo, ekitiibwa kibe gy'ali emirembe n'emirembe. Amiina (Abaebbulaniya 13:20-21).

Kya kubeera lwa kukola kwe mu ffe, so si lwa kukola kwaffe mu ffennyini, ekigendererwa kya Katonda kino mu kututonda we kiri okutuukirizibwa. Bwe kirabika ng'abamu ku ffe baali ewala nnyo ku kufaanana kwonna Kristo enkyukakyuka nga eyo ne kiba nga teyinza kubaawo, tuteekwa okujjukira nti Omutonzi waffe tannamala kututonda. Olunaku lulituuka, bwe tutaamuziyiza, omulimu ogwatandika mu Olubereberye lwe gulimalirizibwa mu Okubikkulirwa, era ebitonde byonna, awamu naffe ffennyini, biryebulibwa okuva mu buddu bwabyo obw'okuvunda ne bifuna eddembe ery'ekitiibwa ery'abaana ba Katonda (Abaruumi 8:21).

Kubanga tumanyi nti ebitonde byonna bibadde bisinda wamu mu bulumi obw'okuzaala okutuusa kaakano. So si bitonde byokka, wabula naffe ffennyini, abalina ebibala ebibereberye eby'Omwoyo, tusinda munda mwaffe nga tulindirira n'essuubi okuba abaana, okununulibwa kw'emibiri gyaffe (Abaruumi 8:22-23).

Kigwana okuba nti ky'oyagala kye kikolebwa ku lwange? Oba kye njagala?

Nange nfuulibwe ekintu, ekitali ng'ekikyo; ekyange, era ekijjudde obukuusa obusaddaakaza ennyo?

Ndizaalibwa Katonda, oba omuntu obuntu?

Mfuulibwe nga Kristo, oba ku nteekateeka endala?

Singa omulimu gwo mu nze gusukka amagezi gange, nga musukkuluma nnyo, nga muwanvu nnyo okusinga bwe nnyinza okutegeera.

Neesiga ddala. Weeyongere, Mukama, n'omulimu gwo omukulu!

Sirina kumanya, magezi, kutegeera, wadde kirowoozo, wadde okutegeera okusaanira okukukakasa mu mulimu gwo, ai Ggwe Atuukiridde. Ontuusizza ku kino, era laba! ky'okoze siyinza kukiyita kirungi. Naye nsobola okukaaba nti: Ai omulabe, Omutonzi tannamala; olunaku lumu olilaba, era olw'okulaba oliddukira ddala.
fields.body_text: Kubanga abo be yamanya olubereberye, era yabateekateeka okufaananyizibwa ekifaananyi ky'Omwana we, alyoke abeere omubereberye mu booluganda abangi (Abaruumi 8:29). Ekigendererwa kya Katonda ekisembayo mu kututonda kyali nti oluvannyuma tulyoke tufaananyizibwe ekifaananyi kya Kristo. Kristo yali wa kubeera omubereberye mu booluganda abangi, ne booluganda be baali ba kufaanana nga ye. Okukangavvulwa n'okutendekebwa kwonna okw'obulamu bwaffe kutunuulira ekigendererwa kino; era Katonda yateeka mu buli mutima gw'omuntu okuyaayaanira, ne bwe kuba nga tekutegeerekeka wadde okwogerwa, ekintu ekisinga obulungi n'obw'ekitiibwa kye kimanyi. Kristo ye kyokulabirako kya buli omu ku ffe kye tuli ba kubeera nga tumaze okukolebwa. Twateekebwateekebwa okufaananyizibwa ekifaananyi kye, alyoke abeere omubereberye mu booluganda abangi. Tuli ba kubeera abagabanyi mu buntu bwa Katonda (2 Peetero 1:4) wamu ne Kristo; tuli ba kujjuzibwa omwoyo gwa Kristo; tuli ba kugabana obulamu bwe obw'okuzuukira, era n'okutambula nga bwe yatambula. Tuli ba kuba omu naye, nga bw'ali omu ne Kitaawe; n'ekitiibwa Katonda kye yamuwa, naye aki tuwa. Era bino byonna bwe biryakolebwa, olwo, so si nga tebinnaba kubaawo, ekigendererwa kya Katonda mu kututonda kiryatuukirira mu bujjuvu, ne tuyimirira nga tuli mu kifaananyi kye era nga tumufaanana. Okufaanana kwaffe ekifaananyi kye kintu ekimaze okutuukirira mu birowoozo bya Katonda, naye, ka njogere bwe ntyo, tukyali mu kkolero, era Omukozi Omukulu Omukugu akyatukolako. Abaagalwa, kaakano tuli baana ba Katonda, era kye tuligenda okuba tekinnalabika; naye tumanyi nti bw'aliraga tuliba nga ye, kubanga tulimulaba nga bw'ali (1 Yokaana 3:2). Era bwe kityo bwe kyawandiikibwa: Bwe kityo bwe kyawandiikibwa nti, Omuntu ow'olubereberye Adamu yafuuka omuntu omulamu; Adamu ow'oluvannyuma yafuuka omwoyo aleeta obulamu. Naye eky'omwoyo si kye kisooka wabula eky'obuntu, n'oluvannyuma eky'omwoyo. Omuntu ow'olubereberye yava mu nsi, muntu wa nfuufu; omuntu ow'okubiri ava mu ggulu. Nga bwe yali omuntu ow'enfuufu, era bwe batyo n'abo ab'enfuufu, era nga bw'ali omuntu ow'omu ggulu, era bwe batyo n'abo ab'omu ggulu. Nga bwe twambadde ekifaananyi ky'omuntu ow'enfuufu, era bwe tutyo tuliyambala ekifaananyi ky'omuntu ow'omu ggulu (1 Abakkolinso 15:45-49). Kya njawulo nnyo okulaba nti enkola eno, eyatandika mu Olubereberye, egambibwa okutuukirizibwa mu Okubikkulirwa, omuntu eyafaanana ng'Omwana w'omuntu we yawa Yokaana obubaka buno obw'amakulu eri abawangula: Awangula, ndimufuula empagi mu yeekaalu ya Katonda wange. Talivaamu emirembe gyonna, era ndimuwandiikako erinnya lya Katonda wange, n'erinnya ery'ekibuga kya Katonda wange, Yerusaalemi omuggya, ekika okuva mu Katonda wange mu ggulu, n'erinnya lyange eriggya (Okubikkulirwa 3:12). Olw'okuba erinnya mu Baibuli bulijjo litegeeza empisa, obubaka buno tebusobola kutegeeza kirala okuggyako nti ekiseera ky'ekisembayo ekigendererwa kya Katonda kituukiridde, n'okukula kw'omwoyo okw'omuntu kutuukiridde, era afuuliddwa, Katonda kye yateekateeka okuva ku lubereberye, mu butuufu okumufaanana n'okuba ekifaananyi kye, ne kimusaanira okuwandiikibwako erinnya lya Katonda! Ebigambo bibulwa maanyi mu maaso g'ekkomererero ery'ekitiibwa nga lino! Naye Mukama waffe akiraga edda mu kusaba kwe okw'ekyewuunyo, bw'asabira booluganda be nti bonna babeere omu, nga ggwe, Kitange, bw'oli mu nze, nange bwe ndi mu ggwe, nabo babeere mu ffe, ensi elyoke ekkirize nti ggwe wantuma. Ekitiibwa kye wampa mbawadde bo, balyoke babeere omu nga ffe bwe tuli omu, nze mu bo naawe mu nze, balyoke batuukirire okuba omu (Yokaana 17:21-23). Obumu bwandibadde obwa kumpi oba obutuukiridde okusinga buno? Paulo naye akiraga edda okutuukirira kuno okw'ekitiibwa bw'alangirira nti, bwe tubonaabona ne Kristo, era tuligulumizibwa wamu naye; era bw'akakasa nti okubonaabona okw'ekiseera kino ekya kaakano tekugeraageranyizika na kitiibwa ekiribikkulirwa gye tuli (Abaruumi 8:18). Ebitonde byonna bilindirira okubikkulirwa kw'ekitiibwa kino; kubanga Paulo ayongera n'agamba nti ebitonde bilindirira n'okwegomba okungi okubikkulirwa kw'abaana ba Katonda (Abaruumi 8:19). Era ku nkomerero ayongerako nti so si bitonde byokka, wabula naffe, abalina ebibala ebibereberye eby'Omwoyo, tusinda munda mwaffe nga tulindirira n'essuubi okulongoosebwa okuba abaana, okununulibwa kw'emibiri gyaffe (Abaruumi 8:23). Nga tutunuulira ekkomererero ery'ekitiibwa nga lino, lye sisobola kwogerako okusingawo ku kubukiriza, tetusaanidde na ssanyu okwaniriza enkola, wadde nga ziyinza okuba ez'obulumi, ze tugenda okutuukirira nazo? Era tetusaanidde kufuba n'obunyiikivu okuba nga tukola wamu naye (2 Abakkolinso 6:1) mu kuyamba okukituukiriza? Ye ye muzimbi omukulu omukugu, naye ayagala tumuyambeko mu kuzimba ekizimbe ky'empisa zaffe, era atukubiriza okwegendereza engeri gye tuzimbamu. Ffenna, mu buli kaseera k'obulamu bwaffe, tuli mu kuzimba kuno. Oluusi tuzimba n'embaawo z'omuwendo za zzaabu, na ffeeza, n'amayinja ag'omuwendo, ate oluusi tuzimba n'embaawo, n'essubi, n'ebisasiro. Era tulabulwa mu bukulu nti omulimu gwa buli omu gulyeraga, kubanga Olunaku lulugwolesa, kubanga gulibikkulwa n'omuliro, era omuliro guligezesa engeri y'omulimu buli omu gw'akoze (1 Abakkolinso 3:13). Tewali kwewala kino. Olunaku olwo bwe luliituuka, tetuyinza kusuubira kukweka mbaawo zaffe, na ssubi, na bisasiro, ne bwe tuba nga twakisobodde okukola bwe tutyo edda. Mu ndowooza yange, tewali kifo kikakali mu Baibuli yonna okusinga ekiri mu Abaggalatiya ekigamba nti: Temulimbibwalimbibwa: Katonda tasekererwa, kubanga buli omuntu ky'asiga, era ky'alikungula. Kubanga asiga eri omubiri gwe, mu mubiri alikungula okuvunda, naye asiga eri Omwoyo, mu Mwoyo alikungula obulamu obutaggwaawo (Abaggalatiya 6:7-8). Bwe butakyukakyuka bw'ekintu kino bwe butiisa bwe butyo. Kikulu nnyo okusinga ekibonerezo kyonna eky'obuyinza obwereere; kubanga ekibonerezo oluusi kiyinza okwewalibwa, naye tewali ngeri ya kukyusaamu enkola y'etteeka ery'obutonde nga lino. Mu Katekisimu gye nalaba gye buvuddeko waaliyo ebibuuzo n'ebiddibwamu bino: Kibuuzo: Empeera ey'obugabi kye ki? Okuddamu: Obugabi obungi n'okusingawo. Kibuuzo: Ekibonerezo eky'obukodo kye ki? Okuddamu: Obukodo obungi n'okusingawo. Tewali Katekisimu eyali yogedde bituufu okusingawo. Ffenna tukimanyi ku bwaffe. Mu lugero lw'ettalanta, Mukama waffe alaga etteeka lino eritayinza kwewalibwa. Okusalirwa omusango kw'omuddu atali mwesigwa oluusi kuyinza okuba nga kutulabikira ng'obutali bwenkanya, naye kwali kungula bukunguzi kw'ekyo omuddu oyo kye yali asize. Kale mumuggyeeko ettalanta mugiwe oyo alina ettalanta ekkumi. Kubanga buli alina aliweebwa n'asingawo, era aliba na bingi. Naye oyo atalina, n'ekyo ky'alina kirimuggyibwako (Matayo 25:28-29). Kino si kigambo kya buyinza bwereere, wabula kwe kubikkulirwa obuzaale bw'ebintu bwennyini, tewali n'omu ku ffe ayinza kubudduka. Naye okuba abakozi wamu ne Katonda, tetuteekwa kuzimba na bikozesebwa bye byokka, wabula era ne mu nkola ze, era emirundi mingi tetuzimanyi. Endowooza yaffe ku kuzimba ya mulimu omuzibu, ogw'okuteganira, ogukolebwa n'entuuyo z'oku kyenyi kyaffe; naye endowooza ya Katonda ya njawulo nnyo. Paulo atubuulira kye kiri: Era ffe ffenna, nga tuli n'obwenyi obutabisiddwa, nga tutunuulira ekitiibwa kya Mukama, tufuulibwa ekifaananyi kye kimu, okuva ku kitiibwa okutuuka ku kirala. Kubanga kino kiva eri Mukama Omwoyo (2 Abakkolinso 3:18). Omulimu gwaffe kwe kutunuulira, era nga bwe tutunuulira, Mukama akola enkyukakyuka ey'ekitalo, ne tufuulibwa ekifaananyi kye kimu Omwoyo wa Mukama. Kino kitegeeza, mazima ddala, okutunuulira, si mu ngeri yaffe ey'ensi ey'okutunuulira obutunuulizi ekintu, wabula mu ngeri ey'obwakatonda ey'okukiraba ddala. Tuli ba kutunuulira ekitiibwa kya Mukama n'amaaso gaffe ag'omwoyo, era tuteekwa okugenda mu maaso nga tukitunuulira. Naye ekitiibwa kya Mukama tekitegeeza kumasamasa kunene oba engule ey'ekitangaala. Ekitiibwa kya Mukama ekituufu kye kitiibwa kya kye ali ne kye akola—ekitiibwa eky'empisa ze. Era kino kye tuli ba kutunuulira. Ka mpe eky'okulabirako. Omuntu ansobya, ne nkemebwa okusunguwala n'okwesasuza. Naye ntunuulira Kristo, ne ndowooza ku kyo kye yandikoze, ne nfumiitiriza ku bukkakkamu bwe n'obuwombeefu bwe, n'okwagala kwe eri omuntu oyo eyansobezza. Nga bwe ntunuulira, ntandika okwagala okuba nga ye, ne nsaba mu kukkiriza nfuulibwe omugabanyi mu buntu bwa Katonda (2 Peetero 1:4), n'obusungu n'okuwoolera eggwanga ne bifiira mu mutima gwange. Njagala omulabe wange era neegomba okumuweereza. Kwe kutunuulira Kristo okwa ngeri eno kwe tuli ba kukyusibwa ne tufuuka ekifaananyi kye; era gye tweyongera okumusemberera, gye n'enkyukakyuka bw'eyongera okwanguwa. Nawulira ku ndabirwamu ey'ekyewuunyo esayansi gy'emanyi eyitibwa endabirwamu ey'oluziga. Nsonda ya wolu ng'omunda gwayo gwonna gubikkiddwa endabirwamu.
