Erina amaanyi ag'okukuŋŋaanya emisinde gy'ekitangaala mu mitendera egy'enjawulo egy'amaanyi, okusinziira ku ngeri gye giba giri okumpi n'ekifo we gisisinkanira ku nkomerero ey'engulu ey'ensonda; amaanyi geeyongera okuba amangi nga ekifo eky'enkomerero we kisemberezebwa. Esayansi ezudde nti mu mutendera ogumu mu kutambula kuno okugenda ku kifo eky'omunda—embiriizi zonna ez'endabirwamu we zisisinkanira mu bumu obutuufu—amaanyi ag'okukuŋŋaanya gakuŋŋaanya ebintu byonna ebireeta ekitangaala eby'emisinde gy'enjuba ne bifuuka okumasamasa okw'amaanyi ennyo, ne kireeta ebintu okulabika ebitalabwangako maaso ga muntu. Kifuula n'omubiri okuba omutangaavu, ne kituyamba okulaba okuyita mu kibikka eky'oku ngulu eky'emibiri gyaffe okutuuka ku nkola ez'omunda wansi. Nga tugenda katono mu maaso mu munda w'endabirwamu yaffe, ebintu eby'ebbugumu eby'emisinde gy'enjuba bikuŋŋaanyizibwa nnyo ne bivaamu ebbugumu erimala okusaanuusa ekyuma mu sikonda kkumi na mukaaga, n'okuggya ebitali byuma birungi mu zzaabu, ne kirekawo akatole akagumu ak'ekyuma ekirongoofu kyokka, mu sikonda kkumi na bina. Nga tweyongera n'okugenda mu maaso, ebintu eby'okukuba ebifaananyi eby'ekitangaala ky'enjuba bikuŋŋaanyizibwa nnyo ne bissaako ekifaananyi eky'olubeerera eky'endabirwamu ku kintu kyonna ekiyisibwa mu kifo eky'okukuŋŋaanya okumala sikonda emu yokka. Nga tweyongerayongera okugenda mu maaso, okumpi n'ekifo eky'obumu, amaanyi ag'okusika ag'ekitangaala gakuŋŋaanyizibwa nnyo ne kiba nti ekintu kyonna ekikibikkulirwako akaseera akatono ako kafuuka magineeti ow'amaanyi, oluvannyuma nga asika ebintu byonna gy'ali. Ka kibe nga bino byonna bituufu mu sayansi oba nedda, sabaawo musayansi wa kumanya, naye wakiri kijja kukola ng'olugero okulaga enkulaakulana y'emmeeme, nga bw'ekyusibwa okuva ku kitiibwa okutuuka ku kitiibwa, mu nkula yaayo okufuuka ekifaananyi kye. Ekisooka, nga bwe tutunuulira ekitiibwa kya Mukama ng'omu ndabirwamu, tutuuka ku kifo eky'okukuŋŋaanya ekitangaala, ekitulaga obwonoonyi bwaffe n'obwetaavu bwaffe. Yesu n'ayongera okwogera nabo, ng'agamba nti, Nze kitangaala ky'ensi. Angoberera taritambulira mu kizikiza, wabula aliba n'ekitangaala eky'obulamu (Yokaana 8:12). Eky'okubiri, nga bwe tusembera okumpi, tutuuka ku kifo eky'okukuŋŋaanya ebbugumu, obucaafu bwaffe bwonna ne ffeeza etaliimu mugaso we biriragalirwa. Kubanga afaanana ng'omuliro gw'omuweesi ow'okulongoosa n'ng'esabbuuni y'omwozi: Alituula ng'omuweesi era ng'omulongoosa wa ffeeza, era alitukuza abaana ba Leevi n'abalongoosa nga zzaabu ne ffeeza, era balireetera Mukama ebiweebwayo mu butuukirivu (Malaki 3:2-3). Eky'okusatu, nga bwe tweyongera okusembera okumpi, tutuuka ku kifo eky'okukuŋŋaanya olw'okukuba ebifaananyi, ekifaananyi kya Kristo we kissibwa olw'olubeerera ku mmeeme zaffe, ne tufuulibwa okumufaanana kubanga tumulaba nga bw'ali. Tumanyi nti bw'aliraga tuliba nga ye, kubanga tulimulaba nga bw'ali (1 Yokaana 3:2). Eky'okuna era eky'enkomerero, nga bwe tutuuka ku kifo eky'obumu, tutuuka ku kifo eky'okusika, empisa zaffe we zifuulibwa okufaanana nnyo nga eza Kristo abantu, nga baziraba, ne basikibwa awatali kuziyizibwa okuwa Kitammwe ali mu ggulu ekitiibwa (Matayo 5:16). Kale, bwe twagala okufuulibwa ekifaananyi kya Kristo, tuteekwa okubeera okumpi era okweyongera okumusemberera. Tuteekwa okweyongera okumanya bulungi empisa ze n'amakubo ge; tuteekwa okutunuulira ebintu okuyita mu maaso ge n'okusalira ebintu byonna omusango okusinziira ku mitindo gye. Okufaanana kuno tekutuukirira lwa kufuba oba lwa kulwanirira; kutuukirira lwa kwefuulira. Okusinziira ku tteeka ery'obutonde, tukula ne tufaanana abo be tumala nabo ebiseera, era empisa ey'amaanyi ennyo bulijjo y'efuga. Era, olw'okuba etteeka ery'obwakatonda liri limu n'etteeka ery'obutonde—wabula likolera mu kitundu ekya waggulu era n'amaanyi agataziyizibwa—tekitusaanidde kutulabikira ng'ekyama nti tuli ba kufaanana Kristo olw'okwegatta naye mu mwoyo. Naye nate nteekwa okuddamu okugamba nti okwegatta kuno ne Kristo tekuyinza kujja lwa kufuba kwaffe ffe, ne bwe kuba nga kwa maanyi kutya. Kristo ye wa kubeera mu mitima gyammwe olw'okukkiriza (Abaefeso 3:17), era teyinza kubeeramu mu ngeri ndala yonna. Paulo, bw'atubuulira nti yakomererwa ne Kristo, agamba nti: Nakomererwa wamu ne Kristo. Si nze nkyali mulamu, wabula Kristo abeera mu nze. N'obulamu bwe mba nga mbaamu kaakano mu mubiri, mbulamu lwa kukkiriza mu Mwana wa Katonda, eyanjagala ne yeewaayo ku lwange (Abaggalatiya 2:20). Kristo abeera mu nze—kino kye kyama eky'enkyukakyuka. Kristo bw'abeera mu nze, obulamu bwe, mu butonde bw'ebintu, buteekwa okweraga mu mubiri gwange, era siyinza kulema kukyusibwa okuva ku kitiibwa okutuuka ku kitiibwa ne mfuuka ekifaananyi kye. Okuyigiriza kwa Mukama waffe ku kino kwetegeevu nnyo: Beera mu nze, nange mbeere mu ggwe. Ng'ettabi bwe litayinza kubala bibala lyokka, wabula bwe libeera mu muzabbibu, era nammwe bwe mutyo, wabula bwe mubeera mu nze. Nze muzabbibu; mmwe matabi. Abeera mu nze nange mu ye, oyo y'abala ebibala bingi, kubanga awatali nze temuyinza kukola kintu (Yokaana 15:4-5). Kino kituufu ddala. Bwe tubeera mu ye, naye n'abeera mu ffe, tetuyinza kwewala kubala bibala bingi n'akatono, ng'amatabi g'omuzabbibu omulamu bwe gatayinza. Mu butonde bw'ebintu bwennyini, ebibala biteekwa okujja. Naye tetuyinza kutwala omuntu ow'edda mu Kristo. Tuteekwa okwambula omuntu ow'edda n'ebikolwa bye nga tetunnaba kwambala Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo (Abaruumi 13:14). Omutume Paulo, bw'awandiikira Abakkolosaayi, azimba okugumya kwe okw'okubeera n'obulamu obutukuvu ku nsonga nti baali bamaze okukola kino: Temulimbagananga, kubanga mwambudde omuntu ow'edda n'ebikolwa bye, ne mwambala omuntu omuggya, akyusibwa okuba omuggya mu kumanya ng'ekifaananyi ky'eyamutonda bwe kiri (Abakkolosaayi 3:9-10). Ekibi kiteekwa okubula Kristo bw'ayingira; tewali mmeeme etaali yeeteefuteefu kwewaayo buli kintu ekitakkiriziganya na kye ayagala eyinza kusuubira kumwaniriza. Omuntu ow'edda ateekwa okusuulibwa wabbali omuntu omuggya bw'aba wa kufuga. Naye byombi, okwambula n'okwambala, biteekwa okukolebwa lwa kukkiriza. Tewali kkubo lirala. Nga bwe ngezezzaako okunnyonnyola awalala, tuteekwa okuggya obuntu bwaffe, n'obwefaaza bwaffe, n'okwagala kwaffe mu ffe ne tubissa mu Kristo. Tuteekwa okwerowoozaako nga abafu eri ffe fennyini era abalamu eri Katonda yekka. Bwe mutyo nammwe mwerowoozeeko nga abafu eri ekibi era abalamu eri Katonda mu Kristo Yesu. Kale ekibi kireme okufuga mu mubiri gwammwe ogufa, ne kibaleetera okugondera okwegomba kwagwo. Temuwaayo bitundu byammwe eri ekibi ng'ebyokukozesa eby'obutali butuukirivu, wabula mwewaayo mmwe eri Katonda ng'abo abaggyibwa mu kufa ne baleetebwa mu bulamu, n'ebitundu byammwe eri Katonda ng'ebyokukozesa eby'obutuukirivu (Abaruumi 6:11-13). Okukkiriza okwo kwennyini okutusobozesa okukwata ku kusonyiyibwa kw'ebibi era kwe kuleeta okwegatta kuno ne Kristo. Eri abo abatategeera tteeka lya kukkiriza, kino awatali kubuusabuusa kijja kubeera kyama kinene nga bwe byali ebyama eby'amaanyi agasika ebintu wansi nga etteeka ery'okusikibwa wansi terinnazuulibwa. Naye eri abo abalitegeera, etteeka ery'okukkiriza likola awatali kukyamu era mu butuufu ng'etteeka ery'okusikibwa wansi, era livaamu ebibala byalyo mu butuufu bwe bumu. Tewali n'omu ayinza okusoma essuula ey'ekkumi n'emu ey'Abaebbulaniya n'alema okulaba nti okukkiriza ge maanyi agawangula byonna. Nze nzikiriza nti ge maanyi agatonda ensi yonna. Lye tteeka erya waggulu erifuga amateeka gonna aga wansi waalyo; ekyo ekirabika ng'ekyamagero mazima nkola ya tteeka lino erya waggulu erifuga. Okukkiriza, nga bwe ngamba, lye tteeka ery'obutonde: Olw'okukkiriza tutegeera nti ensi zonna zaatondebwa n'ekigambo kya Katonda, ekyo ekirabika ne kitakolebwa mu bintu ebirabika (Abaebbulaniya 11:3). Tubuulirwa nti Katonda yayogera ne kikolebwa, yalagira ne kinywera. Era Mukama waffe atugamba nti bwe tuba n'okukkiriza, tuyinza okukola bwe kityo: Yesu n'abaddamu nti, Mube n'okukkiriza mu Katonda. Ddala ddala mbagamba nti, buli agamba olusozi luno nti, Situlibwe, osuulibwe mu nnyanja, n'atabuusabuusa mu mutima gwe, wabula n'akkiriza nti ky'ayogera kijja kubaawo, alikikolerwa. Kyenva mbagamba nti, buli kye musaba mu kusaba, mukkirize nti mukifunye, era kiriba kyammwe (Makko 11:22-24). Okukkiriza, tubuulirwa, kuyita ebitaliiwo ne biba (Abaruumi 4:17). Olw'okubiyita, kubireeta mu bulamu. Kale, wadde nga tetuyinza kulaba kabonero konna ak'omubiri ak'enkyukakyuka nga olw'okukkiriza twambula omuntu ow'edda—ayonoonese ng'okwegomba okulimba bwe kuli—ne tulyoka twambala olw'okukkiriza omuntu omuggya—eyatondebwa ng'ekifaananyi kya Katonda mu butuukirivu obutuufu n'obutukuvu—wabula mu butuufu kikoleddwa. Okukkiriza kukituukirizza. Siyinza kunnyonnyola kino mu by'obwakabona, naye awatali kutya nsobola okukakasa nti mazima manene ag'omu bulamu. Emmeeme ezo ezirekera awo obulamu obw'okwefaako ne zeewaayo eri Mukama azitwaale ddala zizuula nti atwala ensulo ez'omunda ez'obulamu bwazo, era akola mu mmwe, okwagala n'okukola olw'okusiima kwe okulungi (Abafiripi 2:13). Paulo yasabira Abaefeso Kristo abeere mu mitima gyammwe olw'okukkiriza (Abaefeso 3:17), era kino kye kyama kyonna eky'okufuulibwa ekifaananyi kye. Kristo bw'aba abeera mu mutima gwange, kwe kugamba nteekwa okufaanana Kristo. Siyinza kuba atali wa kisa, ow'obusungu, eyeenoonyereza, oba atali mwesigwa; wabula, obukkakkamu bwe, obuwoomerevu bwe, okusaasira kwe okw'ekisa, n'okugonda kwe okw'okwagala eri Kitaawe by'ayagala biteekwa okweraga mu ntambula yange eya buli lunaku n'emboozi yange. Tetugenda kukyusibwa mu bujjuvu ne tufuuka ekifaananyi kya Kristo okutuusa lw'aliraga ne tumulaba nga bw'ali (1 Yokaana 3:2). Naye mu kiseera kino, ku kigero kyaffe ffennyini, obulamu bwa Yesu buteekwa okweraga mu mubiri gwaffe ogufa (2 Abakkolinso 4:11). Bweragibwa mu gwaffe? Tufuuliddwa nga tufaananyizibwa ekifaananyi kya Kristo abantu, nga batulaba, ne balaba akabonero ke era? Mukyala w'omusumba Omumesodisiti yaŋŋamba nti lumu, bwe baali baakajja mu kifo ekiggya, omwana we omuto yayingira oluvannyuma lw'olunaku lwe olusooka olw'okuzannya n'aleekaana n'essanyu nti, Owaŋŋe maama, nsanze omuwala omuto omulungi ennyo, omwenkanyi, ow'okuzannya naye wano n'okwagala siyagala kuddayo mu maaso. Nsanyuse nnyo, munnange, bwe yaddamu maama omwagazi, ng'asanyukira essanyu ly'omwana we; omuwala omuto ye ani erinnya? Owaŋŋe, omwana n'addamu mu kiseera kimu ng'akakkanye, ndowooza erinnya lye ye Yesu. Ki, Furanka! maama eyeewuunya n'aleekaana, otegeeza ki? Kale, maama, n'addamu ng'yeewolereza, yali mulungi nnyo nga siyinza kumanya erinnya lye eddala okuggyako Yesu. Obulamu bwaffe bufaanana Kristo bwe butyo omuntu yenna okusobola okutulowoozaako ekirowoozo ng'ekyo? Kya lwatu eri buli muntu atwetoolodde nti tubadde ne Yesu? Eky'ennaku, emirundi mingi si kya njawulo ddala? Abamu ku ffe si ba busungu era ba buzibu mu bulamu bwabwe nga kyandyogerwa ekya njawulo ddala ku ffe? Paulo agamba nti tuli ba kubeera ebbaluwa eva eri Kristo... etaawandiikibwa na bwino wabula n'Omwoyo wa Katonda omulamu, si ku bipande eby'amayinja wabula ku bipande eby'emitima gy'abantu (2 Abakkolinso 3:3). Nzikiriza ddala nti buli mwana wa Katonda, mu nsi yonna, singa yatandika okuva leero okubeera ebbaluwa eva eri Kristo, ng'abeera n'obulamu obufaanana ddala Kristo eka ne bweru, tewandiyiseewo mwezi ng'amakanisa gajjudde abantu abaagala okumanya ebisingawo, nga bajja okulaba eddiini ki eyandifudde bwe kityo obuntu ne bufuuka ekintu eky'obwakatonda. Ensi ejjudde abantu abatakkiriza mazima g'eddiini y'Ekikristaayo, era tewali kiribakkirizisa okuggyako ebituufu bye batayinza kuwakanya. Tuteekwa okubasisinkana n'obulamu obukyusibbwa. Bwe balaba nti edda twali ba busungu, kaakano tuli bawoomerevu; edda twali ba malala, kaakano tuli beetoowaze; edda twali beeraliikirivu, kaakano tuli bagumiikiriza era abateefu; era bwe tuba tusobola okukakasa nti y'eddiini ya Kristo evuddeko enkyukakyuka eno, tebayinza kwewala kukwatibwa. Omusajja Omukristaayo eyali afunye ettutumu ery'okutya Katonda olw'omulimu gwe omunyiikivu, eky'ennaku era yalina n'ettutumu ery'obusungu obubi n'olulimi olwogi. Naye ku nkomerero, olw'ensonga gye tewali n'omu eyayinza kutegeera, enkyukakyuka yalabika ng'emujjidde. Obusungu bwe n'olulimi lwe ne bifuuka ebiwoomerevu era ebikkakkamu nga bwe byali edda eby'obukambwe era ebyogi. Mikwano gye ne balaba ne beewuunya, era ku nkomerero omu ku bo n'amubuuza obanga yali akyusizza eddiini ye. Nedda, omusajja n'addamu, sikyusizza ddiini yange, wabula ku nkomerero nkkirizza eddiini yange okunkyusa. Eddiini yaffe etukyusizza wa? Kyangu nnyo okuba n'eddiini ey'omu kkanisa, eddiini ey'omu kukuŋŋaana okw'okusaba, oba eddiini ey'emirimu gy'Ekikristaayo, naye kintu kya njawulo ddala okuba n'eddiini eya buli lunaku. Okulaga okutya Katonda mu maka kye kimu ku bitundu ebisinga obukulu eby'Obukristaayo, naye era kya bulabe nnyo. Si kya bulijjo obutafuna Bakristaayo abakola obutuukirivu bwabwe mu maaso g'ab'ebweru balyoke balabibwe abantu, naye ababulwa nnyo okulaga okukkiriza kwabwe mu maka. Nnamanya lumu kitaawe w'abaana eyali ow'amaanyi nnyo mu kusaba mu kukuŋŋaana okwa buli wiiki era eyawuniikiriza nnyo mu kugumya bantu nga ekkanisa yonna yakwatibwa okutya Katonda kwe; naye bwe yaddayo eka oluvannyuma lw'enkuŋŋaana, yali munyiivu era mukambwe nnyo nga mukyala we n'ab'omu maka baali batya n'okwogera ekigambo mu maaso ge. Era bwe musaba, temubanga ng'abannanfuusi. Kubanga baagala okuyimirira ne basaba mu makuŋŋaaniro ne ku nsonda z'enguudo, balyoke balabibwe abantu. Ddala ddala mbagamba nti, bafunye empeera yaabwe (Matayo 6:5). Ebigambo bino, bafunye empeera yaabwe, bindabikira nga bimu ku bikakali ennyo mu Baibuli. Kye tukola tulyoke tulabibwe abantu kirabibwa abantu, era ekyo kwe kukoma. Tewali kufaanana Kristo mu butuukirivu obwa ngeri eyo. Obutuukirivu obufaanana Kristo bwe butuukirivu obugumira ebigezo ebya buli lunaku n'essanyu era obugumiikiriza wansi w'okusosonkerezebwa mu maka; obusasula obulungi olw'obubi era obusisinkana okukoonagana kwonna okw'obulamu obwa buli lunaku n'obuwoomerevu n'obukkakkamu. Bugumiikiriza era bwa kisa; okwagala tekukwatirwa buggya wadde okwenyumiriza; tekwegulumiza wadde okuba okw'ekyejo. Tekunoonya bibwo kwokka; tekusunguwala wadde okubiikira; tekusanyukira butali butuukirivu, wabula kusanyukira mazima. Okwagala kugumira byonna, kukkiriza byonna, kusuubira byonna, kugumiikiriza byonna (1 Abakkolinso 13:4-7). Kino kye kitegeeza okufaananyizibwa ekifaananyi kya Kristo! Tumanyiiko ku butuukirivu obufaanana buno? Oluusi twogera ku kutuukiriza kye tuyita emirimu gyaffe egy'eddiini, nga tutegeeza okuweereza mu kkanisa, ebiseera ebiteekeddwawo eby'okusinza, oba emirimu gy'Ekikristaayo. Tetulootako nti omulimu gwaffe ogw'eddiini gwa maanyi nnyo okusinga—okufaanana Kristo mu ntambula yaffe eya buli lunaku n'emboozi yaffe okusinga n'okuba abeesigwa mu bintu ebirala ebyo—wadde nga byegombebwa mu byo byennyini. Obutuukirivu bw'Abawandiisi n'Abafalisaayo bwali butuukirivu bwa bigambo n'ebigambo, n'obwa mikolo egy'obwedda; kino emirundi mingi kiwuniikiriza nnyo ab'ebweru. Naye, olw'okuba tekyali kirala, Mukama waffe akyenkanya n'ebigambo eby'amaanyi ennyo: Zibasanze mmwe, abawandiisi n'Abafalisaayo, bannanfuusi! Kubanga muwaayo ekimu eky'ekkumi ekya kaamintu, na diiri, na kamuni, ne muleka ebintu eby'etteeka ebisingako obuzito: obwenkanya, n'okusaasira, n'obwesigwa. Bino mwandibikoze, awatali kuleka birala. Zibasanze mmwe, abawandiisi n'Abafalisaayo, bannanfuusi! Kubanga muli ng'amalaalo agasiigiddwa engobozi eyeeru, ku bweru agalabika amalungi, naye munda gajjudde amagumba g'abafu n'obucaafu bwonna (Matayo 23:23, 27). Era ayongerako nti, Bwe mutyo nammwe ku bweru mulabika ng'abatuukirivu eri abantu, naye munda mujjudde obunnanfuusi n'obujeemu (Matayo 23:28). Kyangu nnyo okwogera ebintu ebirungi ku bulamu obw'eddiini, naye okuba mazima kye twogera nsonga ya njawulo ddala. Mmanyi omusomesa w'e Sunday School eyali ayigiriza abayizi be ennyo ku kusuula ebikweraliikiriza byonna ku Mukama n'okumwesiga mu biseera eby'okugezesebwa; baali bawuniikiridde nnyo. Naye ku nkomerero, akabi ne kajja mu bulamu bw'omusomesa ono, era abamu ku bayizi be ne bamulaba mu maka ge nga kikyaliwo. Mu kwewuunya kwabwe n'ennaku yaabwe, ne bamulaba ng'yeraliikirira, ng'atabusetabuse, ng'eeraliikirira, era ng'emulugunya; mu bufunze, ng'akola nga tewali Katonda wa kwesiga, oba ng'amakubo ge si makubo ga kwagala na bulungi. Kyali ekyokuyigirako eri abaana abo ekyayonoona obulungi bwonna okuyigiriza kw'omusomesa oyo okw'edda kwe kwali kulabika ng'okusobola okutuukiriza. Omu ku bo, eyali munyiikivu okwetegereza, yaŋŋamba n'obuwanguzi nti, Nnali ndowooza nti tekiyinza kuba kya mazima Muky'omuwala —— bw'atubuulira ku ngeri gye tuyinza okwesigamu Mukama mu buli kintu; ne kaakano ndaba nti kyali kwogera kwa kulaga bulungi kwokka, kubanga ye yennyini takikola. Omukristaayo omunyiivu, oba eyeeraliikirira, Omukristaayo eyaggwaamu amaanyi, ow'ennaku, Omukristaayo abuusabuusa, Omukristaayo eyeemulugunya, Omukristaayo asaba nnyo, Omukristaayo omwefaako, omukambwe, ow'omutima omukakanyavu, Omukristaayo eyeefaako yekka, Omukristaayo ow'olulimi olwogi oba ow'omwoyo omukaawu—mu bufunze, Omukristaayo atafaanana Kristo—kya kumwenkanya okubuulira empewo n'okubuulira ab'omu maka ge oba mikwano gye abamulaba nga bw'ali. Tewali kudduka tteeka lino ery'ebintu eritayinza kwewalibwa, era kirungi tulikkirize amangu. Bwe twagala abaagalwa baffe okwesiga Mukama, ebitabo by'okwogera ku kino tebijja kubakkirizisa n'akatundu kamu ku lukumi ng'okulaba obwesige obutono obwa mazima ku ludda lwaffe mu kiseera eky'obwetaavu bwe kuli. Okusaba okusinga obuwanvu n'okubuulira okusinga eddoboozi tebigasa mu maka gonna, ne bwe byandikoze bulungi ku katebe k'okubuulira, wabula nga waliwo okubeera mu bulamu okw'olwatu okw'ebyo ebibuulirwa. Abakristaayo abamu balabika ng'balowooza nti ebibala Baibuli by'esaba ngeri emu ey'emirimu gy'eddiini egy'okungulu, ng'okukuba enkuŋŋaana, okukyalira abaavu, oba okuddukanya ebitongole eby'obugabi. Naye, amazima ge nti Baibuli tebyawa buwa bino ng'ebibala eby'Omwoyo, wabula egamba nti ekibala ky'Omwoyo kwe kwagala, essanyu, emirembe, obugumiikiriza, ekisa, obulungi, obwesigwa, obuwombeefu, okwefuga (Abaggalatiya 5:22-23). Empisa efaanana Kristo eteekwa okuba ekibala ky'okubeeramu kwa Kristo. Ebintu ebirala awatali kubuusabuusa biriva ku mpisa eno; naye ekisooka era ekisinga obukulu ye mpisa, oba ebirala byonna bijja kuba bikoola bwokka. Omuwandiisi ow'omu biseera bino yagamba nti: Omuntu tayinza kuba kisukka ku ekyo empisa ze kye zimufuula. Omuntu tayinza kukola kisingawo wadde ekisinga obulungi okusinga okuwaayo oba okulaga ekyo empisa ze kye ziri. Tewali kya muwendo kiyinza kuva mu muntu ekitasooka kubaamu mu muntu. Empisa eteekwa okuyimirira emabega n'okuwagira buli kintu—okubuulira, olunyiriri lw'ennyimba, ekifaananyi, ekitabo. Tewali na kimu ku byo kya muwendo awatali yo. Okusobola okufaananyizibwa ekifaananyi kya Kristo, kya lubeerera tuteekwa okufuulibwa abagabanyi mu buntu bwa Katonda (2 Peetero 1:4). Era, bwe kiba bwe kityo, obuntu bwa Katonda obwo buteekwa okweraga. Ebitusanyusa, bye twegomba, n'ebigendererwa byaffe bijja kufaanana ebya Kristo; tujja kulaba ebintu okuyita mu maaso ge. Kino tekyewalika; kubanga obuntu bwa Katonda gye buli, ebibala byabwo tebiyinza kulema kweraga. Gye bitaba nga byeragidde, tuwalirizibwa okusalawo nti omuntu oyo, ne bw'aba alangirira atya n'eddoboozi, tannafuulibwa mugabanyi mu buntu bwa Katonda. Nsobola okuwulira omuntu ng'abuuza nti, Naye otegeeza ddala okugamba nti, okusobola okufuulibwa abagabanyi mu buntu bwa Katonda, tuteekwa okulekera awo okufuba kwaffe ffennyini kwonna? Tuteekwa kwambala Kristo lwa kukkiriza kwokka, ne tumuleka abeere mu ffe era akole mu ffe okwagala n'okukola olw'okusiima kwe okulungi? Era okkiriza nti olwo alikikola ddala? Ku kino nziramu n'amaanyi ennyo nti, yee, ntegeeza ekyo kyennyini. Ntegeeza nti bwe tweewaayo ffennyini eri ye ffenna, ajja n'abeera mu ffe era ye yennyini bwe bulamu bwaffe. Tuteekwa okuwaayo obulamu bwaffe bwonna eri ye: ebirowoozo byaffe, ebigambo byaffe, entambula yaffe eya buli lunaku, okutuula kwaffe n'okugolokoka kwaffe. Olw'okukkiriza tuteekwa okwewaayo ffennyini era, ka njogere bwe ntyo, okuyingira mu Kristo n'okubeera mu ye. Olw'okukkiriza tuteekwa okwambula omuntu ow'edda, era olw'okukkiriza tuteekwa okwambala omuntu omuggya. Olw'okukkiriza tuteekwa okwerowoozaako nga abafu eri ekibi era abalamu eri Katonda—nga abafu ddala nga bwe tuli abalamu. Olw'okukkiriza tuteekwa okutegeera nti obulamu bwaffe obwa buli lunaku ye Kristo abeera mu ffe; era, nga tulekera awo emirimu gyaffe ffennyini, tuteekwa okumuleka akole mu ffe okwagala n'okukola olw'okusiima kwe okulungi. Si mazima agamukwatako ge gateekwa okujjuza emitima gyaffe, wabula ye yennyini—Kristo omulamu, omwagazi, ow'ekitiibwa—alikola, bwe tumuleka, mu butuufu n'atufuula ekifo kye eky'okubeeramu. Alifuga era alifuga munda mu ffe era ateekere ebintu byonna wansi we (Abafiripi 3:21). Kale, omuntu yenna bw'aba mu Kristo, aba kitonde kiggya. Eby'edda biweddewo; laba, ebiggya bizze (2 Abakkolinso 5:17). Kyali si kigambo kya ngero busa Mukama waffe, mu Kubuulira okw'ekyewuunyo okw'oku Lusozi, bwe yagamba abayigirizwa be nti, Kale mmwe mube abatuukirivu, nga Kitammwe ali mu ggulu bw'ali omutuukirivu (Matayo 5:48). Yali ategeeza, mazima ddala, okusinziira ku busobozi bwaffe obw'obuntu, naye yali ategeeza amazima ago ag'okufaananyizibwa ekifaananyi kye kye twateekebwateekebwa. Era mu Bbaluwa eri Abaebbulaniya, tulagibwa engeri gye kiri okutuukirizibwa: Kale Katonda ow'emirembe eyakomyawo okuva mu bafu Mukama waffe Yesu, omusumba omukulu ow'endiga, olw'omusaayi ogw'endagaano etaggwaawo, abawe buli kintu ekirungi mulyoke mukole by'ayagala, ng'akola mu ffe ekyo ekimusanyusa mu maaso ge, ku bwa Yesu Kristo, ekitiibwa kibe gy'ali emirembe n'emirembe. Amiina (Abaebbulaniya 13:20-21). Kya kubeera lwa kukola kwe mu ffe, so si lwa kukola kwaffe mu ffennyini, ekigendererwa kya Katonda kino mu kututonda we kiri okutuukirizibwa. Bwe kirabika ng'abamu ku ffe baali ewala nnyo ku kufaanana kwonna Kristo enkyukakyuka nga eyo ne kiba nga teyinza kubaawo, tuteekwa okujjukira nti Omutonzi waffe tannamala kututonda. Olunaku lulituuka, bwe tutaamuziyiza, omulimu ogwatandika mu Olubereberye lwe gulimalirizibwa mu Okubikkulirwa, era ebitonde byonna, awamu naffe ffennyini, biryebulibwa okuva mu buddu bwabyo obw'okuvunda ne bifuna eddembe ery'ekitiibwa ery'abaana ba Katonda (Abaruumi 8:21). Kubanga tumanyi nti ebitonde byonna bibadde bisinda wamu mu bulumi obw'okuzaala okutuusa kaakano. So si bitonde byokka, wabula naffe ffennyini, abalina ebibala ebibereberye eby'Omwoyo, tusinda munda mwaffe nga tulindirira n'essuubi okuba abaana, okununulibwa kw'emibiri gyaffe (Abaruumi 8:22-23). Kigwana okuba nti ky'oyagala kye kikolebwa ku lwange? Oba kye njagala? Nange nfuulibwe ekintu, ekitali ng'ekikyo; ekyange, era ekijjudde obukuusa obusaddaakaza ennyo? Ndizaalibwa Katonda, oba omuntu obuntu? Mfuulibwe nga Kristo, oba ku nteekateeka endala? Singa omulimu gwo mu nze gusukka amagezi gange, nga musukkuluma nnyo, nga muwanvu nnyo okusinga bwe nnyinza okutegeera. Neesiga ddala. Weeyongere, Mukama, n'omulimu gwo omukulu! Sirina kumanya, magezi, kutegeera, wadde kirowoozo, wadde okutegeera okusaanira okukukakasa mu mulimu gwo, ai Ggwe Atuukiridde. Ontuusizza ku kino, era laba! ky'okoze siyinza kukiyita kirungi. Naye nsobola okukaaba nti: Ai omulabe, Omutonzi tannamala; olunaku lumu olilaba, era olw'okulaba oliddukira ddala.

fields.title: Katonda Amala
fields.body_html:
"Ggwe emmeeme yange, lindirira Katonda yekka mu kasirise; kubanga essuubi lyange liva gy'ali. Ye yekka lwe lwazi lwange n'obulokozi bwange, kye kigo kyange; siinyeenyezebwenga. Obulokozi bwange n'ekitiibwa kyange biri ku Katonda; olwazi lwange olw'amaanyi, obuddukiro bwange, ye Katonda" (Zabbuli 62:5-7).

Essomo ery'enkomerero era erisingira ddala obukulu emmeeme ly'erina okuyiga, ye nsonga eno nti Katonda, era Katonda yekka, y'amala ku byetaago byayo byonna. Lino lye ssomo nga byonna by'atukolamu bigenderera okutuyigiriza; era kuno kwe kuzuula okusinga byonna mu bulamu bwaffe bwonna obw'Ekikristaayo. KATONDA AMALA!

Mu kitabo kino tubadde tulowooza ku ngeri ezimu ez'empisa za Katonda n'amakubo ge, nga bwe zaatubikkulirwa mu Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo; era n'ensobi ezimu ezitulemesa okwenyweza obujjuvu obuli obwaffe mu ye. Kaakano nga tumaliriza, njagala nnyonnyole, nga bwe nsobola, ekyo kye ndaba ng'ekivaamu mu nsonga eyo yonna.

Bwe kiba nga Katonda bw'ali nga bw'alabika okuva mu bibikkulirwa bye tubadde tulowoozaako; bw'aba nga ddala ye "Katonda ow'okusanyusa kwonna," nga bwe tulabye; bw'aba nga ye Musumba waffe; bw'aba nga ddala era mu mazima ye Kitaffe; mu bufunze, bwe kiba nga engeri zonna ennyingi ze tubadde tuyiga ez'empisa ze n'amakubo ge nga za mazima ddala, kale tuteekwa, nga bwe kindabikira, okutuuka ku kukakasa okw'amaanyi nti ye yekka, mu ye yennyini, y'amala ku byetaago byaffe byonna ebiyinza okubaawo, era nti tuyinza okuwummulira mu ye n'obwesige obujjuvu emirembe gyonna.

Abakristaayo abasinga obungi, ndowooza, bayimbye emirundi mingi obutabala ebigambo bino eby'omu lumu ku nnyimba zaffe ezisinga okumanyibwa: "Ggwe, Ayi Kristo, gw'oyo gwe njagala yekka, ebisinga byonna mbisanga mu ggwe."

Naye nsuubira nti si ffe ffenna abasobola okwogera mu bwesimbu nti ebigambo ebyo bibaddemu amazima gonna mu bulamu bwaffe. Kristo tabadde kyonna kye twetaaga. Tubadde twetaaga ebintu bingi nnyo okumwongerako. Twetaaze okuwulira okw'amaanyi ku ye, oba okutegeera obulungi obw'okubeerawo kwe naffe, oba okubikkulirwa okw'omunda okw'okwagala kwe; oba twesombye enteekateeka ez'enjigiriza ennungi, oba omulimu gw'Ekikristaayo ogw'obuwanguzi, oba ekintu ekimu oba ekirala, awatali ye yennyini, ekituwa eddembe ery'okumusaba.

Kristo yekka, Kristo mwokka, awatali kwongerako yonna ku by'omanyi bye tulina ebimukwatako, tabadde atumala, newaakubadde nga tuyimba bwe tutyo; era n'okulaba tetulaba engeri gy'ayinza okutumalira.

Omuyimbi wa Zabbuli yayogera mu nnaku ziri edda nti, "Ggwe emmeeme yange, lindirira Katonda yekka mu kasirise; kubanga essuubi lyange liva gy'ali" (Zabbuli 62:5). Naye kaakano Omukristaayo agamba nti, "Emmeeme yange, lindirira enjigiriza zange entuufu, kubanga kwe nsuubira kuva mu zo;" oba nti, "Emmeeme yange, lindirira embeera zange ennungi n'okuwulira kwange, oba emirimu gyange emituukirivu, oba okusaba kwange okw'amaanyi, oba okufuba kwange okw'obunyiikivu, kubanga kwe nsuubira kuva mu bino." Okulindirira Katonda yekka kirabika ng'ekimu ku bintu ebisingira ddala obulabe bye bayinza okukola, era okusuubira kwabwe kuve mu ye yekka kiwulikika ng'okuzimba ku musenyu. Bagolola emikono ku buli ludda nga banoonya ekintu kye banaawaguliriza, era okutuusa nga byonna ebirala bibaggwaako we banaateeka obwesige bwabwe mu Katonda yekka. George Macdonald agamba nti: "Tutunuulira Katonda ng'obuddukiro bwaffe obw'enkomerero era obunafu ennyo. Tumugendako lwe tuba tetulina wandala we tugenda. Ate ne tuyiga nti embuyaga ez'obulamu tezituleese ku njazi, wabula mu mwalo gwe twali twegomba."

Tewali mmeeme eyinza okubeera mu kuwummula okwa nnamaddala okutuusa ng'evudde ku kwesiga ekintu kyonna ekirala era ng'ewalirizibbwa okwesiga Mukama yekka. Ng'okusuubira kwaffe bwe kukyava mu bintu ebirala, tewali kirala kitulindiridde okuggyako okwatiikirira. Embeera z'omutima n'okuwulira biyinza okukyuka, era bijja kukyuka ng'embeera zaffe bwe zikyuka; enjigiriza n'ennono biyinza okusuulibwa; omulimu gw'Ekikristaayo guyinza obutaakako kantu; okusaba kuyinza okulabika ng'okufiirwa amaanyi gaakwo; ebisuubizo biyinza okulabika ng'ebilemererwa; buli kintu kye twakkiririzaamu oba kye twesiga kiyinza okulabika nga kimalirwaawo, ne Katonda yekka n'asigalawo—Katonda yekka, Katonda mwereere, singa nkkirizibwa okwogera bwe ntyo; Katonda mwokka era yekka.

Oluusi tugamba nti, "Singa nnasangako ekisuubizo ekituukana n'embeera yange, olwo nnandiwummudde." Naye ebisuubizo biyinza okutegeerebwa obubi oba okukozesebwa obutali bwe kigwanidde, era mu kiseera kye tuba tweyambisizza obuzito bwaffe bwonna okwesigama ku byo, biyinza okulabika nga bitulemererwa ddala. Naye Oyo eyasuubiza, ali emabega w'ebisuubizo bye era asinga nnyo ebisuubizo bye, tayinza kulemererwa oba kukyuka. Omwana omuto tamwetaaga kufuna bisuubizo bya maama we okumusanyusa; alina maama we yennyini, era amumala. Maama we asinga ebisuubizo lukumi. Mu ndowooza yaffe esingira ddala obulungi ku kwagala oba omukwano, ebisuubizo tebiyingiramu. Omuntu omu ayinza okwagala okusuubiza, nga Mukama waffe bw'akola, naye omulala tabyetaaga; obuntu bw'oyo akwagala oba mukwano gwo businga ebisuubizo bye byonna. Era singa buli kisuubizo kisangulwa mu Baibuli, twandisigazza Katonda, era Katonda yanditumazizza. Nziramu okukyogera nti: Katonda yekka, ye yennyini, nga bw'ali, awatali kwongerako kintu kyonna ku ludda lwaffe—oba embeera z'omutima oba okuwulira, oba by'omanyi, oba emirimu emirungi, oba enjigiriza entuufu, oba ekintu ekirala kyonna eky'ebweru oba eky'omunda: "Ye yekka lwe lwazi lwange n'obulokozi bwange, kye kigo kyange; siinyeenyezebwenga" (Zabbuli 62:6).

Kino sikitegeeza nti tetusaanidde kubeera na kuwulira, oba by'omanyi, oba ebibikkulirwa, oba emirimu emirungi, oba enjigiriza entuufu. Tuyinza okubeera na bino byonna, naye biteekwa okuba ebivaamu okulokolebwa so si nsonga y'okulokolebwa; era tebiyinza kwesigibwa nga kya kulaga mbeera yaffe ey'omwoyo. Byonna bintu ebijja ne bigenda, era emirundi mingi biva ku mbeera y'obulamu bwaffe, oba ebituwetolodde, oba oluusi ne ku ludda embuyaga gy'ekunta. Abantu abamu, ng'ekyokulabirako, tebasobola kukkiriza nti Katonda abaagala embuyaga bw'ekunta okuva ebuvanjuba. Era bwe twesiga ekintu kyonna ku bino, ne katono katono, ng'omusingi gw'obwesige bwaffe oba essanyu lyaffe, ddala tujja kwesittala. Kye ntegeeza kwe kuti tuteekwa okwewala byonna awatali kwesigama ku byo n'akatono, nga tuwummulira mu nsonga ennene era ey'ekitiibwa nti Katonda gy'ali era nti ye Mulokozi waffe; nga tulina obulamu obw'omunda obukulaakulana bulungi era obuwangula awatali by'omanyi bino oba emirimu gyaffe nga bwe bukulaakulana nabyo. Tuteekwa okusanga Katonda—ekituufu nti Katonda gy'ali—nga akuma ku byetaago byaffe byonna eby'omwoyo, oba nga twewulira nga tuli mu ddungu oba mu kiwonvu ekigimu. Tuteekwa okwogera n'omunnabbi nti: "Newaakubadde nga omutiini teguttojjera, so tewali bibala ku mizabbibu, n'ekibala ky'omuzeyituuni ne kigwako, n'ennimiro ne zitaala mmere, ekisibo ne kisalibwako mu kiraalo, so nga tewali nte mu biraalo, kyokka nnaasanyukira Mukama; nnaajaguza mu Katonda ow'obulokozi bwange" (Kaabakuuku 3:17-18).

Emmeeme yakolerwa kino era teyinza kufuna kuwummula wabula mu kino. Noolwekyo, byonna Katonda by'atukolamu bikolebwa okutuusa ku ekyo; era emirundi mingi awalirizibwa okutuggyako essanyu mu buli kintu ekirala alyoke atuwalirize okusanga essanyu lyaffe mu ye yekka era mu ye yenna. Kiyinza okuba ekirungi, oboolyawo, okusanyukira ebisuubizo bye, oba okusanyukira ebibikkulirwa by'atuwadde, oba by'omanyi bye tufunye; naye okusanyukira Oyo eyasuubiza yennyini—ye yekka—awatali bisuubizo, oba by'omanyi, oba bibikkulirwa, kino kye ntikko y'obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo. Kino kye kifo kyokka gye tusobola okumanyira emirembe egy'ekitalo egisukka okutegeera kwonna era nga tewali kiyinza kugidiba.

Kizibu okunnyonnyola bulungi kye ntegeeza. Twemanyiiza nnyo okulowooza nti ebintu bino byonna ebiwerekera obulamu obw'omwoyo bwe bwo bulamu obw'omwoyo bwennyini, ne kituzibuwalira okwawukana nabyo. Tetusobola kulowooza nti Mukama ayinza kubeera kintu kyonna gye tuli okuggyako nga twesangamu ekintu ekitukakasa okwagala kwe n'okulabirira kwe. Era bwe twogera ku kusanga byonna mu ye, awatali kubuusabuusa tutegeeza nti tubisanga mu kuwulira kwaffe oba mu ndowooza zaffe ku ye. Ng'ekyokulabirako, bwe tuwulira okwagala okwaka gy'ali, olwo tusobola okwogera n'omutima gwaffe gwonna nti amala; naye okwaka kuno bwe kuggwaamu, nga mu kiseera kimu tekulwawo kukola bwe kutyo, olwo tetukyawulira nga tusanze byonna byaffe mu ye. Amazima gali nti ekitumazza si Mukama, wabula okuwulira kwaffe ku Mukama. Naye tetukimanyi; noolwekyo, okuwulira kwaffe bwe kuggwaamu, tulowooza nti Mukama y'atulemereddwa, ne tugwa mu kizikiza.

Mazima ddala, kino kyonna kya busirusiru nnyo, naye kya bulijjo nnyo mu bulamu bwaffe olw'ekyo abantu abatono nnyo be basobola okulaba obusirusiru bwakyo. Oboolyawo ekifaananyi kiyinza okutuyamba okulaba obulungi. Ka tulowooze ku musajja avunaanibwa omusango, ayimiridde mu maaso g'omulamuzi. Kiruwa ekyandibadde eky'omugaso eri omusajja oyo: okuwulira kwe eri omulamuzi, oba okuwulira kw'omulamuzi eri ye? Yandimaze ekiseera kye ng'akuuma ku nneewulira ze, ng'agezaako okulaba oba yeewulira nga omulamuzi amwagala, oba yandikuumye omulamuzi n'agezaako okuzuula okuva mu ndabika ye oba ebigambo bye oba yandisuubidde omusango omulungi oba nedda? Mazima ddala, twandyanguyiriza okwogera nti okuwulira kw'omusajja yennyini tekulina makulu na katono mu nsonga eno, era nti endowooza n'okuwulira kw'omulamuzi kwokka kwe kusaanira okulowoozebwako akaseera.

Omusajja ayinza okuba n'"okwaka" kwonna n'"okumanyako" kwonna okuyinza okulowoozebwa, naye bino tebyandibaddeeko mugaso na gumu. Buli kintu kyandyesigamye ku Mulamuzi yekka. Kino kye twandiyita amazima ageeyoleka gokka. Mu ngeri y'emu, bwe tunaakozesa amagezi gaffe amasaawe ku nsonga eno, tetuyinza butalaba nti ekintu ekituufu ddala mu nkolagana yaffe ne Mukama si kye tuwulira gy'ali, wabula ky'awulira gye tuli. Omusajja avunaanibwa ateekwa okusanga mu Mulamuzi byonna bye yeetaaga, bw'aba ng'ajja kubisangawo. Obumazi bwe tebuyinza kuva mu ye yennyini, wabula buteekwa okuva mu oyo omukisa gwe gwesigamye ku ye. Era obumazi bwaffe, Omutume bw'agamba, tebuva mu ffe ffennyini wabula buva mu Katonda.

"Si kubanga tumala ffe ffennyini okulowooza ku kintu kyonna nga kiva mu ffe, wabula obumazi bwaffe buva eri Katonda." (2 Abakkolinso 3:5) Kale kino kye ntegeeza nti Katonda amala. Kye kiti nti tusanga mu ye, mu kituufu nti gy'ali, era mu mpisa ze, byonna bye tuyinza okwetaaga eri buli kintu. Katonda ali, era ateekwa okuba, okuddamu kwaffe eri buli kibuuzo na buli kukaaba okw'obwetaavu. Bwe wabaawo ekibulako mu Oyo eyeetikka okutulokola, tewali kya kwongerako kye tuyinza okukola ekyandikimaze; era bwe wataba kibulako mu ye, kale ye, ye yennyini, era mu ye yennyini, amala.

Nnandyagadde kirage ng'ekisoboka okunnyonnyola amakulu gange, kubanga nzikiriza nti kye kyama ky'okununulibwa okw'olubeerera okuva mu buli kuteganyizibwa n'obutabeera na mirembe okw'obulamu bwonna obw'Ekikristaayo. Okuteganyizibwa kwo n'obutabeera na mirembe biva mu kufuba kwo okw'amaanyi naye okutaliimu kugasa okuteekawo omusingi omumativu ogw'obwesige munda mu ggwe wennyini; ng'ekyokulabirako, ekyo ky'olowooza okuba okuwulira okutuufu, oba omuwendo omutuufu ogw'obunyiikivu, oba wadde, bwe wataba kirala, omutindo ogumala ogw'okwegomba ebintu eby'omwoyo. Era olw'okuba nga tewali ku bintu bino ekyandimativu (era nkugamba nti, tekiimativu emirembe gyonna), tekisoboka bulamu bwo obw'eddiini kubeera kintu kirala okuggyako okutabeera na mirembe.

Naye bwe tulaba nti obulokozi bwaffe bwonna, okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero, bwesigamye ku Mukama yekka; era bwe tuba tuyize nti asobola era ayagala okutukolera "ebisukkiridde ennyo okusinga byonna bye tusaba oba bye tulowooza" (Abeefeso 3:20), olwo emirembe n'okusanyusa tebiyinza butalema kufuga. Buli kintu kyesigamye ku kiki, oba Mukama, mu ye era mu ye yennyini, amala okutulokola, oba ebintu ebirala biteekwa okwongerwako ku ludda lwaffe okumumaza.

Ekintu ekyanyamba nze kennyini, okusinga ekintu kyonna, okutuuka ku kukakasa nti Katonda ddala yali ammala, kyali kye nnayitamu emyaka egiwerako emabega. Kyali mu kiseera mu bulamu bwange obw'eddiini lwe nnali mpita mu kubuuza n'okutabulwa okungi, era bwe nnawulira nti tewali Mukristaayo eyali abaddeko n'ebizibu ebyenjawulo nga byange edda. Kyali nga waliwo omukyala eyali asula okumpi nange mu biro ebyo, okumala wiiki ntono, eyali ayitibwa Omukristaayo ow'omwoyo ennyo, era gwe nnali mbuuliriddwa okugendako okufuna obuyambi obw'omwoyo. Kyeyava, olunaku olumu olw'olweggulo, ne nfuna obuvumu, ne ŋŋenda okumulaba, ne mmufukira ebizibu byange; nga nsuubira nti ddala ajja kunfaako nnyo era anaafuba nnyo okukola kyonna ky'ayinza okunnyamba.

Yampuliriza n'obugumiikiriza, so teyansaliramu; naye bwe nnamala okwogera ebyange, era bwe nnasirika, nga nsuubira okusaasirwa n'okulowoozebwako, yagamba butereevu nti, "Yee, byonna by'oyogera biyinza okuba ebituufu ddala, naye wabula, newaakubadde ebyo byonna, waliwo Katonda." Ne nnindirira edda akaseera nga nsuubira ekirala, naye tewali kyajja, era mukwano gwange era omusomesa yalabika ng'ayogedde byonna ebyetaagisa.

"Naye," ne nnyongera, "mazima ddala tootegeera ng'ebizibu byange bwe biri eby'amaanyi era eby'okutabula." "Nedda, nnategeera," mukwano gwange n'anziramu, "naye wabula, nga bwe nkugamba, waliwo Katonda." Era saasobola kumuwaliriza kunziramu kigambo kirala kyonna. Kyandabikira nga kya kunnyiiza nnyo era ekitamativu. Nnawulira nti eby'enjawulo byange era mu mazima ebinnyamu ennyo tebiyinza kuddibwamu kintu kyangu bwe kityo, ekyali okwogera bwokka nti, "Yee, naye waliwo Katonda." Nnamanya nti Katonda gy'ali, mazima ddala, naye nnawulira nti nnali nneetaaga ekisingako ku Katonda yekka; era ne nfikako nti mukwano gwange, wadde nga yali ayatiikiridde nnyo ng'omusomesa ow'omwoyo, wabula teyasobola kumalako nsonga ey'enjawulo nga yange bwe yali.

Kyokka, obwetaavu bwange bwali bunene nnyo, ne siireka oluvannyuma lw'okugezaako okusooka, naye ne mmuddirako emirundi n'emirundi, buli kiseera nga nnina essuubi nti oluusi anaatandika okutegeera obukulu bw'ebizibu byange, era anampe obuyambi obumala. Kyali kya bwereere. Saasobola kuggya kuddamu kulala kwonna. Bulijjo eri buli kintu kyajjanga okuddamu okwangu, n'endabika ey'okuggyawo ddala ensonga, nti, "Yee, mmanyi; naye waliwo Katonda." Ate oluvannyuma, olw'okuddiŋŋana kwe okutasalako, ne nkakasibwa nti mukwano gwange ddala era mu mazima yakkiririza nti ekituufu ky'okubeerawo kwa Katonda kyokka, ng'Omutonzi era Omununuzi w'abantu, era nange ng'omu ku baabwe, kwali okuddamu okumala byonna eri buli bwetaavu bwonna obw'ebitonde bye. Ate oluvannyuma, olw'okukyogera emirundi mingi era ng'akakasa nnyo, ne ntandika mpolampola okwewuunya oba nga Katonda ayinza okuba ng'amala, ne ku bwetaavu bwange, wadde nga bwali bungi era eby'enjawulo nga bwe nnabuwulira. Okuva ku kwewuunya ne nziggwako mpolampola ku kukkiriza nti, ng'Omutonzi era Omununuzi wange, ateekwa okuba ng'amala; ate oluvannyuma okukakasa ne kunjjira nti ddala yali ammala, n'amaaso gange ne gazibuka ku kituufu eky'obumazi obujjuvu era obutuukiridde obwa Katonda.

Ebizibu byange ne bibula ng'eky'amagero, ne sikola kintu kirala okuggyako okwewuunya engeri gye nnali nsobodde okuteganyizibwa nabyo, ng'ekiseera kyonna waliwo Katonda, Katonda ow'amaanyi era alaba byonna, Katonda eyantonda, noolwekyo eyali ku ludda lwange, era eyayagala nnyo okundabirira n'okunyamba. Nnali nzudde nti Katonda ammala, era emmeeme yange n'ewummula.

Obumazi obujjuvu obwa Katonda busaanidde okuba obutuukiridde eri omwana wa Katonda nga bwe bumazi obujjuvu obwa maama omulungi bwe buli eri omwana we. Ffenna tumanyi okuwummula okujjuvu okw'omwana omuto mu maaso ga maama we ne mu kwagala kwa maama we. Okuba nga maama we gy'ali kimala okumalawo okutya kwonna n'okuteganyizibwa kwonna. Tekyetaagisa maama kusuubiza kintu; ye yennyini, nga bw'ali, awatali bisuubizo era awatali kunnyonnyola, ye byonna omwana by'ayetaaga. By'ennaayitamu ng'omwana byanjigiriza kino, awatali kubuusabuusa kwonna. Maama yali eddagala eri ebizibu byange byonna, era nnakkiririza ddala nti yali eddagala eri ebizibu by'ensi yonna, singa byonna byandireeteddwa gy'ali. Omuntu yenna bwe yalaga okubuusabuusa ku busobozi bwe okutereeza buli kimu, nzijukira n'obunyoomi obungi bwe nnabasirisanga nga njogera nti, "Ah! Naye tomanyi maama wange."

Era kaakano, omuntu yenna alwana bw'alemererwa okulaba nti Katonda amala, njagala kwogera, si na bunyoomi, wabula n'okusaasira okutakoma, nti, "Ah, mukwano gwange omwagalwa, tomanyi Katonda! Singa omumanyi, tewandirese kulaba nti ye ddagala eri buli bwetaavu bw'emmeeme yo, era nti ye ddagala erimala byonna." Katonda amala, wadde nga tewali kisuubizo kirabika ng'ekituukana n'embeera yo, era nga tewali kuwulira kw'omunda kukuwa bwesige. Oyo asuubiza asinga ebisuubizo bye; okubeerawo kwe kwe musingi ogw'obwesige omukakafu okusinga okuwulira okw'omunda okusingira ddala amaanyi.

"Ayi, yogera bwogezi erinnya lya Katonda, wansi ddala mu mitima gyo egy'omunda, olabe engeri emmeeme mu kaseera akatono gy'eva ku kutya kwonna okw'okweraliikirira."

Naye omuntu ayinza okwogera nti, "Kino kyonna, awatali kubuusabuusa, kya mazima, era nnandikikkirizza mangu singa nnandisobodde okukakasa nti kinkwatako. Naye siriimu mugaso era nzijjudde ekibi n'olwekyo siwulira ng'alina eddembe eri obugagga bw'ekisa obw'engeri eyo."

Okusingako, bw'oba nga toliimu mugaso era ng'ojjudde ekibi, olina eddembe ku bumazi obujjuvu obwa Katonda.

Obutaba na mugaso bwo n'ekibi kyo bye bikuwa eddembe erisingira ddala okwogera. Nga omuntu bwe yagamba, mwonoonyi yekka ayagala okulokolebwa y'ayimirira mu kkubo ly'Omulokozi. Baibuli egamba nti: "Ekigambo kyesigwa era kisaanira okukkirizibwa okujjuvu, nti Kristo Yesu yajja mu nsi okulokola aboonoonyi; be nsinga okuba omubi." (1 Timoseewo 1:15) Teyajja kulokola batuukirivu, oba abanyiikivu, oba abakozi ab'obunyiikivu, wabula okulokola aboonoonyi bokka. Kale lwaki twandimaze ekiseera n'amaanyi gaffe nga tugezaako okwekolera eddembe, eryoyo, oluvannyuma eritali ddembe, wabula ekiziyiza kyokka?

Ng'okussa essira kwaffe bwe kuli ku ffe ffennyini ne ku by'omanyi byaffe, kuba kuvudde ku Mukama. Kino ge magezi amasaawe. Nga bwe nnayogedde awalala, tusobola kulaba kintu kye tutunuulira kyokka, era nga tutunuulira ffe ffennyini, tetuyinza "kutunuulira Katonda." Si kubanga yeekweka; bulijjo gy'ali mu maaso ga bonna abamutunuulira. Naye bwe tuba nga tutunuulira eludda olulala, tetuyinza kusuubira kumulaba.

Emabega, kiyinza okuba nga amaaso gaffe gaali gasimbye nnyo ku ffe ffennyini era n'okwebuuza kwaffe kwonna okw'omunda kwali kwokka ku mbeera yaffe: Okwagala kwange eri Katonda kubuguma bumala? Ndi munyiikivu bumala? Okuwulira kwange gy'ali kuli nga bwe kusaanidde? Nnina obunyiikivu bumala? Nziyiwulira obwetaavu bwange nga bwe kisaanidde? Twabadde mu nnaku kubanga tetwasobola kuddamu bibuuzo bino mu ngeri emativu. Wadde nga tetukimanyi, kyali kisa nti tetwasobola kubiddamu mu ngeri emativu; kubanga singa twasobola, "nze" waffe yandigulumizibbwa, era twandijjudde okweyagala n'amalala.

Bwe twagala okulaba Katonda, okwebuuza kwaffe okw'omunda kuteekwa okuba ku ye, so si ku ffe ffennyini. Katonda anziyiwulira atya? Okwagala kwe eri nze kubuguma bumala? Alina obunyiikivu bumala? Ayiwulira obwetaavu bwange mu buziba obumala? Munyiikivu bumala? Wadde nga ebibuuzo bino biyinza okulabika ng'ebitassa kitiibwa eri abamu, biraga bwokka okubuusabuusa n'okutya okw'emitima mingi egyawukanawukana. Byetaaga kubuuzibwa kwokka okulaga nti okubuusabuusa n'okutya kuno kwe kutassa kitiibwa okwennyini. Ffenna tumanyi engeri okuddamu okw'obuwanguzi eri ebibuuzo ng'ebyo bwe kwandibadde. Tewandibadde kubuusabuusa kuyinza kugumira bujulizi bwakwo, era emmeeme ebuuza n'eddamu ebibuuzo bino mu bwesimbu ejja kutuusibwa ku kukakasa okw'amaanyi era okujjuvu nti Katonda ali, era ateekwa okuba, ng'amala.

"Ebintu byonna byammwe," Omutume bw'alangirira: "Oba Pawulo oba Apolo oba Keefa oba ensi oba obulamu oba okufa oba ebiriwo kaakano oba ebigenda okujja—byonna byammwe, nammwe muli ba Kristo, ne Kristo wa Katonda." (1 Abakkolinso 3:21–23) Tekyandisobose kigambo kyonna kubeera kya bugazi kusinga kino. Ebintu byonna byammwe kubanga muli ba Kristo—si kubanga muli balungi nnyo oba abasaanidde, wabula olw'obutereevu era olw'okuba muli ba Kristo. Ebintu byonna bye twetaaga bitundu ku busika bwaffe mu ye, era binaatulindirira okubiwangula. Ka ebyetaago byaffe n'ebizibu bibe binene batya, mu "bintu ebyo byonna" mulimu ebituweebwa "ebisukkiridde ennyo okusinga byonna bye tusaba oba bye tulowooza" (Abeefeso 3:20).

Kubanga gy'ali, buli kintu kiteekwa okutugendera bulungi. Kubanga maama gy'ali, buli kintu kiteekwa okugendera bulungi abaana be, okusinziira ku busobozi bwe; era kino kiteekwa okuba amazima ennyo okusinga eri Mukama.

Eri omwana, emabega w'ebyo byonna ebikyuka, waliwo ekituufu kimu ekitakyuka eky'okubeerawo kwa maama we. Ng'omwana bw'aba ng'omulamu, omwana ateekwa okulabirirwa; era Katonda bw'aba ng'omulamu, abaana be nabo bateekwa okulabirirwa. Kirala ki ky'ayinza okukola, ng'ali nga bw'ali? Okulagajjala, obutafaayo, okwerabira, n'obutamanya byonna tebisoboka gy'ali. Amanyi buli kimu, afaayo ku buli kimu, asobola okuddukanya buli kimu, era atwagala. Kiki ekirala kye twandisabye?

Abatukuvu ba Katonda mu mirembe gyonna baamanya kino era baategeera nti Katonda yali abamala. Yobu yagamba, okuva mu buziba bw'ennaku n'okugezesebwa abatono nnyo bye bayinza okwenkanankana nabyo: "Wadde nga annzita, nnaamwesiganga." (Yobu 13:15) Dawudi yasobola okwogera mu kiseera eky'ennaku ye esingira ddala okuluma: "Newaakubadde nga ntambulira mu kiwonvu eky'ekisiikirize eky'okufa, siritya kabi konna, kubanga ggwe oli nange; oluga lwo n'omuggo gwo bye binsanyusa." (Zabbuli 23:4) Era nate yasobola okwogera nti: "Katonda kye kiddukiro kyaffe n'amaanyi gaffe, omubeezi eyeyanguyiza mu kubonaabona. Kyetuva tutatya wadde ng'ensi ekyusibwa, wadde ng'ensozi zisitulibwa ne zisuulibwa mu makkati g'ennyanja, wadde ng'amazzi gaayo gawuluguma ne gabimba, wadde ng'ensozi zikankana olw'okuzimba kwago... Katonda ali wakati mu kyo; tekirinyeenyezebwa; Katonda anaakiyamba obudde nga bunaakya." (Zabbuli 46:1–3, 5) Pawulo yasobola okwogera n'obuwanguzi, wakati mu kugezesebwa okungi okuzito: "Kubanga nkakasa nti newaakubadde okufa newaakubadde obulamu, newaakubadde bamalayika newaakubadde abafuzi, newaakubadde ebiriwo kaakano newaakubadde ebigenda okujja, newaakubadde amaanyi, newaakubadde obugulumivu wadde obuwanvu, wadde ekintu kirala kyonna mu bitonde byonna, tekiriyinza kutwawula ku kwagala kwa Katonda okuli mu Kristo Yesu Mukama waffe." (Abaruumi 8:38–39) Noolwekyo, mmwe emitima gy'Abakristaayo egibuusabuusa era egiriko ennaku, mu kitangaala ky'ebyo byonna bye tuyize ebikwata ku Katonda ow'okusanyusa kwonna, temuyinza kutegeera nga Yobu, Dawudi, Pawulo, n'abatukuvu ab'emirembe gyonna, nti tewali kirala kyetaagisa okusirisa okutya kwammwe okuggyako kino: nti Katonda ali. Okubeerawo kwe okw'obwereere kwe kakalu konna obwetaavu bwammwe kwe bwetaaga eri obuyambi bwabwo obukakafu. Tewali kiyinza kubaawula ku kwagala kwe—ddala tewali. Buli mbeera eyinza okubaawo eteekeddwateekeddwa wano, era tewali n'emu ku zo eyinza okubaawula ku kwagala kwa Katonda okuli mu Kristo Yesu Mukama waffe.

Oluvannyuma lw'okulangirira ng'okuno, ani ku ffe ayinza okuvvuunuka okubuuza oba okubuusabuusa okwagala kwa Katonda? Era olw'okuba nga atwagala, tayinza kubaawo ate n'alemererwa okutuyamba. Tetumanyi olw'okwennyini kwaffe engeri okwagala bwe kuteekwa okufuka gyekka mu kuwa omukisa abo kwe kwagala? Tetusobola kutegeera nti Katonda, ali kwagala—ali, ka njogere bwe ntyo, akolebwa mu kwagala—atayinza butatuwa mukisa? Tetwetaaga kumwegayirira okutuwa omukisa; tayinza butakikola.

Noolwekyo Katonda amala; Katonda amala eri obulamu buno, era Katonda amala eri obulamu obutaggwaawo. KATONDA AMALA!

"Okutuula bwokka n'olowooza ku Katonda, Ayi essanyu nga bwe liri!

Okulowooza endowooza eyo, okussa Erinnya, Ensi teriiko ssanyu lisinga."

ENKOMERERO
fields.body_text: "Ggwe emmeeme yange, lindirira Katonda yekka mu kasirise; kubanga essuubi lyange liva gy'ali. Ye yekka lwe lwazi lwange n'obulokozi bwange, kye kigo kyange; siinyeenyezebwenga. Obulokozi bwange n'ekitiibwa kyange biri ku Katonda; olwazi lwange olw'amaanyi, obuddukiro bwange, ye Katonda" (Zabbuli 62:5-7). Essomo ery'enkomerero era erisingira ddala obukulu emmeeme ly'erina okuyiga, ye nsonga eno nti Katonda, era Katonda yekka, y'amala ku byetaago byayo byonna. Lino lye ssomo nga byonna by'atukolamu bigenderera okutuyigiriza; era kuno kwe kuzuula okusinga byonna mu bulamu bwaffe bwonna obw'Ekikristaayo. KATONDA AMALA! Mu kitabo kino tubadde tulowooza ku ngeri ezimu ez'empisa za Katonda n'amakubo ge, nga bwe zaatubikkulirwa mu Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo; era n'ensobi ezimu ezitulemesa okwenyweza obujjuvu obuli obwaffe mu ye. Kaakano nga tumaliriza, njagala nnyonnyole, nga bwe nsobola, ekyo kye ndaba ng'ekivaamu mu nsonga eyo yonna. Bwe kiba nga Katonda bw'ali nga bw'alabika okuva mu bibikkulirwa bye tubadde tulowoozaako; bw'aba nga ddala ye "Katonda ow'okusanyusa kwonna," nga bwe tulabye; bw'aba nga ye Musumba waffe; bw'aba nga ddala era mu mazima ye Kitaffe; mu bufunze, bwe kiba nga engeri zonna ennyingi ze tubadde tuyiga ez'empisa ze n'amakubo ge nga za mazima ddala, kale tuteekwa, nga bwe kindabikira, okutuuka ku kukakasa okw'amaanyi nti ye yekka, mu ye yennyini, y'amala ku byetaago byaffe byonna ebiyinza okubaawo, era nti tuyinza okuwummulira mu ye n'obwesige obujjuvu emirembe gyonna. Abakristaayo abasinga obungi, ndowooza, bayimbye emirundi mingi obutabala ebigambo bino eby'omu lumu ku nnyimba zaffe ezisinga okumanyibwa: "Ggwe, Ayi Kristo, gw'oyo gwe njagala yekka, ebisinga byonna mbisanga mu ggwe." Naye nsuubira nti si ffe ffenna abasobola okwogera mu bwesimbu nti ebigambo ebyo bibaddemu amazima gonna mu bulamu bwaffe. Kristo tabadde kyonna kye twetaaga. Tubadde twetaaga ebintu bingi nnyo okumwongerako. Twetaaze okuwulira okw'amaanyi ku ye, oba okutegeera obulungi obw'okubeerawo kwe naffe, oba okubikkulirwa okw'omunda okw'okwagala kwe; oba twesombye enteekateeka ez'enjigiriza ennungi, oba omulimu gw'Ekikristaayo ogw'obuwanguzi, oba ekintu ekimu oba ekirala, awatali ye yennyini, ekituwa eddembe ery'okumusaba. Kristo yekka, Kristo mwokka, awatali kwongerako yonna ku by'omanyi bye tulina ebimukwatako, tabadde atumala, newaakubadde nga tuyimba bwe tutyo; era n'okulaba tetulaba engeri gy'ayinza okutumalira. Omuyimbi wa Zabbuli yayogera mu nnaku ziri edda nti, "Ggwe emmeeme yange, lindirira Katonda yekka mu kasirise; kubanga essuubi lyange liva gy'ali" (Zabbuli 62:5). Naye kaakano Omukristaayo agamba nti, "Emmeeme yange, lindirira enjigiriza zange entuufu, kubanga kwe nsuubira kuva mu zo;" oba nti, "Emmeeme yange, lindirira embeera zange ennungi n'okuwulira kwange, oba emirimu gyange emituukirivu, oba okusaba kwange okw'amaanyi, oba okufuba kwange okw'obunyiikivu, kubanga kwe nsuubira kuva mu bino." Okulindirira Katonda yekka kirabika ng'ekimu ku bintu ebisingira ddala obulabe bye bayinza okukola, era okusuubira kwabwe kuve mu ye yekka kiwulikika ng'okuzimba ku musenyu. Bagolola emikono ku buli ludda nga banoonya ekintu kye banaawaguliriza, era okutuusa nga byonna ebirala bibaggwaako we banaateeka obwesige bwabwe mu Katonda yekka. George Macdonald agamba nti: "Tutunuulira Katonda ng'obuddukiro bwaffe obw'enkomerero era obunafu ennyo. Tumugendako lwe tuba tetulina wandala we tugenda. Ate ne tuyiga nti embuyaga ez'obulamu tezituleese ku njazi, wabula mu mwalo gwe twali twegomba." Tewali mmeeme eyinza okubeera mu kuwummula okwa nnamaddala okutuusa ng'evudde ku kwesiga ekintu kyonna ekirala era ng'ewalirizibbwa okwesiga Mukama yekka. Ng'okusuubira kwaffe bwe kukyava mu bintu ebirala, tewali kirala kitulindiridde okuggyako okwatiikirira. Embeera z'omutima n'okuwulira biyinza okukyuka, era bijja kukyuka ng'embeera zaffe bwe zikyuka; enjigiriza n'ennono biyinza okusuulibwa; omulimu gw'Ekikristaayo guyinza obutaakako kantu; okusaba kuyinza okulabika ng'okufiirwa amaanyi gaakwo; ebisuubizo biyinza okulabika ng'ebilemererwa; buli kintu kye twakkiririzaamu oba kye twesiga kiyinza okulabika nga kimalirwaawo, ne Katonda yekka n'asigalawo—Katonda yekka, Katonda mwereere, singa nkkirizibwa okwogera bwe ntyo; Katonda mwokka era yekka. Oluusi tugamba nti, "Singa nnasangako ekisuubizo ekituukana n'embeera yange, olwo nnandiwummudde." Naye ebisuubizo biyinza okutegeerebwa obubi oba okukozesebwa obutali bwe kigwanidde, era mu kiseera kye tuba tweyambisizza obuzito bwaffe bwonna okwesigama ku byo, biyinza okulabika nga bitulemererwa ddala. Naye Oyo eyasuubiza, ali emabega w'ebisuubizo bye era asinga nnyo ebisuubizo bye, tayinza kulemererwa oba kukyuka. Omwana omuto tamwetaaga kufuna bisuubizo bya maama we okumusanyusa; alina maama we yennyini, era amumala. Maama we asinga ebisuubizo lukumi. Mu ndowooza yaffe esingira ddala obulungi ku kwagala oba omukwano, ebisuubizo tebiyingiramu. Omuntu omu ayinza okwagala okusuubiza, nga Mukama waffe bw'akola, naye omulala tabyetaaga; obuntu bw'oyo akwagala oba mukwano gwo businga ebisuubizo bye byonna. Era singa buli kisuubizo kisangulwa mu Baibuli, twandisigazza Katonda, era Katonda yanditumazizza. Nziramu okukyogera nti: Katonda yekka, ye yennyini, nga bw'ali, awatali kwongerako kintu kyonna ku ludda lwaffe—oba embeera z'omutima oba okuwulira, oba by'omanyi, oba emirimu emirungi, oba enjigiriza entuufu, oba ekintu ekirala kyonna eky'ebweru oba eky'omunda: "Ye yekka lwe lwazi lwange n'obulokozi bwange, kye kigo kyange; siinyeenyezebwenga" (Zabbuli 62:6). Kino sikitegeeza nti tetusaanidde kubeera na kuwulira, oba by'omanyi, oba ebibikkulirwa, oba emirimu emirungi, oba enjigiriza entuufu. Tuyinza okubeera na bino byonna, naye biteekwa okuba ebivaamu okulokolebwa so si nsonga y'okulokolebwa; era tebiyinza kwesigibwa nga kya kulaga mbeera yaffe ey'omwoyo. Byonna bintu ebijja ne bigenda, era emirundi mingi biva ku mbeera y'obulamu bwaffe, oba ebituwetolodde, oba oluusi ne ku ludda embuyaga gy'ekunta. Abantu abamu, ng'ekyokulabirako, tebasobola kukkiriza nti Katonda abaagala embuyaga bw'ekunta okuva ebuvanjuba. Era bwe twesiga ekintu kyonna ku bino, ne katono katono, ng'omusingi gw'obwesige bwaffe oba essanyu lyaffe, ddala tujja kwesittala. Kye ntegeeza kwe kuti tuteekwa okwewala byonna awatali kwesigama ku byo n'akatono, nga tuwummulira mu nsonga ennene era ey'ekitiibwa nti Katonda gy'ali era nti ye Mulokozi waffe; nga tulina obulamu obw'omunda obukulaakulana bulungi era obuwangula awatali by'omanyi bino oba emirimu gyaffe nga bwe bukulaakulana nabyo. Tuteekwa okusanga Katonda—ekituufu nti Katonda gy'ali—nga akuma ku byetaago byaffe byonna eby'omwoyo, oba nga twewulira nga tuli mu ddungu oba mu kiwonvu ekigimu. Tuteekwa okwogera n'omunnabbi nti: "Newaakubadde nga omutiini teguttojjera, so tewali bibala ku mizabbibu, n'ekibala ky'omuzeyituuni ne kigwako, n'ennimiro ne zitaala mmere, ekisibo ne kisalibwako mu kiraalo, so nga tewali nte mu biraalo, kyokka nnaasanyukira Mukama; nnaajaguza mu Katonda ow'obulokozi bwange" (Kaabakuuku 3:17-18). Emmeeme yakolerwa kino era teyinza kufuna kuwummula wabula mu kino. Noolwekyo, byonna Katonda by'atukolamu bikolebwa okutuusa ku ekyo; era emirundi mingi awalirizibwa okutuggyako essanyu mu buli kintu ekirala alyoke atuwalirize okusanga essanyu lyaffe mu ye yekka era mu ye yenna. Kiyinza okuba ekirungi, oboolyawo, okusanyukira ebisuubizo bye, oba okusanyukira ebibikkulirwa by'atuwadde, oba by'omanyi bye tufunye; naye okusanyukira Oyo eyasuubiza yennyini—ye yekka—awatali bisuubizo, oba by'omanyi, oba bibikkulirwa, kino kye ntikko y'obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo. Kino kye kifo kyokka gye tusobola okumanyira emirembe egy'ekitalo egisukka okutegeera kwonna era nga tewali kiyinza kugidiba. Kizibu okunnyonnyola bulungi kye ntegeeza. Twemanyiiza nnyo okulowooza nti ebintu bino byonna ebiwerekera obulamu obw'omwoyo bwe bwo bulamu obw'omwoyo bwennyini, ne kituzibuwalira okwawukana nabyo. Tetusobola kulowooza nti Mukama ayinza kubeera kintu kyonna gye tuli okuggyako nga twesangamu ekintu ekitukakasa okwagala kwe n'okulabirira kwe. Era bwe twogera ku kusanga byonna mu ye, awatali kubuusabuusa tutegeeza nti tubisanga mu kuwulira kwaffe oba mu ndowooza zaffe ku ye. Ng'ekyokulabirako, bwe tuwulira okwagala okwaka gy'ali, olwo tusobola okwogera n'omutima gwaffe gwonna nti amala; naye okwaka kuno bwe kuggwaamu, nga mu kiseera kimu tekulwawo kukola bwe kutyo, olwo tetukyawulira nga tusanze byonna byaffe mu ye. Amazima gali nti ekitumazza si Mukama, wabula okuwulira kwaffe ku Mukama. Naye tetukimanyi; noolwekyo, okuwulira kwaffe bwe kuggwaamu, tulowooza nti Mukama y'atulemereddwa, ne tugwa mu kizikiza. Mazima ddala, kino kyonna kya busirusiru nnyo, naye kya bulijjo nnyo mu bulamu bwaffe olw'ekyo abantu abatono nnyo be basobola okulaba obusirusiru bwakyo. Oboolyawo ekifaananyi kiyinza okutuyamba okulaba obulungi. Ka tulowooze ku musajja avunaanibwa omusango, ayimiridde mu maaso g'omulamuzi. Kiruwa ekyandibadde eky'omugaso eri omusajja oyo: okuwulira kwe eri omulamuzi, oba okuwulira kw'omulamuzi eri ye? Yandimaze ekiseera kye ng'akuuma ku nneewulira ze, ng'agezaako okulaba oba yeewulira nga omulamuzi amwagala, oba yandikuumye omulamuzi n'agezaako okuzuula okuva mu ndabika ye oba ebigambo bye oba yandisuubidde omusango omulungi oba nedda? Mazima ddala, twandyanguyiriza okwogera nti okuwulira kw'omusajja yennyini tekulina makulu na katono mu nsonga eno, era nti endowooza n'okuwulira kw'omulamuzi kwokka kwe kusaanira okulowoozebwako akaseera. Omusajja ayinza okuba n'"okwaka" kwonna n'"okumanyako" kwonna okuyinza okulowoozebwa, naye bino tebyandibaddeeko mugaso na gumu. Buli kintu kyandyesigamye ku Mulamuzi yekka. Kino kye twandiyita amazima ageeyoleka gokka. Mu ngeri y'emu, bwe tunaakozesa amagezi gaffe amasaawe ku nsonga eno, tetuyinza butalaba nti ekintu ekituufu ddala mu nkolagana yaffe ne Mukama si kye tuwulira gy'ali, wabula ky'awulira gye tuli. Omusajja avunaanibwa ateekwa okusanga mu Mulamuzi byonna bye yeetaaga, bw'aba ng'ajja kubisangawo. Obumazi bwe tebuyinza kuva mu ye yennyini, wabula buteekwa okuva mu oyo omukisa gwe gwesigamye ku ye. Era obumazi bwaffe, Omutume bw'agamba, tebuva mu ffe ffennyini wabula buva mu Katonda. "Si kubanga tumala ffe ffennyini okulowooza ku kintu kyonna nga kiva mu ffe, wabula obumazi bwaffe buva eri Katonda." (2 Abakkolinso 3:5) Kale kino kye ntegeeza nti Katonda amala. Kye kiti nti tusanga mu ye, mu kituufu nti gy'ali, era mu mpisa ze, byonna bye tuyinza okwetaaga eri buli kintu. Katonda ali, era ateekwa okuba, okuddamu kwaffe eri buli kibuuzo na buli kukaaba okw'obwetaavu. Bwe wabaawo ekibulako mu Oyo eyeetikka okutulokola, tewali kya kwongerako kye tuyinza okukola ekyandikimaze; era bwe wataba kibulako mu ye, kale ye, ye yennyini, era mu ye yennyini, amala. Nnandyagadde kirage ng'ekisoboka okunnyonnyola amakulu gange, kubanga nzikiriza nti kye kyama ky'okununulibwa okw'olubeerera okuva mu buli kuteganyizibwa n'obutabeera na mirembe okw'obulamu bwonna obw'Ekikristaayo. Okuteganyizibwa kwo n'obutabeera na mirembe biva mu kufuba kwo okw'amaanyi naye okutaliimu kugasa okuteekawo omusingi omumativu ogw'obwesige munda mu ggwe wennyini; ng'ekyokulabirako, ekyo ky'olowooza okuba okuwulira okutuufu, oba omuwendo omutuufu ogw'obunyiikivu, oba wadde, bwe wataba kirala, omutindo ogumala ogw'okwegomba ebintu eby'omwoyo. Era olw'okuba nga tewali ku bintu bino ekyandimativu (era nkugamba nti, tekiimativu emirembe gyonna), tekisoboka bulamu bwo obw'eddiini kubeera kintu kirala okuggyako okutabeera na mirembe. Naye bwe tulaba nti obulokozi bwaffe bwonna, okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero, bwesigamye ku Mukama yekka; era bwe tuba tuyize nti asobola era ayagala okutukolera "ebisukkiridde ennyo okusinga byonna bye tusaba oba bye tulowooza" (Abeefeso 3:20), olwo emirembe n'okusanyusa tebiyinza butalema kufuga. Buli kintu kyesigamye ku kiki, oba Mukama, mu ye era mu ye yennyini, amala okutulokola, oba ebintu ebirala biteekwa okwongerwako ku ludda lwaffe okumumaza. Ekintu ekyanyamba nze kennyini, okusinga ekintu kyonna, okutuuka ku kukakasa nti Katonda ddala yali ammala, kyali kye nnayitamu emyaka egiwerako emabega. Kyali mu kiseera mu bulamu bwange obw'eddiini lwe nnali mpita mu kubuuza n'okutabulwa okungi, era bwe nnawulira nti tewali Mukristaayo eyali abaddeko n'ebizibu ebyenjawulo nga byange edda. Kyali nga waliwo omukyala eyali asula okumpi nange mu biro ebyo, okumala wiiki ntono, eyali ayitibwa Omukristaayo ow'omwoyo ennyo, era gwe nnali mbuuliriddwa okugendako okufuna obuyambi obw'omwoyo. Kyeyava, olunaku olumu olw'olweggulo, ne nfuna obuvumu, ne ŋŋenda okumulaba, ne mmufukira ebizibu byange; nga nsuubira nti ddala ajja kunfaako nnyo era anaafuba nnyo okukola kyonna ky'ayinza okunnyamba. Yampuliriza n'obugumiikiriza, so teyansaliramu; naye bwe nnamala okwogera ebyange, era bwe nnasirika, nga nsuubira okusaasirwa n'okulowoozebwako, yagamba butereevu nti, "Yee, byonna by'oyogera biyinza okuba ebituufu ddala, naye wabula, newaakubadde ebyo byonna, waliwo Katonda." Ne nnindirira edda akaseera nga nsuubira ekirala, naye tewali kyajja, era mukwano gwange era omusomesa yalabika ng'ayogedde byonna ebyetaagisa. "Naye," ne nnyongera, "mazima ddala tootegeera ng'ebizibu byange bwe biri eby'amaanyi era eby'okutabula." "Nedda, nnategeera," mukwano gwange n'anziramu, "naye wabula, nga bwe nkugamba, waliwo Katonda." Era saasobola kumuwaliriza kunziramu kigambo kirala kyonna. Kyandabikira nga kya kunnyiiza nnyo era ekitamativu. Nnawulira nti eby'enjawulo byange era mu mazima ebinnyamu ennyo tebiyinza kuddibwamu kintu kyangu bwe kityo, ekyali okwogera bwokka nti, "Yee, naye waliwo Katonda." Nnamanya nti Katonda gy'ali, mazima ddala, naye nnawulira nti nnali nneetaaga ekisingako ku Katonda yekka; era ne nfikako nti mukwano gwange, wadde nga yali ayatiikiridde nnyo ng'omusomesa ow'omwoyo, wabula teyasobola kumalako nsonga ey'enjawulo nga yange bwe yali. Kyokka, obwetaavu bwange bwali bunene nnyo, ne siireka oluvannyuma lw'okugezaako okusooka, naye ne mmuddirako emirundi n'emirundi, buli kiseera nga nnina essuubi nti oluusi anaatandika okutegeera obukulu bw'ebizibu byange, era anampe obuyambi obumala. Kyali kya bwereere. Saasobola kuggya kuddamu kulala kwonna. Bulijjo eri buli kintu kyajjanga okuddamu okwangu, n'endabika ey'okuggyawo ddala ensonga, nti, "Yee, mmanyi; naye waliwo Katonda." Ate oluvannyuma, olw'okuddiŋŋana kwe okutasalako, ne nkakasibwa nti mukwano gwange ddala era mu mazima yakkiririza nti ekituufu ky'okubeerawo kwa Katonda kyokka, ng'Omutonzi era Omununuzi w'abantu, era nange ng'omu ku baabwe, kwali okuddamu okumala byonna eri buli bwetaavu bwonna obw'ebitonde bye. Ate oluvannyuma, olw'okukyogera emirundi mingi era ng'akakasa nnyo, ne ntandika mpolampola okwewuunya oba nga Katonda ayinza okuba ng'amala, ne ku bwetaavu bwange, wadde nga bwali bungi era eby'enjawulo nga bwe nnabuwulira. Okuva ku kwewuunya ne nziggwako mpolampola ku kukkiriza nti, ng'Omutonzi era Omununuzi wange, ateekwa okuba ng'amala; ate oluvannyuma okukakasa ne kunjjira nti ddala yali ammala, n'amaaso gange ne gazibuka ku kituufu eky'obumazi obujjuvu era obutuukiridde obwa Katonda. Ebizibu byange ne bibula ng'eky'amagero, ne sikola kintu kirala okuggyako okwewuunya engeri gye nnali nsobodde okuteganyizibwa nabyo, ng'ekiseera kyonna waliwo Katonda, Katonda ow'amaanyi era alaba byonna, Katonda eyantonda, noolwekyo eyali ku ludda lwange, era eyayagala nnyo okundabirira n'okunyamba. Nnali nzudde nti Katonda ammala, era emmeeme yange n'ewummula. Obumazi obujjuvu obwa Katonda busaanidde okuba obutuukiridde eri omwana wa Katonda nga bwe bumazi obujjuvu obwa maama omulungi bwe buli eri omwana we. Ffenna tumanyi okuwummula okujjuvu okw'omwana omuto mu maaso ga maama we ne mu kwagala kwa maama we. Okuba nga maama we gy'ali kimala okumalawo okutya kwonna n'okuteganyizibwa kwonna. Tekyetaagisa maama kusuubiza kintu; ye yennyini, nga bw'ali, awatali bisuubizo era awatali kunnyonnyola, ye byonna omwana by'ayetaaga. By'ennaayitamu ng'omwana byanjigiriza kino, awatali kubuusabuusa kwonna. Maama yali eddagala eri ebizibu byange byonna, era nnakkiririza ddala nti yali eddagala eri ebizibu by'ensi yonna, singa byonna byandireeteddwa gy'ali. Omuntu yenna bwe yalaga okubuusabuusa ku busobozi bwe okutereeza buli kimu, nzijukira n'obunyoomi obungi bwe nnabasirisanga nga njogera nti, "Ah! Naye tomanyi maama wange." Era kaakano, omuntu yenna alwana bw'alemererwa okulaba nti Katonda amala, njagala kwogera, si na bunyoomi, wabula n'okusaasira okutakoma, nti, "Ah, mukwano gwange omwagalwa, tomanyi Katonda! Singa omumanyi, tewandirese kulaba nti ye ddagala eri buli bwetaavu bw'emmeeme yo, era nti ye ddagala erimala byonna." Katonda amala, wadde nga tewali kisuubizo kirabika ng'ekituukana n'embeera yo, era nga tewali kuwulira kw'omunda kukuwa bwesige. Oyo asuubiza asinga ebisuubizo bye; okubeerawo kwe kwe musingi ogw'obwesige omukakafu okusinga okuwulira okw'omunda okusingira ddala amaanyi. "Ayi, yogera bwogezi erinnya lya Katonda, wansi ddala mu mitima gyo egy'omunda, olabe engeri emmeeme mu kaseera akatono gy'eva ku kutya kwonna okw'okweraliikirira." Naye omuntu ayinza okwogera nti, "Kino kyonna, awatali kubuusabuusa, kya mazima, era nnandikikkirizza mangu singa nnandisobodde okukakasa nti kinkwatako. Naye siriimu mugaso era nzijjudde ekibi n'olwekyo siwulira ng'alina eddembe eri obugagga bw'ekisa obw'engeri eyo." Okusingako, bw'oba nga toliimu mugaso era ng'ojjudde ekibi, olina eddembe ku bumazi obujjuvu obwa Katonda. Obutaba na mugaso bwo n'ekibi kyo bye bikuwa eddembe erisingira ddala okwogera. Nga omuntu bwe yagamba, mwonoonyi yekka ayagala okulokolebwa y'ayimirira mu kkubo ly'Omulokozi. Baibuli egamba nti: "Ekigambo kyesigwa era kisaanira okukkirizibwa okujjuvu, nti Kristo Yesu yajja mu nsi okulokola aboonoonyi; be nsinga okuba omubi." (1 Timoseewo 1:15) Teyajja kulokola batuukirivu, oba abanyiikivu, oba abakozi ab'obunyiikivu, wabula okulokola aboonoonyi bokka. Kale lwaki twandimaze ekiseera n'amaanyi gaffe nga tugezaako okwekolera eddembe, eryoyo, oluvannyuma eritali ddembe, wabula ekiziyiza kyokka? Ng'okussa essira kwaffe bwe kuli ku ffe ffennyini ne ku by'omanyi byaffe, kuba kuvudde ku Mukama. Kino ge magezi amasaawe. Nga bwe nnayogedde awalala, tusobola kulaba kintu kye tutunuulira kyokka, era nga tutunuulira ffe ffennyini, tetuyinza "kutunuulira Katonda." Si kubanga yeekweka; bulijjo gy'ali mu maaso ga bonna abamutunuulira. Naye bwe tuba nga tutunuulira eludda olulala, tetuyinza kusuubira kumulaba. Emabega, kiyinza okuba nga amaaso gaffe gaali gasimbye nnyo ku ffe ffennyini era n'okwebuuza kwaffe kwonna okw'omunda kwali kwokka ku mbeera yaffe: Okwagala kwange eri Katonda kubuguma bumala? Ndi munyiikivu bumala? Okuwulira kwange gy'ali kuli nga bwe kusaanidde? Nnina obunyiikivu bumala? Nziyiwulira obwetaavu bwange nga bwe kisaanidde? Twabadde mu nnaku kubanga tetwasobola kuddamu bibuuzo bino mu ngeri emativu. Wadde nga tetukimanyi, kyali kisa nti tetwasobola kubiddamu mu ngeri emativu; kubanga singa twasobola, "nze" waffe yandigulumizibbwa, era twandijjudde okweyagala n'amalala. Bwe twagala okulaba Katonda, okwebuuza kwaffe okw'omunda kuteekwa okuba ku ye, so si ku ffe ffennyini. Katonda anziyiwulira atya? Okwagala kwe eri nze kubuguma bumala? Alina obunyiikivu bumala? Ayiwulira obwetaavu bwange mu buziba obumala? Munyiikivu bumala? Wadde nga ebibuuzo bino biyinza okulabika ng'ebitassa kitiibwa eri abamu, biraga bwokka okubuusabuusa n'okutya okw'emitima mingi egyawukanawukana. Byetaaga kubuuzibwa kwokka okulaga nti okubuusabuusa n'okutya kuno kwe kutassa kitiibwa okwennyini. Ffenna tumanyi engeri okuddamu okw'obuwanguzi eri ebibuuzo ng'ebyo bwe kwandibadde. Tewandibadde kubuusabuusa kuyinza kugumira bujulizi bwakwo, era emmeeme ebuuza n'eddamu ebibuuzo bino mu bwesimbu ejja kutuusibwa ku kukakasa okw'amaanyi era okujjuvu nti Katonda ali, era ateekwa okuba, ng'amala. "Ebintu byonna byammwe," Omutume bw'alangirira: "Oba Pawulo oba Apolo oba Keefa oba ensi oba obulamu oba okufa oba ebiriwo kaakano oba ebigenda okujja—byonna byammwe, nammwe muli ba Kristo, ne Kristo wa Katonda." (1 Abakkolinso 3:21–23) Tekyandisobose kigambo kyonna kubeera kya bugazi kusinga kino. Ebintu byonna byammwe kubanga muli ba Kristo—si kubanga muli balungi nnyo oba abasaanidde, wabula olw'obutereevu era olw'okuba muli ba Kristo. Ebintu byonna bye twetaaga bitundu ku busika bwaffe mu ye, era binaatulindirira okubiwangula. Ka ebyetaago byaffe n'ebizibu bibe binene batya, mu "bintu ebyo byonna" mulimu ebituweebwa "ebisukkiridde ennyo okusinga byonna bye tusaba oba bye tulowooza" (Abeefeso 3:20). Kubanga gy'ali, buli kintu kiteekwa okutugendera bulungi. Kubanga maama gy'ali, buli kintu kiteekwa okugendera bulungi abaana be, okusinziira ku busobozi bwe; era kino kiteekwa okuba amazima ennyo okusinga eri Mukama. Eri omwana, emabega w'ebyo byonna ebikyuka, waliwo ekituufu kimu ekitakyuka eky'okubeerawo kwa maama we. Ng'omwana bw'aba ng'omulamu, omwana ateekwa okulabirirwa; era Katonda bw'aba ng'omulamu, abaana be nabo bateekwa okulabirirwa. Kirala ki ky'ayinza okukola, ng'ali nga bw'ali? Okulagajjala, obutafaayo, okwerabira, n'obutamanya byonna tebisoboka gy'ali. Amanyi buli kimu, afaayo ku buli kimu, asobola okuddukanya buli kimu, era atwagala. Kiki ekirala kye twandisabye? Abatukuvu ba Katonda mu mirembe gyonna baamanya kino era baategeera nti Katonda yali abamala. Yobu yagamba, okuva mu buziba bw'ennaku n'okugezesebwa abatono nnyo bye bayinza okwenkanankana nabyo: "Wadde nga annzita, nnaamwesiganga." (Yobu 13:15) Dawudi yasobola okwogera mu kiseera eky'ennaku ye esingira ddala okuluma: "Newaakubadde nga ntambulira mu kiwonvu eky'ekisiikirize eky'okufa, siritya kabi konna, kubanga ggwe oli nange; oluga lwo n'omuggo gwo bye binsanyusa." (Zabbuli 23:4) Era nate yasobola okwogera nti: "Katonda kye kiddukiro kyaffe n'amaanyi gaffe, omubeezi eyeyanguyiza mu kubonaabona. Kyetuva tutatya wadde ng'ensi ekyusibwa, wadde ng'ensozi zisitulibwa ne zisuulibwa mu makkati g'ennyanja, wadde ng'amazzi gaayo gawuluguma ne gabimba, wadde ng'ensozi zikankana olw'okuzimba kwago... Katonda ali wakati mu kyo; tekirinyeenyezebwa; Katonda anaakiyamba obudde nga bunaakya." (Zabbuli 46:1–3, 5) Pawulo yasobola okwogera n'obuwanguzi, wakati mu kugezesebwa okungi okuzito: "Kubanga nkakasa nti newaakubadde okufa newaakubadde obulamu, newaakubadde bamalayika newaakubadde abafuzi, newaakubadde ebiriwo kaakano newaakubadde ebigenda okujja, newaakubadde amaanyi, newaakubadde obugulumivu wadde obuwanvu, wadde ekintu kirala kyonna mu bitonde byonna, tekiriyinza kutwawula ku kwagala kwa Katonda okuli mu Kristo Yesu Mukama waffe." (Abaruumi 8:38–39) Noolwekyo, mmwe emitima gy'Abakristaayo egibuusabuusa era egiriko ennaku, mu kitangaala ky'ebyo byonna bye tuyize ebikwata ku Katonda ow'okusanyusa kwonna, temuyinza kutegeera nga Yobu, Dawudi, Pawulo, n'abatukuvu ab'emirembe gyonna, nti tewali kirala kyetaagisa okusirisa okutya kwammwe okuggyako kino: nti Katonda ali. Okubeerawo kwe okw'obwereere kwe kakalu konna obwetaavu bwammwe kwe bwetaaga eri obuyambi bwabwo obukakafu. Tewali kiyinza kubaawula ku kwagala kwe—ddala tewali. Buli mbeera eyinza okubaawo eteekeddwateekeddwa wano, era tewali n'emu ku zo eyinza okubaawula ku kwagala kwa Katonda okuli mu Kristo Yesu Mukama waffe. Oluvannyuma lw'okulangirira ng'okuno, ani ku ffe ayinza okuvvuunuka okubuuza oba okubuusabuusa okwagala kwa Katonda? Era olw'okuba nga atwagala, tayinza kubaawo ate n'alemererwa okutuyamba. Tetumanyi olw'okwennyini kwaffe engeri okwagala bwe kuteekwa okufuka gyekka mu kuwa omukisa abo kwe kwagala? Tetusobola kutegeera nti Katonda, ali kwagala—ali, ka njogere bwe ntyo, akolebwa mu kwagala—atayinza butatuwa mukisa? Tetwetaaga kumwegayirira okutuwa omukisa; tayinza butakikola. Noolwekyo Katonda amala; Katonda amala eri obulamu buno, era Katonda amala eri obulamu obutaggwaawo. KATONDA AMALA! "Okutuula bwokka n'olowooza ku Katonda, Ayi essanyu nga bwe liri! Okulowooza endowooza eyo, okussa Erinnya, Ensi teriiko ssanyu lisinga." ENKOMERERO
